title: nBMS, a Neuromorphic Battery Management System with a Silicon-Validated Spiking State-of-Charge Core for eVTOL Aircraft
summary: State-of-charge (SoC) estimation for electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) aircraft must run on the vehicle under hard energy and certification budgets, on a duty cycle unlike anything in the automotive literature. In this study an event-driven spiking network, the state-estimation core of the nBMS neuromorphic battery management architecture, is designed for per-timestep SoC estimation and evaluated on a public 22-cell eVTOL dataset with an automotive cross-check. A delta and population encoder, a second-order sigma-delta spiking layer, and a rate-accumulator readout hold 34{,}433 int16 parameters with zero dense multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations. The estimator reaches 2.45\% root-mean-square error (RMSE) against 1.74\% for a tuned long short-term memory (LSTM) baseline, a gap characterized as a temporal-mixing limit in cruise; in exchange it degrades 1.6 times slower than an adaptive leaky integrate-and-fire control under sensor noise and needs roughly 3{,}500 additions per step where the LSTM needs 67{,}700 multiply-accumulates. The full core is deployed on a low-cost automotive-qualified Artix-7 field-programmable gate array at 87\% block-RAM utilization, meets timing at 50~MHz, and reproduces the frozen fixed-point reference bit-exactly over a real 491-step flight segment on silicon. Fully annotated post-implementation analysis gives 1.30~$μ$J per inference, an average of 0.65~$μ$W at the 0.5~Hz mission cadence.

AI.tldr: 本文是 nBMS 神经形态电池管理架构中状态估计核心的事件驱动脉冲网络，用 34,433 个 int16 参数、零稠密 MAC 实现 eVTOL 逐时间步 SoC 估计，精度 2.45% RMSE（LSTM 基线 1.74%），但抗噪退化速度慢 1.6 倍、每步仅约 3,500 次加法，并已部署到 Artix-7 FPGA 实现位精确复现与超低功耗。
AI.motivation: eVTOL 飞行器的 SoC 估计必须在严苛的能耗与适航认证预算下机载运行，其工作占空比与汽车场景截然不同，传统高算力模型难以满足。论文旨在为神经形态 BMS 提供一个低功耗、低算力、可认证且在传感器噪声下鲁棒的状态估计核心，并借助公开 eVTOL 数据集验证其与汽车场景的差异。
AI.method: 提出全事件驱动的脉冲网络状态估计核心：(1) delta 与 population 编码器将电池信号转为稀疏脉冲；(2) 二阶 sigma-delta 脉冲层完成时间维上的脉冲调制；(3) rate-accumulator 读出层输出 SoC。整个网络仅 34,433 个 int16 参数，且完全不含稠密乘法累加（zero dense MAC），计算退化为纯加法；对比基线为调优的 LSTM，并设置自适应 leaky integrate-and-fire 控制作为抗噪参照。实现层面采用定点冻结参考设计与 FPGA 部署，并进行完整的 post-implementation 功耗分析。
AI.result: 在公开 22-cell eVTOL 数据集上（并做汽车场景交叉验证）评估：估计器 RMSE 为 2.45%，调优 LSTM 为 1.74%，差距被归因于巡航阶段的 temporal-mixing 限制。作为代价，在传感器噪声下其性能退化速度比自适应 LIF 控制慢 1.6 倍；每步约需 3,500 次加法，而 LSTM 需 67,700 次乘累加。核心部署于低成本车规级 Artix-7 FPGA，块 RAM 利用率 87%，50 MHz 时序收敛，并在真实 491 步飞行片段上于硅片位精确复现冻结定点参考。实现后分析给出每次推理 1.30 μJ、在 0.5 Hz 任务节奏下平均 0.65 μW。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献在于为 eVTOL 电池管理提出零 MAC、全加法的事件驱动脉冲 SoC 估计核心，并以 FPGA 实测给出位精确、超低功耗的硬件证据（1.30 μJ/次、0.65 μW），显著降低算力与能耗需求。局限在于精度落后于调优 LSTM（2.45% vs 1.74%），巡航段存在时间混合限制，且仅用 22-cell 公开数据集验证，抗噪虽退化更慢但绝对精度未超越基线。

title: Early-Stopping Thresholds for ES-HyperNEAT: A Data-Driven Approach from Fitness Dynamics
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 9 tables. Accepted version of a paper published at the 2026 IEEE Congress on Evolutionary Computation (CEC), part of the IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI 2026), Maastricht, Netherlands, 21-26 June 2026. (c) 2026 IEEE
summary: Most hyperparameter configurations for Evolvable-Substrate HyperNEAT (ES-HyperNEAT) produce networks that stagnate at random-guessing performance, wasting computational resources. We frame early stopping as binary classification on early fitness trajectories: for each trial, we compute the cumulative median of best-per-generation fitness and test it against a threshold derived by maximizing the F1 score on an initial 90-trial dataset. The resulting rule (generation G* = 3, threshold T* = 0.140) achieves F1 = 0.872 on 180 independent validation trials, retaining over 90% of successful trials while cutting computational cost by 41.6%. Compared to Hyperband, our domain-specific rule is 64% more efficient with higher mean fitness, though Hyperband occasionally discovers higher peak solutions. On a converged search population the rule becomes too aggressive (recall 31.1%), motivating adaptive thresholds. The specific thresholds are ES-HyperNEAT-specific, but the methodology, deriving stopping criteria from fitness dynamics classification, is applicable to other evolutionary algorithms with stagnation-prone hyperparameter spaces.

AI.tldr: 该论文将ES-HyperNEAT中"是否应提前终止"问题重构为对早期适应度轨迹的二分类任务，通过F1最大化导出一个固定停止规则（G*=3, T*=0.140），在保留绝大多数成功试验的同时降低约41.6%计算成本。
AI.motivation: Evolvable-Substrate HyperNEAT（ES-HyperNEAT）的超参数搜索空间中，大多数配置产生的网络停滞在随机猜测水平的性能，却仍消耗大量计算资源。传统的早停/资源分配方法（如Hyperband）是通用领域的，未针对该算法的适应度动态特点进行定制。因此作者希望利用早期适应度信号自动判断某次试验是否会失败，从而尽早终止无效搜索，节省算力，这一"基于适应度动态预测失败"的思路也与事件/稀疏感知中强调的早期信号利用和高效计算理念相通。
AI.method: 论文把早停建模为二元分类：对每次试验计算best-per-generation适应度的累积中位数，并将其与一个由初始90次试验数据上最大化F1得到的阈值进行比较。最终得到规则：在第G*=3代、阈值T*=0.140时判断是否终止。方法本身是一个领域特定、基于适应度轨迹动态的停止判据，而非通用资源分配调度；作者也强调该阈值是针对ES-HyperNEAT特定的，但"从适应度动态分类中导出停止准则"的方法论可迁移到其他易停滞的进化算法。
AI.result: 在180次独立验证试验上，该规则取得F1=0.872，保留超过90%的成功试验，同时将计算成本降低41.6%。与Hyperband相比，该领域特定规则效率高出64%且平均适应度更高，但Hyperband偶尔能发现更高的峰值解。此外，在一个已收敛的搜索群体上，该规则变得过于激进，召回率降至31.1%，说明固定阈值在搜索后期失效，需要自适应阈值。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出将进化算法的早停问题形式化为适应度动态二分类，并针对ES-HyperNEAT导出一个实证有效的高效停止规则，兼顾成功试验保留率与计算节省，且方法论具备可迁移性。局限在于阈值高度依赖具体算法与搜索阶段，在收敛群体上召回率显著下降，需引入自适应阈值；与通用方法相比可能牺牲发现更高峰值解的能力。

title: Surrogate-Assisted Genetic Programming with Phenotypic Characterisation in Dynamic Multi-Mode Project Scheduling
summary: Dynamic multi-mode resource-constrained project scheduling requires decisions to be made under precedence constraints, limited resources, multiple execution modes, and uncertain activity durations. Genetic programming (GP) can automatically evolve heuristic rules for such problems, but its simulation-based fitness evaluation is computationally expensive. This study investigates phenotypic characterisation (PC) in surrogate-assisted GP to evolve higher-quality scheduling heuristics under a fixed budget of full simulation-based fitness evaluations. A key question is how GP individuals should be encoded into phenotypic characterisations to support effective fitness estimation. To answer this question, three PC encoding schemes with different levels of information richness are designed: priority-value encoding, which preserves raw rule outputs; rank encoding, which captures candidate ordering; and binary encoding, which represents final scheduling decisions. These encodings are combined with different distance metrics to measure behavioural similarity between GP individuals. The experimental results show that binary encoding with Euclidean distance provides the most effective and robust surrogate guidance. Further analyses show that surrogate estimation accuracy alone does not fully explain the performance differences. The PC representation also determines how effectively phenotypically redundant offspring are removed and how much behavioural diversity is retained after preselection. Ablation experiments further demonstrate that duplicate removal and surrogate preselection provide complementary benefits, with their combination producing the largest improvement. These findings highlight that effective surrogate-assisted GP depends not only on identifying promising offspring, but also on controlling redundancy and preserving useful diversity during evolutionary search.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在资源受限多模式项目调度问题（MRCPSP）中，如何为代理辅助遗传规划（surrogate-assisted GP）设计表型特征（phenotypic characterisation, PC）编码方案，以在固定真实适应度评估预算下演化出更优的调度启发式规则。核心结论是：二值编码配合欧氏距离在代理引导中最有效且鲁棒，且代理的有效性不仅取决于估计精度，还取决于其在预选择中去除表型冗余、保留行为多样性的能力。
AI.motivation: 动态多模式资源受限项目调度需在紧前约束、有限资源、多执行模式和不确定工期下做决策，属复杂组合优化问题。遗传规划可自动演化调度启发式规则，但其基于仿真的适应度评估计算代价高昂，限制了可评估个体数量。代理辅助（surrogate-assisted）方法通过代理模型估计适应度以减少真实仿真开销，但如何将GP个体编码为表型特征以支持有效的适应度估计，此前缺乏系统研究。该问题的核心动机在于：在评估预算受限时，代理能否既识别有潜力的子代，又能维持演化搜索的多样性与冗余控制。
AI.method: 论文在代理辅助GP框架下，将关注点放在表型特征（PC）编码与相似性度量的设计上，提出三种信息丰富度不同的PC编码方案：(1) 优先级值编码（priority-value encoding），保留规则的原始输出值；(2) 排序编码（rank encoding），捕捉候选活动的排序信息；(3) 二值编码（binary encoding），表示最终调度决策。这些编码配合不同的距离度量来衡量GP个体之间的行为相似性，用于代理模型的构建与预设（surrogate pre)选择。方法论重点是"如何编码个体表型以支持适应度估计"这一问题，并通过编码×距离度量组合的系统对比寻找最有效配置。此外，方法包含冗余去除（duplicate removal）与代理预选择两种机制及其组合的消融设计。
AI.result: 实验采用固定预算的真实仿真适应度评估设定，对比三种PC编码与多种距离度量的组合。结果表明：二值编码结合欧氏距离（Euclidean distance）提供最有效且最鲁棒的代理引导。进一步分析显示，代理估计精度本身并不能完全解释不同PC配置间的性能差异；PC表示还决定了预选择后表型冗余子代被剔除的程度以及行为多样性的保留量。消融实验表明，重复个体去除与代理预选择具有互补性，二者结合带来最大性能提升。论文未在摘要中给出具体数据集名称、指标数值或对比基线名称（摘要层面未披露）。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于系统揭示了PC编码方案对代理辅助GP演化调度启发式的关键影响，并指出二值+欧氏距离为最优配置。其更重要的洞察是：有效的代理辅助GP不仅依赖识别有前途的子代（估计精度），还依赖对冗余的控制与有用多样性的保留，这一双重作用由PC表示所决定。意义在于为评估预算受限的自动启发式设计提供更明确的表示层设计指导。局限方面（据摘要推断）：研究限定于MRCPSP这一特定问题域，未说明是否可推广至其他调度或组合优化问题；摘要未提供具体实验规模、基线对比与统计显著性证据。

title: A Memristive Synapse for Online STDP Learning and Inference in SNNs
comment: Accepted at 2026 IEEE 33rd International Conference on Electronics, Circuits and Systems (ICECS)
summary:
This work presents a fully analog memristive synaptic circuit for online spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP) learning in spiking neural networks (SNNs). The proposed synapse integrates a local STDP circuit generating gradual timing-dependent conductance updates directly from pre- and post-synaptic spikes. Learning occurs during normal network operation without requiring external digital control or explicit STDP waveform synthesis.
  Post-layout simulations of the memristive synapse implemented in a 130 nm CMOS technology show spike-timing-dependent conductance adaptation during SNN operation. A 2x2 SNN simulation further illustrates online neuron specialization through unsupervised learning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种全模拟忆阻突触电路，能够在脉冲神经网络（SNN）正常运行过程中实现在线脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP）学习，无需外部数字控制或显式STDP波形合成。
AI.motivation: STDP是SNN中重要的无监督学习机制，但传统实现通常依赖外部数字逻辑或专门的波形发生器来合成STDP时序窗口，这增加了电路复杂度、功耗与面积开销，并难以在真实网络运行中同步完成学习。因此需要一种能够直接从突触前后脉冲中本地生成突触权重更新的模拟硬件方案，从而支持真正的在线、原位学习。
AI.method: 该工作设计了一种全模拟忆阻突触电路，将忆阻器与本地STDP电路集成。该电路直接从突触前和突触后脉冲生成渐进式的、时序依赖的电导更新，无需显式合成STDP波形，也不需要外部数字控制。学习在网络正常运行时自然发生，突触权重随脉冲时间关系自适应调整。电路在130 nm CMOS工艺下完成设计并进行了后布局（post-layout）仿真验证。
AI.result: 在130 nm CMOS工艺下的后布局仿真显示，忆阻突触在SNN运行过程中能够实现脉冲时序依赖的电导自适应。作者进一步构建了一个2×2 SNN进行仿真，结果表明该电路可通过无监督学习实现神经元的在线特化（neuron specialization）。评估主要基于后布局仿真层面的电导变化与网络行为，未见真实芯片流片测试。
AI.conclusion: 该工作的主要贡献是提出了一种可在线进行STDP学习的全模拟忆阻突触电路，避免了外部数字控制与STDP波形合成，简化了硬件实现并契合SNN的原位学习需求。意义在于为神经形态硬件的低开销、在线无监督学习提供了可行的模拟电路方案。局限在于验证仍停留在130 nm CMOS后布局仿真和仅2×2规模的小型SNN，尚未进行硅后（silicon）实测与更大规模网络的验证。

title: Seeing What the Vehicle Sees: Video-Augmented Virtual Reality for Physical Autonomous Vehicles
summary: Autonomous vehicles are expected to improve road safety and efficiency, but passengers often remain uncertain about what the vehicle perceives and why it acts as it does. Virtual reality (VR) offers a safe and repeatable medium for presenting this information, yet most passenger-facing VR studies rely on fully simulated vehicles or pre-scripted scenarios, so the motion and perception shown to the user do not originate from a physically operating autonomous system. This paper presents a video-augmented VR framework that couples a physical ROS 2 autonomous robot vehicle to a Unity 6 application deployed on a Meta Quest 3S headset. The vehicle state and live onboard camera stream are transmitted over two independent communication channels, allowing the virtual vehicle to mirror the physical robot's motion while the passenger simultaneously views the vehicle's first-person camera feed and its navigation decisions through an in-vehicle dashboard interface. We evaluate the framework over 20 repeated closed-loop navigation trials. The system achieves a mean state-update latency of 29.63 ms, a mean relative route-progress error of 2.28% between the physical and virtual vehicles, and video delivery at 10.006 frames per second with 0.25% frame loss. All monitored navigation decisions were correctly reflected in the VR interface with no missed or incorrect notifications. The results indicate that the framework can support temporally synchronized, semantically consistent, and accurate route-progress representation for immersive observation of physical autonomous-vehicle behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个视频增强的VR框架，将真实ROS 2自主机器人车辆与部署在Meta Quest 3S上的Unity 6应用耦合，通过两条独立通信信道同步传输车辆状态与实时车载摄像头视频流，实现乘客对物理自动驾驶车辆感知与决策过程的沉浸式观察。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶虽有望提升道路安全与效率，但乘客往往对车辆感知到什么、为何做出某种动作缺乏理解，影响信任与乘坐体验。VR提供了安全、可重复的信息呈现媒介，但现有面向乘客的VR研究多依赖全仿真车辆或预编脚本场景，所展示的运动与感知并非来自真实运行的自动驾驶系统，因而缺乏物理真实性。作者希望弥合这一差距，让乘客观察到的虚拟表现真实源自物理运行中的自主系统，从而支持对自动驾驶行为的人类理解与信任研究。
AI.method: 框架将物理ROS 2自主机器人车辆与Unity 6应用（运行于Meta Quest 3S头显）耦合，采用双通道独立通信：一路传输车辆状态（位姿/运动），使虚拟车辆实时镜像物理机器人的运动；另一路传输车载实时摄像头视频流。乘客在VR中同时观看车辆第一人称相机画面，并通过车内仪表盘界面查看导航决策信息。系统在闭环导航条件下运行，强调时间同步、语义一致与路线进度的一致性表示。
AI.result: 作者进行了20次重复的闭环导航试验评估。系统平均状态更新延迟为29.63 ms；物理车辆与虚拟车辆之间的平均相对路线进度误差为2.28%；视频传输速率为10.006 FPS，帧丢失率0.25%；所有被监测的导航决策均在VR界面中被正确反映，无遗漏或错误通知。结果表明该框架可支持时间同步、语义一致且准确的路线进度表示。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于将真实ROS 2自主车辆与商用VR头显（Meta Quest 3S）通过双通道连接集成，实现物理来源的运动镜像、第一人称视频回传与决策可视化，并在重复闭环试验中验证了低延迟、低进度误差与高决策一致性。意义在于为乘客理解自动驾驶感知与决策提供具有物理真实性的沉浸式观察平台。局限在于评估规模有限（20次闭环试验、单一平台与场景），视频帧率较低（约10 FPS），且未涉及乘客主观体验、信任度或可用性的用户研究指标。

title: Personalized and Explainable Blood Pressure Estimation from PPG via Hybrid CNN--Morphological Features
summary: Continuous cuffless blood pressure (BP) monitoring using photoplethysmography (PPG) offers a promising solution for personalized healthcare. However, existing methods have two major limitations. Handcrafted feature-based approaches rely on precise fiducial point detection and are limited to short-term analysis, while deep learning models, despite their accuracy, often operate as black boxes with limited physiological interpretability. To address these challenges, we propose a physiology-guided hybrid framework for personalized BP estimation that couples a convolutional neural network (CNN) branch capturing global and local waveform dynamics with a morphology-prior branch that explicitly encodes person-specific vascular characteristics. By embedding a morphology-based feature set that explicitly encodes individual vascular characteristics, the proposed framework enhances personalization and reduces dependence on large-scale training datasets. Evaluated on a subset of the MIMIC-III database under a subject-specific (personalized) testing protocol, the proposed personalized physiology-guided hybrid approach achieved mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 3.77 mmHg for systolic BP and 2.36 mmHg for diastolic BP, corresponding to relative improvements of 43.7% and 32.4% over a subject-specific (personalized) CNN-only baseline. SHAP-based analysis confirmed that the introduced morphology-prior features align with individual vascular characteristics, reinforcing per-subject interpretability. These findings highlight the potential of personalized, physiology-guided hybrid learning with novel morphological descriptors for accurate and explainable BP monitoring in real-world settings.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"生理引导"的混合框架，用于个性化无袖带血压估计：CNN 分支捕捉全局与局部脉搏波形动态，形态学先验分支显式编码个体血管特征，从而提升个性化能力、减少对大规模训练数据的依赖，并增强可解释性。
AI.motivation: 基于光电容积脉搏波（PPG）的连续无袖带血压监测是个人化医疗的重要方向，但现有方法存在两方面局限：（1）手工特征方法依赖精确的特征点（fiducial point）检测，且多局限于短时分析；（2）深度学习模型虽精度高，却常为黑箱，缺乏生理可解释性。论文希望同时兼顾精度、个性化适应性与可解释性，降低对大规模标注数据的依赖。
AI.method: 提出生理引导的混合学习框架，采用双分支结构：（1）CNN 分支，提取脉搏波形的全局与局部动态特征；（2）形态学先验分支（morphology-prior branch），通过嵌入一组形态学特征显式编码个体特异性的血管特性。两条分支耦合（hybrid），将数据驱动的波形表征与人体生理先验结合，使模型在个体层面实现个性化并减少对大数据集的依赖。可解释性通过 SHAP 分析验证——检验所引入的形态学先验特征是否与个体血管特征一致。整体上属于混合式（CNN + 手工/形态学先验）的可解释血压估计范式，而非端到端黑箱模型。
AI.result: 在 MIMIC-III 数据库的一个子集上，采用受试者特异性（个性化）测试协议进行评估。评价指标为平均绝对误差（MAE）：收缩压（SBP）3.77 mmHg，舒张压（DBP）2.36 mmHg；相比仅用 CNN 的个性化基线，分别取得 43.7% 与 32.4% 的相对提升。SHAP 分析表明，所引入的形态学先验特征与个体血管特征相吻合，支持逐受试者的可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出一种带新型形态学描述子的个性化、生理引导混合学习框架，在个性化测试协议下同时实现较高精度与可解释性。意义在于展示将生理先验与深度特征耦合可在减少数据依赖的同时提升准确度和透明度，有助于真实场景下的无袖带血压监测。可能局限：仅在 MIMIC-III 的单一子集上、采用受试者特异性协议评估，尚未验证跨人群/跨数据集的泛化能力；形态学先验的质量可能仍受信号质量与特征提取稳健性影响。

title: BudgetBench: A Budget-Tiered Protocol and Pilot Harness for Memory Strategy Evaluation in Local Large Language Model Agents
comment: 44 pages, 4 figures. Code and artifacts: https://github.com/aviskaar/budgetbench
summary:
For local large language model agents, active context is a scarce resource: memory capacity, prefill latency, cache growth, and service objectives all constrain how many input tokens each call can afford. We present BudgetBench, an active-budget protocol and reference harness that treats the per-call input-token budget as the independent variable when comparing memory strategies. Holding the model, task, sampler, and decoding fixed, it sweeps budgets over 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, and 32K tokens and records quality, budget utilization, latency, and, as a first-class outcome, budget-violation rates. The core contribution is this reusable measurement surface: a swappable MemoryStrategy contract, explicit budget enforcement, deterministic or versioned graders, prompt-audit metadata, and reproducibility artifacts, released at https://github.com/aviskaar/budgetbench.
  We substantiate the protocol with pilot studies rather than final rankings. Across a local qwen2.5:1.5b pilot (89 items each on SWE-bench Verified and LongBench v2), a hosted 50-item Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench replication with exact tokenization, and a 500-item LongMemEval oracle study scored by the official GPT-4o evaluator, the harness exposes budget-compliance failures, non-monotonic quality curves, and operating points that single-budget evaluation hides. The budgeted-versus-full-context direction remains unresolved: the local slice is near-null and the hosted replication favors full context in point estimate. We report results transparently, including that the early pilot's tokenizer approximation undercounts some served-model prompts, so its violation rows are tokenizer-approximation diagnostics, not claim-bearing results; all timings are operational diagnostics. The reusable contribution is the protocol, harness, and failure-reporting discipline needed to scale fixed-budget memory-strategy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BudgetBench——一种"主动预算（active-budget）"评测协议与参考工具链，将每次调用的输入 token 预算视为自变量，用于比较本地 LLM agent 的记忆策略。核心贡献并非某个新方法或排名，而是一套可复用的测量面：可替换的 MemoryStrategy 接口、显式预算约束、确定性/版本化评分器、prompt 审计元数据与可复现工件。
AI.motivation: 对本地 LLM agent 而言，活跃上下文是稀缺资源：记忆容量、prefill 时延、KV cache 增长与服务目标（SLO）共同限制了单次调用可承载的输入 token 数。然而现有记忆策略评测通常只报告单一预算下的质量，掩盖了预算合规性失败、质量-预算曲线的非单调性以及真实可用的工作点。因此需要一个把 token 预算当作受控自变量、并把"预算违规率"作为一等指标的标准化评测框架。
AI.method: 方法层面是一项协议设计而非模型创新：(1) 固定模型、任务、采样器与解码配置，仅扫描预算 {2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K}；(2) 引入 MemoryStrategy 可替换契约，使不同记忆/检索压缩策略在同一预算下可比；(3) 显式预算强制（budget enforcement），在调用层面截断或拒绝超预算输入，并记录质量、预算利用率、时延与预算违规率；(4) 确定性或版本化 grader、prompt 审计元数据、可复现工件，保证评测可比性与可追溯性。工具已开源。
AI.result: 作者强调这是 pilot 研究而非最终排名，用于验证协议可用性。设置包括：本地 qwen2.5:1.5b 在 SWE-bench Verified 和 LongBench v2 上各 89 条；50 条 Qwen3 30B-A3B LongBench 复现实验（使用精确 tokenization）；500 条 LongMemEval oracle 研究，采用官方 GPT-4o evaluator 评分。结果显示：harness 能暴露预算合规失败、质量随预算的非单调曲线，以及被单预算评测掩盖的工作点。"budgeted vs. full-context"的结论尚未确定——本地切片接近零差异，托管复现在点估计上略偏向 full-context。作者透明披露早期 pilot 的 tokenizer 近似会低估部分实际服务端 prompt 长度，故其违规行只作为 tokenizer 近似诊断而非结论性证据，所有时延数据仅为运维诊断指标。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是评测协议、harness 与"失败报告纪律"，为固定预算下的记忆策略评测提供可扩展的标准化基础设施，填补了预算作为自变量、违规率作为一等指标的空白。意义在于推动 agent 记忆研究从单点 SOTA 报告转向预算-质量-时延权衡的系统刻画。局限在于：尚无量化的方法排名结论，budgeted 与 full-context 的相对优劣未定；pilot 规模较小（数十至数百条）且存在 tokenizer 近似偏差；时延指标不具可比性。

title: Big Brains and Changing Environments: Cause or Consequence?
summary: Large brains are metabolically costly, and associations with changing environments do not imply they evolved there, as the Cognitive Buffer Hypothesis (CBH) would suggest. They may instead evolve in stable conditions and later facilitate colonization of changing environments. Using neuro-evolution in an artificial seasonal foraging task, we compared agents evolving exclusively in changing environments to agents first evolved in static environments before transitioning. Results show that larger neural networks in dynamic environments arise mainly from prior static evolution, achieving superior performance under unpredictable changes. Our results challenge strict CBH predictions, provide agent-based (computational) support for a colonization-based account and highlight the role of evolutionary history in brain size evolution.

AI.tldr: 论文通过神经进化（neuro-evolution）实验，在一个带季节性的觅食任务中对比"仅在变化环境中进化"与"先在静态环境中进化、再迁移到变化环境"两类智能体，发现动态环境中的更大神经网络规模主要源自先前的静态进化，而非变化环境本身直接驱动，从而对认知缓冲假说（CBH）提出挑战，并支持基于定殖（colonization）的解释。
AI.motivation: 大型大脑代谢代价高昂，其进化机制尚存争议。认知缓冲假说（Cognitive Buffer Hypothesis, CBH）认为大脑变大是为了应对环境变化带来的认知挑战，即"变化环境驱动大脑进化"。然而，作者指出，与变化环境相关联并不等于大脑就进化于该环境中——大脑可能先在稳定条件下进化变大，随后才帮助生物定殖到多变环境。这一问题关系到进化生物学中"大脑规模进化的因果方向"，需要一个可控制、可重复的计算模型来厘清进化历史的作用。
AI.method: 作者采用神经进化（neuro-evolution）方法，构建了一个人工季节性觅食任务作为实验环境。实验设置两类进化路径：一是"动态进化组"，智能体全程只在变化（季节性）环境中进化；二是"迁移进化组"，智能体先在静态环境中进化，随后再过渡到变化环境。通过比较两组进化出的神经网络的规模（网络大小/复杂度）及其在不同可预测性变化条件下的任务表现，来分离"环境变化"与"进化历史"对大脑规模及行为适应性的影响。
AI.result: 结果表明：在动态环境中出现的大规模神经网络主要起因于先前的静态进化阶段，而非变化环境本身的直接选择压力；迁移进化组在不可预测的变化条件下表现出更优的性能。这提示静态环境下进化出的较大网络为后续应对环境波动提供了预适应（preadaptation）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究通过基于智能体的计算建模，对认知缓冲假说的严格预测提出了挑战，为"定殖驱动"的大脑进化解释提供了计算支持，并强调了进化历史在脑容量演化中的关键作用。其意义在于用可控的神经进化实验为进化生物学假说提供机制性证据。局限性可能包括：人工觅食任务对真实生态复杂度的简化、神经进化代理与生物进化的差异，以及结论依赖于特定任务设计与选择机制，其向真实生物系统的外推仍需谨慎。

title: ShieldVLA: Feasibility-Aware Safety Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models demonstrate strong generalization in robotic manipulation and navigation, but existing fine-tuning methods provide limited safety guarantees. Current approaches primarily rely on Lagrangian optimization that enforces safety through soft penalties on expected cumulative cost, often resulting in residual constraint violations or overly conservative behavior. Moreover, learning safety in visual domains is challenging due to the absence of dense per-step safety annotations. We propose ShieldVLA, a safety-aligned fine-tuning framework for VLA models based on Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) reachability. ShieldVLA learns a model-free approximation of the HJ reachability value function directly from visual observations to estimate the safe operating region. The learned safety critic gates policy optimization by separating reward maximization within feasible regions from recovery near unsafe states, avoiding persistent reward-cost trade-offs. To enable scalable supervision in visual environments, we introduce rubric-based VLM safety scores that convert semantic safety feedback into structured critic targets without requiring manual cost labels. Across five navigation and manipulation benchmarks spanning multiple VLA backbones, ShieldVLA reduces cumulative safety cost by 57% on average and improves task success rate by +0.13 over SafeVLA.

AI.tldr: ShieldVLA 提出一种基于 Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) 可达性的安全对齐微调框架，通过从视觉观测中学习无模型的 HJ 可达性价值函数（安全 critic），并将其用于门控策略优化，从而避免传统拉格朗日软惩罚导致的约束残余违反或过度保守问题。
AI.motivation: VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在机器人操作与导航中展现出较强的泛化能力，但现有微调方法的安全性保证有限。主流方法依赖拉格朗日优化，通过对期望累积成本的软惩罚施加安全约束，常导致两类问题：(1) 仍存在残余的约束违反；(2) 行为过度保守而牺牲任务性能。此外，在视觉域中学习安全约束面临关键挑战——缺乏逐步（per-step）的密集安全标注，难以进行有效的监督学习。因此，需要一种既能提供更严格安全保证、又能在无密集标注情况下可扩展学习的安全对齐方法。
AI.method: ShieldVLA 的核心是引入 Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) 可达性理论进行安全对齐微调。主要技术组件包括：(1) 从视觉观测直接学习一个无模型（model-free）的 HJ 可达性价值函数近似，用于估计安全运行区域（可行域）；(2) 将学习到的安全 critic 作为策略优化的门控机制——在可行区域内侧重奖励最大化，在接近不安全状态时转向恢复（recovery）行为，从而避免持续存在的奖励-成本权衡（reward-cost trade-off）；(3) 为解决视觉环境下缺乏人工成本标签的问题，提出基于评分标准（rubric-based）的 VLM 安全分数，将语义层面的安全反馈转换为结构化的 critic 监督目标，实现可扩展的监督信号生成。
AI.result: 论文在五个导航与操作基准（benchmarks）上进行评估，并覆盖多种 VLA 骨干模型（backbones）。与 SafeVLA 相比，ShieldVLA 平均降低累积安全成本 57%，同时任务成功率提升 +0.13。结果表明该方法在增强安全性的同时并未牺牲（反而提升）任务性能，避免了传统拉格朗日方法的保守性问题。
AI.conclusion: ShieldVLA 的主要贡献在于：将 HJ 可达性引入 VLA 安全对齐微调，通过无模型视觉安全价值函数实现安全门控策略优化，并利用 rubric-based VLM 安全分数解决视觉域缺乏密集安全标注的监督难题。该方法在多个基准和骨干上同时改善安全成本与任务成功率，显示出相较拉格朗日软惩罚方法的优势。潜在局限包括：HJ 价值函数近似依赖 VLM 评分质量与视觉泛化能力，安全保证为近似性质而非严格理论保证；此外评估主要集中于导航与操作任务，向更广泛开放环境与实时系统的迁移能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Part Grounding, Not Action Knowledge: Locating the Bottleneck in VLM Affordance Prediction
summary: Benchmarks agree that vision-language models reason poorly about low-level manipulation, but an aggregate accuracy score does not say which step fails. We separate two steps that affordance questions conflate: identifying which part of an object to act on, and knowing what action that part requires. Across 19 articulated objects we asked eight models, spanning three developers, what motion a robot should apply. Under an open prompt, push was produced once in 64 evaluations where it was correct, despite being correct for 8 of 19 objects and appearing in the offered label set every time. Inspecting the outputs showed why: models described a different part than the one being scored, e.g. explaining how to pick up a camera rather than press its button. Naming the target part raises action accuracy by 0.32 to 0.63 for every model, from 0.158-0.474 to 0.684-0.947, and push recall from 0-1/8 to 7-8/8. No model beats a constant answer that ignores the image under the open prompt; once the part is named, all eight do. Asked to describe the same part in free prose with no label set, models produce pressing language for 6 to 8 of 8. These results are hard to reconcile with missing action knowledge, and instead point to part grounding as the dominant bottleneck, a pattern that holds across all three model families and does not diminish with capability. Naming the part supplies the grounding variable, so this bounds what a perfect part detector would offer rather than demonstrating a general model of mechanics. Two supporting results agree: on real photographs only three of eight models localize grasp points better than a constant baseline, and on rendered objects none do. We also document two measurement errors of our own, a threshold that let a constant baseline score 0.929 and a labelling rule wrong on 4 of 19 objects, both caught only by testing our numbers against trivial alternatives.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过解耦"可供性(affordance)"问答中的两个步骤——识别对象上应作用的部件(part grounding)与判断该部件所需动作(action knowledge),发现视觉语言模型(VLM)在低级操作推理上的主要瓶颈是部件定位而非动作知识缺失;明确命名目标部件可将所有模型的动作用于准确率从0.158–0.474提升至0.684–0.947。
AI.motivation: 现有基准普遍认为VLM对低级操作推理能力弱,但聚合准确率分数无法说明具体是哪一步失败。可供性提问将"作用哪个部件"与"该部件需要何种动作"混为一谈,导致失败归因不明。作者希望厘清这一混淆,判断失败究竟源于缺乏动作机械知识,还是源于无法将问题文本与图像中的正确部件对齐(part grounding),从而界定一个理想部件检测器所能带来的性能上限。
AI.method: 研究选取19个铰接物体(articulated objects),询问8个模型(来自3个模型家族)机器人应施加何种运动。设置两类提问范式:(1)开放式提问(open prompt),不指明部件;(2)在提问中明确命名目标部件(named part),再让模型从候选标签集中选择动作(含push等)。同时要求模型在无标签集条件下用自由文本描述同一部件,以"pressing language"的出现频率衡量其隐含理解。作者还以"忽略图像的常数答案(constant baseline)"作为对照基线,并将模型输出与被打分部件进行人工比对,识别出模型描述了与被打分部件不同的部件的现象。此外在真实照片与渲染物体上进行抓取点(grasp point)定位实验。
AI.result: 在开放式提示下,当push为正确答案(19个物体中有8个)、且push每次都出现在候选标签集中时,64次评测中仅在1次正确输出push。命名目标部件后,所有模型的动作用于准确率从0.158–0.474提升至0.684–0.947(+0.32至+0.63),push召回率从0–1/8提升至7–8/8。在开放式提示下没有任何模型优于忽略图像的常数基线;一旦命名部件,全部8个模型均超过该基线。无标签集的自由描述中,模型对6–8/8的部件产生pressing语言。该模式在三个模型家族中一致,且不随模型能力增强而减弱。抓取点定位实验显示:真实照片上仅3/8模型优于常数基线,渲染物体上0/8优于基线。作者还报告自身两处测量误差:一个使常数基线得分达0.929的阈值设定,以及一条在19个物体中4个上出错的标注规则,二者均通过对照平凡替代方案被发现。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是将可供性推理拆解为部件定位与动作知识两个变量,并以受控实验证明部件定位是VLM低级操作推理的主导瓶颈,该结论跨三个模型家族稳定且不随规模/能力提升而缓解。其意义在于为"理想部件检测器"的性能上限提供边界约束(而非证明通用机械模型)。局限在于:命名部件仅提供了grounding变量,因此结论bound的是部件检测器上限;抓取点定位实验中多数模型不优于常数基线;作者也坦承自身存在两处测量错误,提示该类评测对阈值与标注规则高度敏感,需以平凡替代方案进行稳健性检验。

title: A derivative-fidelity failure mode in physics-informed neural networks: strengthened benchmark evidence from function-value training
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) use automatic differentiation to impose differential-equation residuals, but good agreement in function values does not necessarily imply accurate derivatives. This paper formulates derivative fidelity as a failure mode of PINNs and tests it with one-dimensional benchmarks. Multilayer perceptrons are trained only on function values for sin(x) and exp(x), while second derivatives obtained by automatic differentiation are evaluated separately. The hypothesis is strengthened by additional tests over training-point density, activation functions, endpoint-dense evaluation, and both L2 and maximum-error diagnostics. The results show that visually accurate function approximation can coexist with substantially larger second-derivative errors, especially near high-curvature boundary regions. The experiment provides a diagnostic protocol for distinguishing value accuracy from physics-residual reliability.

AI.tldr: 该论文将"导数保真度"（derivative fidelity）明确为物理信息神经网络（PINN）的一种失效模式：仅拟合函数值并不能保证自动微分得到的导数准确。作者用一维基准（sin(x)、exp(x)）构建了一套诊断协议，验证函数值精度与二阶导数精度之间的解耦现象。
AI.motivation: PINN 通过自动微分将微分方程残差纳入损失，从而在训练中受到物理约束。然而，优化目标最终反映在函数值上，函数值误差小并不必然意味着其导数（即物理残差的核心量）也准确。若导数不可靠，即使损失下降、可视化结果良好，PINN 求解的物理方程实际上仍可能不成立。因此，识别并量化这一失效模式，对评估 PINN 是否真正"学到了物理"具有重要意义。
AI.method: 作者采用多层感知机（MLP）作为代理模型，仅以函数值监督进行训练（未显式约束导数），目标函数为 sin(x) 与 exp(x)。训练完成后，单独用自动微分计算二阶导数并与解析真值对比。为增强结论稳健性，实验系统地变化多个因素：训练点密度、激活函数类型、端点密集采样评估（endpoint-dense evaluation），并同时使用 L2 误差与最大误差（max-error）两种诊断指标，构建出一套区分"数值精度"与"物理残差可靠性"的诊断协议。
AI.result: 在一维基准测试中，结果显示：函数近似在视觉与 L2 意义上可以相当准确，但其二阶导数误差显著更大，尤其在高曲率边界区域（boundary regions）附近误差被放大。该现象在不同训练点密度与激活函数下持续存在，并通过最大误差诊断得到进一步确认。论文以诊断性实验为主，未涉及大规模数据集或复杂 PDE 求解任务。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于将导数保真度显式地形式化为 PINN 的失效模式，并提出可复用的诊断流程，用于区分函数值精度与物理残差可靠性，提醒研究者不应仅以函数拟合质量（或可视化效果）判断 PINN 的有效性。局限在于实验规模有限：仅使用一维正弦/指数函数与 MLP，尚未验证在高维、真实 PDE 系统及复杂架构中的普适性；同时也未提出直接的缓解或正则化方法来提升导数精度。

title: Complete Suffix Prediction for Recommendation via Latent Retrieval over Process Graphs
summary: Complete suffix prediction is challenging in sequential decision settings, where the same prefix can remain compatible with several plausible suffixes. We propose a graphbased metric-learning framework that reformulates complete suffix prediction as latent retrieval over process graphs. Prefixes and suffixes are represented as directed attributed graphs and encoded by edge-conditioned graph neural networks, allowing event-level activities and transition-level durations to be modelled jointly. Prefix representations are projected into the latent suffix space through a predictor trained with a joint reconstruction and contrastive objective strengthened using process-aware hard negatives. To stabilise the learned retrieval geometry, spectral normalisation, and retrieval robustness, spectral normalisation is applied to enforce a Lipschitz constraint on both encoders and predictor. Experiments on two real-life process datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves the best overall results across nearly all evaluated criteria. It improves semantic suffix accuracy measured by normalized Damerau-Levenshtein distance, yields strong retrieval quality through Recall@1, Recall@5, and MRR@5, and maintains temporal plausibility according to Mean Absolute Error. These results show that graph-based latent retrieval is an effective alternative to sequential suffix prediction for recommendation-oriented process monitoring under structural and KPI-related constraints.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于图的度量学习框架，将"完整后缀预测"从序列生成问题重新表述为过程图上的潜在检索（latent retrieval）问题，通过边条件图神经网络联合建模事件级活动与转移级时长，并在潜在后缀空间中实现检索式预测。
AI.motivation: 在序列决策场景中，同一前缀可能对应多种合理的后续后缀，完整后缀预测具有内在的不确定性，传统序列预测方法难以有效处理这种一对多的多模态关系。该问题在面向推荐的过程监控（process monitoring）中尤为重要，且需同时满足结构约束与KPI相关约束，因此作者主张用检索替代生成来更好地捕捉多可能性。
AI.method: 方法核心是将前缀与后缀均表示为有向属性图（directed attributed graphs），由边条件图神经网络（edge-conditioned GNN）编码，从而联合建模事件级活动（event-level activities）与转移级时长（transition-level durations）。随后通过一个预测器将前缀表示投影到潜在后缀空间，该预测器以重构（reconstruction）与对比（contrastive）联合目标训练，并使用过程感知的硬负样本（process-aware hard negatives）增强对比学习。此外，对两个编码器及预测器施加谱归一化（spectral normalization），以强制 Lipschitz 约束，从而稳定学习到的检索几何结构。
AI.result: 在两个真实过程数据集上进行实验。评估指标包括：语义后缀准确度（normalized Damerau-Levenshtein distance）、检索质量（Recall@1、Recall@5、MRR@5）以及时间合理性（Mean Absolute Error）。结果显示该框架在几乎所有评估标准上取得最佳整体结果：语义后缀准确度提升，检索质量强，且保持时间合理性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于将完整后缀预测重构为过程图上的图基潜在检索任务，并验证了其在推荐导向的过程监控中的有效性，说明图基潜在检索可作为序列式后缀预测的有效替代方案。潜在局限包括：仅在两个真实数据集上验证，且较依赖过程图结构构建与硬负样本设计。

title: Harnessing human expertise for high-precision robotic assembly in industrialized construction: A sample-efficient installer-in-the-loop interactive reinforcement learning framework
comment: 22 pages, 11 figures, 10 tables. Published in Advanced Engineering Informatics
summary: Industrialized construction imposes stringent precision requirements on robotic assembly of modular components such as prefabricated window units. In tolerance-critical operations, the central bottleneck is not only mechanical clearance but also converting tacit installer expertise into data-efficient autonomy under sparse acceptance feedback, contact variability, and millimeter-scale constraints. We present an installer-in-the-loop interactive reinforcement learning framework that acquires expertise through offline teleoperated demonstrations, sparse event-driven binary takeovers at contact-failure boundaries, and acceptance-aligned terminal rewards, logged under a unified schema for traceable offline-to-online adaptation. A temporally abstract action-sequence policy built on Q-chunking with Flow Q-Learning captures multimodal recovery maneuvers under sparse terminal rewards, while a non-updating warm-start phase stabilizes the offline-to-online transition. The framework is evaluated in MuJoCo across the workflow from suction acquisition through clearance-limited seating, under structured staging and end-to-end randomized placement. Within a defined stress-test regime with 2 mm per-side clearance, bounded pose perturbations, and friction randomization, the pipeline attains 100\% autonomous seating with 12--15 min of cumulative installer supervision over 3.0 h of online training, and reaches the 95\% success milestone in approximately 0.5 h and 1.5 h in the two experiments. We also report wall-clock adaptation time, cumulative takeover minutes, intervention-rate decay, and stage-wise failure attribution to inform supervision budgeting. Ablations isolate the complementary contributions of temporal abstraction, installer intervention, and warm-start value calibration.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"安装工人在环（installer-in-the-loop）"的交互式强化学习框架，用少量人工遥操作演示、稀疏的接触失败点接管信号和"验收对齐"的终止奖励，实现预制窗单元在毫米级间隙下的机器人自主装配。策略基于 Q-chunking 时间抽象与 Flow Q-Learning，并通过非更新的暖启动阶段稳定离线到在线迁移。
AI.motivation: 工业化建筑对模块化构件（如预制窗单元）的机器人装配有严格的精度要求。在容差敏感的装配任务中，瓶颈不仅是机械间隙，还包括：把安装工人难以言表的经验（tacit expertise）转化为数据高效的自主能力，同时面临三个困难——稀疏的验收反馈（仅有成功/失败信号）、接触状态的高度可变性，以及毫米级约束。论文关注的是如何在这种稀疏、非结构化反馈下进行监督成本可控的学习。
AI.method: 框架由三部分数据来源组成：(1) 离线遥操作演示；(2) 在接触失败边界触发的稀疏、事件驱动的二元接管（binary takeover）；(3) 与验收标准对齐的终止奖励。这些数据以统一 schema 记录，以支持可追溯的离线到在线适应。策略层面采用基于 Q-chunking 的时间抽象动作序列策略，结合 Flow Q-Learning，用以在稀疏终止奖励下捕捉多模态的恢复动作（recovery maneuvers）；另设一个"不更新参数"的暖启动阶段，以稳定离线到在线的过渡（warm-start value calibration）。
AI.result: 在 MuJoCo 中评估，覆盖从吸盘获取（suction acquisition）到限间隙就位（clearance-limited seating）的完整流程，并分别测试结构化摆放与端到端随机摆放两种设置。在压力测试条件下（每侧间隙 2 mm、有界位姿扰动、摩擦随机化），管线实现 100% 自主就位，累计仅需 12–15 分钟安装工人的监督，在线训练 3.0 小时；两组实验中分别约 0.5 小时和 1.5 小时达到 95% 成功率的里程碑。论文还报告了墙钟适应时间、累计接管分钟数、干预率衰减以及分阶段失败归因，用于指导监督预算分配。消融实验分离了时间抽象、安装工人干预与暖启动价值校准三者的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是一个面向高精度工业装配的交互式 RL 框架，通过稀疏事件驱动的接管信号和终止奖励，把安装工人经验高效注入策略，并用时间抽象动作分块与暖启动校准解决稀疏奖励与离线-在线迁移问题，从而在极小间隙下以很低的人工监督成本达成高成功率。局限方面：实验仅在 MuJoCo 仿真中开展，未在真实硬件上验证；"每侧 2 mm 间隙"等条件属于特定压力测试范围；接触动力学与摩擦的仿真到现实差距，以及真实安装工人经验的可扩展性，仍是待检验的问题。

title: Synthetic Leprosy Image Generation Using Mask-Conditioned Latent Diffusion and Transfer Learning from Large Chronic Wound Datasets
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, 3 tables. Code and data pipeline: https://github.com/Yusufa09/SyntheticImageGeneration
summary: Machine learning for neglected tropical diseases is limited by data, not algorithms: public annotated image sets for leprosy (Hansen's disease) number in the hundreds, orders of magnitude below what generative models require. We ask whether a model trained on abundant chronic wound photography transfers to this low-data regime. We build a three-stage pipeline. First, a DeepLabV3-ResNet50 segmentation network (validation Dice 0.876, IoU 0.799) supplies lesion masks for two wound datasets that ship without them. Second, we assemble a mask-conditioned latent diffusion model from Stable Diffusion 1.5 components and train it on 3,280 region-of-interest wound crops, widening the UNet input convolution from 4 to 11 channels to admit three mask feature maps and a blurred low-frequency context latent. Third, we fine-tune this model on 708 leprosy image-mask pairs drawn from 764 images of approximately 150 patients. We evaluate with LPIPS perceptual distance, anchored by a real-versus-real baseline computed on the same 242 anchor images as the cross-set comparisons; without that reference the cross-set distances cannot be interpreted. The generated set shows no mode collapse: its internal perceptual diversity (0.662) is statistically indistinguishable from that of the real leprosy set (0.672, 95% CI [0.664, 0.680]). Generated images sit 0.044 LPIPS outside the real distribution - measurably apart, but under half of one standard deviation. Fine-tuning shifted the output distribution only marginally, which we trace to lesion geometry reaching the network through input concatenation alone. Chronic wound photography is therefore a viable donor domain for leprosy lesion synthesis: low-level appearance transfers well, and the remaining barrier is semantic control rather than image quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个三阶段流程，将慢性伤口摄影（数据丰富）作为供体域，迁移到麻风病（Hansen's disease）病灶图像合成这一低数据场景；通过分割、掩膜条件潜扩散模型构建与微调，证明生成图像的感知质量与多样性可接近真实麻风数据分布，主要瓶颈在于语义控制而非图像质量。
AI.motivation: 被忽视热带病（NTDs）的机器学习研究受限于数据而非算法：麻风病公开标注图像集仅有数百张，比生成模型所需数据量少数个数量级。论文的核心问题是：在数据充足的慢性伤口摄影上训练的生成模型，能否迁移到这种极低数据区制，从而为麻风病灶合成提供可行的数据增强途径。这一问题的意义在于，若低层外观可迁移，则可绕过标注数据稀缺的基础障碍，只需解决语义控制问题。
AI.method:
方法由三个串联阶段组成：
1) 分割阶段：使用 DeepLabV3-ResNet50 分割网络（验证集 Dice 0.876，IoU 0.799）为两个原本不带掩膜的伤口数据集生成病灶掩膜。
2) 生成模型构建：基于 Stable Diffusion 1.5 组件组装掩膜条件潜扩散模型，在 3,280 个 ROI 伤口裁剪图上训练；关键架构改动是将 UNet 输入卷积从 4 通道扩展为 11 通道，以接纳三张掩膜特征图与一个模糊低频上下文潜变量。
3) 微调阶段：在 764 张图像、约 150 名患者中抽取的 708 对麻风图像-掩膜样本上微调该模型。
评估采用 LPIPS 感知距离，并以同一批 242 张锚点图像上的 real-versus-real 基线作为参照，使跨集距离可被解释。论文据此指出，病灶几何信息仅通过输入拼接进入网络，因此微调对输出分布的移动有限。
AI.result: 评估指标为 LPIPS 感知距离，并以 242 张锚点图像上的 real-versus-real 基线作为参照。主要发现：(a) 生成集未出现模式崩塌，其内部感知多样性为 0.662，与真实麻风集（0.672，95% CI [0.664, 0.680]）在统计上不可区分；(b) 生成图像距真实分布外 0.044 LPIPS，可测量地偏离但不足一个标准差的一半；(c) 微调仅边际性地移动输出分布，作者将其归因于病灶几何只通过输入拼接进入网络。结论是低层外观迁移良好，剩余障碍在于语义控制而非图像质量。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于验证了慢性伤口摄影可作为麻风病灶合成的可行供体域，并构建了包含分割、掩膜条件潜扩散建模与低数据微调的完整流程，同时以锚点基线方法为跨集 LPIPS 比较提供了可解释的评价参照。其意义在于将 NTD 领域的数据瓶颈从"图像质量"重新定位为"语义控制"。潜在局限包括：对生成分布的刻画主要依赖 LPIPS 多样性指标，缺少下游检测/诊断任务的增益验证；微调样本仅约 708 对、约 150 名患者，规模极小；掩膜条件仅通过输入通道拼接注入，可能是语义控制不足的架构根因，论文未给出改进方案或对照实验。

title: Land Art as a Big-Data Climate Sensor
summary: Robert Smithson's 1970 land artwork Spiral Jetty, located in the north arm of Utah's Great Salt Lake, has alternated between submergence and exposure during severe lake decline. We analyze 1,744 co-registered Landsat 4-9 and Sentinel-2 image chips spanning every year and calendar month from 1984 to 2025. A 14-feature complexity signature combines Shannon entropy, multiscale permutation entropy, fractal dimension, lacunarity, gray-level co-occurrence texture, intensity statistics, and ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 features. These measurements are compared with a 42-year monthly climate and hydrology panel from NASA GISTEMP, USGS NWIS, Open-Meteo, and the Global Carbon Budget. Bootstrap analysis shows that Shannon entropy is a weak proxy and does not support an earlier small-sample claim of positive correlation with global temperature. By contrast, coarse-scale permutation entropy and mean intensity track lake elevation strongly, with Spearman correlations of 0.85 to 0.88 and 95 percent confidence intervals excluding zero. The third principal component of the ResNet50 embeddings emerges without supervision as an AI climate axis, correlating 0.86 with cumulative CO2 and -0.83 with lake elevation. Image complexity leads lake stage by about three years, with Pearson r = 0.58 at lag +3 and a 95 percent confidence interval of 0.40 to 0.73. STL decomposition reveals a non-monotonic trend that rises from 1984 to 2015 and declines sharply thereafter as the lake approaches record-low elevations. Partial correlations controlling for month and sensor confirm robustness to seasonal and sensor effects. These results refine the art-as-thermometer metaphor into an art-as-leading-indicator-of-hydrological-state interpretation. The dataset, feature pipeline, and analysis code are released as a public benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文将 Robert Smithson 的《Spiral Jetty》大地艺术作品视为大盐湖水文状态的"指示器"，利用 1984–2025 年共 1,744 幅 Landsat 4-9 与 Sentinel-2 影像切片构建 14 维"复杂性签名"，并与 42 年的气候/水文面板数据做统计分析（相关性、Bootstrap 置信区间、STL 分解、偏相关），发现影像复杂度对湖面水位具有约三年的领先性。
AI.motivation: 《Spiral Jetty》因大盐湖水位剧烈波动而反复被淹没与露出，此前基于小样本的研究曾声称 Shannon 熵与全球温度正相关，但结论不稳。作者希望用长时间序列、跨传感器的高质量遥感数据重新检验"艺术即温度计"的隐喻，并进一步探索是否可将陆地艺术作品视作水文/气候状态的领先指标，同时为遥感+气候交叉分析提供可复现的公开基准。
AI.method: 构建 1984–2025 年、覆盖每年每月的 1,744 幅共配准 Landsat 4-9 与 Sentinel-2 影像切片。特征管线为 14 维复杂性签名：Shannon 熵、多尺度排列熵、分形维数、lacunarity（空隙度）、灰度共生矩阵纹理、强度统计量，以及 ImageNet 预训练的 ResNet50 嵌入。气候与水文侧构建 42 年月度面板，数据来自 NASA GISTEMP、USGS NWIS、Open-Meteo 和 Global Carbon Budget。分析手段包括 Bootstrap 置信区间、Spearman/Pearson 相关、滞后互相关（lag 分析）、STL 趋势分解、对 ResNet50 嵌入做主成分分析（PCA）、以及控制月份与传感器的偏相关。
AI.result: 实验为长时间序列相关性/因果倾向分析，无传统分类或检测评测指标，主要指标为 Spearman、Pearson 相关系数及其 95% 置信区间。主要发现：（1）Shannon 熵是弱代理，Bootstrap 结果不支持此前小样本提出的与全球温度正相关的结论；（2）粗尺度排列熵与平均强度强跟随湖面水位，Spearman 相关性 0.85–0.88，置信区间不含零；（3）ResNet50 嵌入的第三主成分在无监督情况下自发形成"AI 气候轴"，与累积 CO2 相关 0.86、与湖面水位相关 −0.83；（4）影像复杂度领先湖面水位约三年，滞后 +3 处 Pearson r = 0.58（95% CI 0.40–0.73）；（5）STL 分解显示非单调趋势，1984–2015 上升后随水位创历史低点而急剧下降；（6）控制月份与传感器的偏相关确认结论对季节性和传感器差异稳健。作者公开数据集、特征管线与分析代码作为基准。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于以大规模、跨传感器的长时间遥感序列，纠正了早期 Shannon 熵与温度正相关的弱证据，并将"艺术即温度计"的隐喻细化为"艺术即水文状态领先指标"，同时展示预训练 CNN 嵌入经 PCA 后可无监督地编码气候相关信息。方法学上强调 Bootstrap 置信区间、滞后分析与偏相关等稳健统计。局限包括：相关性/领先性分析不能确立因果机制；研究仅针对单一地点与单一艺术作品，泛化性有限；特征对传感器和季节效应的敏感性虽经偏相关部分控制，但可能仍存在残余混杂；ResNet50 嵌入的"AI 气候轴"解释性仍属事后解读。

title: Event-Native Symbolic-Temporal Spike Encoding Framework for Heterogeneous Cyber Streams
comment: Accepted in The 38th IEEE International Conference on Tools with Artificial Intelligence (ICTAI)
summary:
Spiking neural networks (SNNs) have shown promise for sparse, event-driven computation through stateful processing that is naturally compatible with low-power edge hardware. These properties align with cyber monitoring, where data arrives asynchronously, and malicious behavior often emerges through temporal patterns across event sequences. However, cyber streams are not composed solely of continuous numeric signals: their informative structure is also carried by categorical identifiers, irregular timing, and local behavioral context. Traditional rate- and population-based spike encodings are not naturally suited to these heterogeneous semantics, while conventional intrusion detection system (IDS) pipelines typically resolve the mismatch by converting raw events into flows, fixed aggregation windows, or dense tensors. Although useful for conventional classifiers, these transformations introduce buffering latency, obscure native temporal structure, and weaken the computational advantages of event-driven neuromorphic processing.
  We introduce an event-native symbolic-temporal spike encoding framework that maps heterogeneous cyber events directly into sparse, spike-compatible inputs. By assigning encoding roles to semantic identity, local frequency context, and inter-event timing, the framework preserves categorical semantics and temporal dynamics. We validate the approach on packet-level Network IDS and extend it to message-level CAN IDS, using both domains to evaluate whether the encoding exposes usable structure for recurrent SNNs operating directly on native event streams. Under edge-oriented, $μ$Caspian-aligned hardware constraints, compact recurrent SNNs achieve strong anomaly detection performance, with an operational hybrid metric ($J_{hybrid}$) of 0.987 on Network IDS and 0.980 on CAN IDS.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"事件本原"的符号-时序脉冲编码框架（event-native symbolic-temporal spike encoding），将异构网络与CAN总线事件直接映射为稀疏脉冲输入，配合紧凑循环SNN在边缘硬件约束下实现高精度异常/入侵检测。
AI.motivation: 网络监控（cyber monitoring）数据具有异步到达、语义异构的特点：既有连续数值信号，也包含类别型标识符（如IP、CAN ID）、不规则时间间隔以及局部行为上下文；恶意行为往往体现在跨事件序列的时序模式中。SNN因其状态化、事件驱动的稀疏计算特性天然契合此类场景。然而，传统基于速率（rate-based）或群体（population-based）的脉冲编码难以承载这种异构语义；而常规IDS流程往往将原始事件转换为流（flows）、固定聚合窗口或稠密张量，虽然便于传统分类器处理，却引入了缓冲延迟、破坏了原生时序结构，并削弱了神经形态事件驱动计算的优势。因此核心动机是：设计一种不依赖流化/窗口化转换、直接面向原生事件流的脉冲编码方式。
AI.method: 提出事件本原的符号-时序脉冲编码框架，直接将异构cyber事件映射为稀疏、脉冲兼容的输入。其核心是给编码分配三类角色：1）语义身份（semantic identity）——对类别型标识符进行编码，保留分类语义；2）局部频率上下文（local frequency context）——编码局部行为统计/频率信息；3）事件间时序（inter-event timing）——编码不规则时间间隔，保留原生时间动力学。通过将身份、频率与时间三个维度解耦编码，框架在脉冲域内同时保留类别语义与时序动态。在此基础上，使用紧凑型循环SNN（compact recurrent SNN）直接作用于原生事件流进行检测，避免流聚合与固定窗口。整体设计遵循边端（edge-oriented）约束，并与μCaspian类神经形态硬件对齐。
AI.result: 在两类域上验证：包级Network IDS（packet-level）与扩展到消息级CAN IDS（message-level）。评估目标为：该编码是否能为直接处理原生事件流的循环SNN暴露可用结构。在面向边端、与μCaspian对齐的硬件约束下，紧凑循环SNN取得较强的异常检测性能：在Network IDS上综合运行指标J_hybrid = 0.987，在CAN IDS上J_hybrid = 0.980。论文通过跨域（网络流量与车载总线）实验表明该事件本原编码具有跨域可迁移性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于：提出面向异构cyber事件的事件本原符号-时序脉冲编码，显式建模语义身份、局部频率与事件间时序，从而绕开flow/窗口聚合带来的缓冲延迟与原生时序信息损失；并在包级Network IDS与消息级CAN IDS上验证其与紧凑循环SNN结合的有效性（J_hybrid分别为0.987与0.980），契合低功耗神经形态边缘部署。意义在于为SNN/神经形态计算在入侵检测等异步、时序驱动任务中提供了一条不依赖稠密张量化的建模范式。可能局限：评价主要依赖单一综合指标J_hybrid，其定义与权重未在摘要中说明；尚未给出与主流IDS基线及不同编码方案的详细对比、延迟/功耗等边端实测数据，跨域泛化也仅在两域上验证。

title: Learning Manipulation-Sufficient Representations via Outcome Bottlenecks
summary: Networked manipulation endpoints couple perception to actuation across compute- and bandwidth-limited links, yet commonly exchange dense geometric states optimized for fidelity rather than action outcomes. A stochastic representation is learned with a policy-free, action-conditioned outcome bottleneck: marginal outcome log-loss supplies distortion and a KL term regularizes rate. The construction is motivated by the minimal statistic that preserves the outcome distribution of every admissible action, while the implemented finite model is evaluated as a rate-regularized mixture predictor. The same encoder and outcome head support grasp selection, singleton conformal filtering, active viewpoint selection, and latent test-time adaptation. A finite-probe theorem identifies the local level-set tangent space with the null space of an outcome Jacobian. The synthetic oracle verifies this result; on scanned objects, an analytic surrogate agrees with measured simulator invariances within \(0.56^\circ\). Across 11,979 simulated grasps on 13 objects, a reconstructed-geometry wrench score attains 0.542 AUC against lift success and falls below chance on curved objects, while our representation attains 0.876. At 25\% commitment, executed-grasp success is 0.503 versus 0.984. The 512-byte interface is \(288\times\) smaller than one RGB-D frame and runs at 16\,ms per CPU decision. Independent synthetic points track the tested conformal levels; scanned-object all-pair coverage is reported as a clustered empirical diagnostic. On unseen objects, within-scene AUC falls to 0.569, and a full-feedback update raises empirical mean pairwise coverage from 0.728 to 0.883.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向网络化机械臂操作端点的随机表征学习方法：用"动作条件的outcome瓶颈"作为信息压缩目标，将感知状态压缩为512字节接口，在保留任意可行动作结果分布的前提下，支撑抓取选择、共形筛选、主动视角选择与测试时适应。
AI.motivation: 网络化操作端点需在算力与带宽受限的链路上把感知连接到动作，但传统做法交换的是为几何保真度优化的稠密几何状态（如点云/RGB-D帧），而非为"动作结果"优化。这种以保真度为目标的表征既占用大量带宽，又往往与下游操作任务的成败不直接相关。作者提出应从"保留每个可行动作的结果分布"这一最小充分统计量出发来学习表征，使通信内容直接服务于动作决策。
AI.method: 1) 表征：学习一个策略无关（policy-free）、动作条件的outcome瓶颈随机表征。目标函数由两部分构成——边缘outcome对数损失提供失真项（distortion），KL项对速率（rate）进行正则化，形成速率-失真框架。2) 理论：给出有限探针定理（finite-probe theorem），将局部水平集切空间与outcome雅可比矩阵的零空间等同，用以刻画表征不变性方向。3) 模型实现：作为速率正则化的混合预测器（mixture predictor）进行评估。4) 复用性：同一编码器与outcome头同时支持抓取选择、单样本共形滤波（singleton conformal filtering）、主动视角选择和潜空间测试时适应（test-time adaptation）。5) 接口：512字节的状态接口，每CPU决策16ms。
AI.result: - 理论验证：合成oracle验证了有限探针定理；在扫描物体上，解析代理（analytic surrogate）与实测仿真不变性偏差在0.56°以内。- 主实验：在13个物体、11,979次仿真抓取上，基于重建几何的wrench分数对抬升成功的AUC为0.542，在曲面上甚至低于随机水平；而所学表征达到0.876 AUC。- 承诺-成功率：25%承诺（commitment）下，执行抓取成功率为0.503，对比基线0.984。- 效率：512字节接口比单帧RGB-D小288倍，CPU决策耗时16ms。- 统计保证：独立合成点符合所测共形水平；扫描物体的全对覆盖率作为聚类经验诊断报告。- 泛化与适应：未见物体上场景内AUC降至0.569；使用全反馈更新后，经验平均成对覆盖率从0.728提升至0.883。
AI.conclusion: 贡献：提出以动作条件的outcome分布保留为核心的速率-失真表征学习框架，将感知压缩问题从几何保真转向决策相关的最小充分统计，并在单一表征上统一抓取选择、共形不确定性、主动感知与测试时适应；给出去噪-速率框架下的有限探针理论结果，实现了极端紧凑（512字节、16ms CPU）且AUC显著优于几何基线的接口。意义：为带宽受限的机器人/远程操作、实时边缘感知提供了"任务导向通信"的范式。局限：理论保证为局部、渐近性有限；未见物体性能明显下降（AUC 0.569），表明泛化受限；承诺-成功率相较基线仍偏低；覆盖率保证仅为经验/聚类的诊断，而非严格分布无关保证。

title: Don't Just Look, Intervene: Perturbation Based Region Labeling for VQA Images
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) should rely on visual evidence that directly determines the correct answer, but supervision for grounding visual reasoning is often expensive to obtain manually or tied to dataset-specific annotation primitives. We instead introduce model-causal visual evidence as an annotation target, defined as the set of image regions whose counterfactual intervention changes a model's answer distribution for a given image-question pair. Based on this principle, we introduce Counterfactual Search for Grounding Regions (CSGR). CSGR is a scalable pipeline that proposes candidate regions, perturbs them, measures their effect on answer sensitivity, and aggregates this evidence across multiple judges to approximate answer-critical regions in VQA data. To assess whether CSGR annotations contain a useful supervision signal, we plug them into three existing grounding-aware training routines: attention steering, Visual CoTfinetuning, and latent visual reasoning. These experiments test whether the proposed annotation scheme can provide a useful supervision signal across multiple ways of consuming region labels, rather than introducing a new way of using them. Across competing automatic region-labeling mechanisms, CSGR annotations provide the most consistent gains over Cross Entropy-only finetuning in both in-domain and out-of-domain evaluations, indicating that the proposed labeling scheme captures useful region-level information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"模型因果视觉证据"（model-causal visual evidence）作为标注目标，定义为对图像-问题对进行反事实干预后能改变模型答案分布的图像区域集合，并据此设计了可扩展的自动标注流水线 CSGR（Counterfactual Search for Grounding Regions），用于为 VQA 数据生成近似"答案关键区域"的监督信号。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）的推理应当依赖真正决定正确答案的视觉证据，但现有的视觉 grounding 监督要么依赖昂贵的人工标注，要么与特定数据集的标注原语（annotation primitives）强绑定，难以大规模获取。作者希望找到一种不依赖人工、可扩展且与数据集标注形式解耦的监督目标，用于提升 VLM 的视觉 grounding 与推理能力。
AI.method: 核心思想是将标注目标从"人类认定的显著/相关区域"转向"模型因果敏感区域"：即以反事实干预下模型答案分布发生变化的区域作为答案关键证据。CSGR 流水线包括四个步骤：(1) 提出候选区域（region proposal）；(2) 对候选区域进行扰动（perturbation）；(3) 度量扰动对答案敏感度（answer sensitivity）的影响；(4) 在多个 judge 模型之间聚合证据，从而近似出 VQA 数据中的答案关键区域。为验证该标注的信号价值，作者并未提出新的区域标注使用范式，而是将 CSGR 标注接入三种已有的 grounding-aware 训练流程：attention steering、Visual CoT finetuning 与 latent visual reasoning。
AI.result: 实验在 VQA 数据上进行，对比对象为若干竞争性的自动区域标注机制（automatic region-labeling mechanisms），基线为仅使用交叉熵（Cross Entropy-only）微调。评测涵盖域内（in-domain）与域外（out-of-domain）两类设置。结果显示，在多种区域标签消费方式下，CSGR 标注相较其他自动标注方法提供了最为一致、稳定的性能提升，说明该标注方案确实捕获了有用的区域级信息。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出"模型因果视觉证据"这一可扩展的标注目标及 CSGR 自动标注流水线，并通过跨多种训练范式的验证表明其监督信号的有效性与鲁棒性（域内/域外均一致受益）。其价值在于降低了对人工 grounding 标注与数据集特定标注原语的依赖，为 VLM 视觉推理监督提供了新思路。潜在局限包括：因果区域为模型相关（model-dependent）而非人类语义意义上的证据，可能受 judge 模型偏差影响；反事实搜索依赖候选区域提议与扰动方式的设计，计算开销与区域粒度控制有待进一步评估；文中并未提出新的区域标签使用方式，收益取决于下游训练流程。

title: LLMs or Naive Bayes? Old Gems or New Ways
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Accepted to the Proceedings of Practice and Experience in Advanced Research Computing (PEARC '26), Minneapolis, Minnesota, USA
summary: Large language models (LLMs) prompt a recurring question in research computing: should classical methods like Naive Bayes (NB) be retired? We benchmark Complement Naive Bayes against zero-shot and few-shot LLMs spanning four model families and a 37x range in scale (27B to a 1T-parameter mixture-of-experts) across text classification tasks. LLMs dominate only in zero-data regimes (98.0% vs 88.2% on Amazon Polarity sentiment), and even that win is contamination-prone: on a low-contamination sentiment task NB beats the zero-shot LLM (81.7% vs 73.0%). However, once labeled data is available (e.g., AG News), NB reaches 89.1% accuracy, statistically indistinguishable from the zero-shot 27B LLM (89.0%) and better than the 397B frontier model (84.8%), at thousands of samples/sec on a commodity CPU. Fine-tuned DistilBERT reaches 90.6% but at far lower throughput than NB at batch size 1 (Table 2). Our measured GPU throughput analysis shows small-LLM batched inference is 40-486x slower than NB CPU inference (the multiplier depends strongly on the host CPU), exposing a structural gap bounded by memory bandwidth, with roughly two orders of magnitude lower energy per sample. For resource-constrained HPC practitioners performing text classification with labeled data, NB remains the optimal choice. We show the decision line is task-dependent (NB reaches LLM parity around $N \sim 10^4$ labels for topic classification, while zero-data sentiment favors the LLM at all N tested) and provide a Kubernetes Helm operator that automates model selection using configurable thresholds and verifiable Prometheus metrics.

AI.tldr: 该论文对Complement Naive Bayes与零样本/少样本大语言模型（27B至1T参数MoE，跨越37倍规模）在文本分类任务上进行系统基准对比，指出在拥有标注数据时NB在准确率、吞吐和能效上均具竞争力，并提供基于Kubernetes的自动模型选择算子。
AI.motivation: LLM的兴起使研究者质疑经典方法（如Naive Bayes）是否应被淘汰。论文针对资源受限的HPC场景，探讨在文本分类中何时应使用NB、何时应使用LLM，揭示LLM的优势仅限于零数据或少数据场景，且易受数据污染影响，从而为实用模型选择提供量化依据。
AI.method: 论文将Complement Naive Bayes与零样本/少样本LLM进行对比，覆盖四个模型家族、27B至1T参数（MoE）的37倍规模范围。评估包括准确率、CPU/GPU吞吐（含batch size 1场景）及每样本能耗，并分析决策边界随标注样本数N的变化；同时提供Kubernetes Helm operator，利用可配置阈值与Prometheus指标自动化模型选择。
AI.result: LLM仅在零数据场景占优（Amazon Polarity情感分析98.0% vs NB 88.2%），但在低污染情感任务上NB反超（81.7% vs 73.0%）。有标注数据时（如AG News），NB达89.1%，与零样本27B LLM（89.0%）无统计差异，且优于397B前沿模型（84.8%）。微调DistilBERT达90.6%但吞吐远低于NB。小型LLM批量GPU推理比NB CPU推理慢40–486倍，每样本能耗约低两个数量级。决策线任务相关：主题分类中NB约在N≈10^4标注样本达到LLM持平。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明在具备标注数据的文本分类任务中，Complement Naive Bayes仍是资源受限HPC实践者的最优选择，其准确率可与大模型持平而吞吐和能效显著更高。主要贡献在于量化的决策边界、污染敏感的评估视角及自动模型选择算子。局限在于结论针对文本分类，未涵盖需要深层语义理解或生成能力的任务，且LLM对比集中于特定模型家族。

title: Sensory Precision Inference for Multimodal Arbitration under Uncertainty
comment: This work has been accepted for publication in the International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI2026) proceedings. This is the Submitted Manuscript before any peer review. The reviewed and edited version will be available on Springer Nature Link
summary: Autonomous agents operating on multisensory data cannot assume that all sensory modalities remain consistently informative. In real environments, sensory streams are frequently corrupted by noise, missing data, or inter-modal incongruence, requiring adaptive arbitration between competing sensory hypotheses. While active inference provides a principled framework for uncertainty-guided inference, the role of dynamically inferred sensory precision in generative multimodal arbitration under sensory conflict remains comparatively underexplored. We propose a multimodal perceptual inference model in which latent beliefs and modality-specific sensory precisions are jointly updated through iterative free-energy minimization. In our proposed model, sensory precision dynamics not only reflect sensory uncertainty but actively shape the evolution of latent beliefs during multimodal conflict. In addition, we introduce a learned prior over sensory precisions that induces structured, class-dependent precision patterns and influences cross-modal inference dynamics. We evaluate the model using a synthetic multimodal MNIST dataset combining visual, auditory, and tactile representations of digit classes under controlled sensory noise and inter-modal incongruence. Results show that dynamic precision inference improves reconstruction robustness under corrupted sensory evidence, supports coherent latent inference from reduced sensory evidence, and enables stable arbitration between conflicting modalities. Furthermore, learned precision priors generate interpretable precision structures that shape inference dynamics and cross-modal latent structure. These findings support sensory precision inference as a mechanistic control process for adaptive multimodal belief formation under uncertainty, highlighting precision dynamics as a computational mechanism for robust and interpretable multisensory integration.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种多模态感知推理模型，将潜在信念与各模态特有的"感觉精度（sensory precision）"通过迭代自由能最小化联合更新，并引入可学习的精度先验以生成类别相关的结构化精度模式；在合成多模态 MNIST（视觉/听觉/触觉）上验证了动态精度推理在噪声、缺失与模态冲突下提升重建鲁棒性、支持降级证据下的连贯推理，并实现稳定模态仲裁。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体在多感官环境下无法假设各模态始终信息一致：真实场景中感觉流常受噪声、数据缺失或跨模态不一致（incongruence）影响，因此需要在竞争性感官假设之间进行自适应仲裁。主动推理（active inference）提供了不确定性引导推理的原则性框架，但"动态推断的感觉精度"在感官冲突下如何驱动生成式多模态仲裁，目前研究相对不足。该工作正是针对这一机制空白，探究精度推断能否作为自适应多模态信念形成的控制过程。
AI.method: 核心是自由能最小化框架下的联合推断：1）潜在信念（latent beliefs）与模态特有的感觉精度同步、迭代地更新，精度并非被动反映不确定性，而是主动塑造冲突期间潜在信念的演化轨迹；2）引入可学习的精度先验（learned prior over sensory precisions），诱导类别相关（class-dependent）的结构化精度模式，进而影响跨模态推理动态与潜在结构。模型本质上是在多模态生成模型中显式建模并动态调节跨模态精度权重，实现不确定性引导的模态重加权/仲裁。
AI.result: 在合成多模态 MNIST 数据集上评估，数据由数字类别的视觉、听觉、触觉三种表示构成，并在受控的感觉噪声与跨模态不一致条件下测试。结果显示：动态精度推断在感官证据被损坏时提升重建鲁棒性；在感官证据减少时仍支持连贯的潜在推理；在模态冲突时实现稳定的仲裁；此外，学习到的精度先验产生了可解释的精度结构，塑造了推理动态与跨模态潜在结构。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于将感觉精度推断确立为不确定性下自适应多模态信念形成的机制性控制过程，并证明精度动态可实现鲁棒且可解释的多感官整合。意义在于为主动推理框架中多模态仲裁提供了可解释的计算机制。局限方面，实验基于合成多模态 MNIST 数据与受控噪声/冲突条件，尚未在真实多传感器或复杂感知任务中验证，泛化性有待进一步考察。

title: Self-Evolving AI for Humanoids: Mechanisms, Safety, and Evaluation of Post-Deployment Self-Improvement
comment: The paper includes 30 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables, and is considered for publication
summary: Humanoid robots are becoming an important part of embodied artificial intelligence, driven by advances in reinforcement learning for locomotion, world models for prediction, and vision-language-action models for general control. However, most of these systems remain static after deployment. A policy is trained offline for a fixed objective and then frozen, even though the tasks, environments, and robot bodies keep drifting over time. An emerging paradigm of self-evolving agents aims to address this problem by allowing systems to improve from their own post-deployment experience. Since most existing studies focus on disembodied software agents, this survey examines how self-evolution changes when an agent has a physical body. We first define self-evolution for humanoids and represent a deployed robot using a state tuple that includes its policy, perception, memory, workflow, and body. This state is updated by an evolution operator in a slow outer loop with a lifelong objective. We then organize the literature into four complementary mechanisms of self-evolution, presented in increasing order of autonomy: self-learning, self-adaptation, self-optimization, and self-generation. Since changes to a humanoid can introduce physical hazards, we treat safety and uncertainty as key design dimensions of the evolution operator, and further formulate admissible evolution as a constraint enforced by a world-model verification gate within a human-oversight envelope. Finally, we present that evaluation should track the robot's evolving trajectory rather than a fixed checkpoint, and we identify the lack of a benchmark designed specifically for self-evolving humanoids. Moreover, we outline open challenges spanning AI algorithms, on-board systems, and governance.

AI.tldr: 这是首篇系统综述"具身自进化智能体"（self-evolving embodied agents）的论文，聚焦人形机器人。作者将已部署机器人建模为一个包含策略、感知、记忆、工作流与本体（body）的状态元组，并通过一个带终身目标的"慢外层循环"中的进化算子持续更新该状态；进而把自进化文献归纳为自学习、自适应、自优化、自生成四类递进机制，并将安全与不确定性作为进化算子的核心设计维度。
AI.motivation: 当前人形机器人受益于强化学习运动控制、世界模型预测和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的进展，但绝大多数系统在部署后即被"冻结"：策略离线训练完成用于固定目标后不再更新，而任务、环境和机器人本体却在持续漂移。新兴的"自进化智能体"范式试图让系统从自身部署后的经验中改进，但已有研究多集中于无实体的软件智能体（disembodied agents），未讨论当智能体拥有物理身体时所引入的本质差异——尤其是物理动作可能带来真实伤害。因此论文的动机是：明确"具身化"如何改变自进化的定义、机制与约束，并为人形机器人领域提供统一的框架与研究路线。
AI.method: 论文以综述与概念框架为主。核心方法论贡献包括：(1) 给出人形机器人自进化的定义，并将已部署机器人形式化为一个状态元组，涵盖 policy、perception、memory、workflow 与 body 五个要素；(2) 提出由一个"进化算子"（evolution operator）在慢时间尺度的外层循环（slow outer loop）中更新该状态，优化目标为终身（lifelong）目标而非固定任务；(3) 将自进化机制按其自主性递增划分为四类互补范式：self-learning（自学习）、self-adaptation（自适应）、self-optimization（自优化）、self-generation（自生成）；(4) 将安全与不确定性视为进化算子的关键设计维度，提出"可容许进化"（admissible evolution）作为一种受约束的优化，并由世界模型验证门（world-model verification gate）在人类监督包络（human-oversight envelope）内强制执行。此外，论文主张评价范式应从固定检查点转向追踪机器人自身的演化轨迹。
AI.result: 作为一篇综述，论文本身不报告实验结果或定量指标。其主要"发现"是对领域现状的结构化诊断：(1) 现有自进化研究主要面向无实体软件智能体，具身场景下的自进化尚缺乏系统性梳理；(2) 缺少专为自进化人形机器人设计的基准（benchmark），这是当前评估体系的关键缺口；(3) 提出评价应基于机器人随时间的演化轨迹，而非单一静态检查点。论文同时梳理了跨 AI 算法、机载系统（on-board systems）与治理（governance）三个层面的开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于：（i）首次针对具身人形机器人的自进化给出形式化定义与状态元组/进化算子框架；（ii）提出四类递进式自进化机制的分类体系；（iii）将安全性、不确定性与人类监督纳入进化算子的约束设计，提出世界模型验证门与可容许进化概念；（iv）指出缺乏自进化人形机器人专用基准，并给出跨算法、系统与治理的开放问题。其意义在于把人形机器人的部署后学习从"一次性离线训练"推向"终身、受约束的持续演化"视角。可能的局限：由于是综述与框架性工作，缺少具体算法实现、实验验证与定量对比；状态元组、进化算子和验证门目前主要停留于概念层面，其可操作性与实际安全保证（如世界模型验证门的可靠性、监督包络的界定）仍有待后续工作检验。

title: What Does the Encoder Actually Decide? A Controlled Comparison of Vision Backbones on Joint Tree Segmentation and Stereo Depth
summary: A robot pruning trees needs two facts per pixel: whether it belongs to a tree, and its distance. Both are usually obtained via task heads attached to a vision backbone chosen by reputation rather than measurement. Holding dataset, decoders, losses, schedule, and evaluation fixed, we ask: how much does the encoder choice change joint semantic segmentation and stereo depth on thin vegetation? We build a hard parameter-sharing network with one encoder feeding both branches, swapping only the encoder without downstream retuning. We evaluate [N] encoders across [M] architecture families (CNNs, transformers, hybrids, MLP-mixers, state-space models) near a ~25M budget, trained from scratch. Depth is evaluated on tree pixels only; segmentation uses boundary F1 and background IoU to prevent "label-everything-tree" shortcuts. Three findings stand out. First, the strongest encoders are convolutional and hybrid, not transformers: [BestEncoder] leads with [MIoU] segmentation mIoU and [Delta] depth $δ_1$, while [X] of [Y] plain vision transformers collapse when trained from scratch. Second, parameter count does not predict quality --- [SmallEncoder] at only [P]M parameters outranks models two orders of magnitude larger. Third, segmentation and depth rankings agree strongly (Spearman $ρ$ = [RhoValue]), showing no task conflict. Finally, [K] of [N] encoders collapse to degenerate all-tree segmentation --- exposed by boundary F1 but hidden by region IoU.

AI.tldr: 本文以受控实验方式系统评测"编码器（backbone）选择"对细长植被（树木）上联合语义分割与立体深度估计的影响。在固定数据集、解码器、损失、训练计划与评测协议的前提下，构建硬参数共享的单编码器双分支网络，从头训练约25M参数预算下、涵盖CNN、Transformer、混合、MLP-mixer、状态空间模型（SSM）等[M]个架构族共[N]个编码器，发现卷积与混合编码器优于纯Transformer，参数量不能预测质量，且两个任务排名高度一致（无任务冲突）。
AI.motivation: 机器人修剪树木需要每个像素同时提供两个信息：是否为树（语义分割）以及到树的距离（深度）。现有做法通常把任务头挂在一个"凭声誉而非实测"选择的视觉骨干上，导致无法判断性能差异究竟来自编码器还是下游设计。本文动机是在严格受控条件下回答：编码器选择对细长植被的联合分割+立体深度到底有多大影响。该问题重要，因为细枝叶是低纹理、细结构、边界主导的困难场景，分割易退化为"把所有像素标成树"，深度在树像素上也难评估；若缺乏受控对比，机器人感知系统的骨干选型就会缺乏依据。
AI.method: 构建硬参数共享（hard parameter-sharing）网络：单一编码器同时馈入分割分支与立体深度分支，仅在切换编码器时保持下游全部不变、不进行再微调，从而隔离编码器变量。评测[M]个架构族（CNN、Transformer、Hybrid、MLP-Mixer、状态空间模型）下的[N]个编码器，均约25M参数预算并从零训练（from scratch）。评测设计上有两点关键考量：深度只在树木像素上评估；分割除mIoU外引入边界F1（boundary F1）与背景IoU，以抑制"把一切标成树"的退化捷径。文中还报告了编码器排名间的Spearman秩相关，用于分析任务冲突。
AI.result: 主要发现有三点：(1) 最强编码器为卷积与混合架构而非Transformer——[BestEncoder]取得领先的分割mIoU=[MIoU]与深度δ1提升[Delta]，而[Y]个纯视觉Transformer中有[X]个在从头训练时崩溃；(2) 参数量无法预测质量——仅[P]M参数的[SmallEncoder]超过大其两个数量级的模型；(3) 分割与深度的编码器排名强一致（Spearman ρ=[RhoValue]），表明两任务之间不存在明显冲突。此外，[N]个编码器中有[K]个塌缩为退化的"全树"分割，该失败模式被边界F1暴露、却被区域IoU掩盖，说明单一区域IoU指标具有欺骗性。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于提供了一个受控的编码器基准，量化了骨干选择对细长植被联合语义分割与立体深度的影响，并给出可用结论：卷积/混合骨干在~25M从头训练设置下优于纯Transformer，参数量不是可靠指标，两任务可共享编码器而无显著冲突。方法学意义在于用边界F1+背景IoU揭示"全树"退化、并指出区域IoU会掩盖该失败。局限包括：结论针对特定数据集、约25M预算与从头训练设定，是否可迁移到其他规模、预训练或更大模型尚待验证；深度仅在树像素评估，未全面反映背景几何质量。

title: Early Prediction of Satellite Collision Probability Using a Hybrid TCN-Transformer Model for a CDM-Based Conjunction Analysis Framework
comment: Accepted in 2026 AAS/AIAA Astrodynamics Specialist Conference
summary: The rapid expansion of operational satellites and orbital debris has increased the frequency of close approach events in low Earth orbit (LEO), creating a higher operational burden for satellite operators. This problem is especially critical for satellites using electric propulsion, where low-thrust maneuver capability imposes additional time constraints on collision avoidance planning. In current practice, Conjunction Data Messages (CDMs) provide relative state, covariance, miss distance, time of closest approach, and probability of collision (PoC) information for conjunction assessment. However, the nonlinear propagation of orbital uncertainties and the sensitivity of PoC to covariance evolution make the interpretation of sequential CDMs challenging. This study proposes a learning-based framework for early prediction of satellite conjunction risk by estimating the PoC expected in the subsequent CDM update of the same close approach event. In the proposed methodology, an Unscented Transform-based propagation and backpropagation framework is first used to evaluate the sensitivity of the collision risk metric to CDM parameters. In addition, Principal Component Analysis is applied to the numerical CDM parameters to identify the features most relevant to PoC variation. The results obtained from the sensitivity analysis and PCA are then used to justify the selected raw CDM parameters and to construct derived metrics representing relative motion, encounter geometry, and covariance-related uncertainty. Using the resulting sequential enriched conjunction dataset, a hybrid Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN)-Transformer model is trained to learn the temporal evolution of conjunction risk. The framework is applied to CDMs received and analyzed within TÜBİTAK UZAY, demonstrating its potential for earlier and more consistent operational risk evaluation for LEO satellite conjunctions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于学习的卫星会合（conjunction）风险早期预测框架，通过预测同一次接近事件在下一次CDM（Conjunction Data Message）更新中的碰撞概率（PoC），并采用混合TCN-Transformer模型对CDM序列的时序演化建模，服务于低轨（LEO）卫星碰撞规避规划。
AI.motivation: 随着LEO运行卫星与轨道碎片数量激增，近距离接近事件频发，给卫星运营方带来更高负担；对使用电推进的卫星而言，低推力机动能力进一步压缩了规避规划的时间裕度，使早期风险预判尤为关键。当前实践依赖CDM提供的相对状态、协方差、最近接近距离、TCA与PoC等信息，但轨道不确定性的非线性传播以及PoC对协方差演化的高度敏感性，使连续CDM序列的解读变得困难，因此需要一种能够预测后续CDM中PoC、从而支持更早、更一致风险评估的方法。
AI.method: 方法包含三个层次。第一，采用基于无迹变换（Unscented Transform）的传播与反向传播框架，评估碰撞风险指标对CDM参数的敏感性。第二，对数值型CDM参数应用主成分分析（PCA），识别与PoC变化最相关的特征。第三，依据敏感性与PCA结果筛选原始CDM参数，并构造表示相对运动、接近几何与协方差相关不确定性的派生指标，形成序列化的“富化会合数据集（enriched conjunction dataset）”。在此数据基础上训练一个TCN-Transformer混合模型，学习会合风险的时序演化，从而在后续CDM到达前估计其PoC。TCN用于提取局部时序依赖，Transformer用于建模长程时序关系。
AI.result: 实验使用TÜBİTAK UZAY接收和分析的CDM数据进行验证。论文通过无迹变换敏感性分析与PCA为特征选择与派生指标构造提供依据，并在序列化富化数据集上训练TCN-Transformer模型来预测后续CDM中的PoC。结果显示该框架在LEO卫星会合场景中对碰撞风险具备更早且更一致的风险评估潜力。摘要未给出具体数据集规模、评价指标数值或对比基线结果。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于：将卫星会合PoC预测形式化为对同一次接近事件下一次CDM更新的时序预测问题；结合无迹变换敏感性分析与PCA进行数据驱动的特征工程；并提出TCN-Transformer混合时序模型，在真实运营CDM数据上展示了早期风险评估能力，对电推进卫星的碰撞规避规划具有运营意义。局限在于摘要未报告定量性能与基线对比，且框架的可迁移性、跨事件泛化能力与对CDM稀疏/不规则采样的鲁棒性尚未说明。

title: Ensemble-Conditioned Molecular Design
comment: Code available at: https://github.com/rssrwn/ensemble-cond-design datasets and checkpoints available at: https://zenodo.org/records/22485204
summary: Molecular design is typically approached as a problem of finding molecules which can adopt a single bioactive conformation. In reality, molecules occupy a distribution over conformations, and many of the properties which determine whether a candidate is viable depend on that distribution rather than on any single conformer. We reframe molecular design as an optimisation of both the modes and properties of molecules' conformational ensembles, where modes can be represented as shapes, pharmacophore profiles or protein pockets, and properties are aggregate scalars computed over the whole distribution. To realise this we introduce ensemble-conditioned guidance, a framework which conditions 3D molecular generative models on both axes simultaneously. Mode conditions are composed adaptively at inference by combining the vector fields produced under each condition. Conditions may be targeted or avoided, mixed across modalities and combined in arbitrary numbers, allowing a wide range of design tasks to be expressed with a single trained model. We introduce adaptive symmetry learning to allow conditions from different reference frames to be composed, and extend our generative framework to enable flexible-size generation. We evaluate on new benchmarks for multi-mode conditioning and ensemble property optimisation, and apply the framework to two practical drug discovery tasks, dual-target binder design and active-state-selective agonist design, where in both cases conditioning on the additional state improves the desired outcome over single-state conditioning.

AI.tldr: 该论文将分子设计重新定义为对分子构象系综（conformational ensemble）的"模式"与"系综性质"的联合优化，提出 ensemble-conditioned guidance 框架，使 3D 分子生成模型能够同时在两类条件轴上被引导，从而用单一模型支持多种复杂药物设计任务。
AI.motivation: 传统分子设计通常假设分子只采用单一生物活性构象（single bioactive conformation），但真实分子在溶液中占据一个构象分布，而决定候选分子是否可行的许多性质（如结合选择性、平均活性、构象倾向性）实际上依赖于整个分布而非任一单一构象。因此仅针对单一构象优化会与实际需求脱节。作者希望将设计目标扩展为同时优化构象系综的多个模式（modes）与在整个分布上计算的聚合标量性质（aggregate scalars），以更贴近真实药物发现场景（如双靶点结合、活性态选择性激动剂设计）。
AI.method: 核心方法是 ensemble-conditioned guidance：在 3D 分子生成模型中，同时对"模式轴"和"性质轴"进行条件化。模式可以是形状（shapes）、药效团轮廓（pharmacophore profiles）或蛋白口袋（protein pockets）；性质是定义在整个构象分布上的聚合标量。推理时，自适应地组合每个条件产生的向量场（vector fields）来合成模式条件，条件可被"目标化"或"回避"，可跨模态混合、以任意数量组合，从而使单个训练模型可表达广泛的多种设计任务。此外提出 adaptive symmetry learning（自适应对称性学习），用于组合来自不同参考系的条​​件；并扩展生成框架以支持 Flexible-size generation（可变大小生成）。
AI.result: 作者构建了针对多模式条件化（multi-mode conditioning）与系综性质优化（ensemble property optimisation）的新基准进行评估，并将框架应用于两个实际药物发现任务：双靶点结合体设计（dual-target binder design）与活性态选择性激动剂设计（active-state-selective agonist design）。在两个任务中，相较于单状态条件化（single-state conditioning），额外加入状态条件都改善了期望结果。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于：将分子设计从单构象视角拓展为系综层面的模式与性质联合优化；提出 ensemble-conditioned guidance 与自适应对称性学习，实现跨模态、多条件、可目标/可回避的灵活组合，并支持可变大小生成；在自建基准与两个真实药物发现任务上验证了有效性。局限在于评估主要依赖新提出的基准与两个下游任务，模式与性质的形式化仍受所选模态（形状/药效团/口袋）限制，跨参考系条件的组合依赖对称性学习，其鲁棒性与泛化性有待更广泛验证。

title: GzDRL: Reproducible and Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning with Gazebo
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: We present GzDRL, a novel single-process reinforcement learning (RL) framework for Gazebo that overcomes longstanding bottlenecks in scalable, reproducible robotics experimentation. Unlike conventional middleware-based RL-Gazebo integrations that suffer from nondeterminism and irreproducibility, GzDRL introduces a systematic, middleware-free environment-stepping mechanism that directly synchronizes agent actions and physics updates. This design enables deterministic, high-throughput data collection, efficient vectorization, and reproducible RL training and evaluation. Comprehensive benchmarks demonstrate that GzDRL achieves the highest workstation throughput among the evaluated frameworks while remaining competitive with GPU-accelerated simulators on laptop hardware, and maintains precise agent-environment synchronization, multi-agent scalability, and experiment-level reproducibility. We further validate sim-to-real transfer by deploying learned policies directly onto a physical quadrotor, without fine-tuning. Our results establish GzDRL as an accessible and reproducible platform for advancing RL in robotics and automation.

AI.tldr: GzDRL 是一个面向 Gazebo 的单进程强化学习框架，通过无中间件（middleware-free）的环境步进机制直接同步智能体动作与物理仿真更新，实现确定性、高吞吐、可复现的机器人 RL 训练与评估，并完成了无需微调的仿真到真机（sim-to-real）四旋翼迁移验证。
AI.motivation: 传统基于中间件（如 ROS + Gazebo）的 RL 仿真集成存在长期瓶颈：通信中间件引入非确定性（nondeterminism）与不可复现性（irreproducibility），数据采集吞吐低，难以高效向量化，从而阻碍了机器人强化学习实验的可扩展性与结果可信度。该问题对机器人学习研究至关重要，因为可复现性与高吞吐采样是 RL 训练稳定性和实验对比有效性的前提。
AI.method: 提出 GzDRL——一种单进程（single-process）的 Gazebo RL 框架。其核心是系统性的、无中间件的环境步进机制：将智能体动作与物理引擎更新直接同步，绕过中间件通信层，从而获得确定性（deterministic）的仿真步进、高吞吐数据采集和高效的环境向量化（vectorization）。该设计支持多智能体扩展与实验级可复现性，并提供统一的训练与评估接口。
AI.result: 论文进行了全面基准测试（benchmark），结果表明：GzDRL 在所评估的框架中取得最高的工作站（workstation）吞吐量，同时在笔记本硬件上与 GPU 加速仿真器的性能具有竞争力；在智能体—环境精确同步、多智能体可扩展性和实验级复现性方面均保持良好表现。此外，通过将学习到的策略直接部署到真实四旋翼上且无需微调（without fine-tuning），验证了 sim-to-real 迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出了一种无中间件、单进程的 Gazebo RL 集成范式，解决了机器人 RL 中长期存在的确定性与复现性瓶颈，并提供了高吞吐、可向量化、可扩展的实验平台，且通过真机四旋翼部署验证了实用性。其意义在于降低可复现机器人 RL 实验的门槛。潜在局限包括：摘要未给出具体任务、数据集、量化指标数值及对比框架清单，sim-to-real 验证仅涉及单一四旋翼平台，泛化性与更大规模多智能体场景下的表现尚待进一步评估。

title: EMCStereo: Attention-Enhanced Stereo Matching for Thin-Structure Depth Estimation with a Synthetic Tree-Branch Benchmark
summary: Thin structures such as tree branches are among the hardest cases for stereo matching: a branch is only a few pixels wide, the background is cluttered, and dense ground truth for real branches is nearly impossible to label by hand. We make three contributions. First, EMCStereo integrates three lightweight attention modules into a PSMNet-style cost-volume backbone: Efficient Multi-scale Attention (EMA) on deep semantic features, a Multi-Scale Fusion block (MSFblock) learning spatial pyramid weights instead of concatenating them, and Coordinate Attention (CoordAtt) on final matching features. Because MSFblock collapses four pyramid branches into one, the modules leave the network 2.0% smaller and add only 1.7% inference time overhead. Second, VirtualTree is a synthetic stereo dataset rendered in Unreal Engine 5 with a simulated ZED Mini rig, providing 5,520 pairs with exact disparity for thin branches. Third, an eight-way ablation establishes a run-to-run noise floor of 0.009 px end-point error (EPE). EMCStereo achieves 1.31 px EPE (5.96% D1-all) on the VirtualTree test split, 1.00 px on SceneFlow, and 0.80, 0.73, 0.62, and 3.19 px on KITTI 2012, KITTI 2015, ETH3D, and Middlebury, with depth accuracy delta_1 from 92.6% to 98.7%. Evaluated against the noise floor, the attention stack is accuracy-neutral at a 100-epoch budget, while MSFblock and CoordAtt cost 0.03-0.05 px unless EMA is present.

AI.tldr: EMCStereo 通过向 PSMNet 风格代价体主干引入三个轻量注意力模块（EMA、MSFblock、CoordAtt），在几乎不增加计算量的前提下改善细结构（如树枝）的立体匹配；同时提出虚幻引擎 5 渲染的合成数据集 VirtualTree 提供细枝精确视差真值，并通过八路消融量化了运行间噪声下限。
AI.motivation: 细结构（如树枝）是立体匹配中最困难的场景之一：目标仅数个像素宽、背景杂乱、真实细枝的稠密视差真值几乎无法人工标注。这类细结构对机器人/无人机感知中的避障与近距精细几何重建十分关键，但缺少带精确真值的训练与评测数据，也缺少在精度与效率间平衡的专用网络设计。
AI.method: 在 PSMNet 风格代价体主干上集成三个轻量注意力模块：1) EMA（Efficient Multi-scale Attention）作用于深层语义特征；2) MSFblock（Multi-Scale Fusion block）学习空间金字塔各分支的融合权重而非简单拼接，并将四条金字塔分支压缩为一条；3) CoordAtt（Coordinate Attention）作用于最终匹配特征。因 MSFblock 的分支压缩，整体网络体积减小 2.0%，推理时间仅增加 1.7%。数据侧提出 VirtualTree：在 Unreal Engine 5 中用模拟 ZED Mini 双目相机渲染的合成立体数据集，含 5,520 对图像并给出细枝的精确视差真值。
AI.result: 通过八路消融实验建立运行间噪声下限为 0.009 px EPE。EMCStereo 在 VirtualTree 测试集达 1.31 px EPE（5.96% D1-all），SceneFlow 上 1.00 px；KITTI 2012/2015、ETH3D、Middlebury 上分别为 0.80/0.73/0.62/3.19 px，深度精度 delta_1 从 92.6% 提升至 98.7%。相对噪声下限，在 100 epoch 训练预算下注意力堆叠对精度基本中性；MSFblock 与 CoordAtt 在 EMA 缺失时带来 0.03–0.05 px 的精度代价。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献为三点：面向细结构的轻量注意力增强立体匹配网络 EMCStereo、提供细枝精确真值的合成数据集 VirtualTree，以及用以判别性能差异显著性的噪声下限消融方法。结果表明注意力模块在近零开销下可维持精度并改善细结构匹配。局限在于主要依赖合成数据评估细枝性能，真实细结构场景验证有限，且注意力增益在噪声下限尺度上偏小。

title: Evaluating LLM-Generated Rules for Heart Disease Prediction
summary: This study compares traditional machine learning models and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated rule-based systems for heart disease prediction using the UCI Heart Disease dataset. Several classifiers, including Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, and Random Forest, were evaluated alongside rule-based systems generated using GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 4.6. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. Experimental results show that traditional machine learning models consistently outperform LLM-generated rule-based systems in predictive performance. Random Forest achieved the best overall performance with 90.2% accuracy, a precision of 0.829, perfect recall of 1.0, and an F1-score of 0.906. Naive Bayes followed closely with 88.5% accuracy and an F1-score of 0.881. In contrast, the LLM-generated rule models achieved lower performance, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 reaching 80.3% accuracy (F1-score: 0.833) and GPT-4o obtaining 70.5% accuracy (F1-score: 0.690). Despite the performance gap, the LLM-generated rules provide interpretable IF-THEN diagnostic logic that enhances explainability and transparency in clinical decision-making. These findings highlight the trade-off between predictive performance and interpretability in medical artificial intelligence systems. The complete implementation of all experiments, including machine learning models and LLM-derived rule classifiers, is publicly available in the GitHub repository at https://github.com/FeisalAlaswad/LLM-Rule-ML-Heart-Disease-Prediction .

AI.tldr: 该研究在 UCI Heart Disease 数据集上系统比较了传统机器学习分类器（LR、KNN、SVM、Naive Bayes、Decision Tree、Random Forest）与由 GPT-4o 和 Claude Sonnet 4.6 生成的规则式（IF-THEN）诊断系统在心脏病预测任务上的性能，揭示了预测精度与可解释性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 心脏病预测是临床决策支持中的关键任务，既需要较高的预测精度，也需要模型决策的透明性与可解释性。传统机器学习模型（如集成方法）通常精度较高但"黑箱"特性明显，难以直接向临床医生解释；而大语言模型（LLM）近年来展现出将医学知识转化为显式 IF-THEN 规则的能力，其生成规则天然具备可读性与可解释性。然而，LLM 生成规则系统与传统机器学习模型在同一医学数据集上的定量性能对比尚缺乏系统性研究，本文正是为填补这一空白，量化两者的性能-可解释性权衡。
AI.method: 研究基于 UCI Heart Disease 数据集构建二分类预测任务。基线方法包括六种传统分类器：Logistic Regression、K-Nearest Neighbors、Support Vector Machine、Naive Bayes、Decision Tree 和 Random Forest。对照方法为使用 GPT-4o 与 Claude Sonnet 4.6 两个 LLM 生成的规则式诊断系统（rule-based systems），其输出为显式的 IF-THEN 诊断逻辑，可直接用于分类判断。评估采用准确率（Accuracy）、精确率（Precision）、召回率（Recall）与 F1-score 四项指标。所有实验代码（含机器学习模型与 LLM 规则分类器）已在 GitHub 公开。
AI.result: 实验结果表明传统机器学习模型在预测性能上全面优于 LLM 生成的规则系统。Random Forest 表现最佳，准确率 90.2%、精确率 0.829、召回率高达 1.0、F1-score 0.906；Naive Bayes 紧随其后，准确率 88.5%、F1-score 0.881。LLM 规则模型性能相对较低：Claude Sonnet 4.6 准确率 80.3%（F1-score 0.833），GPT-4o 准确率 70.5%（F1-score 0.690）。尽管存在性能差距，LLM 生成的规则提供了可解释的 IF-THEN 诊断逻辑，在临床决策的透明度与可解释性方面具有优势。
AI.conclusion: 本文的核心贡献在于在同一心脏病预测数据集上定量对比了传统机器学习模型与 LLM 生成规则系统的性能，明确呈现了医疗 AI 中"预测精度 vs 可解释性"的权衡：集成模型（Random Forest）精度最高，而 LLM 规则在可解释性上占优但精度偏低。研究提示可考虑二者结合（如以规则辅助解释黑箱模型）。局限性在于仅使用单一数据集（UCI Heart Disease），模型与 LLM 配置的泛化性尚未验证，且未报告统计显著性检验或交叉验证细节，结论的外推需谨慎。

title: Physical Kernel: Structured Visual Latents for Dark Manipulation
summary: We study dark manipulation: after a brief lit Write encodes z0 = Enc(rgb), a policy pi(z) and open-loop dynamics f(z,a) complete contact-rich skills without further pixels (dark_f). On ManiSkill StackCube (n=160; seed packs 0/1000), dark_f attains 68.1% stacked on the five-rung chain (near_A -> grasped -> lifted -> on_B -> stacked), compared with 35.6% for per-step lit_reenc and 0% for freeze/encode_black. On a shared Write->HOLD protocol (n=40), occlusion and camera-aligned GT contact-neighbor masks drive lit lift from 43% to 0%, while dark_f holds 82.5%; shuffling actions inflates dynamics MSE by ~9.4x; write-time appearance shifts break encoding (night: 0% stacked), yet the same shifts during HOLD leave dark_f lift unchanged; Write length Tw is flat once the stop phase is reached, while earlier stops and write-time blur/JPEG sharply cut stacked. A dedicated pi_write reaches 35% vision-budget stacked (n=80); matched Dreamer-style/pixel nulls without privileged geom stay at 0%. Privileged state-RSSM MPC reaches ~35% stacked with 9D dark observations -- a stronger-observation null, not a matched visual baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出并系统研究"暗操作"（dark manipulation）范式：策略在短暂"写入"（Write）阶段仅用 RGB 像素编码出潜在状态 z0=Enc(rgb)，随后在接触密集的技能执行阶段完全不依赖像素，仅凭策略 π(z) 与开环动力学 f(z,a) 完成任务（dark_f）。在 ManiSkill StackCube 上 dark_f 达到 68.1% 堆叠成功率，显著优于逐步重编码（lit_reenc, 35.6%）与编码冻结/黑图（0%）。
AI.motivation: 论文关注接触密集操作任务中视觉感知的角色边界问题：当机器人进入接触后，像素信息是否仍然必要？动机在于揭示现有"每步重编码"式视觉策略在遮挡、相机对齐接触掩码、写入期外观扰动等条件下的脆弱性——例如遮挡使 lit lift 从 43% 降至 0%，而 dark_f 仍保持 82.5%。这为理解视觉在操作中的必要性、以及构建对遮挡/外观变化鲁棒的实时策略提供了实验依据。
AI.method: 方法核心是将感知与执行在时间上解耦：Write 阶段以编码器 Enc 将 RGB 映射为潜在状态 z0；执行阶段由策略 π(z) 与开环动力学 f(z,a) 推演，不再访问像素（dark_f）。对比方法包括：逐步光照重编码 lit_reenc、冻结编码 freeze、黑图编码 encode_black、专用 π_write（35% 视觉预算），以及 Dreamer 风格/像素基线（无特权几何信息，均为 0%）。此外引入 9D 暗观测的 privileged state-RSSM MPC 作为"更强观测"上界对照。分析手段包括动作打乱（动力学 MSE 膨胀约 9.4×）、写入期外观漂移（夜间）、写入长度 Tw 消融、及写入期模糊/JPEG 压缩扰动。
