AI.method: MorphoStyle 建立在形状条件化的有限标量量化变分自编码器（Finite-Scalar-Quantization VAE, FSQ-VAE）之上，将风格迁移建模为模块化的潜空间解耦，包含三项关键设计：(i) 对比式风格编码器（contrastive style encoder），提取与内容解耦的风格嵌入；(ii) 文本引导的风格路由机制（text-guided style-routing），在文本-运动特征空间中定位与风格相关的关节点；(iii) 流形保持的风格调制器（manifold-preserving style modulator），以时间门控的低秩偏移形式将具判别性的风格嵌入注入内容特征中。该设计旨在同时保留内容保真度、风格判别性与形状一致的动力学。
AI.result: 论文在基准数据集上进行了大量实验，结果表明 MorphoStyle 在形状控制与运动风格迁移两方面均优于竞争性基线方法，并能够同时提供定量的形状控制能力。摘要未披露具体的评测指标与数值结果，详细设置与数据可参见项目网站（https://github.com/funkdub/MorphoStyle）。
AI.conclusion: MorphoStyle 的主要贡献在于统一了形状感知的运动生成与风格迁移，通过对比式风格编码、文本引导的路由与流形保持的调制实现风格与内容、形体形态的解耦，缓解了内容泄漏与动力学破坏问题，并在实验中取得优于基线的表现。潜在局限在于其依赖 FSQ-VAE 潜空间与文本引导信号的质量，且摘要未给出具体定量结果与对极端体型的泛化性验证。

title: Biquaternionic Space with Complex-valued Attention for Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion
summary: Temporal knowledge graph embedding (TKGE) models infer missing facts in knowledge graphs that evolve over time. Many existing models use a single geometric space, which can limit their ability to represent diverse relational patterns, or treat entity representations as static. We propose Biquaternionic Space with Complex-valued Attention (BSCA), a TKGE model that combines circular and hyperbolic rotations within a unified biquaternionic framework. A complex-valued attention mechanism adaptively fuses time-conditioned and relation-conditioned entity representations, allowing them to vary with temporal and relational context. Experiments on five benchmark datasets show competitive performance across datasets, with the largest improvement on GDELT: BSCA achieves an MRR of 52.1\%, compared with 38.1\% for the strongest baseline in our comparison.

AI.tldr: 提出 BSCA，一种双四元数空间（biquaternionic space）时态知识图谱嵌入模型，在统一框架内融合圆旋转与双曲旋转，并用复值注意力机制自适应融合时间条件与关系条件的实体表示，在五个基准数据集上取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 时态知识图谱嵌入（TKGE）需要推断随时间演化的知识图谱中的缺失事实。现有模型存在两点局限：(1) 多采用单一几何空间，难以刻画多样化的关系模式（如对称、反对称、组合、层次等）；(2) 常将实体表示视为静态，无法随时间和关系语境变化。几何空间表达能力的不足以及实体表示的静态性，会限制模型对复杂时态关系模式的建模精度。
AI.method: BSCA 在统一的双四元数（biquaternion）框架下同时纳入圆旋转（circular rotation）与双曲旋转（hyperbolic rotation），从而在单一表示体系中兼容两类几何变换，以覆盖多样化的关系模式。此外，引入复值注意力机制（complex-valued attention），自适应地融合“时间条件”与“关系条件”两种实体表示，使实体嵌入随时间和关系语境动态变化，而非保持静态。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上进行实验，整体性能具有竞争力；在 GDELT 数据集上提升最为显著，MRR 达到 52.1%，而对比中最强基线为 38.1%。摘要未提供其余数据集的具体数值、数据集名称、评价指标细节（除 MRR 外）及消融实验信息。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于：将圆旋转与双曲旋转统一到双四元数空间，并以复值注意力机制实现时间与关系条件下的动态实体表示。其意义在于提升 TKGE 对多样化关系模式的建模能力，并在 GDELT 上取得大幅改进。潜在局限：双四元数运算与复值注意力可能带来更高的计算与参数开销；摘要仅给出部分指标，缺乏对其他数据集结果的详细报告与消融验证。

title: X-WBC: A Cross-Embodiment Foundation Model for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
summary: Scaling humanoid whole-body control toward general-purpose deployment requires large human motion corpora and training experience shared across robot bodies. Existing methods usually train one policy per robot, leaving motion experience isolated across embodiments. We introduce X-WBC, a cross-embodiment foundation framework that separates relatively shared human motion semantics from embodiment-specific physical execution. Human-centered command tokens align full human motion, robot reference motion, and sparse VR observations. A causal Transformer learns reusable temporal structure from mixed multi-robot rollouts, while lightweight robot-specific modules map the shared representation to each robot's proprioception and action space. Across nine simulated embodiments, external motions, and four real robots, experiments show that joint training improves tracking, the aligned representation supports consistent control across command sources, and the learned policy remains competitive beyond the training corpus. These results support heterogeneous humanoids as joint data sources and establish cross-embodiment joint training as a practical route toward whole-body control foundation models.

AI.tldr: X-WBC 是一个跨本体（cross-embodiment）的全身控制（WBC）基础框架，将相对共享的人类运动语义与本体相关的物理执行解耦：以人类中心的 command token 对齐全人体运动、机器人参考运动和稀疏 VR 观测，用因果 Transformer 从多机器人混合 rollout 中学习可复用的时序结构，再用轻量级机器人专属模块映射到各本体的本体感觉与动作空间；在 9 个仿真本体、外部运动和 4 台真实机器人上验证了联合训练的收益。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身控制要走向通用部署，需要大规模人类运动语料以及可跨机身共享的训练经验。但现有方法通常是"一机器人一策略"，导致运动经验在各本体之间彼此隔离，无法复用。论文的动机是把不同异构人形机器人视为联合数据源，通过统一表征实现跨本体的经验共享，从而为全身控制基础模型（foundation model）提供一条可行路径。
AI.method: 核心思路是做"语义-执行"分层解耦。1) 表示与对齐：设计以人类为中心的 command token，将三类信号——完整人体运动、机器人参考运动、稀疏 VR 观测——映射到同一对齐空间，使不同来源的指令具备一致语义。2) 共享主干：使用因果 Transformer（causal Transformer）作为时序主干，在多机器人混合 rollout 上学习可复用的时间结构与运动先验；因果结构对应控制的在线/自回归特性。3) 本体适配：为每台机器人配备轻量级 robot-specific 模块，将共享表征解码到该机器人各自的本体感觉（proprioception）与动作空间，从而在不复制整套策略的前提下吸收本体差异。整体可视为共享语义编码器 + 本体特定解码器的架构。
AI.result: 实验覆盖 9 个仿真本体、外部（训练语料之外）运动以及 4 台真实机器人。主要发现有三点：其一，跨本体联合训练相比单独训练提升了运动跟踪性能；其二，对齐后的共享表征使得不同指令来源（人体运动、机器人参考运动、稀疏 VR 观测）下的控制行为保持一致；其三，学到的策略在训练语料之外的泛化场景仍具备竞争力（remains competitive beyond the training corpus）。摘要未给出具体指标数值、数据集名称或对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献是提出 X-WBC 这一跨本体全身控制基础框架，通过人类中心 command token 对齐与因果 Transformer 共享主干 + 本体特定适配模块，把异构人形机器人组织为联合数据源，并将跨本体联合训练确立为通向全身控制基础模型的实际可行路线。局限方面：摘要未量化具体精度、未说明真实机器人实验的任务范围与成功率，也未讨论本体形态差异过大时的共享表征退化风险、多本体联合训练的计算与数据成本等。

title: What Input Resolution Is Required for Bird Species Identification, and What Is Its Latency Cost on an Edge Device? A Study of 14 Input Resolutions and Six Architectures with On-Device Measurements
comment: 25 pages, 7 figures, 7 tables. On-device measurements on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano (JetPack 6.2, TensorRT 10.3). Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22697995
summary: Bird-strike mitigation at wind farms requires identifying distant birds that span only tens of pixels, so the classifier's input resolution N is a design variable, not a fixed specification. We study it with a factorial design over 14 side lengths N (16 to 224), six architectures, two training and evaluation regimes and 30 random seeds -- 2,520 checkpoints and 5,040 evaluations -- plus latency measured on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano. Four results. (1) The selected N depends on the target: 0.90 is met on validation by ResNet50 at N=112 in an estimated 1.85 ms (0.8980 on test) and 0.95 by DINOv2-L at N=144 in 12.70 ms; changing the model buys more accuracy than raising N (+5.93 versus +2.33 points at N=112). (2) The benefit of lowering N depends on the assumed preprocessing path: N=224 -> 80 saves 13.5% when each individual is decoded from its own file but 46.2% when the detector decodes the 4K frame once; the Pareto set grows from 20 to 23 configurations. (3) Accuracy must be measured on the deployed engine: half precision costs ViT-S/16 alone 4 to 7 points at N>=96 while the CNNs stay within 0.1 points, and with selection held at validation the choice differs at 26 of 176 targets. A broken FP16 engine can run faster than a correct one, undetectable from latency; admitting 14 ViT-S/16 FP32 configurations moves the recommendation over the 0.931-0.938 band and under the 10 ms budget. (4) ViT-L-scale models fit this device, but activations exceed the FP16 range; splitting the graph at transformer-block boundaries confines FP32 to the affected segments, making the deployed DINOv2-L chain 1.85x faster than the single-engine build. We also quantify how the regime-difference sign stabilises with seed count; a sensitivity split removing some forms of group sharing preserves all 14 non-trivial signs at the selection boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文通过大规模因子实验（14种输入边长N从16到224 × 6种架构 × 2种训练/评估机制 × 30个随机种子，共2,520个checkpoint、5,040次评估，并在NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano上测量延迟），系统研究"分类器输入分辨率N应作为设计变量而非固定规格"这一问题，面向风电场远距离鸟类（仅数十像素）的鸟击缓解场景，给出精度-延迟权衡的多项实证结论。
AI.motivation: 风电场鸟击缓解需要识别远距离、仅占几十像素的小目标鸟类，因此分类器输入分辨率N是设计变量而非既定规格。论文关注的核心问题是：在边缘设备（Jetson Orin Nano）上，如何在给定精度目标与延迟预算下选择合适的输入分辨率、模型架构与精度（FP16/FP32）部署方案，并揭示常见做法（仅看验证集精度、假设预处理路径固定、忽略部署引擎数值误差）可能带来的误导性结论。
AI.method: 采用因子实验设计（factorial design）扫描14个side length N（16–224）、6种架构、2种训练与评估regime、30个随机种子，累计2,520个checkpoint与5,040次评估，并在Jetson Orin Nano上实测延迟。同时对比两种预处理路径假设：每个个体从自身文件解码 vs 检测器对4K帧只解码一次。在部署层面研究FP16半精度对ViT与CNN的影响，并提出在transformer block边界切分计算图、将FP32限制在受影响segment的方法以支持ViT-L规模模型。
AI.result: 四点主要结果：(1) 最优N依赖目标——ResNet50在N=112达验证0.90（测试0.8980，估计延迟1.85 ms），DINOv2-L在N=144达0.95（12.70 ms）；换模型带来的精度增益大于提高N（N=112处+5.93 vs +2.33点）。(2) 降低N的收益取决于预处理路径：N=224→80在"逐个解码"假设下仅省13.5%，而"4K帧单次解码"下省46.2%，Pareto集从20增至23个配置。(3) 精度必须在实际部署引擎上测量：FP16使ViT-S/16在N≥96时损失4–7点，而CNN保持在0.1点内；选择锁定在验证集时，176个目标中有26个的最优选择发生变化；损坏的FP16引擎可能比正确的更快且无法从延迟察觉；纳入14个ViT-S/16 FP32配置后推荐结果在0.931–0.938区间变动且仍低于10 ms预算。(4) ViT-L规模模型可放入该设备但激活值超出FP16范围；在transformer block边界切分图、将FP32限制在受影响segment后，部署的DINOv2-L链路比单引擎构建快1.85倍。此外量化了regime-difference符号随种子数的稳定过程，并指出移除部分group sharing形式的敏感性切分在selection boundary处仍保留全部14个非平凡符号。
AI.conclusion: 论文的贡献在于将输入分辨率、架构选择、预处理路径与部署数值精度纳入统一的实证框架，用大规模因子实验与真实边缘设备测量揭示多处反直觉结论：模型容量比分辨率更有效、省时收益取决于预处理假设、部署引擎数值误差可改变模型选择、图切分可让ViT-L规模模型高效运行。其意义在于为风电场远距离小目标鸟类识别等边缘视觉任务提供可复现的设计准则。局限在于结果高度依赖特定硬件（Jetson Orin Nano）、特定任务与数据集，符号稳定性虽经种子敏感性分析验证，但结论向其他设备、模型族与任务的泛化性仍需进一步验证。

title: Learning Source Acquisition Policies by Offline Planning
summary: Predicting under an acquisition budget requires choosing feature groups whose value can depend on later queries. O-MPAC transfers finite-horizon risk-cost targets from complete training records into a shared source-action scorer. At inference time, the scorer uses partial observations and source metadata, re-scores after each query, and applies a hard cost mask. We analyze how tied teacher targets and the remaining planning horizon affect the learned decisions. Uniform supervision over tied minima preserves the target distribution under source relabeling. In a five-seed routing experiment, it achieves 0.965 accuracy under both original and context-last orders. On six real tasks, validation selects H1 without action cross-entropy in all thirty splits. O-MPAC has the highest mean budget-integrated accuracy on five tasks against source-adapted GDFS, DIME, AACO+NN and a static policy.

AI.tldr: O-MPAC 提出一种在采集预算约束下进行特征组选择的方法：把有限时域的"风险-成本"目标从完整训练记录蒸馏到一个共享的"来源-动作"打分器中，使推理时能基于部分观测与来源元数据逐步查询、每次查询后重新打分，并施加硬性成本掩码。
AI.motivation: 在有限采集预算下预测时，需要决定先查询哪些特征组；关键困难在于某个特征组的价值依赖于后续还会查询什么（即"价值的顺序依赖性"），因此简单的静态或贪心策略难以最优。该问题在成本敏感的感知/诊断/路由等场景中有实际意义：查询本身有成本，需在预算内最大化准确率。
AI.method: 方法核心是 O-MPAC：将完整训练记录上的有限时域风险-成本（risk-cost）目标迁移（监督）到一个共享的打分器中，该打分器以"来源（source）"与候选"动作（action，即是否/选哪个特征组）"为输入。推理时，打分器利用当前部分观测和来源元数据，在每次查询后重新打分；并通过硬成本掩码（hard cost mask）屏蔽违反预算的动作。论文还分析了并列教师目标（tied teacher targets）与剩余规划时域（remaining planning horizon）对学习决策的影响，并提出对并列最小值做均匀监督（uniform supervision over tied minima），从而在来源重标注（source relabeling）下保持目标分布不变。
AI.result: 在一个五随机种子的路由（routing）实验中，O-MPAC 在"原始顺序"和"上下文最后（context-last）顺序"下均达到 0.965 的准确率。在六个真实任务上，验证集在全部三十个划分（30 splits）中都选择了 H1（不含动作交叉熵的配置）。与经过来源适配的 GDFS、DIME、AACO+NN 以及静态策略相比，O-MPAC 在五个任务上取得最高的"预算积分准确率"（mean budget-integrated accuracy）。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于：将有限时域风险-成本目标蒸馏为可复用的来源-动作打分器、支持逐次查询的重打分与硬预算掩码，并给出并列目标下的均匀监督以保证重标注下目标分布的一致，同时在路由与六个真实任务上相对 GDFS/DIME/AACO+NN 及静态策略取得更优的预算积分准确率。局限方面，摘要未给出任务规模、成本/风险的具体设定与理论最优性保证，其泛化性与对来源元数据质量的依赖仍需进一步验证。

title: A Vision Based Framework Integrating Attention and Action Cues for Interpretable Cognitive Workload Assessment in Human Robot Collaborative Assembly
summary: The introduction of human-robot collaboration (HRC) in industrial assembly operations is revolutionizing the manufacturing landscape. In this evolving environment, operators are required to seamlessly coordinate their manual tasks with real-time task information and robotic behaviors. These demands fluctuate during operation, yet conventional workload assessments depend on body-worn physiological sensors that complicate practical deployment. Here, we present a vision-based attention--action framework for continuous and interpretable workload-related assessment in HRC assembly. The framework combines RGB-D observations with robot states and calibrated task-related areas to construct a temporally confirmed representation of operator behavior. This representation identifies where task demand is concentrated and explains how it develops when attention and action diverge, the task context changes, or the operator hesitates. We evaluated the framework in a three-level collaborative gearbox assembly experiment with ten participants, using subjective ratings and synchronized physiological signals as independent references. Raw NASA-TLX ratings confirmed increasing perceived workload across conditions, with significant effects on overall workload and its mental and temporal dimensions. The vision-derived HRC-CWL output was significantly associated with ECG-derived features in seven of nine participants with complete correlation data. Synchronized interaction episodes further showed temporal correspondence between detected hesitation and physiological activity. Real-time deployment demonstrated that the framework can operate without requiring operators to wear additional sensors. These findings support HRC-CWL as an interpretable behavioral proxy for cognitive ergonomics analysis and adaptive robot assistance, rather than a direct psychophysiological measure of workload.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于视觉的"注意力—动作"（attention–action）框架，融合RGB-D观测、机器人状态与标定任务区域，构建时序确认的操作员行为表征，实现对人在协作（HRC）装配中认知工作负荷的连续、可解释评估，无需佩戴生理传感器。
AI.motivation: 在工业装配的人机协作（HRC）中，操作员需实时协调手动任务、任务信息与机器人行为，其工作负荷在作业过程中动态波动。传统工作负荷评估依赖穿戴式生理传感器（如ECG、EEG等），在实际产线部署中成本高、干扰操作，难以规模化应用。因此论文希望提供一种非侵入、可实时部署且具可解释性的认知工效学评估手段，以支撑自适应机器人辅助。
AI.method: 1）多源输入：RGB-D视觉观测 + 机器人状态 + 经标定的任务相关区域（task-related areas）。2）"注意力—动作"分解：将操作员行为在时空上构建为时序确认（temporally confirmed）的表征，用以表达"任务需求集中在哪里"（注意力指向）以及"当注意力与动作发生分离、任务情境转变或操作员出现犹豫时需求如何演变"。3）输出 HRC-CWL（协作工作负荷）指标作为行为代理量。4）实时部署，无需操作员额外佩戴传感器。
AI.result: 实验为三级协作齿轮箱装配任务，10名被试。参考基准：原始NASA-TLX主观评分与同步生理信号。结果：NASA-TLX确认工作负荷随条件等级显著上升，总体负荷及心理、时间维度均具显著效应；视觉导出的HRC-CWL在9名具备完整相关性数据的被试中有7名与ECG导出的特征显著相关；同步交互片段显示检测到的"犹豫"与生理活动存在时间对应关系。实时部署验证了无附加传感器的可运行性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出一个融合视觉、机器人状态与任务区域的可解释注意力—动作框架，将HRC中的工作负荷评估转化为无需穿戴设备的行为代理指标。意义在于支撑认知工效学分析与自适应机器人辅助。局限：作者明确指出HRC-CWL是行为代理（behavioral proxy），而非对工作负荷的心理生理直接测量；样本量较小（10人、其中9人有完整相关性数据），结论普适性有待更大规模与更多任务类型验证。

title: SPARK: Representation-Level KV Memory Alignment for Safer Vision-Language Models
summary:
Vision-language models (VLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreaks that distribute harmful intent across text and images, making unimodal safety mechanisms insufficient. We investigate whether this vulnerability can be mitigated directly in the multimodal key-value (KV) memory formed during prefill, without modifying model parameters at inference time. We introduce SPARK, a two-stage framework for targeted KV-memory repair. Stage 1 uses a disposable diagnostic adapter to identify harm-associated directions in multimodal key and value representations. Stage 2 projects out these directions, learns a lightweight residual repair, and anchors repaired keys with an image-structural prior to preserve visual grounding. Rather than applying the intervention uniformly, SPARK mixes repaired and original memory using a head-wise coefficient g_h* determined by intervention-relevant subspace energy E_h, requiring no explicit harm classifier at inference.
  Across LLaVA-OneVision-7B, Chameleon-7B, Qwen2-VL-7B, and InternVL2-4B, SPARK reduces multimodal attack success while preserving general capability. On LLaVA-OneVision-7B, image-only jailbreak attack success falls to 4.7%, while MMMU remains within 0.6 points of the undefended model (47.8 vs. 48.4) with near-baseline language quality. On MM-SafetyBench, attack success decreases from 39.2% to 12.4%. Even under white-box adaptive joint prompt-image attacks, attack success is limited to 20.3%, compared with 54.6% for the undefended model. These results suggest that multimodal jailbreak behavior can be substantially mitigated by selectively repairing intervention-relevant KV subspaces at prefill, particularly when harmful evidence is carried by the visual modality.

AI.tldr: SPARK 是一个两阶段的多模态 KV 记忆修复框架，在推理阶段不修改模型参数的前提下，通过在 prefill 阶段识别并投影去除多模态 key/value 表征中的"有害方向"，并用头级系数混合修复与原始记忆，从而显著降低视觉语言模型的多模态越狱攻击成功率，同时保持通用能力与语言质量。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）面临将有害意图分散在文本与图像之间的越狱攻击，使得仅针对单一模态的安全机制失效。论文旨在探索能否在推理时（prefill 阶段）直接修复多模态 KV 记忆，而无需重新训练或修改模型参数，从而提供一种轻量、可插拔的安全缓解方案。这尤其重要，因为有害证据可能由视觉模态承载，而现有单模态防御难以捕捉跨模态的联合威胁。
AI.method: SPARK 是一个两阶段 KV 记忆修复框架。阶段一：使用一次性的诊断适配器（disposable diagnostic adapter）在多模态 key 与 value 表征中定位与"有害"相关的方向（harm-associated directions）。阶段二：将这些方向投影去除（project out），学习一个轻量级残差修复（residual repair），并用图像结构先验（image-structural prior）锚定修复后的 keys，以保留视觉定位（visual grounding）能力。关键创新在于不统一施加干预，而是基于与干预相关的子空间能量 E_h 计算头级系数 g_h*，对修复后的记忆与原始记忆进行混合，因此推理时无需显式的有害分类器。
AI.result: 在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B、Chameleon-7B、Qwen2-VL-7B 和 InternVL2-4B 四个模型上评估，SPARK 均降低多模态攻击成功率并保持通用能力。在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 上，纯图像越狱攻击成功率降至 4.7%，MMMU 分数与未防御模型相差在 0.6 分以内（47.8 vs. 48.4），语言质量接近基线。在 MM-SafetyBench 上，攻击成功率从 39.2% 降至 12.4%。即使在白盒自适应联合 prompt-image 攻击下，攻击成功率也被限制在 20.3%，而未防御模型为 54.6%。
AI.conclusion: 论文主要贡献是提出 SPARK，证明通过选择性修复 prefill 阶段中与干预相关的 KV 子空间，可显著缓解多模态越狱行为，尤其当有害证据由视觉模态承载时。方法无需推理时参数修改，具有良好的通用性与可移植性。可能局限包括：依赖一次性诊断适配器质量、白盒自适应攻击下仍残留 20.3% 成功率、以及在更大模型与更多模态组合上的泛化性尚需验证。

title: Nonparametric Variance-Penalized Actor-Critic: Statistical Inference for Risk-Sensitive Reinforcement Learning
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Variance penalization is a principled approach to risk-sensitive reinforcement learning (RL) that explicitly trades expected return for policy stability. Existing methods require a dedicated second critic to estimate return variance online, adding architectural complexity and compounding estimation error during learning. We propose a nonparametric variance-penalized actor-critic (VPAC) framework that replaces the variance critic with statistically grounded online estimators based on bootstrapping and random scaling, techniques drawn from the statistical inference literature for stochastic approximation. These estimators require no auxiliary network, maintain a single-critic architecture, and produce variance penalties that are bounded by construction, enabling clean convergence analysis. We establish almost-sure convergence for both a variance-penalized Q-learning algorithm and a two-timescale actor-critic variant via the ordinary differential equation (ODE) method, requiring only that variance estimates remain bounded rather than consistent. Empirically, we evaluate across discrete and continuous stochastic environments, demonstrating that the proposed methods match or exceed the variance reduction achieved by the existing dual-critic VPAC baseline while eliminating the overhead of a second critic. We further validate on a high-temperature superconductor (HTS) manufacturing case study, where VPAC-RS (Random Scaling) achieves a 74% reduction in steady-state critical current variability and a 63% reduction in episode return standard deviation, translating directly to improved yield consistency. Our results establish nonparametric statistical inference as a practical and theoretically sound alternative to auxiliary critics for risk-sensitive RL.

AI.tldr: 提出非参数方差惩罚演员-评论家框架（VPAC），用基于自举（bootstrapping）与随机缩放（random scaling）的在线统计估计器替代专用方差评论家网络，在不增加辅助网络的前提下实现风险敏感强化学习，并给出几乎必然收敛的理论保证。
AI.motivation: 方差惩罚是一种有原则的风险敏感强化学习方法，通过显式地在期望回报与策略稳定性之间做权衡，有助于提升策略在随机环境中的稳定性与可靠性。然而现有方法通常需要一个专门的"第二评论家"来在线估计回报方差，这带来两个问题：一是架构复杂度增加，二是方差估计本身的误差会在学习过程中不断累积、与主评论家的估计误差相互耦合，影响学习质量。因此，论文的动机是寻找一种不需要辅助网络、同时具备理论可分析性的方差估计方式，将风险敏感RL从"依赖额外网络拟合"转向"依赖统计推断工具"，从而降低实现成本并提升理论清晰度。
AI.method: 论文提出非参数方差惩罚演员-评论家（VPAC）框架。核心思路是用源自随机逼近统计推断文献的在线估计器替换方差评论家：一类基于bootstrapping（自举重采样）构造方差估计，另一类基于random scaling（随机缩放，即VPAC-RS），二者均为非参数方法，不需要额外参数化网络，因此整个学习系统保持单评论家架构。由于这些估计器在构造上使方差惩罚项天然有界，论文得以借助常微分方程（ODE）方法进行收敛性分析：分别为方差惩罚Q-learning算法与双时间尺度（two-timescale）演员-评论家变体证明了几乎必然收敛，且收敛条件仅要求方差估计保持有界，而无需其一致（consistent）——这是相比依赖方差评论家的方法在理论要求上的放松。整体上，方法将风险敏感目标中的方差项改写为由在线统计量直接给出的惩罚，从而在算法结构、理论分析与实现复杂度三方面同时简化。
AI.result: 实验覆盖离散与连续状态的随机环境，比较对象是已有的双评论家VPAC基线，评价指标主要是方差削减程度（以及回报标准差等风险度量）。结果显示，所提方法在方差削减效果上达到或超过双评论家基线，同时省去了第二个评论家带来的计算与架构开销。论文进一步给出高温超导体（HTS）制造案例研究，其中VPAC-RS（随机缩放）将稳态临界电流的变异性降低74%，episode回报标准差降低63%，论文指出这一改善可直接转化为良率一致性的提升。理论部分则通过ODE方法给出了方差惩罚Q-learning与双时间尺度演员-评论家的几乎必然收敛性证明。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献是：提出单评论家、非参数的方差惩罚演员-评论家框架，用bootstrapping与random scaling等在线统计估计器取代专用方差评论家，并从理论上证明了相关算法的几乎必然收敛（仅需方差估计有界）。其意义在于把非参数统计推断确立为辅助评论家之外的一种实用且理论可靠的风险敏感RL替代方案，并在真实工业（HTS制造）场景中验证了方差削减到良率一致性的转化。可能的局限在于：论文聚焦风险敏感RL而非感知任务，未涉及事件相机、视觉感知或小目标检测等方向；实验规模以标准随机环境和单一工业案例为主；收敛性分析依赖有界性假设而非估计一致性，估计器的统计效率与实际方差惩罚的紧致程度仍需进一步考察。

title: Distributed Safe Cooperative Vector Field for Trajectory Curvature Constrained Multi-Robot Systems
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures. Best Student Paper Award at the 9th Chinese Conference on Swarm Intelligence and Cooperative Control (CCSICC 2025)
summary: Trajectory curvature constraints are inherent in practical multi-robot systems due to the limited turning capabilities of the robots. Without properly accounting for these constraints, robots may fail to accomplish assigned tasks, and their trajectories may diverge from the intended paths. This paper proposes a distributed safe cooperative vector field approach for multi-robot systems subject to trajectory curvature constraints. The proposed approach is composed of a cooperative vector field and a safety-oriented collision avoidance vector field, aiming to address the problems of cooperative motion and safe collision avoidance in multi-robot path-following tasks. A safety-oriented collision avoidance vector field with adaptively adjustable reactive boundary is developed to accommodate the kinematic curvature constraints of robots, thereby ensuring the physical feasibility of collision avoidance maneuvers. The proposed vector field requires only a single virtual variable from each neighboring robot to achieve cooperative motion and ensure both obstacle avoidance and inter-robot collision avoidance. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated through both simulations and real-world experiments on an actual multi-robot platform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分布式安全协同矢量场（cooperative vector field）方法，用于解决受轨迹曲率约束的多机器人路径跟随任务，通过引入自适应可调反应边界的避碰矢量场，在保证协同运动的同时确保避障与机器人间避碰的物理可行性。
AI.motivation: 实际多机器人系统由于机器人转向能力有限，普遍存在轨迹曲率约束。若路径规划与协同控制不加以考虑这些运动学约束，机器人可能无法完成指定任务，且实际轨迹会偏离期望路径。因此，如何在分布式框架下同时兼顾协同运动、避障、机器人间避碰以及曲率约束的物理可行性，是亟需解决的问题。
AI.method: 提出方法由两部分矢量场构成：(1) 协同矢量场（cooperative vector field），负责多机器人路径跟随任务中的协同运动；(2) 面向安全的避碰矢量场（safety-oriented collision avoidance vector field），其关键创新是设计了可自适应调整的反应边界（adaptively adjustable reactive boundary），以适配机器人的运动学曲率约束，从而保证避碰机动的物理可行性。值得注意的是，该方法在协同运动中每个机器人仅需来自邻居机器人的单个虚拟变量（single virtual variable）即可实现协同，同时兼具障碍物避让与机器人间避碰能力，体现了通信高效的分布式特性。整体为分布式架构，无需集中式协调。
AI.result: 论文通过仿真和真实多机器人平台上的实验验证了所提方法的有效性。摘要未给出具体的数据集、评价指标或定量对比结果，主要结论为方法在仿真与实际平台上均能实现满足曲率约束的安全协同路径跟随。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出一种同时处理协同运动与安全避碰的分布式矢量场方法，并通过自适应反应边界显式适配机器人的曲率约束，且仅需邻居间的单个虚拟变量实现协同。其意义在于提升多机器人系统在受限转向能力下的任务完成度与运动可行性。摘要未披露定量指标、对比基线与局限性讨论，方法的可扩展性、通信拓扑假设及实验规模等仍有待正文进一步说明。

title: Sparsity-Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization
summary: Deploying deep neural networks in real-world settings requires models that are both compact and robust to common corruptions. However, at deployment-relevant high sparsity, standard pruning pipelines often degrade corruption robustness, and existing sharpness-aware training/pruning approaches provide limited robustness gains. We address this issue by introducing Sparsity-Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SA-SAM), which derives a sparsity-dependent SAM/ASAM perturbation radius by keeping the mean absolute perturbation (an $\ell_1$-based proxy) approximately invariant as sparsity increases. As a simple complementary option, we evaluate Magnitude-Weighted Hessian (MWH), derived from a second-order removal-path analysis, yielding an importance proportional to $\mathrm{Diag}(F)_i\,|w_i|$, where $\mathrm{Diag}(F)$ is the diagonal empirical Fisher used as a curvature proxy in our implementation. Across CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, and ImageNet-100-C, our approach achieved stronger corruption robustness than the considered pruning baselines at 80--90\% sparsity, while preserving clean accuracy. We additionally quantify the robustness--throughput trade-off by reporting measured inference throughput under sparse execution at deployment-relevant sparsity levels.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Sparsity-Adaptive Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SA-SAM)，通过让平均绝对扰动（ℓ1 代理）在稀疏度增加时近似保持不变，推导出与稀疏度相关的 SAM/ASAM 扰动半径；同时评估了基于二阶移除路径分析的 Magnitude-Weighted Hessian (MWH) 重要性准则，从而在部署相关的高稀疏度下同时保持干净精度与损坏鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现实部署要求神经网络既紧凑又能抵抗常见损坏（corruption）。然而在部署相关的高稀疏度（如 80–90%）下，标准剪枝流程往往导致损坏鲁棒性下降，而现有的 sharpness-aware 训练/剪枝方法带来的鲁棒性提升有限。因此需要一种能在高稀疏度下缓解鲁棒性退化、同时不牺牲干净精度的剪枝/训练策略。
AI.method: 核心方法为 SA-SAM：推导稀疏度依赖的 SAM/ASAM 扰动半径，其动机是在稀疏度上升时保持平均绝对扰动（ℓ1 代理）近似不变，从而避免高稀疏度下扰动相对于权重尺度的失衡。作为简单互补选项，论文提出 Magnitude-Weighted Hessian (MWH)，由二阶移除路径分析导出，重要性度量为 Diag(F)_i·|w_i|，其中 Diag(F) 为实现中用作曲率代理的对角经验 Fisher。整体可视为将 sharpness-aware 目标与稀疏化流程结合的自适应半径方案。
AI.result: 在 CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C 和 ImageNet-100-C 上评估，在 80–90% 稀疏度下，方法相较所考虑的剪枝基线取得更强的损坏鲁棒性，同时保持干净精度。论文还报告了部署相关稀疏度级别下稀疏执行的实测推理吞吐量，用以量化鲁棒性—吞吐量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出 SA-SAM（稀疏度自适应扰动半径）与 MWH 重要性准则，缓解了高稀疏度剪枝下的损坏鲁棒性退化问题，并在多个 C 型损坏基准上验证有效性，同时给出吞吐量测量。潜在局限：扰动不变性依据 ℓ1 代理近似、MWH 使用对角 Fisher 作为曲率近似，且实验集中在中小规模数据集（最高 ImageNet-100），更大大规模模型与真实部署场景有待验证。

title: Communication-Efficient LLM Adaptation over Decentralized GPU Meshes
summary: Decentralized training enables large-model training over low-end GPUs and internet-grade connections, but communication along both data-parallel and pipeline-parallel axes becomes the primary bottleneck. We study post-pretraining adaptation in this setting. We propose an asynchronous two-circuit system: a fast compressed training circuit drives throughput using activation masking for pipeline-parallel (PP) transfer and compressed data-parallel (DP) synchronization, while a slow anchor circuit runs occasional unmasked forward--backward passes off the critical path. Then, we introduce a spectral correction optimizer that uses these delayed anchor priors to denoise masked gradients without blocking the fast stream. Although prior work has found aggressive activation compression unreliable, we show that masking supports post-pretraining adaptation at high compression rates when anchored this way. Pipeline-parallel compression alone yields up to a $9\times$ throughput gain, and combining it with data-parallel compression increases beyond $40\times$ over internet-grade $\sim 200$Mbps connections, while matching dense uncompressed performance across domain adaptation and continual pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于去中心化训练的异步双回路系统：快速回路利用激活掩码实现流水线并行（PP）传输压缩与数据并行（DP）同步压缩以提升吞吐，慢速锚定回路在关键路径外执行少量未掩码的前向-反向传播，并配合"谱校正优化器"利用延迟的锚定先验对掩码梯度去噪，从而在互联网级带宽下实现高压缩率的后预训练适配。
AI.motivation: 大规模模型训练日益依赖去中心化、低端 GPU 与普通互联网连接，但数据并行与流水线并行两个维度上的通信成为主要瓶颈。已有的激进激活压缩方案被证明不可靠，难以在保持精度的同时大幅降低通信量。因此，作者关注"后预训练适配"（post-pretraining adaptation）场景，希望在极低带宽（约 200Mbps）下仍能达到接近无压缩稠密训练的性能。
AI.method: 提出异步双回路架构：(1) 快速压缩训练回路，通过激活掩码（activation masking）压缩流水线并行的中间激活传输，同时对数据并行梯度进行压缩同步，驱动训练吞吐；(2) 慢速锚定回路，在关键路径之外偶尔执行未掩码的前向-反向传播，产生"锚定先验"。进一步设计谱校正优化器（spectral correction optimizer），利用这些延迟的锚定先验在频域对掩码引起的梯度噪声进行校正/去噪，且不阻塞快速流。关键在于用锚定机制补偿激进激活压缩带来的信息损失。
AI.result: 在互联网级约 200Mbps 连接条件下，仅使用流水线并行压缩即可获得最高约 9 倍吞吐提升；结合数据并行压缩后吞吐提升超过 40 倍。在域适配（domain adaptation）与持续预训练（continual pretraining）任务上，达到与稠密、无压缩基线相匹配的性能。实验表明激活掩码在高压缩率下可用于后预训练适配，这与先前认为激进激活压缩不可靠的结论形成对比。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献包括：验证了在锚定机制支持下高压缩率激活掩码对后预训练适配的可行性，提出异步双回路系统与谱校正优化器，并在低带宽去中心化训练中实现显著吞吐增益且性能不降。意义在于推动低端 GPU 与互联网连接上的大模型训练/适配。局限在于：方法聚焦后预训练适配而非从零预训练，未明确说明模型规模、任务多样性及锚定回路的额外计算与延迟开销影响。

title: Low Clearance Hinge Joint Mechanism Based on 3D Printing on Sheet Fabrication Methodology
summary: This paper presents a low-clearance hinge joint mechanism based on the 3D printing on sheet fabrication method. This approach simplifies the fabrication of hinge mechanisms and overcomes limitations of conventional origami manufacturing by eliminating the need for adhesives commonly used during assembly, making it suitable for robots at the tens-of-centimeters scale. The advantages and disadvantages of three types of hinge joint mechanisms are compared, and a hinge joint that can be designed with low clearance for various facet thicknesses is selected. Based on the selected hinge joint, the twisting angle and bending force are analyzed, leading to the implementation of a clearance of 0.1 mm. Torsional resistance is experimentally evaluated to measure the torque required for twisting caused by plastic deformation and clearance. The results show that the torque associated with plastic deformation is sufficient to constrain the undesired degrees of freedom of the hinge joint, while the torque required for twisting due to clearance is minimal. Based on the analyzed data, the proposed hinge joint mechanism is applied to a 3-degree-of-freedom delta robot manipulator, demonstrating precise motion with low clearance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于"片材3D打印"（3D printing on sheet）的低间隙铰链关节机构，通过消除传统折纸制造中常用的胶粘剂来简化铰链制造，并将其应用于一个3自由度Delta机械臂，实现低间隙的精确运动。
AI.motivation: 折纸（origami）式机构在数十厘米尺度的机器人中具有轻量、可折叠等优势，但传统制造方法通常依赖胶粘剂进行装配，工艺复杂且限制了机构的可靠性与精度。铰链关节作为折纸机构的核心部件，其间隙（clearance）直接决定运动精度。因此，作者希望设计一种无需胶粘、可适配不同面板厚度、且具备低间隙特性的铰链机构，以提升折纸机器人的可制造性与运动性能。
AI.method: 核心方法是"片材上的3D打印"制造工艺。论文首先对比了三种铰链关节机构的优缺点，并选择出一种可为不同面板（facet）厚度设计低间隙的铰链类型。随后对该铰链的扭转角（twisting angle）与弯曲力（bending force）进行分析，据此实现0.1 mm的间隙。作者进一步通过实验评估扭转阻力（torsional resistance），分别测量由塑性变形（plastic deformation）和间隙引起的扭转所需力矩。
AI.result: 实验结果表明：由塑性变形产生的力矩足以约束铰链关节中不期望的自由度，而由间隙引起的扭转所需力矩极小。基于上述分析数据，作者将所提出的铰链关节应用于一个3自由度Delta机器人机械臂，验证了其低间隙下的精确运动能力。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献在于提出了一种无需胶粘剂、适用于数十厘米尺度机器人的低间隙铰链关节机构，并通过间隙分析、扭转阻力实验及Delta机械臂演示验证了其有效性。该方法简化了折纸机构的制造流程，同时保证了运动精度。潜在局限在于：论文未涉及感知、控制算法或动态性能等系统层面的评估，铰链的长期耐久性、疲劳特性以及在大尺度或高频驱动条件下的表现也尚待进一步验证。

title: SpermYOLO: A Coordinated YOLO-Based Detector for Accurate and Efficient Sperm and Impurity Detection in Microscopic Images
summary: Accurate sperm detection is essential for computer-assisted semen analysis, yet it remains challenging in microscopic images due to dense distributions, visually similar artifacts, and sperm-like impurities. In this paper, we propose SpermYOLO, a coordinated and compact YOLOv11-derived framework for joint sperm and impurity detection in microscopic images. SpermYOLO introduces four architectural improvements: C3k2-IDB for channel-wise discriminative feature extraction, D2SEM for spatial--spectral semantic enhancement, MFM for adaptive multi-scale feature fusion, and the DESD Head for detail-enhanced shared prediction. Experiments on the SVIA semen microscopic imaging benchmark show that SpermYOLO achieves 97.2\% sperm AP and 75.4\% impurity AP, outperforming generic detectors, dedicated sperm detection models, and improved YOLO variants. Compared with the baseline model, SpermYOLO improves sperm AP, impurity AP, $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$, and $\mathrm{mAP}_{50:95}$ by 1.6, 10.0, 5.8, and 2.7 percentage points, respectively, while preserving a lightweight model scale. Cross-scene evaluation on the SDTB testicular-biopsy microscopy benchmark shows that SpermYOLO remains effective with extremely small sperm targets and complex tissue backgrounds, achieving the highest $\mathrm{mAP}_{50}$ and $\mathrm{mAP}_{50:95}$ of 74.8\% and 31.2\%, respectively. Ablation studies and qualitative analyses further support these improvements by demonstrating the contributions of the proposed modules and showing more focused feature response patterns than the baseline model. These findings suggest that SpermYOLO is an effective and efficient approach for sperm detection in challenging microscopic imaging scenarios.

AI.tldr: SpermYOLO：一个基于 YOLOv11 的紧凑协调检测框架，联合检测显微图像中的精子与杂质，通过四个模块改进（C3k2-IDB、D2SEM、MFM、DESD Head），在 SVIA 精子显微基准上达到 97.2% 精子 AP 与 75.4% 杂质 AP，并在 SDTB 睾丸活检基准的极小目标场景下保持领先。
AI.motivation: 计算机辅助精液分析（CASA）依赖准确的精子检测，但显微图像面临三大困难：精子分布密集、伪影与精子视觉相似（visually similar artifacts）、存在类精子杂质（sperm-like impurities）。通用检测器与已有专用精子检测模型在此类密集、小目标、类间相似场景下判别能力不足，尤其是杂质检测精度低，容易产生误检并影响后续计数与质量评估。
AI.method: 方法以 YOLOv11 为基线，提出四项架构改进：(1) C3k2-IDB，用于通道维度的判别性特征提取，增强精子与视觉相似伪影/杂质之间的区分；(2) D2SEM，进行空间—光谱（spatial–spectral）语义增强，突出目标区域的语义响应；(3) MFM，自适应多尺度特征融合，应对精子尺寸差异与密集分布；(4) DESD Head，细节增强的共享预测头，提升细小目标的定位与分类精度。整体为精子与杂质联合检测（joint sperm and impurity detection），并保持轻量化模型规模。
AI.result: 在 SVIA 精液显微成像基准上，SpermYOLO 取得 97.2% 精子 AP 与 75.4% 杂质 AP，优于通用检测器、专用精子检测模型及改进的 YOLO 变体。相较基线，精子 AP、杂质 AP、mAP50、mAP50:95 分别提升 1.6、10.0、5.8 和 2.7 个百分点，且模型规模保持轻量。跨场景评估在 SDTB 睾丸活检显微基准上进行，面对极小精子目标和复杂组织背景，取得最高 mAP50 74.8% 与 mAP50:95 31.2%。消融实验与定性分析验证了各模块贡献，并显示相比基线更聚焦的特征响应模式。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是面向显微精子检测提出紧凑协调的 YOLOv11 派生框架及四个互补模块，同时实现精子与类精子杂质的联合检测，在平衡精度与模型规模方面取得明显提升（尤其杂质 AP 提升 10.0 点），并展现出跨数据集（SVIA→SDTB）与极小目标场景的泛化能力。局限在于：评估仅涵盖 SVIA 与 SDTB 两个显微基准，未涉及视频/时序信息或多物种精子形态；杂质类别定义域较窄，跨设备、跨染色协议的鲁棒性仍有待验证。

title: Multimodal deep learning from spectra for small-molecule structure identification: enhancing robustness with mixed-condition training
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Supplementary information: 17 pages, 5 figures and 10 tables, provided as an ancillary PDF. Preprint
summary: In practical molecular characterization, small-molecule structure identification benefits from complementary spectroscopic evidence, but missing, degraded, or mismatched spectra challenge multimodal models. Herein, we incorporate domain knowledge from spectroscopy and chemistry into mixed-condition training for candidate structure reranking, using a reproducible evaluation protocol and mixture-of-experts (MoE) fusion. The protocol incorporates perturbations tailored to each spectroscopic modality and chemically informed spectrum replacements to cover variations in spectral availability, quality, and consistency. A total of 79,462 test samples were evaluated across 30 predefined conditions using simulated spectra from the Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset (MSSD) for mass spectrometry (MS), infrared (IR) spectroscopy, and 1H and 13C nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), with up to 128 hard candidate structures per sample. A controlled two-by-two factorial comparison of complete-input training versus mixed-condition training and vanilla concatenation versus MoE fusion, with matched evaluation conditions, showed that mixed-condition training provided the main gains in both architectures. For MoE, mean reciprocal rank (MRR), averaged equally across conditions, increased from 0.9203 to 0.9763, a relative increase of 6.08%. Recall at rank 1 (R@1), averaged over the same conditions, increased from 89.50% to 96.36%, an increase of 6.86 percentage points and a relative increase of 7.67%. IR-only and MS/MS-only MRR increased from 0.4337 to 0.9307 and from 0.3711 to 0.8575, reaching 2.15 and 2.31 times their respective baseline values, while complete-input performance remained high. These results support integrating domain knowledge into training-condition design to improve robustness, with further gains from MoE under mixed-condition training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将光谱学与化学领域知识融入"混合条件训练"（mixed-condition training），用于多模态光谱候选分子结构重排序任务，并通过专家混合（MoE）融合提升鲁棒性。在MSSD数据集（MS、IR、1H/13C NMR）上评测30种预设条件、79,462个测试样本，MoE下MRR相对提升6.08%，R@1提升7.67%，缺失模态（IR-only、MS/MS-only）场景下MRR提升约2倍以上。
AI.motivation: 小分子结构鉴定依赖多源互补的光谱证据（质谱、红外、核磁共振等）。但真实场景中经常出现某些模态缺失、质量退化或谱图与分子不匹配的情况，导致现有多模态模型性能急剧下降。论文的动机是：与其设计更复杂的模型架构，不如从训练条件设计入手，利用光谱学与化学的领域知识构造更贴近真实失配情形的训练样本，从而提升模型在多样化和不完美观测条件下的鲁棒性，并避免评估协议不可复现的问题。
AI.method: 核心思路是为候选结构重排序（candidate structure reranking）引入领域知识驱动的混合条件训练，并对比不同融合方式。具体包括：(1) 设计可复现的评测协议，针对每种光谱模态施加定制化扰动，并采用化学信息学指导的谱图替换（chemically informed spectrum replacements），以覆盖光谱可用性、质量与一致性三个维度的变化；(2) 采用双因素（2×2）受控实验设计，比较"完整输入训练 vs. 混合条件训练"与"朴素拼接（vanilla concatenation） vs. MoE融合"两组因素在匹配评测条件下的交互效应；(3) MoE融合架构将各模态专家表示进行门控融合，替代简单的特征拼接。
AI.result: 实验基于Multimodal Spectroscopic Dataset (MSSD)的模拟光谱，涵盖MS、IR、1H NMR与13C NMR四种模态，每个样本最多128个困难候选结构，共79,462个测试样本、30个预设条件。评测指标为MRR与R@1（在条件间等权平均）。2×2对比显示：混合条件训练是两种架构下性能提升的主要来源；在MoE架构下，MRR由0.9203升至0.9763（相对+6.08%），R@1由89.50%升至96.36%（+6.86个百分点，相对+7.67%）。单模态退化条件下提升尤为显著：IR-only的MRR由0.4337升至0.9307（2.15倍），MS/MS-only的MRR由0.3711升至0.8575（2.31倍），同时完整输入条件下的性能仍保持较高水平，说明鲁棒性提升未以牺牲完备输入性能为代价。
AI.conclusion: 论文表明，将光谱学与化学领域知识编码进训练条件设计（扰动与化学合理的谱图替换）是提升多模态结构鉴定鲁棒性的有效手段，且在此训练范式下MoE融合可带来额外增益；同时提供了可复现的混合条件评测协议，便于公平比较。主要局限在于：实验使用模拟光谱而非真实实验谱，评测条件由预设扰动集合定义，可能无法完全覆盖真实退化与噪声分布；且结论主要建立在MSSD数据与重排序任务上，向其他数据集或端到端结构预测任务的泛化性尚待验证。

title: Planning in the Backbone: DiffAdapterVLA for Native Continuous Trajectory Generation with Driving VLMs
summary: Pretrained driving vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual, route, language, and driving context into rich driving priors, yet their representation objectives remain separated from continuous driving planning. Existing methods typically begin trajectory generation only after the VLM has formed a final condition, leaving depth-wise condition computation outside the stepwise formation of trajectory state. We introduce DiffAdapterVLA, which realizes Planning in the Backbone: it injects explicit trajectory tokens into selected VLM late layers, bringing trajectory state into backbone forward computation, where it co-evolves with driving conditions at different depths. Lightweight layer-wise DiffAdapters organize this computation into recursive trajectory refinement, while asymmetric joint attention preserves directed guidance from the condition stream to trajectory planning. By placing planning within existing backbone computation rather than relying on an independent trajectory planner, DiffAdapterVLA adapts only lightweight trajectory modules to turn existing driving priors into efficient continuous planning capability. NAVSIM results show that it achieves high-quality closed-loop planning with low end-to-end latency using few trainable parameters, and demonstrate that jointly evolving trajectory state and depth-wise driving conditions in VLM late-layer computation effectively realizes continuous trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: DiffAdapterVLA 提出"Planning in the Backbone"范式，将显式轨迹 token 注入 VLM 的后期层，使轨迹状态与驾驶条件在最深层前向计算中共同演化；通过轻量级层次化 DiffAdapter 实现递归轨迹精化，并用非对称联合注意力保持条件流对轨迹规划的定向引导，从而将预训练驾驶 VLM 的驾驶先验直接转化为连续闭环规划能力。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶视觉语言模型（VLM）虽已融合视觉、路线、语言与驾驶语境的丰富先验，但其表示目标与连续驾驶规划相互割裂。主流做法是等 VLM 形成最终条件表征后，再交由独立的轨迹规划器生成轨迹，导致"深度方向上的条件计算"被排除在轨迹状态的逐步形成过程之外。这一解耦带来两个问题：一是预训练先验中蕴含的层次化信息未被用于逐步细化轨迹；二是额外规划器引入参数与延迟开销，不利于实时闭环驾驶。因此作者希望让规划本身成为主干前向计算的一部分。
AI.method: 核心思路是 "Planning in the Backbone"：将显式 trajectory token 注入 VLM 选定的后期层，使轨迹状态进入主干前向计算，并在不同深度上与驾驶条件协同演化。技术上：(1) 轻量级层次化 DiffAdapter 将这一过程组织为递归式轨迹精化，即每层在已有轨迹状态基础上进行逐步去噪/细化式更新；(2) 非对称联合注意力（asymmetric joint attention）在条件流与轨迹流之间保持单向的定向引导，即条件→轨迹的信息流受约束，避免轨迹反向污染条件表征；(3) 由于规划被置于既有主干计算中，只训练少量新增的轻量轨迹模块即可将已有驾驶先验转化为连续规划能力，无需独立规划器。整体属于参数高效微调（PEFT）式设计。
AI.result: 在 NAVSIM 闭环规划基准上进行评估，结果显示该方法以较少的可训练参数实现了高质量闭环规划，并保持了较低的端到端推理延迟。实验进一步验证了：在 VLM 后期层计算中让轨迹状态与深度方向驾驶条件联合演化，可有效实现连续轨迹规划，说明将规划嵌入主干优于依赖独立规划器的解耦方案。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出把连续轨迹规划内嵌到驾驶 VLM 主干晚期层的计算中，用轻量 DiffAdapter 与非对称联合注意力实现递归轨迹精化与定向条件引导，在 NAVSIM 上以低参数、低延迟取得高质量闭环规划结果，证明"规划即主干计算"是可行且高效的。局限方面：摘要仅给出 NAVSIM 单一基准结果，未报告其他数据集或真实车辆/边缘硬件上的泛化与部署表现；对 VLM 后期层选择、DiffAdapter 层数与非对称注意力设计的敏感性也需进一步消融验证。

title: Vision-Language Models for Criterion-Level Grading of Handwritten Examinations in Outcome-Based Education
summary: Criterion-level grading connects examination performance to learning outcomes, but manual marking introduces workload and variation between markers. This study evaluates vision-language models (VLMs) for handwritten outcome-based assessment across five dimensions: accuracy, human agreement, repeated-run reliability, error concentration, and explanation quality. Using 1,982 criterion-level records from 485 undergraduate examination answers, we compare 20 configurations spanning Qwen2.5-VL, InternVL3, Pixtral, a Donut baseline, and a cascade ensemble. Evaluation setups include zero-shot prompting, few-shot prompting, partial fine-tuning, and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA). Two independent faculty markers regraded all 291 test criteria, providing a human agreement baseline on the same assessment materials. Qwen2.5-VL with LoRA achieved Quadratic Weighted Kappa (QWK) of 0.727 and mean absolute error of 0.435 marks against the examiner, compared with mean human-pair QWK of 0.551. This comparison reflects calibration to the examiner's training marks. LoRA outperformed partial fine-tuning for all three instruction-tuned VLMs, while few-shot prompting reduced QWK in every configuration with valid prompted scores. Aggregate reliability and exact repeatability diverged: intraclass correlations ranged from 0.790 to 0.874, yet 50.2-63.6% of criteria changed marks across five sampled runs. Attention-guided deletion showed no statistically significant advantage over random masking, and four faculty reviewers reached no consensus on explanation usefulness. These findings highlight the need for rubric-specific calibration, repeatable scoring, review of consequential errors, and separate validation of explanations. The released evaluation protocol supports criterion-level assessment research and grading tools with teacher oversight.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了视觉语言模型（VLM）在手写答案的准则级（criterion-level）成果导向评分中的表现，覆盖准确率、人机一致性、重复运行可靠性、错误集中度与解释质量五个维度。基于485份本科考试答案的1,982条准则级记录，比较20种配置（Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL3、Pixtral、Donut基线及级联集成），发现Qwen2.5-VL+LoRA达到QWK 0.727、MAE 0.435，高于人类评分者两两平均QWK 0.551，但聚合可靠性与逐条重复性出现分离，且模型解释质量未获教师共识认可。
AI.motivation: 准则级评分将考试表现与学习成果（learning outcomes）建立可解释的联系，但人工批改带来巨大工作负担以及评分者之间的差异（marker variation）。已有VLM研究多关注整体分数预测或单一准确率指标，缺乏对成果导向评估场景下细粒度准则评分的多维度可靠性验证，尤其是重复运行一致性（repeatability）与错误分布、解释可用性等对实际教学评分工具至关重要的性质未被充分考察。该问题关系到自动化评分能否在教师监督下安全落地。
AI.method: 研究构建了一个多维度VLM评分评估框架，输入为手写考试答案图像及对应评分准则（rubric），执行准则级打分。比较对象包括Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL3、Pixtral三种指令微调VLM，以及Donut基线和一个级联集成（cascade ensemble），共20种配置。适配策略涵盖zero-shot提示、few-shot提示、部分微调（partial fine-tuning）和LoRA低秩适配。评估设计包含五个维度：准确率、人类一致性、重复运行可靠性、错误集中度、解释质量。为建立人类基线，两位独立教师对全部291条测试准则重新评分。可靠性分析采用组内相关系数（ICC）与五次采样运行的逐条精确重复率；解释质量通过注意力引导删除（attention-guided deletion，与随机掩码对照）和四位教师评审进行评估。
AI.result: 在1,982条准则级记录、485份答案、291条测试准则上，Qwen2.5-VL+LoRA相对考官取得QWK 0.727与MAE 0.435分，而人类评分者两两平均QWK仅为0.551（需注意该对比反映的是模型向考官训练评分校准的结果）。LoRA在三种指令微调VLM上均优于部分微调；few-shot提示在所有产生有效提示分数的配置中均降低QWK。聚合可靠性与精确重复性出现分歧：ICC介于0.790–0.874，但50.2%–63.6%的准则在五次采样运行中发生分数变化。注意力引导删除相对随机掩码无统计显著优势，四位教师评审对解释有用性未达成共识。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出了面向准则级成果导向评估的多维度VLM评测协议，并公开该协议以支持后续研究与带教师监督的评分工具开发；实证表明LoRA优于部分微调与few-shot，同时揭示了高聚合一致性掩盖低逐条可重复性的关键问题。意义在于指出自动评分落地需要：准则特定校准、可重复打分机制、对高风险错误的审查，以及将解释质量与分数准确性分离验证。局限包括：评价仅限485份本科考试答案与单一学科/考官校准范式，人类基线仅两位评分者，解释质量缺乏教师共识因而难以定量定论，且QWK优于人类的结论受校准效应影响而不可直接外推。

title: Towards Identifying the Dataset Biases Causing Phantom Transfer
summary: Recent work has shown that a teacher model can transfer a bias to a student through a dataset from which every explicit reference to that bias has been filtered out, and that no data-level defense reliably removes or detects it even when knowing what bias to look for. Aiming to shed light on the hidden traces of these biases, we show that a simple signature based on Sentence BERT embeddings can identify the topic of such a bias with a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.83 if the teacher model used by the attacker is known and 0.46 if it is not. Additionally, we observe that different teacher models appear to express the same bias through different vocabulary.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究“教师模型通过数据蒸馏向学生模型传递隐蔽偏见”的现象，提出一种基于 Sentence BERT 嵌入的简单签名（signature）来检测这种被过滤掉显式引用的隐性偏见主题，并发现不同教师模型会用不同词汇表达同一偏见。
AI.motivation: 此前的相关工作表明：即使从数据集中过滤掉所有对某一偏见的显式引用，教师模型仍能通过该数据集将这种偏见转移给学生模型；而且没有任何数据层面的防御手段能够可靠地移除或检测这种偏见，即便防御方已知要寻找的偏见是什么。这种“隐藏痕迹”对模型安全、数据治理和可信 AI 构成威胁，因此作者希望揭示这些隐性偏见在数据中留下的可被识别的痕迹，为检测提供新的思路。
AI.method: 方法上，作者并未依赖传统的偏见词表或显式触发词检测，而是构建了一个“签名”（signature）：使用 Sentence BERT 对（被传递偏见的）文本数据进行嵌入表示，再利用该嵌入来推断数据中隐含的偏见主题（topic）。也就是说，签名刻画的是句子级语义嵌入空间中与特定偏见主题相关联的模式，而不再依赖于任何偏见相关的显式词汇。实验进一步对比了两种情形：攻击者使用的教师模型已知，以及教师模型未知。
AI.result: 实验以 Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) 作为主题识别性能指标。结果显示：当教师模型已知时，该签名识别偏见主题的 MCC 达到 0.83；当教师模型未知时，MCC 下降至 0.46。此外，作者观察到不同教师模型往往通过不同的词汇来传达相同的偏见，说明偏见的语义表达会随教师模型而变化，这解释了为何仅靠词汇层面检测手段难以奏效，也支持了使用语义嵌入签名的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 本文的主要贡献在于揭示了教师模型到学生模型的偏见传递会在数据中留下可检测的语义痕迹，并提出一种基于 Sentence BERT 嵌入的简单签名方法，在已知/未知教师模型两种设定下分别取得 0.83 与 0.46 的 MCC。其意义在于为隐蔽（latent）偏见传递的检测提供了低成本且有效的方向，并指出“同一偏见、不同词汇”这一现象。局限方面：当教师模型未知时检测性能明显下降（MCC 仅 0.46），说明该签名在现实威胁模型下的泛化能力仍有限；实验仅报告了 MCC 指标、未展示更多数据集与评估细节，且方法仍属事后检测而非防御，难以从根本上去除偏见。

title: Assistance Torque Estimation via Dynamics-Aware Optimization for Lower-Limb Exoskeleton in Complex Environments
summary: Ground-truth human joint torque estimation relies on motion capture systems, which suffer from limited outdoor usability and significant deployment expenses. Furthermore, direct scaling of ground-truth joint torques to obtain motor torque commands is not necessarily the optimal strategy. To address the aforementioned limitations, inspired by the human motion generation process, this paper proposes a novel assistance torque estimation method based on the dynamic model. From an optimization perspective, the proposed method directly generates motor-assist torque and lowers the cost of data acquisition. Then, a data-driven assistance torque prediction network is trained to enable accurate real-time prediction under complex outdoor environments. Experimental results demonstrate that optimized (estimated) assistance torque exhibits better phase consistency with gait trajectories and better alignment with task characteristics. Relative to the Zero torque condition, the predicted torque can decrease metabolic rate by 11.8%-17.7%, heart rate by 8.9%-14.3%, and peak muscle activation levels by 28.2%-54.0%, respectively. This provides a new perspective for low-cost adaptive exoskeleton assistance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于动力学模型的辅助力矩估计方法，从优化视角直接生成电机辅助力矩，避免依赖昂贵的运动捕捉地面真值，并训练数据驱动网络实现复杂户外环境下的实时辅助力矩预测，用于低成本自适应外骨骼控制。
AI.motivation: 传统人体关节力矩的地面真值估计依赖运动捕捉系统（motion capture），其户外可用性差、部署成本高昂。此外，直接将地面真值关节力矩按比例缩放以生成电机力矩命令并非最优策略。这些限制使得低成本、可在户外使用的自适应外骨骼辅助难以实现，因此需要一种既能降低数据采集成本、又能直接产生更优电机辅助力矩的方法。
AI.method: 受人类运动生成过程启发，作者提出一种基于动力学模型（dynamic model）的辅助力矩估计方法。从优化角度出发，该方法不经过“先估计人体关节力矩、再缩放映射”的间接流程，而是直接生成电机辅助力矩，从而降低数据采集成本并避免缩放次优问题。随后训练一个数据驱动的辅助力矩预测网络，使模型能够在复杂户外环境下进行准确的实时预测，实现自适应外骨骼辅助控制。
AI.result: 实验表明，优化（估计）得到的辅助力矩与步态轨迹具有更好的相位一致性，并与任务特征更贴合。相较于 Zero torque 条件，所预测的力矩可使代谢率降低 11.8%–17.7%，心率降低 8.9%–14.3%，峰值肌肉激活水平降低 28.2%–54.0%。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于：提出从优化视角直接生成电机辅助力矩的动力学模型方法，降低地面真值数据采集成本，并结合数据驱动网络实现户外实时预测，验证了其在代谢率、心率和肌肉激活方面的显著改善，为低成本自适应外骨骼辅助提供了新思路。可能的局限在于：文摘未说明所用数据集规模、受试者数量与多样性，也未给出户外环境泛化性的量化评估，实时预测网络的鲁棒性与安全性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Robust low-rank tensor completion via factorized weighted tensor schatten-p norm minimization
summary: Low-rank tensor factorization provides a flexible framework for completing multidimensional data from incomplete and corrupted observations. However, unweighted spectral regularizers impose a common shrinkage profile across singular components, which may excessively attenuate dominant low-rank components, and factorized variants either lack component-specific weighting or require costly singular value decompositions (SVDs). This paper proposes two weighted Schatten-$p$ tensor factorization models, termed \WSpTFI{} and \WSpTFII{}, under the tensor-tensor product (t-product) framework to address these limitations. \WSpTFI{} is motivated by a factorized weighted tensor Schatten-$p$ norm identity and permits flexible, possibly asymmetric factor exponents. \WSpTFII{} constructs a regularizer from transform-domain column-pair energies, yielding SVD-free main factor updates and a column-pruning mechanism for reducing redundant rank components. This paper further develops an iteratively reweighted alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM)-type scheme for \WSpTFI{} and an iteratively reweighted least squares (IRLS)--block successive upper-bound minimization (BSUM) scheme for \WSpTFII{}. Theoretical analysis establishes the weighted factorization relation and provides a conditional limiting Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) characterization for \WSpTFI{}. For \WSpTFII{}, the actual damped quadratic block updates yield a quantitative sufficient-decrease mechanism for the fixed-$δ$ smoothed factor objective. This implies asymptotic regularity, and every accumulation point of the fixed-dimensional tail is stationary. Experiments on synthetic tensor completion, color-image restoration, hyperspectral inpainting, and printed-circuit-board defect detection demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality and robustness under various degradation conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种加权 Schatten-$p$ 张量分解模型 WSpTFI 与 WSpTFII，在 t-product 框架下实现分量自适应加权的低秩张量补全。WSpTFI 基于分解式加权张量 Schatten-$p$ 范数恒等式，支持非对称因子指数；WSpTFII 由变换域列对能量构造正则项，实现免 SVD 的主因子更新与列剪枝降秩机制，并分别给出 IRW-ADMM 与 IRLS-BSUM 求解方案及收敛性分析。
AI.motivation: 多维数据（图像、高光谱、缺陷检测数据等）常面临不完整与受噪声/稀疏损坏的观测，张量补全与恢复是核心问题。现有低秩张量方法存在两类缺陷：一是无权重谱正则项对所有奇异分量施加统一的收缩强度，会过度压制占主导的低秩分量，造成重建偏差；二是已有的因子化变体要么缺乏分量级别的差异化加权，要么需要昂贵的奇异值分解（SVD），限制可扩展性与实时性。
AI.method: 在 tensor-tensor product（t-product）框架下构建两个模型。WSpTFI：以分解式加权张量 Schatten-$p$ 范数恒等式为动机，将正则项作用于因子矩阵，允许各因子具有灵活乃至非对称的指数，从而对不同秩分量施加不同强度收缩；求解采用迭代重加权 ADMM 型算法，理论上建立了加权分解关系，并给出条件性极限 KKT 刻画。WSpTFII：从变换域列对能量构造正则项，避免显式 SVD，使主因子更新为免 SVD 形式，并附带列剪枝机制以剔除冗余秩分量；求解采用 IRLS-BSUM 方案，理论分析表明实际使用的阻尼二次块更新为固定 $\delta$ 平滑因子目标提供定量充分下降，进而蕴含渐近正则性，且固定维尾部的每个聚点均为驻点。
AI.result: 实验涵盖四类任务：合成张量补全、彩色图像恢复、高光谱图像 inpainting 以及印刷电路板（PCB）缺陷检测。结果表明两种模型在多种退化条件下均取得有竞争力的重建质量与鲁棒性，验证了分量自适应加权对主导低秩分量的保护作用以及 WSpTFII 免 SVD 更新与列剪枝的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出两种分量加权的 Schatten-$p$ 张量分解模型及其配套可收敛求解算法，兼顾加权灵活性与计算可行性，并提供加权分解关系、KKT 条件与驻点性等理论保障。意义在于缓解统一收缩导致的过压制问题并降低对 SVD 的依赖。局限在于 WSpTFII 的收敛结论针对固定 $\delta$ 平滑目标与固定维尾部，属条件性/渐近性结果，且实验主要集中于经典退化恢复与缺陷检测场景，尚未涉及事件相机、时序建模或实时边缘部署等动态感知任务。

title: Follow the Geometry, Not the Model: Cold Start Semi-Supervised Learning
summary:
Modern semi-supervised learning (SSL) couples pseudo-label generation and classifier training, using the classifier's own confidence to select the pseudo-labels that are then used to update the model. In the cold-start regime, where at most a few labels per class are available, this coupling is ill-posed, since the classifier cannot supervise itself before it has learned.
  To address this problem, we propose VAST (Veracity-Aware Semi-Supervised Training), which decouples these two stages. Probabilistic beliefs over the unlabeled set are first inferred directly from the geometry of a frozen self-supervised embedding and only then distilled into an inductive classifier.
  The construction rests on the Veracity Matrix, a kernel-based structure that aggregates label evidence across the data manifold and admits an interpretation as a Dirichlet posterior under a per-observation powered-likelihood model. Additionally, we introduce Veracity Propagation, a self-terminating belief-spreading step that extends coverage beyond the kernel neighborhood of the labeled set.
  Under a controlled protocol in which all methods receive identical frozen embeddings and labeled sets, VAST outperforms the strongest graph-based SSL baselines at every operating point across three datasets, with statistically significant gains in 7 of 9 comparisons, while producing a deployable inductive classifier rather than requiring transductive graph inference. Compared with end-to-end confidence-gated SSL, we further find that these methods underperform in this setting and, in our experiments, do not consistently exceed labeled-only performance.

AI.tldr: VAST（Veracity-Aware Semi-Supervised Training）将伪标签生成与分类器训练解耦：先由冻结自监督嵌入的几何结构直接推断无标注样本的概率信念（Veracity Matrix，Dirichlet 后验视角），再通过自终止的 Veracity Propagation 扩展覆盖，最后蒸馏出可归纳（inductive）分类器。在冷启动（每类仅极少标签）设定下，于三个数据集、统一的冻结嵌入与标签集协议中全面优于最强图半监督基线，9 组对比中 7 组统计显著。
AI.motivation: 现代半监督学习（SSL）把伪标签生成与分类器训练耦合在一起：用分类器自身置信度去筛选伪标签，再用这些伪标签更新模型。作者指出，在 cold-start 情形（每类至多只有几个标签）下这种耦合是"病态"（ill-posed）的——分类器在尚未学好之前无法自我监督，置信度门控会放大早期错误并形成自确认偏差。论文的动机即是在极低标签预算下打破"自举循环"，避免噪声伪标签被固化进模型。
AI.method:
1) 两阶段解耦：先用一个冻结的自监督嵌入（frozen embedding）建模无标注数据的几何结构，得到对无标注集的概率信念；随后将其蒸馏（distill）进一个可归纳的分类器，从而在推理时不依赖图结构。
2) Veracity Matrix：一种基于核（kernel-based）的矩阵结构，沿数据流形聚合标签证据，使每个无标注样本的标签支持度由邻域证据累积得到；该结构可被解释为在"逐观测幂似然（per-observation powered-likelihood）"模型下的 Dirichlet 后验。
3) Veracity Propagation：一个自终止（self-terminating）的信念传播步骤，用于把标签证据扩散到已标注集核邻域之外，扩大有效覆盖范围，缓解低标签密度下局部核覆盖不足的问题。
4) 输出为可部署的归纳分类器，而非需要测试时图推理的转导（transductive）方案。
AI.result: 实验在三个数据集上进行，并采用受控协议：所有对比方法使用完全相同的冻结嵌入与有标注集合，以保证公平性。评估主要对比最强的基于图的 SSL 基线。结果显示 VAST 在每个操作点（operating point）上都优于这些基线，9 组对比中有 7 组取得统计显著提升；同时 VAST 产出可直接部署的归纳分类器，而图方法需要转导式图推理。此外论文发现，端到端、置信度门控的 SSL 在此冷启动设定下表现更差，且在这些实验中并未稳定超过仅使用有标注数据的基线（labeled-only）。
AI.conclusion: 贡献：提出一种在冷启动半监督设定下解耦"伪标签生成—分类器训练"的框架，以 Veracity Matrix 提供具有 Dirichlet 后验解释的核化标签证据聚合，并以 Veracity Propagation 自终止地扩展标签覆盖；最终得到归纳、可部署的分类器，在受控实验中获得一致且多数据显著的增益。意义：为极低标签预算下的 SSL 提供了替代置信度自举的路径，并说明置信度门控在冷启动下不可靠。局限：方法依赖冻结自监督嵌入的质量与核/流形几何假设；验证仅覆盖三个数据集，未涉及事件相机、时序/视频或目标检测跟踪等感知任务；超参数（核尺度、传播终止条件）的敏感性及大规模场景下的计算代价未在摘要中说明。

title: Understanding User Preferences of a Slope-Aware Variable-Admittance Filter for a Robot Guide Dog
summary: This letter investigates how the parameters of a slope-aware variable-admittance filter influence user preferences in force-based interaction with a robotic guide dog for visually impaired individuals. The proposed system consists of a quadruped robot equipped with a sensor-free rigid handle for physical guidance. The framework combines path following, momentum-based interaction-wrench estimation, and a variable-admittance filter whose stiffness and damping are adapted online from slope information extracted by the robot's depth camera. The adaptation policies are evaluated through high-fidelity simulations and a human-subject study involving blindfolded sighted participants. Multiple strategies are compared using a Taguchi L9 design of experiments. Preliminary main-effect results suggest that increasing stiffness uphill and decreasing it downhill improves both objective and subjective metrics, whereas damping shows no significant main effect.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向视障人士的机器人导盲犬的力交互问题，提出一种"坡度感知的可变导纳滤波器"，其刚度和阻尼依据深度相机提取的坡度信息在线自适应调整，并通过高保真仿真与盲视受试者实验、结合田口L9正交实验设计，分析滤波参数对用户主观与客观偏好的影响。
AI.motivation: 导盲犬可显著帮助视障人士出行，但训练成本高、难以规模化，因此四足机器人导盲成为有前景的替代方案。物理引导中，用户通过刚性手柄与机器人进行力交互，滤波器参数直接决定"顺从性"与"跟随感"的平衡。然而在不同地形（尤其上下坡）下，固定的刚度/阻尼难以同时满足安全性与舒适性，参数如何设计、用户偏好如何变化尚缺乏系统研究。该问题对机器人辅助出行、人机力交互与视障辅助技术的可用性至关重要。
AI.method: 系统由四足机器人加装无传感器的刚性手柄构成，用户仅通过手柄与机器人进行物理耦合。框架包含三部分：(1) 路径跟随控制，使机器人沿规划路径行进；(2) 基于动量的交互力/力矩估计（momentum-based interaction-wrench estimation），无需力传感器即可从关节状态与机器人动力学推算用户施加的力；(3) 可变导纳滤波器，其刚度与阻尼由机器人深度相机提取的坡度信息在线调节。核心创新在于将地形坡度显式纳入导纳参数的自适应策略，并采用田口L9设计实验（正交表）系统比较多种自适应策略在上下坡情况下的表现，从而以较少实验次数分离各参数的主效应。
AI.result: 评估采用高保真仿真与包含盲视（蒙眼）视力正常受试者的人体实验两部分。使用田口L9正交实验设计比较多种参数自适应策略，评价指标涵盖客观指标（如路径跟随精度、力交互平滑度、任务表现）与主观指标（如舒适度、安全感、跟随感等用户偏好）。初步主效应结果表明：上坡时增大刚度、下坡时减小刚度可同时改善客观与主观指标；而阻尼未表现出显著主效应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出并初步验证了一种坡度感知的可变导纳控制框架，用于四足机器人导盲犬的力交互，发现"上坡增刚、下坡减刚"的刚度自适应策略对用户偏好最为有利，而阻尼影响不显著，为机器人导盲系统的参数设计提供了实证依据。意义在于以无传感器方案降低硬件成本，并以正交实验方法高效探索人机力交互参数空间。局限包括：受试者为蒙眼的视力正常者而非真实视障用户；结果基于高保真仿真与初步主效应分析，缺乏交互效应与统计显著性的充分验证；实验规模与地形范围有限，尚未覆盖更复杂地形与长期使用场景。

title: DTI-Guided Volumetric Spherical Harmonics Regression for Single-to-Multi-Shell dMRI Synthesis
summary: Multi-shell diffusion MRI (dMRI) unlocks more expressive microstructural modeling than single-shell scans, yet its longer acquisition time hinders deployment in large-scale cohorts and time-constrained clinical settings. Synthesizing an unobserved shell from a single-shell input is fundamentally ill-posed and further complicated by protocol mismatch, where source and target gradient direction sets may not align. We propose DTI-SHNet, a single-to-multi-shell synthesis framework that operates in the real symmetric spherical harmonics (SH) coefficient domain and performs spatially aware volumetric regression. Given a source shell, we estimate diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) and use direction-agnostic parametric maps along with a brain mask as conditioning priors to guide a 3D U-Net regressor from source-shell to target-shell SH coefficients. To couple coefficient accuracy with signal fidelity, we introduce a signal consistency regularization that reconstructs signals on randomly sampled canonical directions from predicted coefficients and enforces agreement in the signal domain. Experiments on UK Biobank and Cam-CAN data for b=1000 to b=2000 dMRI synthesis show that DTI-SHNet achieves competitive visual quality compared to advanced methods, while better preserving downstream diffusion measures. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiaovhua/dti-shnet.

AI.tldr: DTI-SHNet 提出一种单壳到多壳 dMRI 合成框架，在实对称球谐（SH）系数域进行空间感知的体回归，并引入信号一致性正则化，缓解采集时间与协议不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 多壳扩散 MRI 能提供比单壳更丰富的微结构建模能力，但采集时间显著更长，限制了其在大型队列与时间受限临床场景中的应用。从单壳输入合成未观测壳本质上是病态逆问题，且源与目标的梯度方向集可能不对齐（协议不匹配），进一步增加了难度。因此需要一种能够在方向无关域中建模、并保持下游扩散指标可靠的合成方法。
AI.method: 方法在实对称球谐（SH）系数域中工作，避免对具体梯度方向集的依赖，从而实现方向无关的表示与回归。首先由源壳估计扩散张量成像（DTI），得到方向无关的参量图（如各向异性/扩散率等）与脑掩膜，作为条件先验；随后以 3D U-Net 回归器将源壳 SH 系数映射到目标壳 SH 系数，进行体素级空间感知的三维回归。为兼顾系数精度与信号保真度，引入信号一致性正则化：在随机采样的典型方向上由预测系数重建信号，并在信号域施加一致性约束。
AI.result: 在 UK Biobank 与 Cam-CAN 数据集上进行 b=1000 到 b=2000 的 dMRI 合成实验。结果显示 DTI-SHNet 在视觉质量上与先进方法具有竞争力，同时在下游扩散指标的保持上表现更好，说明其在系数域回归与信号域保真之间取得了较好平衡。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出在 SH 系数域进行单到多壳合成的框架，结合 DTI 参量先验与 3D U-Net，并通过信号一致性正则化提升对下游扩散度量的保持能力，缓解协议不匹配问题。意义在于可降低多壳 dMRI 采集负担，利于大规模队列与临床部署。局限在于本质上仍是病态合成任务，性能可能受源壳信息量、协议差异与数据域偏移影响，且主要验证于特定 b 值范围。

title: Retrieval-Guided Fine-Tuning as Noisy Estimation: Risk bounds and Architectural Analysis
comment: 29 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to the NewInML Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Retrieval-Guided Fine-Tuning (RAG-FT) incorporates retrieved data directly into the training objective, but the statistical consequences of noisy retrieval during training remain theoretically undercharacterized. We study this question by modeling RAG-FT as an estimation problem in a multi-task linear regression framework, using an OLS proxy for single-layer linear self-attention to obtain finite-sample risk bounds. Under homoscedastic retrieval noise, we show that retrieval failure decays exponentially with task separation relative to noise, and derive explicit finite-sample conditions under which RAG-FT achieves lower risk than both target-only and full-corpus training. We then introduce a Distance-Proportional Noise (DPN) model, in which retrieval quality degrades with rank, and compare two estimators under the same retrieval process: the OLS proxy and the literal, uniform-weight forward pass of linear self-attention. We prove that the attention estimator's bias diverges as $Θ(n^{2q})$ even under exact retrieval, while OLS risk remains $Θ(d/n)$ for every noise exponent $q>0$. These results locate the instability not in noisy retrieval itself, but in the fixed, unweighted aggregation of the literal LSA forward pass, which reweighting by reliability empirically removes. We validate the predicted rate separation through direct simulation of the DPN model.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上研究了检索增强生成微调（RAG-FT）中检索噪声对训练统计特性的影响，将其建模为多任务线性回归中的估计问题，并利用单层线性自注意力（LSA）的OLS代理推导有限样本风险界。
AI.motivation: RAG-FT将检索数据直接纳入训练目标，但检索噪声在训练过程中的统计后果缺乏理论刻画。理解这一问题的重要性在于：检索失败、检索质量随排序衰减等实际噪声会影响微调模型的泛化与稳定性，而现有工作多停留在经验层面，缺少对风险与偏差的解析分析。论文旨在回答：在何种条件下，引入检索数据训练优于仅用目标数据或全语料训练，以及噪声如何影响估计器稳定性。
AI.method: 论文提出RAG-FT的估计问题框架：在多任务线性回归中，用OLS作为单层线性自注意力的代理来获得有限样本风险界。在同方差检索噪声假设下，证明检索失败概率随任务分离度相对噪声呈指数衰减，并给出RAG-FT风险低于目标单独训练与全语料训练的显式有限样本条件。进一步引入距离比例噪声（DPN）模型，使检索质量随排序退化，并在同一检索过程下比较两类估计器：OLS代理与线性自注意力按均匀权重的前向传播（literal LSA）。核心理论发现是：LSA估计器的偏差即使在精确检索下也以Θ(n^{2q})发散，而OLS风险对所有噪声指数q>0保持Θ(d/n)。通过DPN模型的直接仿真验证了预测的速率分离。
AI.result: 实验以DPN模型的直接数值仿真为主，验证理论预测的速率分离：OLS估计器的风险保持Θ(d/n)，而均匀加权的LSA前向传播在偏差上随n的2q次幂发散。定理给出检索失败随任务分离度指数衰减及RAG-FT相对目标单独与全语料训练的风险优势条件。仿真结果与理论界一致，表明不稳定性源于LSA前向传播中固定的无权聚合，而非检索噪声本身。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献在于将RAG-FT形式化为多任务线性回归估计问题，给出检索噪声下的有限样本风险界、检索失败的指数衰减规律，以及RAG-FT相对基线的优势条件，并识别出均匀无权聚合是LSA前向传播不稳定的根源，指出按可靠性重加权可经验性地消除该问题。意义在于为检索增强微调的噪声鲁棒性提供理论解释，并指明改进方向。局限在于：分析基于线性回归与单层线性自注意力代理，可能无法完全覆盖深度Transformer和真实RAG场景的复杂性；结论主要依赖仿真验证，尚未在大规模真实任务中系统验证。

title: From Prediction to Decision: World-Model-Guided Action Selection for Continuous Pile Excavation
summary: Wheel-loader excavation is a sequential decision problem in which every scoop changes the terrain available to subsequent actions. A practical world model must predict action consequences accurately, rank candidates in real time, and operate inside the closed loop of a full-size machine. We present the World-Action Model (WAM), which proposes multiple scoops, rejects geometrically inadmissible candidates, jointly predicts signed terrain change and loaded volume, executes the candidate with the largest predicted load, and replans from the newly observed terrain. On 32 geometry-disjoint MinSlope test episodes, adding world-model ranking to matched diffusion proposals reduces the mean scoop count from 651.8 to 540.6 (17.1%), preserves 32/32 completion, and improves every paired episode. In a complete-system comparison, WAM completes 32/32 episodes versus 29/32 for an independently trained soft actor-critic policy. Comparisons of input representations, spatial support, and five architectures identify an accurate and efficient physics-structured predictor. We further evaluate the interface on event-disjoint full-size-loader data and deploy the complete perception-proposal-prediction-selection-execution loop for autonomous excavation. The ROS2/TensorRT implementation processes five candidates in 72.4 ms on a Jetson AGX Orin. The simulation results establish decision-level gains, while the physical experiments demonstrate real-world closed-loop feasibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 World-Action Model (WAM)，将轮式装载机挖掘建模为序贯决策问题：通过扩散模型生成多个铲斗候选动作，经几何可行性筛选后，用物理结构化的世界模型联合预测地形形变与装载体积，执行预测装载量最大的候选并基于新观测地形重规划。仿真中相比匹配的扩散提议将平均铲次从 651.8 降至 540.6（17.1%），全系统对比胜过独立训练的 SAC 策略（32/32 vs 29/32），并在全尺寸装载机上完成 ROS2/TensorRT 闭环部署（Jetson AGX Orin 上 72.4 ms 处理 5 个候选）。
AI.motivation: 轮式装载机挖掘是一个典型的序贯决策问题：每次铲挖都会改变后续动作可用的地形，因此决策必须考虑动作的长期后果。实用的世界模型需同时满足三点要求：(1) 准确预测动作后果（地形变化与装载量）；(2) 实时对候选动作排序；(3) 能嵌入全尺寸真实机器的闭环控制回路中运行。现有方法（如纯强化学习策略）在高维动作空间中缺乏几何可行性约束，且难以在有限算力下实时提供可靠的后果预测，导致铲次多、完成率低、难以迁移到真实设备。
AI.method: WAM 是一个"感知—提议—预测—选择—执行"的闭环系统：(1) 提议阶段用扩散模型生成多个铲斗候选动作；(2) 几何不可行候选被显式拒绝过滤；(3) 世界模型以物理结构化的表示联合预测两项输出——有符号的地形变化（signed terrain change）与装载体积（loaded volume）；(4) 执行预测装载量最大的候选；(5) 从新观测的地形重新规划。作者还系统比较了输入表示、空间支撑域（spatial support）以及五种网络架构，以定位准确且高效的物理结构化预测器。部署侧采用 ROS2/TensorRT，在边缘平台 Jetson AGX Orin 上运行完整回路。
AI.result: 实验在 MinSlope 仿真中进行，使用 32 个几何不相交（geometry-disjoint）的测试回合。在世界模型排序的消融中，将 WAM 排序与匹配的扩散提议结合，使平均铲次从 651.8 降至 540.6（降低 17.1%），32/32 完成，且每一个配对回合均有改善。完整系统对比中，WAM 完成 32/32 回合，独立训练的 soft actor-critic 策略为 29/32。此外报告了输入表示、空间支撑域与五种架构的对比结果，筛选出准确高效的物理结构化预测器；并在事件不相交（event-disjoint）的全尺寸装载机数据上评估该接口，部署了真实自主挖掘闭环。ROS2/TensorRT 实现在 Jetson AGX Orin 上 72.4 ms 内处理 5 个候选。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献在于：把挖掘世界模型形式化为同时预测地形形变与装载体积的序贯决策组件，配合扩散提议、几何筛选与最大预测装载量选择，形成一个可实时运行的闭环系统。仿真结果确立了决策层面的收益（铲次减少、完成率提升、逐回合一致改善），物理实验则验证了全尺寸装载机上闭环部署的可行性。潜在局限包括：世界模型准确性与泛化能力的定量指标未在摘要中给出；仿真与实物之间仍存在差异，"事件不相交"评估虽提升了泛化可信度但规模有限；系统性能与 72.4 ms 的实时预算将随候选数量增长而受算力约束。

title: S3-Tracker: Self-Supervised Surgical Tissue Tracking With Contrastive Random Walks
summary: Robust point tracking in endoscopic videos is essential for computer-assisted intervention and autonomous robotic surgery, enabling continuous registration between intraoperative video and preoperative imaging despite soft tissue deformation. However, supervised tracking methods depend on large annotated datasets, while surgical conditions make reliable trajectory annotation challenging. We propose a self-supervised Track-Any-Point approach that learns from unlabeled surgical videos by establishing global pixel correspondences and inferring point trajectories through contrastive random walks. Trained without annotations, our method achieves performance comparable to existing semi-supervised approaches while implicitly handling tissue deformation. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of self-supervised point tracking in surgical environments and its potential to reduce reliance on annotated data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自监督的"Track-Any-Point"（跟踪任意点）方法，利用无标注手术视频，通过全局像素对应与对比随机游走推断点轨迹，实现内窥镜视频中的鲁棒点跟踪，性能可与现有半监督方法相当。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜视频中的鲁棒点跟踪对计算机辅助干预和自主机器人手术至关重要，可实现术中视频与术前影像之间的连续配准，即使软组织发生形变也能保持对应关系。然而，监督式跟踪方法依赖大规模标注数据集，而手术环境的复杂性（如组织变形、光照变化、遮挡）使得可靠的轨迹标注极为困难，成为该领域的主要瓶颈。因此，探索无需标注的自监督跟踪方案具有重要价值。
AI.method: 论文提出一种自监督的Track-Any-Point（跟踪任意点）框架，仅从无标注手术视频中学习。其核心思想是建立全局像素对应关系（global pixel correspondences），并通过对比随机游走（contrastive random walks）推断点轨迹。该方法在训练过程中无需任何轨迹标注，模型隐式地处理组织形变，从而避免了对显式形变建模或人工标注的依赖。
AI.result: 在无标注数据上进行训练的情况下，该方法在内窥镜视频点跟踪任务上取得了与现有半监督方法相当的性能，并能够隐式应对软组织的形变。这一结果验证了自监督点跟踪在手术环境中的可行性。（注：原文摘要未提供具体数据集名称、评估指标及定量数值。）
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于首次展示了在内窥镜/手术环境中进行自监督点跟踪的可行性，通过对比随机游走从无标注视频中学习点轨迹，性能媲美半监督方法，并有望减少对昂贵标注数据的依赖。潜在局限包括：缺乏具体的定量实验结果和数据集说明，未明确评估在严重遮挡、快速运动或长时程跟踪下的鲁棒性，以及自监督方法与全监督方法之间可能仍存在性能差距。

title: EdgeHAR: An Edge-Native Compact Sensor Foundation Model for Human Activity Recognition
summary: Sensor-based human activity recognition (HAR) is fundamental to ubiquitous and wearable computing, yet existing foundation models are largely designed for cloud-scale deployment and struggle with real-world sensing shifts, including unseen users, devices, sampling rates, and sensor placements. We present \textbf{EdgeHAR}, an edge-native compact sensor foundation model designed for wearable intelligence. Unlike conventional models that entangle activity knowledge with acquisition variations, EdgeHAR learns transferable representations by factorizing sensor signals into three latent codes: an \textbf{(i)Activity-Semantic Code} capturing reusable activity knowledge, a \textbf{(ii)Motion-Dynamics Code} modeling temporal patterns, and an \textbf{(iii)Acquisition-Context Code} representing sensor-specific variations. This disentangled design enables efficient adaptation to new users, devices, placements, and activity classes with limited target-domain data. By incorporating lightweight adaptation modules, EdgeHAR achieves foundation-model-level transferability while satisfying edge constraints in computation, memory, latency, and privacy. Experiments across heterogeneous HAR datasets demonstrate that EdgeHAR maintains competitive recognition performance under distribution shifts with substantially reduced deployment cost. EdgeHAR establishes a practical paradigm for compact, edge-first foundation models for ubiquitous sensing systems.

AI.tldr: EdgeHAR 是一个面向边缘端的紧凑型传感器基础模型，用于可穿戴传感器的人体活动识别（HAR）。其核心思想是将传感器信号解耦为三个潜在编码——活动语义码、运动动态码和采集上下文码，从而在有限目标域数据下高效适应新用户、设备、采样率与佩戴位置，同时满足边缘计算、内存、延迟与隐私约束。
AI.motivation: 现有基于传感器的人体活动识别基础模型大多面向云规模部署，参数庞大、计算开销高，难以在可穿戴/边缘设备上运行。更关键的是，真实传感场景存在显著的分布偏移：未见的用户、不同设备、不同采样率以及不同传感器佩戴位置，都会导致性能大幅下降。传统模型往往将"活动语义知识"与"采集条件变化"纠缠在一起学习，导致泛化性差、迁移代价高。因此，迫切需要一种既能具备基础模型的迁移能力、又能满足边缘约束的紧凑型模型，这对泛在可穿戴感知系统具有重要实用价值。
AI.method: EdgeHAR 采用"解耦表征 + 轻量适配"的架构设计。其核心创新是将传感器信号分解为三个独立的隐空间编码：（i）Activity-Semantic Code（活动语义码），用于捕获可复用的活动知识；（ii）Motion-Dynamics Code（运动动态码），用于建模时间/动态模式；（iii）Acquisition-Context Code（采集上下文码），用于显式表征与传感器相关的采集差异（设备、位置、采样率、用户等）。这种因子化解耦使模型能够将活动知识与采集条件分离，从而在目标域数据有限时，通过引入轻量化适配模块（lightweight adaptation modules）实现对新用户、新设备、新佩戴位置和新活动类别的高效迁移，在保持基础模型级迁移能力的同时满足边缘端在算力、内存、延迟与隐私方面的约束。
AI.result: 论文在多个异构 HAR 数据集上进行了实验评估（涵盖不同用户、设备、采样率与佩戴位置等分布偏移场景）。结果表明，EdgeHAR 在分布偏移条件下仍能保持有竞争力的识别性能，同时显著降低部署开销。实验重点验证了其解耦表征设计在跨域迁移下的有效性以及边缘部署的成本优势，不过摘要中未给出具体数据集名称、评价指标数值或与基线的详细对比数字。
AI.conclusion: EdgeHAR 提出了一种"边缘优先（edge-first）"的紧凑型传感器基础模型范式，主要贡献在于：（1）将传感器信号因子化解耦为活动语义、运动动态与采集上下文三类编码，有效分离了活动知识与采集条件变化；（2）结合轻量适配模块，在有限目标域数据下实现高效的跨用户、跨设备、跨采样率、跨位置迁移；（3）满足边缘端算力、内存、延迟与隐私约束。其意义在于为泛在感知系统提供了实用的紧凑基础模型方案。潜在局限包括：摘要未披露具体实验规模与定量指标、解耦编码在强噪声或复杂多模态传感下的稳定性、以及适配模块对极端域偏移的鲁棒性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Dynamics-Informed Reinforcement Learning for Agile and Energy-Efficient Locomotion of a Monopedal Hopping Quadcopter
summary: Although aerial-legged robots offer combined agility and efficiency, controlling high-speed hopping under complex hybrid dynamics is challenging. Reinforcement Learning (RL) is promising but prone to energy-inefficient "reward hacking". We propose a Dynamics-Informed RL framework for a monopedal hopping quadcopter. By embedding a target Specific Energy into the reward, we constrain the optimization to a physically viable energy manifold, ensuring stable hopping behaviour. By rewarding the phase-consistent behavior, it can encourage bio-inspired stance-phase impulse. Furthermore, penalizing the electro-mechanical power waste induces the motors generate an efficient impulse. This enables the policy to inject energy strictly during spring restitution without heuristic state machines. MuJoCo simulations validate robust height regulation and forward velocity tracking up to 2.0 m/s despite severe attitude-contact coupling. Ultimately, our approach yields a highly agile hopping gait, reducing energy consumption by 82% and 73% compared to hovering baselines and inefficiency baseline, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"动力学感知"的强化学习框架，用于单腿跳跃四足机器人（monopedal hopping quadcopter），通过在奖励中嵌入目标比能量（Specific Energy）将优化约束在物理可行的能量流形上，实现高效、稳定的高速跳跃控制，能耗相比悬停基线降低82%。
AI.motivation: 空中-腿式机器人兼具敏捷性与能效潜力，但其高速跳跃涉及接触-姿态强耦合的混合动力学，控制难度大。强化学习虽具前景，却容易陷入"奖励黑客"（reward hacking），即策略通过非物理或不节能的方式获取高奖励，导致能效低下。核心问题在于：如何在无启发式状态机的前提下，让策略学会在弹簧回弹阶段精准注入能量，从而兼顾稳定性、敏捷性与能量效率。
AI.method: 提出 Dynamics-Informed RL 框架，包含三项关键设计：(1) 在奖励函数中嵌入目标比能量（target Specific Energy），把优化限制在物理可行的能量流形内，保证跳跃行为的稳定性；(2) 奖励相位一致行为（phase-consistent behavior），鼓励仿生式的支撑相（stance-phase）冲量，无需显式状态机即可对齐跳跃周期；(3) 惩罚机电功率浪费（electro-mechanical power waste），引导电机生成高效冲量，使策略严格在弹簧回弹（spring restitution）窗口内注入能量。整体在不依赖启发式有限状态机的情况下，将能量注入时机与动力学相位自然耦合。
AI.result: 在 MuJoCo 仿真中验证，尽管存在严重的姿态-接触耦合，策略仍能实现稳健的高度调节与前进速度跟踪，最高可达 2.0 m/s。最终获得高度敏捷的跳跃步态，相比悬停基线（hovering baseline）能耗降低 82%，相比低效基线（inefficiency baseline）降低 73%。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于将物理能量约束显式嵌入 RL 奖励，替代启发式状态机，实现高效、稳定的高速跳跃控制，并显著降低能耗。意义在于为空中-腿式混合动力学机器人提供了一种物理一致的强化学习范式，可推广至更一般的接触-姿态耦合系统。潜在局限：仅在单腿原型上、且局限于 MuJoCo 仿真验证，未涉及真实硬件、地形扰动、感知噪声或多腿/全身协同控制。

title: Learning Continuous Source Responses For Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
summary: Advances in image generation have made synthetic images increasingly difficult to distinguish from real photographs, raising concerns about the trustworthiness of visual media. Existing AI-generated image detectors often perform well on in-domain data, but their robustness and cross-generator generalization remain limited. These limitations are commonly attributed to overfitting to shortcut cues. Although many methods seek to suppress shortcut learning, most retain binary classification as the training task without reconsidering how the task itself shapes the learned representations. We introduce CuRe, a framework for learning Continuous Source Responses that revisits authenticity detection from the perspective of the training task. CuRe reformulates backbone adaptation as regression of real-generated mixing ratios, providing finer supervision that encourages the model to capture authenticity-related variation beyond binary endpoint separation. We further select a compact source-response subspace to suppress nuisance variation and limit the final classifier's access to potential shortcut cues. Across ten public benchmarks, CuRe achieves an average balanced accuracy of 89.7%, exceeding the second-best method by 5.2 percentage points. Further experiments demonstrate consistent generalization gains across visual backbones and strong robustness to common image degradations. Code is available at https://github.com/manic-cui/CuRe

AI.tldr: CuRe将AI生成图像检测（AIGI检测）从二分类任务重新表述为"连续源响应"回归任务：通过回归真假图像混合比例来提供更细粒度的监督，并选取紧凑的源响应子空间以抑制冗余变化，从而提升跨生成器的泛化能力与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测器多在域内数据上表现良好，但面临鲁棒性差、跨生成器泛化能力有限的问题。作者将此归因于模型过度拟合"捷径线索"（shortcut cues）。已有方法虽尝试抑制捷径学习，但大多保留二分类作为训练任务，未反思任务本身如何塑造所学表征。本文的动机是从训练任务设计角度重新审视真伪检测问题，避免仅关注二分类端点带来的粗粒度监督。
AI.method: CuRe框架的核心思想是学习"连续源响应"（Continuous Source Responses）。其将主干网络的适配（backbone adaptation）重新表述为对"真实—生成混合比例"（real-generated mixing ratio）的回归，用连续的软标签替代二分类标签，提供更细粒度的监督信号，促使模型捕捉与真伪相关的连续变化，而非仅区分两个端点。此外，方法选取一个紧凑的源响应子空间，用于抑制与真伪无关的冗余变化（nuisance variation），并限制最终分类器接触潜在捷径线索的能力。方法强调任务层面的重设计，而非单纯的分类器修补。
AI.result: 在十个公开基准数据集上进行评估，CuRe取得平均平衡准确率（balanced accuracy）89.7%，比次优方法高出5.2个百分点。进一步实验显示，该方法在不同视觉主干网络上均获得一致的泛化增益，并对常见图像退化（image degradation）表现出较强鲁棒性。评估指标以平衡准确率为主，兼顾跨生成器泛化与退化鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: CuRe的主要贡献在于从训练任务视角重新设计AI生成图像检测：以连续混合比例回归替代二分类，并借助源响应子空间抑制捷径线索，显著提升了跨生成器泛化与鲁棒性。其意义在于提示任务重新表述可能比单纯抑制捷径更有效。潜在局限包括：依赖可构造的混合比例监督信号、对主干网络需进行适配、文中未强调在极端退化或未见生成范式下的表现边界。

title: Should All Noises Be Treated Equally: Impact of Input Noise Variability on Neural Network Robustness
summary: Geophysical data collected from active field sites are often contaminated by complex and heterogeneous noise, obscuring weak seismic events, and complicating automated interpretation. Although deep learning offers promising solutions for seismic processing, its performance is highly sensitive to the nature of training noise, especially under out-of-distribution (OOD) conditions. This study investigates the influence of noise parameters, such as type, scale, and complexity on the performance, generalization and robustness of neural networks in two geophysical tasks: first break picking and denoising. We simulate seismic-while-drilling data and apply controlled input source noise augmentation using stochastic generators to vary the noise characteristics. Different neural networks are trained on fixed noise types and scales, then evaluated across both seen and unseen noise scenarios. We incrementally increase the complexity of the noise by introducing compound noise mixtures and assess the performance of the model under increasingly challenging OOD conditions. This yields a robustness matrix that captures the generalizability of each model relative to its training configuration. Results indicate that larger noise scales boost generalization, and that effective alignment between noise type, task complexity, and architecture is key for maximizing generalization gains. In addition, training with compound noises mitigate weaknesses associated with single-noise training, acting as an additional implicit regularizer to improving robustness. These findings highlight key factors influencing model resilience in noisy geophysical environments and offer guidance for developing deep learning models that generalize effectively across diverse and unpredictable noise conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统考察了噪声类型、尺度与复杂度对地球物理神经网络性能、泛化和鲁棒性的影响，通过可控噪声增强与OOD评估构建"鲁棒性矩阵"，揭示了噪声尺度、噪声-任务-架构对齐以及复合噪声训练对泛化的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 主动野外场地采集的地球物理数据常受复杂异构噪声污染，掩盖弱地震信号并干扰自动解释。虽然深度学习在地震处理（如初至拾取、去噪）中展现出潜力，但其性能对训练噪声的特性高度敏感，尤其在分布外（OOD）条件下易失效。然而，噪声参数（类型、尺度、复杂度）究竟如何影响模型的泛化与鲁棒性，缺乏系统性研究，这限制了模型在真实不可预测噪声环境中的部署可靠性。
AI.method: 研究模拟随钻地震（seismic-while-drilling）数据，并利用随机生成器施加可控的输入源噪声增强，以系统性地调节噪声特性。方法上：(1) 针对两个任务——初至拾取（first break picking）与去噪（denoising）训练多种神经网络；(2) 在固定的噪声类型与尺度上训练模型，再在"已见"与"未见"噪声场景下评估；(3) 逐步引入复合噪声混合，递增噪声复杂度，考察模型在日益困难的OOD条件下的表现；(4) 由此构造"鲁棒性矩阵"（robustness matrix），刻画各模型相对于其训练配置的泛化能力。
AI.result: 实验在两个地球物理任务（初至拾取和去噪）上，通过控制噪声类型和尺度进行训练，并在已见/未见噪声及复合噪声混合场景下评估泛化性。主要发现：(1) 较大的噪声尺度反而提升泛化能力；(2) 噪声类型、任务复杂度与网络架构之间的有效对齐是最大化泛化增益的关键；(3) 使用复合噪声训练可缓解单一噪声训练带来的弱点，起到额外的隐式正则化作用，从而提升鲁棒性。这些结论以鲁棒性矩阵形式量化呈现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了噪声尺度、噪声-任务-架构对齐及复合噪声正则化等影响模型在噪声地球物理环境中韧性的关键因素，为开发能在多样、不可预测噪声条件下有效泛化的深度学习模型提供了指导。其价值在于强调OOD鲁棒性与训练噪声配置的关系。局限方面，实验基于模拟数据而非真实野外采集数据，结论的跨任务、跨场景迁移性仍需进一步验证；研究聚焦初至拾取与去噪两类任务，未涉及检测、跟踪等其他感知任务，也未与事件相机、时空建模或边缘高效推理等方向关联。

title: Learning to Exploit Passive Dynamics for Energy-Efficient Target Hopping of a Spring-Legged Quadcopter
summary: Combining aerial thrust with spring-loaded hopping makes monopedal quadcopters promising for locomotion over complex terrain, but heuristic proportional-integral-derivative (PID) tuning limits coordination between active thrust and passive contact dynamics. We present a direct estimated-state-to-motor Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy that commands four motors without an explicit hopping state machine or low-level attitude PID. Its reward combines Energy-Manifold Shaping for mass-normalized vertical-energy tracking and apex-state anchoring with Efficiency Shaping, which uses a history-aware power estimator to penalize general power use, impose an additional airborne-power cost, and penalize airborne near-stationarity. In representative hardware runs, the PPO-based control stack reduced cycle-averaged measured electrical power by 30.7% and mean total normalized thrust by 49.8% relative to the tuned PID-based control stack, while retaining repeatable commanded-height hopping and more concentrated landings. These observations are consistent with improved use of passive dynamics and reduced measured electrical demand.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种直接从估计状态到四个电机指令的 PPO 强化学习控制策略，用于单腿跳跃四旋翼（monopedal quadcopter），通过 Energy-Manifold Shaping 与 Efficiency Shaping 两项奖励设计，在无需显式跳跃状态机与低级姿态 PID 的情况下实现更节能的复杂地形跳跃运动。
AI.motivation: 单腿跳跃四旋翼结合空中推力与弹簧储能跳跃，是复杂地形运动的潜在方案。但传统方法依赖启发式的 PID 调参，难以协调主动推力与被动接触动力学（弹簧压缩/回弹、着地冲击等），导致能耗高、协调性差。作者希望摆脱 PID 调参瓶颈与显式跳跃状态机，让策略自主学习主动-被动动力学的协同，从而降低电气功耗并提高运动的可重复性。
AI.method: 核心是一个 PPO 策略，直接将估计状态映射到四个电机指令，端到端，不使用显式跳跃状态机，也不使用低级姿态 PID。奖励由两部分组成：(1) Energy-Manifold Shaping，对质量归一化的垂直能量进行跟踪，并加入 apex-state anchoring（顶点状态锚定），引导系统沿期望的能量流形运动并在跳跃顶点处稳定；(2) Efficiency Shaping，使用一个带历史感知（history-aware）的功率估计器，惩罚总体功率使用、对空中阶段施加额外功率代价，并惩罚空中近静止（airborne near-stationarity），即抑制低效的“悬停式”空中行为，鼓励利用被动动力学（弹簧）储能与释放。
AI.result: 在代表性硬件实验（真实硬件运行）中，与调优后的 PID 控制栈相比，PPO 控制栈将周期平均实测电气功率降低了 30.7%，平均总归一化推力降低了 49.8%，同时仍保持可重复的指令高度跳跃，并使着陆点更集中。结果表明策略更好地利用了被动动力学，降低了实测电气需求。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于用端到端 PPO 策略替代显式状态机与 PID 姿态控制，并通过能量流形塑形与效率塑形两项奖励实现了主动推力与被动接触动力学的协调，在真实硬件上显著降低功耗与推力需求。意义在于展示了学习型控制在混合空中-接触运动系统（UAV/机器人跳跃运动）中的节能潜力。可能的局限包括：仅在特定单腿跳跃平台上验证、未详述仿真到现实的迁移细节、奖励塑形中的权重与功率估计器依赖领域调整，以及对复杂地形泛化能力的评估尚不充分。

title: Mobile CT Services for Rural, Regional, and Remote Areas: Current Practice and Future Integration with Telehealth and Regulatory-Authorised AI
summary: Computed tomography (CT) plays an essential role in clinical workflow to improve patient outcomes. However, access to CT imaging and specialist interpretation remains limited, particularly in rural, regional, remote (RRR), and other resource-limited settings. Recent advances in mobile CT, telehealth, and artificial intelligence (AI) provide opportunities to extend advanced imaging services to populations in RRR settings. This review examines: 1) mobile CT systems deployed in trucks, trailers, ambulances, and other mobile platforms; 2) telehealth technologies supporting CT-based healthcare; and 3) AI for CT that has received regulatory authorisation or is currently deployed in clinical practice. Applications are evaluated across four clinical functions: screening and diagnosis, patient monitoring, risk prediction, and intervention or therapeutic decision support. The review covers neurological, thoracic, cardiovascular, abdominal, oncological, musculoskeletal, and interventional imaging, with particular attention to stroke, cancer, and other image-guided treatment. Other factors such as regulatory status, deployment status, and estimated technology readiness (TRL) level are compared. Current evidence indicates that mobile CT, telehealth, and AI for conventional CT are individually relatively mature, but fully integration of these technologies remains less widely deployed and validated in the clinical settings. Key barriers include regulatory variation, domain shift, connectivity requirements, cost, workflow integration, cybersecurity, and limited evidence of patient-level benefit. Future research should prioritise prospective, multicentre evaluation of integrated CT systems in real-world and underserved clinical settings.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于移动CT、远程医疗与AI在CT中应用的综述性文章，系统梳理了三类技术在资源受限（乡村、区域、偏远，RRR）场景下的临床部署现状，并按筛查诊断、监测、风险预测、干预决策四大临床功能及多解剖系统进行评估，指出三类技术各自较成熟但整合部署仍稀缺。
AI.motivation: CT在临床工作流中至关重要，但尤其在RRR及其他资源受限环境中，CT成像的可及性和专家解读能力严重不足。移动CT、远程医疗与AI的进展为将先进影像服务扩展到这些人群提供了机会，因此有必要系统审视现有技术成熟度、部署状态与临床证据，以明确差距与未来研究方向。该问题的重要性在于缩小医疗影像可及性的区域不平等。
AI.method: 本文为综述（review），而非提出新模型或算法。其方法框架包括三个技术维度：1）部署于卡车、拖车、救护车等移动平台上的移动CT系统；2）支持CT相关医疗服务的远程/远程医疗技术；3）已获监管授权或已在临床中部署的CT人工智能。评估维度包括四类临床应用（筛查与诊断、患者监测、风险预测、干预或治疗决策支持）、多解剖领域（神经、胸部、心血管、腹部、肿瘤、肌骨及介入影像，重点关注卒中与癌症），并比较监管状态、部署状态与估计的技术成熟度（TRL）水平。
AI.result: 论文采用基于临床功能、解剖系统与技术成熟度（TRL）的比较性综述方式而非定量基准测评，未报告标准数据集上的精度/召回等指标。主要发现为：移动CT、远程医疗与面向传统CT的AI各自均相对成熟，但三者的完全整合在临床环境中的部署与验证仍不广泛。识别出的关键障碍包括监管差异、域偏移（domain shift）、连接性要求、成本、工作流集成、网络安全，以及缺乏患者层面获益的证据。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于从临床功能、解剖覆盖、监管与部署状态、技术成熟度等多角度整合性梳理移动CT、远程医疗与CT人工智能，特别强调RRR及资源受限环境，并指出整合系统部署证据的不足。意义在于为缩小影像可及性差距提供路线图。局限包括：作为综述，缺乏定量基准与患者层面获益的实证数据；对域偏移、连接性等障碍的讨论多以定性为主；未来需在真实世界与欠服务临床环境中开展前瞻性、多中心评估。
