Experiments with DFlash and a DSpark-derived semi-autoregressive drafter across two target models show that this simple Carryover mechanism improves average acceptance length by 6.5--14.7% and end-to-end vLLM speedup by 7.9--14.4% over the corresponding baselines, with speedup gains reaching 28.8% on translation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Carryover Drafting，一种投机解码（speculative decoding）改进机制：将被目标模型验证环节丢弃的"被拒绝 token"的隐藏状态（hidden states）回收，作为临时的 KV 上下文提供给 drafter 复用，并配套提出 parallel draft-verify-draft 训练范式，在保持并行性的前提下让 drafter 接触到与推理对齐的 rejected states。实验显示平均接受长度提升 6.5–14.7%，端到端 vLLM 加速提升 7.9–14.4%（翻译任务最高 28.8%）。
AI.motivation: 投机解码通过让目标模型一次前向并行验证多个草稿 token 来加速 LLM 推理，但验证过程对"接受"与"被拒绝"的 token 都计算了表示，而现有 drafter 只保留接受 token 的表示，导致花在 rejected tokens 上的大量 verifier 计算被浪费。作者发现这些被丢弃的隐藏状态实际上包含关于未来 token 的有用信息，可用于改进后续草稿生成，因此存在显著的计算复用机会。但利用该机会面临两个具体挑战：(1) 推理端——若直接回收会增加草稿延迟，抵消接受长度提升带来的加速；(2) 训练端——标准并行 drafter 训练不会产生与推理对齐的 rejected states，而通过顺序 rollout 获取它们又会牺牲跨训练位置的并行性。该问题重要在于它试图在不改变投机解码基本框架、几乎不增加开销的前提下，进一步从已有算力中"榨取"额外加速。
AI.method: 核心方法为 Carryover Drafting，包含两个协同设计。推理侧：将目标模型验证阶段产生的被拒绝隐藏状态作为临时 KV context 回收，使 drafter 能够有选择地关注（selectively attend）这些状态；该方法复用 drafter 现有接口，仅新增一个可学习 embedding 用于区分"被拒绝状态"与"已提交的上下文"（committed context）；额外 KV 上下文每轮草稿后被替换，长度被约束在一个 proposal block 之内，从而保证延迟开销有界。训练侧：提出 parallel draft-verify-draft 训练流程，让 drafter 在训练时即暴露于推理对齐的 rejected states，同时保持跨训练位置的并行性，避免了顺序 rollout 的代价。
AI.result: 实验采用 DFlash 以及一个源自 DSpark 的半自回归（semi-autoregressive）drafter，在两种目标模型上进行评估。评价指标为平均接受长度（average acceptance length）与端到端 vLLM 加速比。结果显示：相较各自基线，平均接受长度提升 6.5–14.7%，端到端 vLLM 加速提升 7.9–14.4%；在翻译（translation）任务上加速增益最高达 28.8%。作者强调该 Carryover 机制"简单"且有效，即在改动最小的前提下带来稳定收益。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献是识别出投机解码中被拒绝 token 的隐藏状态这一被浪费的计算资源，并提出 Carryover Drafting 通过 KV 上下文回收机制加 parallel draft-verify-draft 训练来有效利用它，在不显著增加延迟的前提下提升接受长度与端到端推理加速。其意义在于为投机解码的效率优化提供了新的复用维度，且与现有 drafter 接口兼容、实现开销低。潜在局限包括：额外 KV 上下文虽被限制在一个 proposal block 内，但仍引入一定推理开销与显存占用，收益可能随任务/模型而变化（尽管翻译任务增益显著）；训练流程依赖对 rejected states 的刻意对齐构造，可能增加训练复杂度；方法仅在有足够"被拒绝"状态产生时才有回收价值，在基线接受率已很高的场景下边际收益可能受限。

title: JEPLO: Joint-Embedding Predictive Learning for LiDAR-Based Legged Locomotion
summary: Light detection and ranging (LiDAR) remains less explored than RGB-D sensing for perceptive legged locomotion, and existing LiDAR-based approaches often rely on explicit mapping. We present JEPLO (Joint-Embedding Predictive learning for legged LOcomotion), a single-stage learning framework for mapping-free, LiDAR-based perceptive locomotion for legged robots. We introduce a proprio-exteroceptive JEPA (PE-JEPA) world model to learn predictive egocentric terrain representations from onboard observations, including raw LiDAR scans. A concurrent JEPA-teacher-student (CJTS) pipeline is further proposed to train a locomotion policy informed by JEPA latent representations in simulation using deep reinforcement learning with a simple reward formulation. The framework achieves successful sim-to-real transfer, enabling omnidirectional traversal of diverse terrains, including long staircases and high boxes, with lightweight onboard computation. Evaluations demonstrate greater robustness than existing perceptive locomotion frameworks, particularly under degraded perception caused by occlusion, sparsity and noise. Further analysis validates JEPLO's ability to retain task-relevant information under these challenging conditions. We open-source our implementation, experimental datasets, and hardware setup designs https://github.com/ASIG-X/JEPLO.

AI.tldr: JEPLO 是一个面向腿式机器人的单阶段、无建图(map-free) LiDAR 感知运动框架,核心是引入本体-外感受联合嵌入预测世界模型(PE-JEPA)从原始 LiDAR 扫描学习预测性自我中心地形表征,并通过并发 JEPA 师生(CJTS)流程用深度强化学习训练运动策略,实现多样化地形的仿真到现实迁移。
AI.motivation: 相比 RGB-D,LiDAR 在腿式机器人感知运动(perceptive legged locomotion)中研究较少,且现有 LiDAR 方法通常依赖显式建图(explicit mapping),带来计算开销、累积误差以及对遮挡/稀疏/噪声感知退化的脆弱性。作者希望构建一个无建图、可从原始机载 LiDAR 观测直接学习地形表征的单阶段学习框架,提升在真实退化感知条件下的鲁棒性,并支持板载轻量计算。
AI.method: 提出 JEPLO 单阶段学习框架。核心组件一:PE-JEPA(proprio-exteroceptive JEPA)世界模型,从机载观测(含原始 LiDAR 扫描与本体状态)学习预测性的自我中心(egocentric)地形表征,属于联合嵌入预测架构(JEPA),在潜空间进行预测而非重建原始信号。核心组件二:CJTS(concurrent JEPA-teacher-student)流程,在仿真中用深度强化学习训练运动策略,策略接收 JEPA 潜表征作为感知输入,并采用简单的奖励设计;teacher-student 并发结构用于将 JEPA 潜空间知识传递到可部署策略。整体实现无显式建图。
AI.result: 实现成功的 sim-to-real 迁移,支持全向(omnidirectional)穿越多样地形,包括长楼梯和高箱体,且板载计算轻量。评估表明在由遮挡、稀疏性和噪声导致的退化感知条件下,鲁棒性优于现有感知运动框架。进一步分析验证了 JEPLO 在挑战性条件下保留任务相关信息的能力。开源了实现、实验数据集与硬件设计(https://github.com/ASIG-X/JEPLO)。
AI.conclusion: 贡献:首次(或早期)将 JEPA 世界模型引入 LiDAR 无建图腿式感知运动,提出 PE-JEPA 与 CJTS,实现多样化地形的 sim-to-real 全向运动,并在退化感知下展现优于现有框架的鲁棒性。意义:为腿式机器人提供了轻量、无建图、对噪声/遮挡/稀疏鲁棒的感知运动范式,并与 JEPA 自监督表征学习方向衔接。局限:摘要未给出具体数据集规模、评估指标数值与量化对比结果,鲁棒性结论的定量支撑需参见正文;方法依赖仿真训练与 sim-to-real 迁移,真实场景泛化边界未在摘要中说明。

title: DynEoMT: Learning Object Dynamicity from Online Segmentation Queries
comment: Submitted to the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV)
summary: Video segmentation models recognize and track objects over time, but they do not indicate whether each segmented region moves independently of the observing camera. This dynamicity attribute cannot be inferred from semantics alone and is confounded by camera ego-motion. We introduce \method, an online framework that augments query-based video segmentation with region-level dynamicity prediction. It jointly produces the original segmentation outputs and a dynamic or static state for each predicted region. At inference, DynEoMT uses only the current frame and propagated queries, without optical flow, depth, camera pose, previous RGB frames, or feature maps. Because established video segmentation benchmarks do not annotate this attribute, we also introduce a class-agnostic offline supervision pipeline using camera-compensated optical flow and confidence-aware temporal filtering. Across VIPSeg, OVIS, YouTube-VIS 2022, and VSPW, DynEoMT achieves balanced accuracies of 84.3, 68.0, 68.6, and 87.6, respectively, while largely preserving segmentation performance. These results show that segmentation-region dynamicity can be learned from propagated queries, enabling its online prediction without a dedicated motion-processing pipeline at inference. The complete code will be released as open source to enable full reproduction of the method and experiments.

AI.tldr: DynEoMT 在查询式（query-based）视频分割框架上引入区域级动静态预测（dynamicity prediction），在输出分割结果的同时为每个预测区域标注动态/静态状态。推理时仅使用当前帧与传播的查询（queries），无需光流、深度、相机位姿、历史 RGB 帧或特征图，并配套提出了一套类别无关的离线监督生成流程。
AI.motivation: 现有视频分割模型能够在时间维度上识别和跟踪目标，但无法判断某个分割区域是否相对观测相机独立运动。该"动态性"属性无法仅从语义类别推断，且会被相机自运动（ego-motion）严重混淆——例如相机运动会使静态背景在图像平面上产生明显位移，因此仅凭像素运动无法区分"物体在动"与"相机在动"。区分动态/静态区域对机器人、自动驾驶、视频理解等下游任务具有重要意义（如运动目标避让、场景解析），但现有视频分割基准（VIPSeg、OVIS、YouTube-VIS、VSPW 等）均未对该属性进行标注。
AI.method: 方法包含两个核心部分。（1）模型侧：DynEoMT 是一个在线（online）框架，将区域级动态性预测头集成到查询式视频分割架构（如基于 EoMT 的 query-based 分割器）中，与原始分割输出联合训练和推理，每个预测区域额外输出动态/静态二分类状态。推理阶段仅依赖当前帧与传播的查询，不需要光流、深度、相机位姿、历史 RGB 帧或历史特征图，从而避免了显式的运动处理流水线。（2）监督侧：由于现有基准缺乏该属性标注，作者提出类别无关的离线监督生成管线，利用相机补偿光流（camera-compensated optical flow）消除 ego-motion 干扰，并采用置信度感知的时间滤波（confidence-aware temporal filtering）来生成和净化伪标签，以提升监督信号可靠性。
AI.result: 在 VIPSeg、OVIS、YouTube-VIS 2022 和 VSPW 四个视频分割基准上进行评估，DynEoMT 的区域级动态性预测分别取得 84.3、68.0、68.6 和 87.6 的平衡准确率（balanced accuracy，适用于动态/静态类别不均衡的二分类指标）。同时，加入动态性预测后分割性能基本得到保持，说明该属性可以在不牺牲原任务的前提下被学习。结果还表明，动态性可以从传播的查询中隐式学习，无需在推理阶段部署专门的运动处理模块。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献有三：首次将区域级动静态预测引入查询式视频分割，并提出无需推理期运动管线的在线方案；提出基于相机补偿光流与置信度感知时间滤波的类别无关离线监督流程，以解决标注缺失问题；在四个主流基准上验证了预测精度与分割性能的兼顾。意义在于将"动态性"这一几何—运动属性与语义分割解耦建模，为视频理解和机器人感知提供了新输出维度。潜在局限包括：依赖离线伪标签的质量；仅在视频分割基准上验证，未在事件相机或极低延迟的真实机器人场景中测试；平衡准确率在 OVIS、YouTube-VIS 2022 等复杂/长尾数据集上（68%左右）仍有提升空间。代码将开源以支持复现。

title: Are Gradient Boosting Models Suitable for Intermittent Demand Forecasting?
summary: Demand forecasting is critical in modern industry, offering opportunities to reduce costs and gain competitive advantage through improved inventory management. However, forecasting becomes particularly challenging for products with intermittent demand, where demand occurs infrequently and time series contain many zero observations. Such dynamics are common across diverse sectors, such as industrial organizations, consumer goods, aviation, automotive, and electronics. Motivated by these challenges, this paper explores the potential of gradient boosting models to improve forecasting performance. We evaluate statistical, specialized, machine learning, and ensemble approaches across multiple datasets. The results show that specialized methods achieve the strongest performance among individual models, while gradient boosting on its own tends to underperform. However, combining a machine learning model with a specialized approach improves forecasting accuracy by up to 10%, demonstrating that even simple ensembles can outperform single models. Overall, the findings highlight the value of combining machine learning with domain-specific forecasting techniques for intermittent demand.

AI.tldr: 本文研究间歇性需求（需求稀疏、含大量零观测值）的时间序列预测问题，系统评估统计方法、专用间歇性需求方法、机器学习与集成方法，发现单一梯度提升模型表现不佳，但将机器学习模型与专用方法集成可将预测精度提升最多 10%。
AI.motivation: 间歇性需求普遍存在于工业、消费品、航空、汽车、电子等多个行业，其特点是需求发生频率低、时间序列中零值占比高，传统预测方法难以建模。准确的间歇性需求预测对库存管理、成本控制和竞争优势至关重要，因此需要评估不同建模范式在此类数据上的适用性与改进空间。
AI.method: 论文在多个数据集上对四类方法进行对比评估：统计方法、面向间歇性需求的专用方法（如 Croston 类方法）、机器学习方法（以梯度提升为主）以及集成方法。核心探索是梯度提升模型在该任务上的潜力，并重点考察将机器学习模型与专用间歇性需求方法相结合的集成策略，而非依赖单一模型。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，专用间歇性需求方法在单模型中表现最佳，而单独使用的梯度提升模型通常表现较差。将机器学习模型与专用方法组合的简单集成方案可将预测精度提升最高约 10%，说明集成方式优于任何单一模型。评价指标围绕预测精度展开，但摘要未给出具体数据集名称与数值细节。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于系统比较了统计、专用、机器学习和集成方法在间歇性需求预测上的表现，并证明即使简单集成也能超越单模型，强调了机器学习与领域专用预测技术结合的价值。局限在于摘要未披露具体数据集、评价指标定义与详细实验设置，且未讨论计算成本与模型可扩展性，因此结论的泛化性有待进一步验证。

title: Uncertainty-Guided Sparse Refinement for Action Chunking Transformer Policies
summary: Learning chunk-based visuomotor policies for long-horizon robot manipulation remains challenging. Recent action-chunking methods have shown promising performance by predicting temporally extended action sequences. However, their failures are often dominated by prediction errors at a small number of critical timesteps rather than uniformly poor predictions across the entire action chunk, making uniform refinement inefficient and insufficiently targeted. To address this bottleneck, we propose Uncertainty-Guided Refinement (UGR), a sparse refinement framework for chunk-based visuomotor policies. Specifically, UGR follows a coarse-to-refine design: it first predicts a full action chunk, estimates per-step temporal uncertainty from the coarse hidden states, and applies residual correction only to the most uncertain timesteps selected by a binary mask. The uncertainty branch is decoupled from the coarse action predictor, enabling clean attribution of the refinement gains to uncertainty-guided correction rather than additional predictor capacity. Extensive experiments on five dual-arm manipulation tasks from the RoboTwin benchmark show that UGR achieves the best success rate on four tasks, improves over the ACT baseline by up to 13% absolute, and outperforms both full-chunk and position-agnostic block refinement in ablation studies.

AI.tldr: UGR（Uncertainty-Guided Refinement）提出一种面向基于动作块（action chunk）的视觉运动策略的稀疏精化框架：先预测整段动作块，再从粗粒度隐状态估计逐步时间不确定性，仅对二值掩码选出的高不确定时间步施加残差修正，从而以粗到精（coarse-to-refine）方式提升长时程双臂操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操作中，动作块（action chunking）方法通过预测时间上延展的动作序列已取得较好效果，但其失败往往由少数关键时间步的预测误差主导，而非整段动作块的均匀劣化。因此对整段动作块做均匀精化（full-chunk refinement）效率低、针对性不足，缺乏对"哪里出错"的显式定位。该文的核心动机是：将精化算力与模型容量集中在真正高风险的时间步上。
AI.method: 方法采用粗到精的稀疏精化设计，包含三个关键要素：（1）粗预测器先输出完整动作块；（2）不确定性分支由粗粒度隐状态（coarse hidden states）估计每一步的时序不确定性，并据此生成二值掩码，选出最不确定的时间步；（3）仅对这些被选中的时间步施加残差修正（residual correction），而非重预测整段动作。重要的架构选择是：不确定性分支与粗动作预测器解耦（decoupled），使精化收益可被清晰归因于"不确定性引导的修正"，而非额外预测器容量带来的提升。这种稀疏性同时降低了精化阶段的计算开销。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 基准的五个双臂操作任务上进行实验。UGR 在其中四个任务上取得最高成功率，相较 ACT 基线最高提升 13%（绝对值）。消融实验表明其优于两种对照方案：全动作块精化（full-chunk refinement）与位置无关的块级精化（position-agnostic block refinement），验证了不确定性引导的稀疏步级选择是性能增益的主要来源而非单纯增加容量。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于将"高不确定时间步主导失败"这一现象转化为显式的稀疏精化机制，通过解耦的不确定性估计实现有针对性的残差修正，在双臂操作任务上以较低精化开销获得显著成功率提升，并提供了可归因的消融分析。潜在局限包括：不确定性估计的校准质量直接决定掩码选择效果；精化仅在最不确定步上施加，若误差来源具有强时间耦合或需全局重规划则可能受限；实验规模限于 RoboTwin 五个任务，向更广泛平台与真实硬件的泛化性尚待验证。

title: PRI-Net: A Lightweight Multimodal Framework for 3D UAV Localization
summary: Accurate 3D localization of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) remains challenging for existing multimodal approaches due to sparse LiDAR geometry, modality-imbalanced fusion, and redundant feature transmission over constrained edge-to-server links. To address these limitations, we propose PRI-Net, an efficient and lightweight multimodal fusion framework for UAV localization that integrates point cloud splatting, residual attention fusion, and an information bottleneck. Specifically, a 3D point cloud splatting (3DPCS) strategy is introduced to transform sparse LiDAR observations into geometrically consistent dense depth maps. A residual attention fusion (RAF) module is then designed to alleviate modal bias by using an image branch for coarse estimation and a gated fusion branch for refinement. In addition, a multimodal information bottleneck (MIB) module compacts features by filtering task-irrelevant redundancy. Experiments show that PRI-Net achieves high localization accuracy with lightweight architectures, while reducing feature dimensionality and improving edge-to-server UAV sensing efficiency and robustness.

AI.tldr: PRI-Net：面向无人机3D定位的轻量级多模态融合框架，融合点云splatting（3DPCS）、残差注意力融合（RAF）与多模态信息瓶颈（MIB），在提升定位精度的同时压缩特征维度，改善边缘-服务器传输效率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 无人机（UAV）的精确3D定位对自主飞行与机器人感知至关重要，但现有多模态方法面临三重瓶颈：(1) LiDAR点云几何稀疏，难以直接提供稠密几何线索；(2) 模态间融合存在偏置（modality-imbalanced fusion），图像与点云贡献不平衡；(3) 边缘设备与服务器之间链路受限，冗余特征传输开销大。这些问题共同制约了定位精度与实时部署能力，因此需要一种既轻量又高效、且能抑制模态偏置的多模态融合方案。
AI.method: 提出PRI-Net，由三个核心模块组成：(1) 3D点云splatting（3DPCS）：将稀疏LiDAR观测投影/溅射为几何一致的稠密深度图，缓解点云稀疏性；(2) 残差注意力融合（RAF）：采用双分支设计，图像分支进行粗估计，门控融合分支进行细化，通过残差注意力机制缓解模态偏置；(3) 多模态信息瓶颈（MIB）：基于信息瓶颈原理过滤与任务无关的冗余特征，压缩特征维度。整体框架强调轻量级架构与边缘-服务器协同。
AI.result: 摘要层面报告：PRI-Net在轻量级架构下实现了较高的定位精度，同时降低了特征维度，提升了边缘到服务器的无人机感知效率与鲁棒性。但摘要未给出具体数据集（如UAV定位基准）、对比方法、评价指标（如定位误差/ADE/FDE）及定量数值，需参阅正文以确认实验细节。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于将点云稠密化、注意力门控融合与信息瓶颈统一到轻量级UAV定位框架中，兼顾精度与边缘传输效率。局限在于：摘要未提供定量结果、数据集细节与消融证据，各模块（3DPCS/RAF/MIB）的独立增益与适用边界尚不明确。

title: WaVeFuse: Regime-Adaptive Equity Index Forecasting via Channel-Wise Wavelet Denoising and Vertical Attention Fusion
comment: 40 pages, 13 Figures, 15 Tables, Preprint, Under Review
summary: Hybrid Deep Learning for equity index forecasting is limited by three problems: propagation of OHLCV noise into derived technical indicators (TIs), channel-indiscriminate multi-scale decomposition that conflates heterogeneous frequency signatures, and static multi-branch fusion that cannot adapt to market regime shifts. WaVeFuse addresses these limitations through a unified dual-branch architecture. Symlet-4 wavelet denoising (level 2, MAD soft threshold) suppresses microstructure noise in OHLCV. Seven low-lag TIs computed from denoised prices are encoded by a causal channel-wise continuous wavelet transform (Morlet, 32 scales) into a per-timestep scale-space matrix. A CNN-BiLSTM branch captures temporal dynamics, while a dual-layer Transformer (heads=4, dk in {16, 32}) models inter-scale spectral dependencies, and their representations are integrated by a 2-token softmax gate Vertical Attention Fusion (VAF) that dynamically reweights branches as market regimes shift. Evaluated under walk-forward validation (WFV) on KOSPI, DAX, NYSE Composite, and Russell 2000 (2010-2023), WaVeFuse achieves R2 = 0.81-0.96 and directional accuracy 70.5-78.3%. It outperforms seven state-of-the-art models by 8.9-20.2% MAE across twelve dataset-period configurations. Diebold-Mariano statistics (4.62-10.38, p<0.001) confirm superiority over a well-tuned XGBoost benchmark across four indices. Ablation verifies component-wise contributions. Under realistic backtesting with 10 basis point transaction costs, WaVeFuse's directional strategy achieves a mean Sharpe ratio of 3.69 across four markets and limits maximum drawdown to 7.5% during the COVID-19 crash. With 152k parameters (0.68MB) and sub-1.3ms GPU inference, WaVeFuse delivers a computationally efficient, regime-robust framework suitable for research and decision-support deployment.

AI.tldr: WaVeFuse 是一个双分支混合深度学习框架，用于股指预测：先用 Symlet-4 小波去噪压制 OHLCV 微结构噪声，再通过因果通道级连续小波变换构造类时频尺度的多尺度表示，最后以 CNN-BiLSTM 与双层级 Transformer 分别建模时序动态与跨尺度频谱依赖，并用可动态重加权的 Vertical Attention Fusion 融合两分支，实现对市场状态切换的自适应。
AI.motivation: 论文针对混合深度学习股指预测的三个核心瓶颈：(1) OHLCV 原始噪声会传播到派生的技术指标（TI）中，污染输入特征；(2) 传统多尺度分解对所有通道一视同仁，混淆了不同频率特征，缺乏通道特异性；(3) 静态多分支融合无法适应市场行情/波动状态的切换（regime shift）。这些问题直接影响预测精度与实盘稳健性，因此在噪声抑制、频率建模与自适应融合三个层面同时改进具有实际意义。
AI.method: 包含三个技术环节。第一，噪声抑制：对 OHLCV 采用 Symlet-4 小波、2 级分解、MAD 软阈值去噪，再把去噪价格用于计算 7 个低滞后技术指标。第二，多尺度表示：对 7 个 TI 施加"因果、通道级"连续小波变换（Morlet 母小波、32 个尺度），得到每个时间步的 scale-space 矩阵，保留通道频率差异。第三，双分支建模与融合：CNN-BiLSTM 分支捕捉时间动态，双层 Transformer（4 头，dk∈{16,32}）建模尺度间频谱依赖；两支表示通过 2-token softmax 门控的 Vertical Attention Fusion（VAF）动态重加权，使模型能随市场状态变化调整分支权重。
AI.result: 在 KOSPI、DAX、NYSE Composite、Russell 2000 四个指数（2010–2023）上采用 walk-forward validation（WFV）评估。R² 达 0.81–0.96，方向准确率 70.5–78.3%；在 12 个数据集-时间段配置上，MAE 比七个 SOTA 模型优 8.9–20.2%。Diebold-Mariano 检验统计量 4.62–10.38（p<0.001），显著优于调参良好的 XGBoost 基准。消融实验验证了各组件贡献。10 个基点交易成本的回测中，方向性策略在四个市场平均 Sharpe 达 3.69，COVID-19 崩盘期间最大回撤仅 7.5%。模型 152k 参数（0.68MB），GPU 推理低于 1.3ms。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出一种将小波去噪、通道级多尺度频谱编码、时序/频域双分支建模与自适应注意力融合统一的股指预测框架，并通过严格 WFV、统计显著性检验、成本回测及消融提供完整验证，同时具备轻量（0.68MB）与低延迟（<1.3ms）特性，适合研究与决策支持部署。潜在局限：评测仅限四个成熟股票指数、单一 2010–2023 时间窗，跨资产（加密、商品、新兴市场）与跨频段泛化未验证；小波母函数、尺度数与阈值策略以人为设定为主，超参敏感性未充分讨论；Sharpe 3.69 等回测指标对交易成本、滑点与执行假设较敏感，实盘可得性仍需进一步验证。

title: DuctAM: A Duct-Assisted Quadrotor-Based Aerial Manipulator Enabling High-Force Push-and-Pull Interactions
summary: Uncrewed Aerial Manipulators (UAMs) extend the capabilities of Uncrewed Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from perception to physical interaction. Among various aerial interactions, push-and-pull operations are fundamental manipulation primitives that require sustained horizontal forces while maintaining stable flight. In this paper, we propose DuctAM, a compact aerial manipulation platform that enhances horizontal force capability for push-and-pull interactions using two ducted fans integrated along the quadrotor interaction axis. An attitude-force decoupled control scheme enables controllable horizontal forces without requiring large attitude changes. Extensive real-world experiments are conducted to validate the DuctAM. Figure-eight trajectory tracking experiments demonstrate stable flight and accurate motion control in both quad and duct modes. Force-measurement experiments quantify the decoupled longitudinal force capability of DuctAM. Finally, representative push-and-pull interaction tasks, including cart pushing, door closing, and drawer opening, verify the practical effectiveness of DuctAM. The results show that DuctAM achieves significantly improved horizontal interaction force capability while maintaining stable flight compared with conventional UAVs.

AI.tldr: DuctAM 是一种紧凑型空中操作平台，通过在四旋翼的交互轴线上集成两个涵道风扇，增强水平推拉交互能力，并提出姿势力解耦控制方案，使飞行器无需大幅倾斜即可输出可控的水平力。
AI.motivation: 无人机（UAV）正从纯感知向物理交互拓展，形成无人空中操作器（UAM）。推（push）与拉（pull）是最基本的操作基元，需要在保持稳定飞行的同时持续施加水平力。然而传统多旋翼要产生水平力必须依靠姿态倾斜，导致姿态与力强耦合：既要维持飞行稳定又要精确施力，二者存在矛盾，限制了大交互力的产生，也影响了接触作业的稳定性与精度。该问题在空中接触式操作（如推车、关门、开抽屉）中尤为关键。
AI.method: 论文提出 DuctAM 平台：在四旋翼沿交互（纵向）轴线上集成两个涵道风扇（ducted fans），用于直接产生水平推力，从而在不依赖大姿态倾斜的情况下提升水平交互力。核心创新是姿势力解耦控制方案（attitude-force decoupled control），将姿态控制与水平力输出解耦，使水平力可独立、可控地施加，同时保持机体姿态稳定以维持飞行与接触。系统具有“四旋翼模式”与“涵道模式”两种工作模式。
AI.result: 论文开展了大量真实世界实验验证：(1) 八字形轨迹跟踪实验，验证在 quad 模式与 duct 模式下均能稳定飞行并实现精确运动控制；(2) 力测量实验，定量评估 DuctAM 解耦纵向力的输出能力；(3) 代表性推拉交互任务，包括推车（cart pushing）、关门（door closing）和开抽屉（drawer opening），验证实际有效性。结果表明，与传统 UAV 相比，DuctAM 在保持稳定飞行的同时显著提升了水平交互力能力。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出一种紧凑的涵道风扇增强型空中操作平台及姿势力解耦控制方案，将推拉操作中姿态与水平力的耦合问题解耦，并通过真实实验验证了轨迹跟踪精度、力输出能力及典型接触操作任务的可行性。其意义在于拓展了 UAV 的物理交互能力，为空中接触式操作提供了新思路。潜在局限包括：实验以真实平台验证为主，摘要未给出定量对比指标与力增益的具体数值；涵道风扇增加了额外重量与能耗，可能影响续航；解耦控制与外部接触力扰动的鲁棒性、以及在复杂环境与自主闭环操作中的泛化能力尚待进一步验证。

title: PuzzleMate: Benchmarking MLLMs for Egocentric Puzzle Assistance
summary:
Personal AI assistants hold the potential to evolve from digital interfaces into embodied companions capable of guiding users through complex physical activities. For these assistants to become integral to daily life, they must do more than identify objects; they must provide precise, step-by-step instructions that align with a user's real-time progress. While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show promise in general visual understanding, their ability to deliver grounded, sequential guidance for fine-grained manipulation tasks remains largely unverified.
  In this paper, we choose the jigsaw puzzle as a strategic testbed for this capability. Unlike general object recognition, puzzle solving demands high-precision spatial reasoning, the ability to distinguish between minute geometric variations, and a rigorous adherence to sequential logic.
  We investigate this capability through PuzzleMate, a novel framework focused on jigsaw puzzle solving captured through an egocentric viewpoint. We deploy PuzzleMate in a user-in-the-loop study to evaluate how well state-of-the-art MLLMs perceive the current puzzle state and generate actionable next-step instructions. Our analysis reveals seven key bottlenecks that limit their effectiveness. Building on these insights, we propose a benchmark that enables systematic evaluation of MLLMs' reasoning capabilities for puzzle solving. Our findings reveal a substantial performance gap in current models like GPT-5.2 and Gemini-2.5-Pro; while these MLLMs are highly capable, they struggle to navigate the intricate reasoning and sequential logic essential for jigsaw puzzle assistance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 PuzzleMate 框架，以拼图游戏作为具身个人 AI 助理能力测试平台，通过以自我为中心（egocentric）视角采集拼图过程，在用户在环（user-in-the-loop）研究中系统评估 SOTA 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）感知拼图状态并生成可执行下一步指令的能力，识别出七类关键瓶颈，并构建了用于系统评估 MLLM 拼图推理能力的基准。
AI.motivation: 论文关注的核心问题是：个人 AI 助理若要成为指导用户完成复杂物理活动的具身伙伴，仅具备物体识别能力远远不够，还必须能够根据用户实时进度提供精确、逐步的操作指令。尽管 MLLM 在通用视觉理解上表现突出，但其在细粒度操作任务中提供"有依据的、序列化"指导的能力尚未得到验证。论文选择拼图作为测试平台，因为拼图求解不同于一般物体识别，它要求高精度空间推理、区分细微几何差异的能力，以及严格遵守序列逻辑——这些恰好是衡量具身指导能力的严苛标准。该问题重要在于它揭示了当前 MLLM 从"看懂"到"指导行动"之间的能力鸿沟。
AI.method: 论文提出 PuzzleMate，一个面向拼图求解的框架，采用以自我为中心视角采集拼图过程，并将其部署于用户在环研究中，用于评估 SOTA MLLM 对当前拼图状态的感知能力以及生成可执行的下一步指令的能力。基于研究中对模型失败模式的分析，作者归纳出七类关键瓶颈，并据此设计了一个系统性基准，用以评估 MLLM 在拼图求解任务中的推理能力。该工作将研究重点从静态视觉理解转向对空间推理精度与序列逻辑一致性的联合考察。
AI.result: 实验在一项用户在环研究中展开，评估对象为当前最先进的 MLLM，文中明确提及 GPT-5.2 与 Gemini-2.5-Pro 等模型。研究分析了这些模型对拼图当前状态的感知以及对下一步指令的生成质量，并从中提炼出七类限制其有效性的瓶颈。主要发现是当前模型存在显著性能差距：尽管这些 MLLM 能力强大，但在拼图辅助所必需的复杂推理与序列逻辑方面仍表现不佳。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献在于：将拼图确立为评估具身 AI 助理细粒度序列指导能力的战略测试平台；通过用户在环研究系统揭示 MLLM 在拼图辅助中的七类关键瓶颈；并提出一个可系统评估 MLLM 拼图求解推理能力的基准。其意义在于指出现有 MLLM 从通用视觉理解迈向可靠、逐步的物理操作指导仍存在实质差距，为后续研究提供了诊断性工具与方向。可能的局限在于：评估集中于拼图这一特定任务，结论向其他操作任务的可推广性有待验证，且摘要未说明基准的规模、评价指标细节以及参与者数量等具体实验设置。

title: OCT-FedSIR: Toward Trustworthy Federated Ophthalmic Learning under Annotation Noise
comment: 38 pages, 7 figures, 4 tables, 6 tables in supplementary material
summary: Federated learning enables collaborative model development without centralizing patient data, but annotation reliability at participating institutions cannot always be assumed. In ophthalmic imaging, differences in disease prevalence and class composition can resemble changes caused by corrupted supervision. We introduce OCT-FedSIR, a reliability-aware spectral framework for federated OCT classification under client-dependent annotation noise and heterogeneous data distributions. OCT-FedSIR combines class-balanced spectral estimation, Stage-I logit adjustment, complementary spectral descriptors, selective spectral relabeling, and noise-aware federated optimization. We evaluated the framework on the Kermany, University of Illinois Chicago, and Wake Forest datasets under symmetric and structured asymmetric noise and three levels of non-IID heterogeneity. Across 117 experimental conditions, OCT-FedSIR achieved a mean accuracy of 86.73%, compared with 79.94% for RoFL and 78.75% for FedCorr. It correctly separated clients with original and corrupted annotations across all evaluated conditions, while the original FedSIR identification procedure was less robust, particularly under asymmetric noise. Spectral relabeling recovered 77.2% of corrupted annotations with 91.3% correction precision and a 3.5% false-correction rate. Retaining corrected clients outperformed spectral pruning by 9.30 percentage points on average. These findings show that annotation noise can often be identified and corrected without discarding informative client data.

AI.tldr: OCT-FedSIR：一种面向联邦 OCT 分类的"可靠性感知频谱框架"，在客户端依赖的标注噪声与数据异质条件下，通过频谱估计、logit 调整、选择性频谱重标注与噪声感知优化，实现标注噪声的识别与纠正而非直接丢弃客户端。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可在不集中患者数据的前提下进行协作建模，但无法假设各参与机构的标注都是可靠的。在眼科 OCT 成像中，疾病患病率与类别构成的差异会与"监督被污染"造成的分布变化高度相似，导致难以区分"数据异质"和"标注损坏"。已有方法（如 RoFL、FedCorr）在该场景下鲁棒性不足，尤其是非对称噪声下难以正确区分正常客户端与被污染客户端。该问题重要，因为眼科标注需专业医生完成、成本高且易出错，若简单剔除疑似噪声客户端会损失大量有价值数据。
AI.method: OCT-FedSIR 是一个可靠性感知的频谱框架，包含若干关键组件：（1）类别平衡的频谱估计（class-balanced spectral estimation），用于在类别不均衡下稳定估计频谱特征；（2）Stage-I logit 调整，缓解类别先验偏移对判别的影响；（3）互补频谱描述子（complementary spectral descriptors），刻画客户端层面的标注可靠性信号；（4）选择性频谱重标注（selective spectral relabeling），对被判定为损坏的标注进行纠正而非直接剔除；（5）噪声感知的联邦优化（noise-aware federated optimization），在训练中显式考虑标注噪声。整体思路是先识别客户端标注可靠性，再纠正而非剪枝。
AI.result: 实验在 Kermany、University of Illinois Chicago、Wake Forest 三个数据集上进行，覆盖对称噪声与结构化非对称噪声以及三种程度的 non-IID 异质性，共计 117 种实验条件。OCT-FedSIR 平均准确率达 86.73%，优于 RoFL 的 79.94% 与 FedCorr 的 78.75%。在所有评估条件下均能正确区分标注正常与损坏的客户端；而原始 FedSIR 的识别流程鲁棒性较弱，尤其在不称噪声下。频谱重标注恢复了 77.2% 的损坏标注，纠正精度 91.3%，误纠正率 3.5%。保留被纠正客户端相比频谱剪枝平均提升 9.30 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 论文主要贡献在于提出可靠性感知的频谱联邦学习框架，证明标注噪声（在 OCT 场景下）通常可被识别并纠正，而无需丢弃包含信息的客户端数据，并给出重标注有效性与"纠正优于剪枝"的量化证据。局限方面，摘要未报告计算/通信开销，实验集中在 OCT 医学影像模态，方法对更广泛视觉任务与自然图像噪声类型的泛化性尚待验证。

title: WLA$^3$: World Latent Action Modeling for Semantics, Dynamics, and Kinematics
comment: Project page can be found at https://wla-3.github.io/
summary: Scaling generalist policy models with heterogeneous data is limited by the lack of unified, low-noise action supervision. Human egocentric videos are abundant, but only a small fraction comes with high-quality hand-action labels. Observed world transitions offer a common source of action-related supervision across data sources. We introduce WLA$^3$ (World Latent Action Modeling for Semantics, Dynamics, and Kinematics), a unified generalist policy model framework built around representations learned by a World Latent Action Model (WLAM). WLAM first learns how multimodal world states change over a local interval, encoding synchronized camera views and available embodiment-state changes into a compact local latent action and a richer transition feature. Reconstruction from partial modalities and consistency across overlapping windows encourage robust transition representations. WLA$^3$ reuses them across semantics, dynamics, and kinematics: local latent actions support action-sensitive physical-dynamics modeling, segment-level features directly supervise the VLM through a Semantic Latent Aggregate (SLA), and an action expert jointly predicts latent actions together with embodiment-specific robot controls. Human videos provide scalable transition supervision, while robot trajectories ground the shared representation in executable native controls. On LARYBench, the final 32D latent action reaches 67.89\% average classification accuracy. WLA$^3$ achieves 81.9% average success across six real-robot tasks versus 66.2% for $π_{0.5}$. Performance improves as generalist policy model mid-training data scales, and human videos support human-to-robot transfer. Project page can be found at https://wla-3.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WLA³（World Latent Action Modeling for Semantics, Dynamics, and Kinematics），一个围绕世界潜在动作模型（WLAM）构建的通用策略（generalist policy）框架。WLAM 从局部时间窗口内学习多模态世界状态的变化，将同步相机视角与可用的具身状态变化编码为紧凑的局部潜在动作（latent action）以及更丰富的转移特征，并在语义、动力学、运动学三个层面复用该表示来训练通用机器人策略。
AI.motivation: 用异构数据扩展通用策略模型的核心瓶颈在于缺乏统一、低噪声的动作监督信号。人类第一视角（egocentric）视频数量庞大，但只有极少数带有高质量手部动作标注，导致监督稀疏且噪声大。论文提出以"观察到的世界状态转移（world transition）"作为跨数据源的通用动作相关监督来源：无论人类视频还是机器人轨迹，都共享"世界如何变化"这一信号，从而绕开对显式动作标签的依赖，实现可扩展的通用策略预训练与跨具身迁移。
AI.method: 核心是世界潜在动作模型（WLAM）：它学习局部区间内多模态世界状态如何变化，将同步的相机视角和可获得的具身状态变化编码为一个紧凑的局部潜在动作与一个更丰富的转移特征。训练上通过部分模态重建（reconstruction from partial modalities）以及重叠窗口间的一致性（consistency across overlapping windows）约束，获得鲁棒的转移表示。WLA³ 将该表示在三个维度复用：（1）语义——通过 Semantic Latent Aggregate（SLA）用片段级特征直接监督 VLM；（2）动力学——用局部潜在动作支持动作敏感（action-sensitive）的物理动力学建模；（3）运动学——由动作专家（action expert）联合预测潜在动作与具身特定的机器人控制信号。人类视频提供可扩展的转移监督，机器人轨迹则将共享表示接地到可执行的原生控制上。
AI.result: 在 LARYBench 上，最终 32 维潜在动作取得 67.89% 的平均分类准确率，表明所学表示具有良好的动作语义可分性。在六项真实机器人任务上，WLA³ 平均成功率达 81.9%，显著优于 π₀.₅ 的 66.2%。此外，随着通用策略模型中训练（mid-training）数据规模扩大，性能持续提升；人类视频可为人类到机器人（human-to-robot）迁移提供支持。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献是提出以世界潜在动作表示为统一接口的通用策略框架 WLA³/WLAM，将异构数据（人类视频与机器人轨迹）对齐到同一动作相关表示空间，在语义、动力学、运动学三方面共享，并以世界转移作为可扩展的低噪声监督源，在基准与真实机器人任务上均验证了有效性及数据规模可扩展性。潜在局限包括：对原始摘要未披露的细节（如具体模态组合、训练数据规模与覆盖范围、潜在动作维度选择的影响、仅在六项任务上的评估规模、以及人类视频迁移的泛化边界）仍需进一步实验验证。

title: MCIQA-2K: A Multi-Dimensional Dataset and No-Reference Quality Assessment Benchmark for Colorized Images
summary: Image colorization is an inherently ill-posed task, since a single grayscale image may correspond to multiple plausible colorized results. Consequently, conventional full-reference image quality assessment (IQA) metrics fail to accurately reflect human perceptual preferences for colorized images. In this paper, we present MCIQA-2K, a large-scale multi-dimensional benchmark specifically designed for no-reference quality assessment of colorized images. We construct a dataset containing 2,000 colorized images generated by five representative colorization models, together with human annotations across three perceptual dimensions: color smearing, semantic color misalignment, and global naturalness. Building upon the proposed benchmark, we further introduce MCIQA, a dedicated multi-branch NR-IQA framework for colorized images. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MCIQA significantly outperforms existing full-reference and no-reference IQA methods on the proposed benchmark, while also exhibiting competitive generalization capability on several widely-used IQA datasets. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/ARBEZ-ZEBRA/MCIQA.

AI.tldr: 提出面向图像上色任务的多维无参考质量评估基准 MCIQA-2K 及配套的多分支 NR-IQA 框架 MCIQA，从颜色涂抹、语义颜色错位和全局自然度三个维度评估上色结果。
AI.motivation: 图像上色是典型的病态（ill-posed）任务：单张灰度图可对应多种合理上色结果。因此基于像素级比对的全参考（FR）IQA 指标（如 PSNR、SSIM）无法准确反映人类对上色图像的感知偏好。同时，现有 NR-IQA 方法并非针对上色伪影设计，缺少专用基准与评测维度，导致上色模型的质量评估缺乏可靠依据。
AI.method: 构建 MCIQA-2K 基准：数据集包含 2,000 张由 5 个代表性上色模型生成的上色图像，并配有覆盖三个感知维度（颜色涂抹 color smearing、语义颜色错位 semantic color misalignment、全局自然度 global naturalness）的人工标注。基于该基准提出 MCIQA——一个面向上色图像的无参考 IQA 框架，采用多分支（multi-branch）结构，对应上述多维感知质量进行建模与预测。
AI.result: 在 MCIQA-2K 基准上的大量实验表明，MCIQA 显著优于现有全参考与无参考 IQA 方法；同时在多个通用 IQA 数据集上展现出有竞争力的泛化能力。评测维度与标注基于人工感知偏好，指标聚焦于与主观质量的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献为：(1) 首次针对上色图像提出多维、大规模 NR-IQA 基准 MCIQA-2K，并定义三个感知评估维度；(2) 提出与之匹配的多分支 NR-IQA 框架 MCIQA，在专用基准上超越现有 FR/NR 方法并保持跨数据集泛化性；数据集与代码已开源。潜在局限：数据规模（2,000 张）与上色模型数量（5 个）有限；人工标注存在主观性，且未明确涉及事件相机、时序建模、小目标检测等方向。

title: Calibrating Interpretability Instruments Before Trusting Their Verdicts
comment: 16 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Companion to "Refusal Reads Only a Slice of What the Model Knows" (submitted concurrently). Per-unit arrays: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22731361. Code: https://github.com/deepsteer/deepsteer
summary: Causal claims about large language model (LLM) internals rest on measurements. Those might include a projection, a cosine, an ablation delta, or an interchange patch among others. These measurements fail in specific, diagnosable ways that return a plausible number instead of an error, so a broken instrument can easily read as a finding. A covariance-matched null can saturate until every direction looks typical, a per-head attribution can overshoot the true residual write threefold on reordered-normalization architectures, an interchange patch can go sign-chaotic because its outcome is pinned at a ceiling, or a read-from verdict can be an artifact of measuring past the layer where the model already decided. This note documents six such failures from a causal interpretability program on refusal and moral representation, spanning several papers and a four-model open-weight panel; each mode is established on one or two of the four. For each we give the tell that catches it and a protocol keyed to a detectable trigger (reordered normalization, massive activations, a low-dimensional decision channel), so we and readers can check whether a given setup is exposed. The discipline reduces to four moves: calibrate against a positive-control ladder, certify with an orthogonal cell, compute power before spending compute, and state every read-from verdict at a depth referenced to the model's commitment. The evidence is four architectures across three families within a single program; external replication across programs is future work.

AI.tldr: 该论文（technique note）针对LLM因果可解释性测量工具的系统性失效问题，记录并分类了六种"无声失败"模式——这些测量会返回看似合理但实为伪迹的数值而非报错，并基于拒绝行为与道德表征的因果可解释性研究项目，在四个开源权重模型上提供可检测触发器与对应协议。
AI.motivation: 关于LLM内部的因果主张（如某方向、某注意力头、某层负责某行为）都建立在具体测量之上：投影、余弦相似度、消融差值、interchange patch（激活替换/交换补丁）等。问题在于这些测量会以"可诊断但被忽略"的方式失效并返回貌似合理的数值，使损坏的工具被误读为发现。例如协方差匹配的null可能饱和导致所有方向都"看起来典型"；per-head归因在reordered-normalization架构上可能将真实残差写入高估三倍；interchange patch因结果被钉在天花板（ceiling）上而出现符号混乱（sign-chaotic）；read-from结论可能源于在被测层已"越过"模型实际决策点的深度进行的测量伪迹。因此需要系统识别这些失效模式并给出可核查的协议，以避免可解释性研究产出不可复现或错误的因果结论。
AI.method: 方法上，作者基于一个关于拒绝（refusal）与道德表征的因果可解释性研究程序，跨多篇论文及一个四模型开源权重面板（four-model open-weight panel），归纳出六种典型失效模式，每种建立在四模型中的一个或两个之上。对每个失效模式，论文给出：(1) 能捕捉该失败的"tell"（诊断线索）；(2) 与可检测触发器相绑定的协议，触发器包括reordered normalization（重排序归一化）、massive activations（大规模激活）、low-dimensional decision channel（低维决策通道）等，用以判断特定实验设置是否暴露于该失效。最终将规范提炼为四个动作：用positive-control ladder进行校准、用orthogonal cell进行认证、在消耗算力前先计算统计功效（power）、以及将每个read-from结论的深度参照模型的"承诺点"（commitment）来陈述。核心创新不在于提出新的解释方法，而在于对既有因果测量工具的失效机理进行系统化分类与防护协议设计。
AI.result: 实验对象为四个开源权重架构，覆盖三个模型家族，均来自同一研究程序。论文以每类失效模式在其中一个或两个模型上得到确立为证据基础，并通过具体测量现象加以说明：协方差匹配null饱和、per-head归因在reordered-normalization架构上高估真实残差约三倍、interchange patch在结果封顶时出现符号混乱、read-from结论源自越过模型决策层的深度测量等。评估方式为诊断性验证与触发器筛查，而非传统benchmark指标。作者明确指出证据范围限于单一程序内的四架构三家族，跨程序的external replication属于未来工作。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献是提出一套针对LLM因果可解释性测量的失效分类学与防护纪律：六种失败模式、对应的诊断线索，以及基于可检测触发器的核查协议，并归纳为校准、正交认证、功效预计算、深度参照承诺点四条准则。其意义在于提醒研究者，损坏的测量工具可能伪装成发现，从而提高LLM内部机制研究的可靠性。局限包括：证据仅来自一个程序内的四个模型（三个家族），外部跨程序复现尚未完成，因此六种失效模式的普遍性与协议在不同架构、不同任务上的泛化能力仍需进一步验证；此外协议依赖诸如reordered normalization、massive activations等特定架构触发器，可能不适用于未包含这些特征的模型。

title: Goal-Oriented Communications for Physical AI: Design and Testbed
comment: Submitting to IEEE for potential publications
summary: Physical AI relies on frequently-updated, latency-sensitive video stream to perceive, reason, and interact with the physical world, resulting in strict latency requirements with much higher data volumes that existing 5G networks cannot support. Goal-oriented communication (GoC) offers as a promising approach to solve this challenge by transmitting only task-relevant semantic representations. However, existing GoC frameworks were mainly evaluated in the simulations while their effectiveness has never been validated in a practical deployment of physical AI application. In this work, we develop an end-to-end GoC testbed for Physical AI, which connects a PiPER robot arm equipped with an RGB-D camera and a 5G modem to an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin edge server through a 5G OpenAirInterface network. We propose and implement three GoC frameworks that transmit 3D bounding boxes, 2D scene graphs, and 3D scene graphs, as three types of semantic representations, respectively. They share the common functional modules designed for closed-loop Physical AI applications, including semantic extraction, full stack 5G transmission, language model inference, digital twin validation, and robotic control. Extensive experiments on our testbed show that our GoC frameworks reduce the task completion time by up to 52.6% and improve task success probability by up to 45%, compared to the traditional framework that periodically transmits the raw image data. These results validate the practical effectiveness of our GoC framework and pave the way for efficient and reliable Physical AI applications over future 6G networks. Project website: https://sites.google.com/view/goc-physical-ai-testbed.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个面向Physical AI的端到端目标导向通信(GoC)实测平台，并实现三种语义表示传输框架（3D边界框、2D场景图、3D场景图），在真实5G网络上验证了GoC相比传统原始图像传输在任务完成时间与成功率上的显著优势。
AI.motivation: Physical AI需要频繁更新、低时延的视频流来感知、推理并与物理世界交互，导致既有严格时延要求又有极高数据量，现有5G网络难以支撑。目标导向通信(GoC)通过仅传输任务相关的语义表示被视为可行方案，但已有GoC框架多在仿真中评估，从未在真实的Physical AI应用部署中验证其有效性，因此缺乏实际可行性证据。
AI.method: 作者搭建了端到端GoC实测平台：机械臂PiPER搭载RGB-D相机与5G模组，通过5G OpenAirInterface网络连接到NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin边缘服务器。提出并实现三种GoC框架，分别传输3D边界框、2D场景图、3D场景图三类语义表示；三者共享面向闭环Physical AI应用的功能模块，包括语义提取、全栈5G传输、语言模型推理、数字孪生验证以及机器人控制。
AI.result: 在自建实测平台上进行了大量实验，对照传统周期性传输原始图像数据的框架。结果表明，所提GoC框架可将任务完成时间最多降低52.6%，任务成功概率最多提升45%。实验在真实5G网络中完成，验证了GoC从仿真走向实际部署的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是首个面向Physical AI的端到端GoC实测平台及三种语义表示传输框架，并在真实5G部署中证明了相对原始图像传输的显著收益。意义在于为未来6G网络中高效可靠的Physical AI应用提供了实践依据。局限可能包括：机器人任务与场景类型相对单一、语义表示种类有限、依赖特定硬件与OAI网络配置，泛化性与大规模多用户场景下的表现尚未充分验证。

title: CGGT: Curve-Grounded Geometry Transformer for 3D Parametric Curve Reconstruction
summary: Recovering editable 3D parametric curves from 2D images is a fundamental challenge in computer graphics, bridging pixel-based perception and vector-based CAD modeling. Existing NeRF- and 3DGS-based methods often rely on dense calibrated views, precomputed 2D edge maps, and costly per-scene optimization, limiting their applicability to casually captured real-world inputs. We propose CGGT, a Curve-Grounded Geometry Transformer that directly grounds 3D-consistent 2D curve instances in the image space from sparse, unposed multi-view images. CGGT combines a geometry-aware transformer encoder for multi-view feature learning with a curve-aware masked-attention decoder for cross-view instance association. In a single forward pass, it predicts camera parameters, dense depth maps, and instance-level 2D curve masks, which are then lifted into 3D and refined through a fast parametric optimization stage to recover compact, editable 3D curve primitives. To support structured curve learning, we introduce Wireframe-100K, a large-scale dataset comprising 100,000 CAD models with diverse topologies, realistic multi-view renderings, and accurate parametric curve annotations. Extensive experiments show that our framework achieves substantial improvements in both reconstruction accuracy and efficiency, particularly under challenging sparse-view settings and in separating persistent 3D structural edges from view-dependent image edges caused by silhouettes, textures, and appearance variations. Despite being trained solely on synthetic data, CGGT generalizes well to real-world images, demonstrating its potential for practical CAD-style wireframe reconstruction from unconstrained visual inputs.

AI.tldr: CGGT 提出一种"曲线接地几何 Transformer"，从稀疏、无位姿的多视角图像中直接在图像空间定位 3D 一致的 2D 曲线实例，单次前向预测相机参数、稠密深度与实例级 2D 曲线掩码，再经快速参数化优化提升为紧凑可编辑的 3D 曲线基元；同时发布大规模合成数据集 Wireframe-100K。
AI.motivation: 从 2D 图像恢复可编辑的 3D 参数化曲线是连接像素级感知与矢量级 CAD 建模的基础问题。现有基于 NeRF 和 3DGS 的方法存在明显局限：依赖稠密且已标定的视角、需要预计算的 2D 边缘图、且需针对每个场景进行昂贵的优化，因而难以适用于随意拍摄的真实输入。此外，一个核心难点是区分持续存在的 3D 结构边缘与由轮廓、纹理和外观变化引起的视角相关图像边缘。论文旨在解决稀疏、无位姿多视角输入下的结构化线框重建问题。
AI.method: CGGT（Curve-Grounded Geometry Transformer）的核心设计包含两部分：一是几何感知 Transformer 编码器，用于多视角特征学习；二是曲线感知的掩码注意力解码器（curve-aware masked-attention decoder），用于跨视角的曲线实例关联。模型在一次前向传播中即预测相机参数、稠密深度图和实例级 2D 曲线掩码，随后通过将 2D 曲线提升（lift）到 3D 并进行快速参数化优化，恢复紧凑、可编辑的 3D 曲线基元。为支持结构化曲线学习，论文构建了 Wireframe-100K 数据集，包含 100,000 个拓扑多样的 CAD 模型、真实感多视角渲染以及精确的参数化曲线标注，用于监督曲线实例的学习。
AI.result: 论文在稀疏视角设置下进行了大量实验，报告了在重建精度和效率两方面的显著提升，尤其在具有挑战性的稀疏视角条件下表现突出。方法能够有效分离持续存在的 3D 结构边缘与由轮廓、纹理及外观变化导致的视角相关图像边缘。值得注意的是，CGGT 仅在合成数据（Wireframe-100K）上训练，却能良好泛化到真实世界图像，仅在合成数据上训练的前提下实现了对无约束视觉输入的 CAD 风格线框重建。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献是：(1) 提出 CGGT 框架，实现从稀疏无位姿多视角图像到紧凑可编辑 3D 参数化曲线的端到端重建，单次前向即完成相机、深度与曲线实例预测；(2) 引入曲线感知的掩码注意力解码机制进行跨视角实例关联；(3) 发布 Wireframe-100K 大规模结构化曲线数据集。其意义在于绕开了 NeRF/3DGS 类方法对稠密标定视角、预计算边缘图和逐场景优化的依赖，提升了实用性与效率。潜在局限包括：最终 3D 曲线仍依赖一个参数化优化细化阶段（并非完全端到端），训练监督来自合成数据，真实场景的分布偏移与曲线标注质量可能影响泛化上限。

title: Refusal Reads Only a Slice of What the Model Knows: Harm-Keyed Routing and Its Exceptions Across Model Families
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures, 15 tables. Companion methods note: "Calibrating Interpretability Instruments Before Trusting Their Verdicts" (submitted concurrently). Per-unit arrays: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22731361. Code: https://github.com/deepsteer/deepsteer
summary: Alignment applied after pretraining is shallow in a measurable way: a single direction in a model's residual stream can be edited out, and the model stops refusing harmful requests. That fact says how easily refusal can be removed, not what the refusal decision was reading in the first place. We ask what it reads, and we separate that from what the model comprehends. Across four open-weight models spanning three families, moral comprehension is native to pretraining: a low-rank moral subspace crystallizes during pretraining, and alignment rotates it once without rebuilding it. The refusal gate, in contrast, is a fresh post-training construction with only a weak pretraining precursor, written into a narrow control-token channel where the refusal decision is orthogonal to the moral-judgment decision. The central result is causal and comes from one model, OLMo-3. A nested interchange rank sweep patches successively larger slices of the moral subspace between matched requests and reads how much of refusal's response transfers: as the basis widens, moral judgment keeps reading more of it, while refusal levels off at the level of a single harm direction, and about three-quarters of refusal's causal input lies outside the moral subspace altogether. Refusal reads the harm percept, not the moral content that judgment reads on the same patches. The picture is not uniform across families. Llama reads broad moral content; Qwen reads beyond the single harm cue but is unresolved at our sample size; GPT-OSS reads harm, and its refusals can be argued in either direction by its own reasoning trace. Where refusal reads only a low-rank slice and routes around the bulk of what the model knows, a rank-one edit removes it. Whether widening what refusal reads would also deepen the behavior is the open question this raises.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分了「模型理解什么」与「拒绝行为读什么」，使用因果方法证明：道德理解（moral comprehension）在预训练阶段就已形成低秩道德子空间，而对齐（alignment）只是对其做一次旋转而未重建；拒绝门控（refusal gate）则是后训练阶段新建的、仅具微弱预训练前驱的构造，写入一个狭窄的控制 token 通道，其拒绝决策与道德判断决策正交。在OLMo-3上通过嵌套交换秩扫描（nested interchange rank sweep）发现，约四分之三的拒绝因果输入落在道德子空间之外，拒绝读取的是「伤害感知」而非同批样本上的「道德内容」。不同模型家族存在差异（Llama读广义道德内容，Qwen读超出单一伤害线索但样本量不足未定，GPT-OSS读伤害且其推理链可向两个方向论证拒绝）。
AI.motivation: 先前工作已表明：对齐可以被单一残差流方向编辑移除（rank-one ablation即可使模型停止拒绝有害请求）。但这一现象只说明「拒绝容易被移除」，并未回答拒绝决策究竟读取了什么信息。核心动机是分离两个常被混淆的问题：(1) 模型对道德内容的表征与理解发生在哪里、何时形成；(2) 拒绝行为在决策时实际依据哪些特征。这一问题对AI安全至关重要——若拒绝只读取一个低秩的伤害线索并绕过模型知识的主体，那么对齐在结构上可能是脆弱的、易被编辑的；理解这一读取机制是为对齐稳健性提供诊断的基础。
AI.method: 作者在四个开源开放权重模型、三个模型家族上进行表征与因果分析。方法要点：(1) 用低秩子空间分析追踪「道德子空间」（moral subspace）在预训练与后训练各阶段的结晶过程，发现其在预训练中形成，对齐阶段仅发生一次旋转而非重建；(2) 将拒绝门控定位为一个后训练新建的构造，写入狭窄的控制 token 通道，并证明拒绝决策与道德判断决策在该通道中正交；(3) 核心因果实验在OLMo-3上完成：采用嵌套交换秩扫描（nested interchange rank sweep），在一对匹配请求之间逐级交换（interchange）道德子空间中越来越大的切片，测量拒绝响应中有多少随之迁移（transfer）。通过对比道德判断与拒绝在不同子空间宽度下的读取增益，估计拒绝因果输入中落在道德子空间内/外的比例；(4) 进行跨家族对比（Llama / Qwen / GPT-OSS）以检验结论的普适性；(5) 以rank-one编辑验证低秩结论。
AI.result: 实验覆盖四个开放权重模型、三个模型家族（OLMo-3、Llama、Qwen、GPT-OSS），评估指标主要为交换（interchange）后的因果迁移量与子空间秩的关系。主要发现：道德理解是预训练原生（native to pretraining），低秩道德子空间在预训练中形成，对齐只做一次旋转。拒绝门控则为后训练新建、仅有微弱预训练前驱。在OLMo-3的嵌套交换秩扫描中，随着交换基加宽，道德判断持续读取更多子空间内容，而拒绝的迁移量在「单一伤害方向」处即饱和；约75%的拒绝因果输入落在道德子空间之外。即：拒绝读取伤害感知（harm percept），而非道德判断所读取的道德内容。跨家族存在差异：Llama读取广义道德内容；Qwen读取超出单一伤害线索的内容，但在该样本量下未能定论；GPT-OSS读取伤害，其推理轨迹可被自身论证向任一方向引导。凡拒绝仅读取低秩切片之处，rank-one编辑即可移除拒绝行为。
AI.conclusion: 贡献在于从机制层面区分了道德理解与拒绝读取，并给出因果关系证据：安全相关行为（拒绝）的因果输入主要是低秩的伤害感知，与模型道德知识的表征主体相分离，这解释了为何对齐行为可被单一方向编辑移除。局限与开放问题：核心因果结果为单模型（OLMo-3）结果，跨家族结论并不一致（Qwen样本量不足未定论）；论文未证明「拓宽拒绝读取的内容」是否会同时深化该行为，此为作者提出的开放问题。该工作属于机制可解释性与对齐安全范畴，与事件视觉、时空建模、目标检测、SNN/神经形态计算等方向无直接关联。

title: SlipSense: Multimodal Tactile Learning for Low-Latency and Generalized Slip Detection
summary: Slip detection is fundamental to dexterous manipulation, yet existing systems often lack precise characterization of detection latency and cross-platform generalization. We present SlipSense, a multimodal tactile slip-detection framework built on TacV5, a compact sensor integrating a $32 \times 32$ piezoresistive array operating at 240 Hz and a 3-axis MEMS accelerometer operating at 8 kHz. The piezoresistive array captures spatial pressure distributions, while the accelerometer captures friction-induced vibrations, providing complementary slip cues. The framework performs modality-specific encoding, intra-sensor fusion, and cross-modal attention with causal temporal prediction at 240 Hz. Experiments on a dataset of 1.4 million frames spanning 37 objects demonstrate the complementarity of the two modalities. SlipSense achieves 96.7% Macro F1 with a false-positive rate below 1.6%, detecting 76% of slip events within 23.1 ms. When trained solely on UMI data, SlipSense generalizes zero-shot to a Tesollo dexterous hand, transferring across unseen objects, distinct sensor units, and robotic platforms without retraining.

AI.tldr: SlipSense 是一个基于新型紧凑传感器 TacV5 的多模态触觉滑动检测框架：TacV5 集成 32×32 压阻阵列（240 Hz）与 3 轴 MEMS 加速度计（8 kHz），通过模态特定编码、传感器内融合与跨模态注意力实现因果时序预测，在 1.4M 帧数据集上取得 96.7% Macro F1，并在零样本条件下跨平台迁移到 Tesollo 灵巧手。
AI.motivation: 滑动（slip）检测是灵巧操作的核心能力，但现有系统普遍存在两个不足：一是对检测延迟缺乏精确刻画，而延迟直接决定抓取控制的实时性；二是跨传感器、跨机械手平台的泛化能力不足，导致系统难以迁移部署。作者据此提出需要同时具备互补感知模态、低延迟因果预测以及强泛化性的滑动检测方案。
AI.method: 核心硬件 TacV5 将两种互补模态集成于单一紧凑传感器：32×32 压阻阵列以 240 Hz 采集空间压力分布，捕捉接触几何与压力中心变化；3 轴 MEMS 加速度计以 8 kHz 采集摩擦诱导振动，捕捉滑动发生的高频瞬态信号。算法流程包括：模态特定的编码（分别适配低频空间压力与高频振动信号的时间尺度）、传感器内（intra-sensor）融合、以及跨模态注意力（cross-modal attention）机制，并采用因果时序预测以支持 240 Hz 的在线推断，避免使用未来帧造成延迟。
AI.result: 在覆盖 37 类物体的 1.4 百万帧数据集上进行实验，验证了压阻阵列与加速度计两种模态的互补性。性能上达到 96.7% Macro F1，假阳性率低于 1.6%，并在 23.1 ms 内检出 76% 的滑动事件，兼具高精度与低延迟。泛化方面，仅在 UMI 数据上训练后，模型可零样本（zero-shot）迁移至 Tesollo 灵巧手，在未见物体、不同传感器单元及不同机器人平台上均无需重训练即可工作。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于：提出集成了高频振动与空间压力感知的紧凑多模态触觉传感器 TacV5，构建了具备因果时序预测与跨模态注意力的滑动检测框架 SlipSense，并系统性地量化了检测延迟与假阳性率，同时展示了跨平台零样本迁移能力。其意义在于为灵巧操作的闭环控制提供了低延迟、可迁移的触觉反馈方案。潜在局限包括：摘要未报告在大规模真实抓取任务中的闭环控制效果，零样本迁移的适用范围仍限于所测试的手部与传感器单元，且跨模态融合对 8 kHz 高频信号的计算开销与边缘部署效率未做充分说明。

title: Selective Tool Use for Agentic Change Visual Question Answering in Remote Sensing
summary: Change visual question answering (Change VQA) requires understanding semantic changes across bi-temporal remote sensing images. Although vision language models (VLMs) have shown promising performance on this task, they remain unreliable when answering questions that require explicit transition statistics, area measurements, or spatial information. To address this limitation, we propose a selective tool use framework in which a single VLM either answers directly or invokes a deterministic change analysis tool to obtain question specific evidence. Specifically, the selected tool operates on bi-temporal semantic maps and returns a structured observation, which the same VLM uses to generate its final answer. To support this framework, we construct a tool augmented extension of CDVQA covering eight question families and three tools for transition, spatial, and temporal analysis. Tool use supervision and observations are derived automatically from the original semantic annotations, without additional manual labeling. We then adapt Qwen3.5-4B using Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to jointly learn direct answering, tool invocation, and evidence conditioned answering. Experiments on 7,164 test questions show that selective tool use with reference semantic maps improves overall accuracy from 73.77% to 88.79% and average family accuracy from 69.11% to 89.65%. When the semantic maps are predicted automatically, the framework achieves 77.47% overall accuracy and 75.06% average family accuracy. These results demonstrate the benefit of question-specific semantic evidence for Change VQA, while highlighting the influence of semantic prediction quality on the resulting performance. Code and tool-augmented annotations will be made publicly available at https://github.com/yakoubbazi/ToolChangeVQA.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种"选择性工具调用"（selective tool use）框架用于变化视觉问答（Change VQA）：单个 VLM（Qwen3.5-4B + LoRA）可选择直接作答，或调用一个确定性的变化分析工具，在双时相语义图上生成结构化观测证据，再据此生成最终答案；同时构建了覆盖八类问题、三种工具（转移/空间/时序分析）的 CDVQA 工具增强扩展数据集。
AI.motivation: Change VQA 需要理解双时相遥感影像之间的语义变化，但现有 VLM 在需要显式转移统计（transition statistics）、面积测量或空间信息的提问上仍不可靠。这类问题本质上要求精确的计数/面积/空间关系推理，而纯语言-视觉端到端模型难以可靠地完成符号化、量化的推断。因此需要一个机制，让模型在"直接回答"与"借助确定性符号工具获取证据"之间自适应选择，以提升对量化与结构化问题的可靠性。
AI.method: 框架核心是单一 VLM 的选择性工具调用：(1) 模型先判定是否调用工具；(2) 若调用，则在双时相语义图上运行确定性变化分析工具，返回结构化观测（transition、spatial、temporal 三类工具，服务于八种问题族）；(3) 同一 VLM 以该观测作为条件证据生成最终答案。数据方面，在 CDVQA 基础上构建工具增强扩展，工具调用监督信号与观测结果均由原始语义标注自动导出，无需额外人工标注。训练上用 LoRA 适配 Qwen3.5-4B，联合学习三项目标：直接作答、工具调用决策、以及证据条件下的作答。
AI.result: 在 7,164 个测试问题上评测。使用参考（真值）语义图时，选择性工具调用将总体准确率从 73.77% 提升至 88.79%，平均问题族准确率从 69.11% 提升至 89.65%。当语义图由模型自动预测时，框架达到 77.47% 总体准确率与 75.06% 平均问题族准确率。结果表明，问题特定的语义证据对 Change VQA 有显著收益，同时语义预测质量对最终性能有明显影响（真值图与预测图之间存在约 11 个百分点的总体准确率差距）。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是：(1) 面向 Change VQA 的选择性工具使用范式，让 VLM 在直接回答与调用确定性变化分析工具之间自适应决策；(2) 构建了覆盖八类问题、三类工具的工具增强 CDVQA 数据集，标注与监督信号可自动化生成；(3) 通过 LoRA 联合训练验证了该框架在多问题族上的显著增益。意义在于显式强调"问题特定的语义证据"对量化型变化理解的价值。局限在于：(a) 性能高度依赖语义图质量，使用自动预测语义图时提升幅度明显缩小；(b) 工具为确定性算法，其能力边界受限于工具覆盖的问题类型；(c) 实验仅在遥感的 CDVQA 上验证，跨域与更复杂变化推理场景的泛化性尚不清楚。

title: Privacy Preserving Gossip Learning
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE CDC 2026
summary: We propose a decentralized privacy-preserving learning algorithm in which each agent holds a single private sample and a shared model. Samples are learned sequentially, and each update must preserve the endpoint mappings at previously learned samples while protecting private data. This gives each agent three roles: (i) a learner that updates the model parameters, (ii) a teacher whose sample is learned at the current iteration, and (iii) a protected agent whose sample has already been learned. We build on Tuning without Forgetting (TwF) method to preserve previously learned mappings and show that TwF provides an indistinguishability guarantee for the learner whenever the set of protected agents contains another sample with the same label. For the teacher, we formulate a minimax optimal control problem that models the differential privacy noise as a worst-case disturbance to prevent performance loss while maintaining the same level of privacy for the gradient. For the protected agents, we compute the projections locally and aggregate them using a private push-sum gossip protocol. We prove geometric convergence of the decentralized gossip algorithm and of the distributed projection for TwF.

AI.tldr: 提出一种去中心化隐私保护学习算法：每个智能体持有单个私密样本与共享模型，样本被顺序学习，且更新过程需保持已学样本的端点映射不变。算法基于 Tuning without Forgetting（TwF），并引入 minimax 最优控制来建模差分隐私噪声，配合私有 push-sum gossip 协议完成投影聚合，证明了去中心化 gossip 与分布式投影的几何收敛性。
AI.motivation: 在联邦/去中心化场景中，既要训练共享模型，又必须保护各智能体的私有样本。传统方法往往在隐私与已学知识保持（防遗忘）之间存在冲突：新样本的学习可能破坏旧样本的映射，而加入隐私噪声又会损害模型性能。该工作试图在去中心化、单样本学习的严格设定下同时满足隐私保护、遗忘抑制与性能保持三个目标。
AI.method: 每个智能体同时承担三种角色：学习者（更新模型参数）、教师（当前迭代被学习的样本提供者）、被保护智能体（样本已被学习）。核心机制包括：(1) 扩展 TwF 方法以保持已学样本的端点映射，并证明：当被保护集合中存在另一同标签样本时，TwF 对学习者提供不可区分性（indistinguishability）保证；(2) 针对教师角色，将差分隐私噪声建模为最坏情况扰动，形式化为 minimax 最优控制问题，从而在维持梯度同等隐私水平的同时避免性能损失；(3) 被保护智能体在本地计算投影，并通过私有 push-sum gossip 协议进行聚合。理论部分证明了去中心化 gossip 算法及 TwF 分布式投影的几何收敛性。
AI.result: 论文以理论分析为主，主要结果包括：TwF 在同标签被保护样本存在条件下对学习者的不可区分性保证；通过 minimax 最优控制实现差分隐私噪声下的性能保持；对去中心化 gossip 算法与 TwF 分布式投影给出几何收敛性证明。摘要中未提供具体数据集、实验设置或量化指标。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种将 TwF 防遗忘机制、差分隐私与去中心化 gossip 优化统一起来的隐私保护学习框架，并给出不可区分性与几何收敛的理论保证，其导师—学习者—被保护智能体的三重角色建模与 minimax 最优控制的隐私噪声处理具有一定新意。潜在局限在于：隐私保证依赖被保护集合中存在同类标签样本这一条件，且摘要未给出实验验证，实际性能与可扩展性有待评估。

title: Touch2Trace: Tactile-Driven Imitation Learning for Dexterous Cable Tracing
summary: Dexterous manipulation of deformable objects demands continuous fingertip-level regulation of pressure, friction, and incipient slip. We study one of the most challenging cases: dexterous cable tracing, feeding a cable through the hand with repeated pinch-and-curl motions of the thumb and index finger. We introduce Touch2Trace, a tactile-driven imitation-learning system for this task, and provide, to our knowledge, the first systematic real-world characterization of how encoder pretraining, control rate, temporal context, and spatial resolution each shape policy performance. The winning learning recipe combines a tactile encoder pretrained for a custom 32 x 32 piezoresistive sensor (TacV5) via self-supervised learning with a lightweight transformer policy trained on teleoperated demonstrations via behavior cloning, deployed at 60 Hz on a Tesollo DG-5F hand. Tactile feedback without vision or explicit cable-state estimation significantly improves tracing performance versus a proprioception-only baseline: from 0.2 cm to 20.1 cm mean distance and 0% to 93% success rate, with zero-shot transfer to unseen cables and routing conditions. The results quantify the influence of key parameters in tactile-driven systems for reliable dexterous deformable object manipulation.

AI.tldr: tldr: 论文提出 Touch2Trace，一个由触觉驱动的模仿学习系统，用于灵巧的线缆追踪（cable tracing）任务，即用拇指与食指反复捏合与弯曲动作将线缆在手中馈送推进。作者给出了首个真实世界中系统性的触觉策略性能表征，量化了编码器预训练、控制频率、时间上下文与空间分辨率四个因素对策略表现的影响。最优配方为：自监督预训练的 32×32 压阻式触觉编码器（TacV5）+ 轻量级 Transformer 策略（行为克隆、遥操作示范）+ 60 Hz 部署于 Tesollo DG-5F 手。
AI.motivation: motivation: 灵巧操作可变形物体（如线缆、绳索、布料）需要指尖级别的连续调节压力、摩擦力并感知初始滑移（incipient slip），这类信息视觉难以稳定获取（遮挡、线缆自身柔性形变、接触状态不可见）。线缆追踪尤其困难：它要求拇指与食指进行重复的捏合—卷曲（pinch-and-curl）动作，使线缆在手中受控地逐段推进，接触状态与局部滑移持续变化。现有工作多依赖视觉或显式的线缆状态估计，而触觉驱动方案的系统性设计规律（如需要多高的控制频率、多长的时序上下文、何种触觉表示）尚缺乏真实世界实验依据。本文的动机即在于填补这一空白，为触觉驱动的可变形物体灵巧操作提供可复用的工程与算法配方。
AI.method: method: 系统由三部分构成：(1) 触觉感知硬件为自定义的 32×32 压阻式触觉传感器阵列 TacV5，用于捕捉指尖接触的压力分布与滑移相关信号；(2) 触觉编码器通过自监督学习（SSL）在该传感器数据上预训练，以获得可迁移的触觉表征，随后用于下游策略；(3) 策略为轻量级 Transformer，采用行为克隆（BC）在遥操作示范数据上训练，输入为触觉与本体感觉（proprioception）时序序列，输出手部关节动作，在 Tesollo DG-5F 五指灵巧手上以 60 Hz 闭环运行。论文的关键实验设计是消融式地变量控制：编码器预训练方式、控制频率、时间上下文长度、触觉空间分辨率，以识别影响策略性能的主导因素。值得注意的是策略不使用视觉输入，也不进行显式的线缆状态估计，完全依赖触觉与本体感觉的时序建模。
AI.result: result: 在真实机器人平台上进行线缆追踪评测，主要指标为线缆推进的平均距离（cm）与任务成功率。核心对比显示，相比仅使用本体感觉的基线，引入触觉反馈带来决定性提升：平均追踪距离从 0.2 cm 提升到 20.1 cm，成功率从 0% 提升到 93%。最优配置为 TacV5 自监督预训练编码器 + 轻量 Transformer 策略 @ 60 Hz。此外，策略展现出零样本（zero-shot）迁移能力，可泛化到训练时未见的线缆类型与走线条件。实验还系统报告了编码器预训练、控制频率、时间上下文与空间分辨率对性能的量化影响，构成该任务下触觉驱动系统的首个系统性真实世界表征。
AI.conclusion: conclusion: 贡献在于：(1) 提出 Touch2Trace，一个纯触觉（无视觉、无显式线缆状态估计）的灵巧线缆追踪模仿学习系统，并在 Tesollo DG-5F 上以 60 Hz 实时闭环验证；(2) 提供了该任务下首个系统性真实世界表征，量化了编码器预训练、控制频率、时间上下文与空间分辨率四类设计变量对策略性能的影响，给出可复用的"最优学习配方"；(3) 通过从 0% 到 93% 的成功率跃升，实证了触觉在可变形物体操作中的不可替代性，并展示了零样本跨线缆、跨走线条件的泛化。局限方面：评测集中于线缆追踪这一具体任务，未与视觉方法做直接对比；触觉感知依赖定制 TacV5 传感器与特定灵巧手硬件，跨硬件/跨传感器的可迁移性仍需验证；自监督预训练的具体收益幅度与时间上下文、频率之间的交互作用虽被量化，但更深层的机理解释有限。

title: Sharing standardized image-derived data in computational pathology using DICOM
comment: Daniela P. Schacherer, Christopher P. Bridge: contributed equally
summary: Development and evaluation of computational pathology methods require access to large and diverse datasets. Over the past decade, various initiatives invested significantly into collecting, centralizing, and sharing pathology imaging data. In contrast, sharing of image-derived data such as region-of-interest delineations or segmentation masks is less well developed. In this work, we describe our approach to encoding and sharing image-derived pathology data in a standardized manner within the National Cancer Institute (NCI) Imaging Data Commons (IDC), a platform that hosts and provides public access to de-identified radiology and pathology data. The IDC relies on the Digital Imaging and Communications in Medicine (DICOM) standard for data harmonization, yet the adoption of DICOM for pathology image-derived content has remained largely unexplored until now. Here, we present five representative datasets harmonized by conversion from their original representations into DICOM and shared publicly in the IDC. We demonstrate the benefits of this harmonization, describe contributions to critical open-source tooling, and discuss technical considerations relevant to broader adoption of DICOM for pathology image-derived data.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一套将病理图像衍生的数据（如感兴趣区标注、分割掩膜）以 DICOM 标准编码并公开共享于 NCI Imaging Data Commons（IDC）的方法，并通过对五个代表性数据集的转换与公开发布，验证了采用 DICOM 统一病理图像衍生内容表示的可行性与优势。
AI.motivation: 计算病理学方法的发展依赖大规模、多样化的数据集。过去十年，各类项目在采集、集中和共享病理影像数据方面投入巨大，但图像衍生数据（如 ROI 勾画、分割掩膜）的共享发展明显不足。此类衍生数据的表示格式与共享方式缺乏统一标准，导致数据难以互操作和复用，成为制约算法开发与评测的瓶颈。IDC 平台虽以 DICOM 作为数据统一标准，但 DICOM 在病理图像衍生内容方面的采用此前基本未被探索，因此需要验证并推广这一标准的适用性。
AI.method: 论文以 DICOM 标准为核心，将来自不同原始表示形式的病理图像衍生数据进行和谐化（harmonization）转换。具体做法是选取五个具有代表性的数据集，将其原始的 ROI 标注与分割掩膜表示转换为 DICOM 格式，并公开托管于 IDC 平台。工作还包括对关键开源工具链的贡献，以支持此类转换与共享流程，并讨论了在更广泛范围内采用 DICOM 表示病理图像衍生数据所需考虑的技术问题。
AI.result: 论文以五个代表性数据集为实验对象，通过将其从原始表示转换为 DICOM 并在 IDC 中公开共享，展示了该和谐化流程的实际效果与优势，同时描述了为支撑该流程而对开源工具所作的贡献。研究重点在于标准化的可行性与收益讨论，而非定量算法评测，因此未报告具体的分割精度或检测指标类数值结果。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于首次系统性地将 DICOM 标准应用于病理图像衍生数据的编码与共享，并在 IDC 平台上公开发布五个和谐化数据集，同时推动了相关开源工具建设。该工作为计算病理学数据的标准化共享提供了可复用的范式，有助于提升数据的互操作性与可发现性。局限在于其本质是数据标准化与基础设施层面的工作，未涉及下游算法性能的定量验证；此外，DICOM 在病理衍生数据上的更广泛采纳仍面临技术与社会层面的推广障碍。

title: Decision-Oriented Uncertainty Quantification for Risk Control in Earth System Spatiotemporal Foundation Models
comment: Accepted to the 22nd International Conference on Advanced Data Mining and Applications (ADMA 2026)
summary: Earth system modeling is shifting from task-specific predictors toward foundation models with general spatiotemporal representation capabilities. Although these models can jointly encode dynamic Earth fields, external forcings, and static geographic context for multistep forecasting, accurate point predictions or statistically calibrated intervals alone are insufficient for high-impact applications such as extremeweather warning, flood control, renewable-energy dispatch, and emergency resource allocation. What matters in practice is whether predictive uncertainty can be translated into reliable decision risk under specific actions, loss functions, and risk preferences. We propose a decision-oriented uncertainty quantification framework for Earth system spatiotemporal foundation models. The framework produces predictive distributions of future states and uses a decision risk adapter to map forecast samples, decision context, and utility functions into action-conditional risks. A utility-aware calibration module further enforces reliability at the downstream decision-loss level rather than only at the forecast-value level. Calibrated risks are then used to select warning, dispatch, inspection, or resource-allocation actions. Compared with the strongest baseline, the proposed method reduces decision regret by 18.7%, lowers the missed-event rate from 14.2% to 9.1%, and improves expected utility by 11.6%, while maintaining 90.4% predictive coverage and reducing decision calibration error from 0.083 to 0.047. These results suggest that decision-oriented uncertainty quantification can improve the robustness and operational value of Earth system foundation models in risk-sensitive applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向决策的地球系统时空基础模型不确定性量化框架：先输出未来状态的预测分布，再通过"决策风险适配器"将预测样本、决策上下文与效用函数映射为动作条件风险，并引入效用感知校准模块在下游决策损失层面（而非仅预测值层面）保证可靠性，最终用于预警、调度、巡检与资源分配等动作选择。相比最强基线，决策后悔降低18.7%，漏检事件率从14.2%降至9.1%，期望效用提升11.6%，同时维持90.4%预测覆盖率并将决策校准误差从0.083降至0.047。
AI.motivation: 地球系统建模正从任务专用预测器转向具备通用时空表征能力的基础模型，这类模型能够联合编码动态地球场、外部强迫与静态地理背景并进行多步预测。但在极端天气预警、防洪、可再生能源调度和应急资源分配等高影响应用中，仅提供点预测或统计校准的区间并不足够。真正关键的问题是：预测不确定性能否在特定动作、损失函数与风险偏好下被转化为可靠的决策风险。因此需要把不确定性量化的目标从"预测值准确/区间校准"上移到"决策层面的风险可靠性"。
AI.method: 框架分三个环节：(1) 由地球系统时空基础模型生成未来状态的预测分布（样本化表征）；(2) 决策风险适配器（decision risk adapter）将预测样本、决策上下文与效用函数共同映射为动作条件风险，使不确定性直接与候选动作绑定；(3) 效用感知校准模块（utility-aware calibration）在决策损失层面强制校准，而非仅在预测值层面校准。校准后的风险随后用于选择预警、调度、巡检或资源分配等动作。核心创新在于把校准目标函数从预测误差层面迁移到下游决策效用层面，实现"决策导向"的不确定性量化。
AI.result: 论文以决策为导向进行评测，关注决策后悔、漏检事件率、期望效用、预测覆盖率与决策校准误差等指标。与最强基线相比：决策后悔下降18.7%，漏检事件率由14.2%降至9.1%，期望效用提升11.6%；同时保持90.4%的预测覆盖率，并将决策校准误差由0.083降至0.047。结果显示，在保持预测层面统计可靠性的同时，决策层面的风险可靠性与操作价值均有提升。原文未给出具体数据集名称与基线模型细节。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出了一套面向决策的地球系统时空基础模型不确定性量化框架，通过决策风险适配器与效用感知校准把预测分布转化为动作条件风险，并在风险敏感应用（预警、调度、资源分配）中验证了决策后悔、漏检率与期望效用上的改进。其意义在于将基础模型的评估与校准目标从预测精度推进到操作风险，强调决策层面的可靠性。潜在局限包括：原文摘要未说明具体数据集、基础模型与基线，结论的可推广性需进一步验证；框架依赖显式定义的效用函数与决策上下文，效用设定偏差可能影响校准与动作选择；效用感知校准可能引入额外的计算与训练开销，对实时性要求高的场景需评估效率。

title: Beyond Single-Axis Testing: Paired Evaluation of Compound Robustness in Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-language-action policies are typically evaluated one perturbation at a time, providing a useful diagnosis of their sensitivity to individual distribution shifts. Real-world deployment, however, may involve several shifts simultaneously, and it remains unclear how these individual robustness measurements compose. We ask whether compound robustness can be inferred from single-axis evaluations. We introduce LIBERO-CTRL, a six-axis benchmark that pairs each initial state across single-axis conditions and a matched simultaneous condition. This design reveals two opposing outcome changes that aggregate success rates cannot distinguish: emergent failures, where all single-axis rollouts succeed but the simultaneous rollout fails, and compensated successes, where at least one single-axis rollout fails but the simultaneous rollout succeeds. Because one transition decreases compound success while the other increases it, they can cancel, making aggregate compound performance appear consistent with single-axis measurements even when individual outcomes differ substantially. These opposing transitions can largely cancel in aggregate: even when the difference between the two transition rates is not statistically distinguishable from zero, as many as 29.0% of matched initial states still change outcome. Across six policies and three severity levels, such outcome changes reach 34.5% in the most affected condition. The relative prevalence of the two transitions varies across policies and severities, while the transition rates remain similar under independent re-evaluation of stochastic policies. Compound robustness therefore cannot be characterized from aggregate single-axis success rates alone; matched per-instance evaluation is needed to reveal how joint perturbations alter behavior.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑"能否从单轴鲁棒性评测推断复合鲁棒性"这一常见假设，提出 LIBERO-CTRL 六轴基准，通过对同一初始状态分别施加单轴扰动与匹配的联合扰动，揭示聚合成功率会掩盖两种相互抵消的结果变化——"涌现失败"（单轴全成功但联合失败）与"补偿成功"（单轴失败但联合成功），从而证明复合鲁棒性必须依赖逐实例配对评估。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的鲁棒性评测通常一次只施加一种扰动，用于诊断对单一分布偏移的敏感度。但真实部署往往同时存在多种分布偏移，而已有的单轴鲁棒性度量是否能组合、外推到联合扰动场景尚不清楚。若把单轴成功率当作复合鲁棒性的代理，可能因聚合指标的统计掩盖而得出误导性结论。因此需要设计能够直接对比"单轴条件"与"匹配联合条件"的评测方法，量化联合扰动如何改变逐实例行为。
AI.method: 提出 LIBERO-CTRL：一个六轴（six-axis）评测基准。核心设计是对每个初始状态同时构造单轴条件与一个相匹配的联合（simultaneous）条件，形成配对（matched per-instance）评测。在此配对结构下定义两类相互对立的结果转变：(1) 涌现失败（emergent failures）——所有单轴 rollout 成功而联合 rollout 失败；(2) 补偿成功（compensated successes）——至少一个单轴 rollout 失败而联合 rollout 成功。前者降低复合成功率、后者提升复合成功率，二者可在聚合层面相互抵消，使得复合表现看起来与单轴测量一致，即使逐实例结果已显著变化。论文据此提出应关注"配对初始状态的结果变化比例"这一实例级指标，而非仅比较聚合成功率。
AI.result: 在六种策略、三个严重度（severity）等级上进行评测。主要发现：(1) 两类转变在聚合层面可大幅抵消——即使涌现失败与补偿成功两者发生率之差在统计上与零不可区分，仍有高达 29.0% 的配对初始状态改变了结果；(2) 在最受影响的条件下，结果变化比例达到 34.5%；(3) 两类转变的相对比例随策略与严重度变化；(4) 在随机策略的独立重复评测下，转变率保持相近，说明该现象并非采样噪声所致。实验表明聚合单轴成功率无法刻画复合鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出 LIBERO-CTRL 这一六轴配对基准，并揭示"涌现失败"与"补偿成功"两种相反的结果转变会抵消，使聚合成功率掩盖真实的实例级行为变化，从而论证复合鲁棒性不能仅由单轴聚合成功率推断，必须采用逐实例配对评测。其意义在于对 VLA 策略鲁棒性评测方法学提出警示，并提供了可诊断的工具。潜在局限在于评测集中于 LIBERO 仿真环境与六轴设定的特定扰动族，所观察到的转变率与抵消程度是否可推广到真实机器人平台、其他任务分布或更多扰动轴，尚需进一步验证。

title: Small Object Detection in Drone Aerial Imagery with LAF-YOLOv10
summary: General-purpose object detectors lose accuracy on UAV footage, where targets span only a handful of pixels and onboard compute is limited. Prior work composes independently-validated architectural techniques into one detector, assuming gains reported in isolation transfer once combined. We stress-test that assumption directly. LAF-YOLOv10 integrates four techniques into YOLOv10n: a Partial Convolution C2f (PC-C2f) backbone block, an Attention-Guided Feature Pyramid Network (AG-FPN), a P2 detection head replacing the large-object P5 head, and Wise-IoU v3 regression, asking whether their combined effect matches what each contributes alone. We train LAF-YOLOv10 three times (seeds 42, 123, 256) on VisDrone-DET2019, benchmark against unmodified YOLOv10n, and use TIDE error decomposition, per-category breakdown, per-component ablation, attention/loss comparisons, zero-shot transfer to UAVDT, and held-out/test-dev evaluation to localize where the combination succeeds or fails. Composability does not hold here. LAF-YOLOv10 reaches 24.0+/-0.4% mAP@0.5 at 2.14M parameters, 7.8 points below YOLOv10n (31.8%), a deficit that transfers to UAVDT (-10.0 points) and is confirmed by held-out and test-dev evaluation (23.5%, 22.5%). Background false positives, localization error, and duplicate detections move in the direction AG-FPN and Wise-IoU were designed to push. Ablation traces the deficit to a specific source: the P2/-P5 head swap costs 2.5 points independently plus a 2.5-point interaction penalty when layered onto a backbone weakened by PC-C2f, whose own 2.0-point loss is consistent with a partial pretrained-weight transplant (73/150 backbone tensors transfer). The failure is attributable to a specific interaction, not the four components individually. Composability must be verified directly, not assumed. Code/checkpoints: https://github.com/Mudassiruddin7/Small-Object-Detection-in-UAV-Imagery.

AI.tldr: 本文对"独立验证有效的架构技巧组合后仍有效"这一假设进行压力测试：将PC-C2f、AG-FPN、P2检测头替换P5、Wise-IoU v3四项技术集成进YOLOv10n（LAF-YOLOv10），在VisDrone-DET2019上系统评估。结果组合并非加性增益，反而比基线低7.8个mAP@0.5点，且将缺陷归因于P2/P5头部替换与PC-C2f弱化骨干之间的特定交互作用。
AI.motivation: 无人机（UAV）航拍图像中的目标往往仅有几个像素（极小目标），且机载算力受限，通用目标检测器在此场景下精度下降。先前工作通常将各自独立验证有效的架构改进（注意力FPN、小目标检测头、新型IoU损失等）直接叠加到同一个检测器中，隐含假设"单独有效则在组合后依然有效"。本文质疑并检验这一可组合性（composability）假设，探讨组合效应是否与各组件单独贡献一致，这对小目标检测器的设计方法论具有重要警示意义。
AI.method: LAF-YOLOv10在YOLOv10n基础上集成四项技术：(1) PC-C2f（Partial Convolution C2f）骨干块；(2) AG-FPN（Attention-Guided Feature Pyramid Network）；(3) 用P2检测头替换大目标P5头以增强小目标特征；(4) Wise-IoU v3回归损失。关键方法学创新在于"组合压力测试"协议：固定主干与训练流程，训练三个随机种子（42/123/256），与未修改YOLOv10n直接对比，并借助TIDE误差分解、逐类别分解、逐组件消融、注意力/损失对比、零样本迁移至UAVDT以及held-out与test-dev评估，精准定位组合失效的来源；同时检查预训练权重迁移是否完整（150个骨干张量中仅73个成功迁移）。
AI.result: 在VisDrone-DET2019上，LAF-YOLOv10取得24.0±0.4% mAP@0.5，参数量2.14M，比YOLOv10n基线（31.8%）低7.8点。该缺陷可迁移至UAVDT（-10.0点），并被held-out（23.5%）与test-dev（22.5%）评估确认。TIDE分解显示背景误检、定位误差、重复检测均朝AG-FPN与Wise-IoU本应改善的方向恶化。消融实验将缺陷归因于特定交互：P2/P5头部替换独立损失2.5点，叠加到被PC-C2f削弱的骨干上时再产生2.5点交互惩罚；PC-C2f自身损失2.0点，与部分预训练权重移植（73/150迁移）的现象一致。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是实证否定了航拍小目标检测中"独立有效技术可组合"的默认假设，并给出可复现的验证协议与明确的失效归因：问题源于特定组件交互（头部替换×弱化骨干），而非四组件各自的缺陷。研究强调了将组合效应直接验证、而非假定的必要性，对UAV感知与轻量检测器设计具有方法论价值。局限在于结论基于单一基线（YOLOv10n）与VisDrone/UAVDT数据集，权重不完整迁移可能 confounding 了部分结论；可组合性失败是否推广到其他骨干、数据集或其他技术组合仍有待验证。代码与权重已开源。

title: Tackling Failure Modes of PINNs and PIKANs Using Conflict-Free Gradients
summary: Scientific machine learning methods such as physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) increasingly rely on domain decomposition for better scalability while solving partial differential equations (PDEs) over complex geometries, yet the resulting composite loss comprising residual, boundary, and interface terms is highly susceptible to conflicting gradients that degrade training. This work bridges domain decomposition with projection-based gradient surgery to systematically mitigate such conflicts in 2D and 3D settings. We evaluate two existing projection-based algorithms, PCGrad and ConFIG, and identify their performance degradation in specific scenarios such as 3D domains with multiple overlapping interfaces. To address this limitation, we propose Norm-PCGrad, a normalized variant that achieves state-of-the-art accuracy across a range of 2D and 3D domain decomposition problems. Across the benchmarks considered, Norm-PCGrad consistently achieves the lowest relative $L_2$ error compared to training without gradient surgery as well as to existing algorithms such as PCGrad and ConFIG, while incurring negligible additional computational overhead. To improve computational efficiency of domain decomposition frameworks such as Extended PINN (XPINN), we propose replacing vanilla PINNs in selected subdomains with separable architectures such as Separable PINN (SPINN), reducing the computational cost from quadratic (or cubic) to linear. We additionally demonstrate that gradient surgery extends to physics-informed Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (PIKANs), yielding substantial accuracy improvements for 3D domain decomposition and confirming the generality of the proposed approach across network architectures.

AI.tldr: 该论文将区域分解（domain decomposition）与基于投影的梯度手术（gradient surgery）相结合，系统性地缓解复合损失中残差、边界与界面项之间的梯度冲突，并提出归一化变体 Norm-PCGrad，在 2D/3D 区域分解 PDE 求解中取得最低相对 L2 误差；同时用 SPINN 替换子域中的 PINN 以降低计算复杂度，并将梯度手术推广到 PIKAN。
AI.motivation: 物理信息神经网络（PINN）在复杂几何上求解偏微分方程（PDE）时，为提升可扩展性而广泛采用区域分解策略。然而，区域分解会产生由残差损失、边界损失和界面损失构成的复合损失，这些项之间存在相互冲突的梯度，导致训练不稳定、精度下降。现有基于投影的梯度手术算法（如 PCGrad、ConFIG）在此类问题上的适用性与失效场景尚未被系统研究，尤其是 3D 多重叠界面等复杂情形。该问题对于科学机器学习求解高维、复杂几何 PDE 具有重要意义。
AI.method: 论文将区域分解与基于投影的梯度手术结合，在 2D 与 3D 设置下系统评估 PCGrad 与 ConFIG 两种现有投影算法，并识别其在 3D 多重叠界面等场景下的性能退化。为此提出 Norm-PCGrad——PCGrad 的归一化变体，通过对梯度投影过程进行归一化以更有效地消解冲突梯度。此外，为提升区域分解框架（如扩展 PINN，XPINN）的计算效率，提出在选定子域中用可分离架构 SPINN 替换原版 PINN，将计算代价从二次（或三次）降至线性。最后验证梯度手术可推广至物理信息 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（PIKAN）。
AI.result: 论文评估的数据集与基准为 2D 和 3D 区域分解 PDE 问题。评价指标为相对 L2 误差，并考察额外计算开销。主要发现：（1）PCGrad 与 ConFIG 在特定场景（如含多个重叠界面的 3D 区域）出现性能下降；（2）Norm-PCGrad 在所考察基准上一致取得最低相对 L2 误差，优于无梯度手术训练以及 PCGrad、ConFIG，且额外计算开销可忽略；（3）采用 SPINN 替换部分子域 PINN 可将计算复杂度由二次（或三次）降为线性；（4）梯度手术同样适用于 PIKAN，在 3D 区域分解上带来显著精度提升，表明方法在不同网络架构上具有通用性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献包括：将区域分解与投影式梯度手术系统性结合；提出归一化变体 Norm-PCGrad 以解决现有算法在复杂 3D 界面下的性能退化；通过 SPINN 降低子域计算复杂度；并验证方法在 PIKAN 架构上的通用性。意义在于提升 PINN 类方法求解复杂几何 PDE 的可扩展性、精度与效率。潜在局限：摘要未说明具体基准数量与规模、归一化理论分析、SPINN 替换带来的精度—效率权衡细节，以及对更强梯度冲突场景的鲁棒性验证。

title: MessyMem: Learning-from-Doing Memory for Mobile Manipulation
comment: Accepted at CoRL 2026. 26 pages, 8 figures. Project page: https://messymem.github.io
summary: Mobile manipulators deployed across many rooms and visits should improve with experience: after discovering that a cabinet is locked or finding an object in a drawer, the robot should reuse that knowledge rather than start each task from scratch. Yet today's robots often treat each task as new: compact scene representations omit interaction-derived knowledge, raw video histories are difficult to query, and VLM planners reason at inference time without persistently updating what the robot knows. We present MessyMem, a persistent memory system that enables mobile manipulators to learn from experience and reuse that knowledge across future tasks. It maintains a spatially grounded 3D scene graph of objects and locations, augments it with properties and outcomes learned through interaction, and links visual observations for fine-grained recall. We evaluate MessyMem in simulation and on a real mobile manipulator. In a continuous 25-task simulation spanning over 3 hours, MessyMem achieves 80.0% task progress, outperforming the strongest ablation by 14.8 percentage points and the strongest external baseline by 28.9 points, while retrieving task-relevant evidence from thousands of stored keyframes and over an hour into the past.

AI.tldr: MessyMem 是一个面向移动操作机器人的持久化记忆系统，通过空间落地的 3D 场景图与交互习得的属性/结果相结合，使机器人能跨任务复用经验，而非每次都从零开始。
AI.motivation: 在真实家居环境中，移动操作机器人会在多房间、多轮次访问中积累经验（如发现某柜子被锁、某物体在抽屉里）。然而现有系统往往把每个任务当作全新任务处理：紧凑的场景表示丢失了交互获得的知识，原始视频历史难以查询，VLM 规划器仅在推理时进行推理而不持久更新机器人所知。这导致经验无法复用、重复探索，降低长时任务效率。
AI.method: MessyMem 维护一个空间落地的 3D 场景图，建模物体与位置；在图上附加通过交互学习到的属性和结果（如"柜子被锁"、"物体位于抽屉中"）；并将视觉观测（keyframes）链接到场景图节点以支持细粒度回忆与检索。任务相关证据可从大量存储关键帧和长时间历史中检索，供 VLM 规划器使用，从而在推理时利用持久记忆而非仅依赖当前观测。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实移动操作机器人上评估。在一次跨越 3 小时以上的连续 25 任务仿真中，MessyMem 达到 80.0% 的任务进度，比最强消融变体高 14.8 个百分点，比最强外部基线高 28.9 个百分点；同时能从数千个存储关键帧中检索任务相关证据，并回溯超过一小时的历史。
AI.conclusion: MessyMem 提出了一种持久记忆机制，将空间场景图、交互习得知识与视觉观测链接，使移动操作机器人能够跨任务复用经验，在长时连续任务中显著优于消融和基线。局限可能包括：对场景图构建与维护的依赖、长期记忆检索的扩展性与查询效率，以及仿真与真实环境评估范围有限。

title: A Building as a Repository: KIR, a Typed Intermediate Representation for Agent-Authored Building Information Models
comment: 13-page paper and 10-page supplement; 8 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/5vbkgsghhh-hash/kir
summary: Autonomous agents that author building information models need more than access to a host API. They need a representation of what they intended, what a compiler decided on their behalf, what was refused, what was observed after execution and what remains unknown. We present KIR, a typed intermediate representation in which a building is authored as a program held in a versioned repository and lowered to host applications as build targets. KIR is organised around seven ways in which a generator writing into a stateful, partially observable host goes silently wrong, and gives each a representation in data: ambiguous selectors become typed refusals with candidates; defaults keep their provenance; obligations that will not be checked are named before execution; vacuous witnesses are rejected statically; a lost transaction response becomes the state UNCONFIRMED with a verify-before-retry rule; the reverse path obeys a census invariant; and decisions are bound by digest to the state they were made against. On a pinned snapshot with 83 operation contracts and Revit as the only backend, offline experiments refuse 29 of 42 stress-test programs with diagnostic codes and no uncaught exception, name 38 of 377 witness obligations as unwitnessable, admit 31 of 100 combinations of execution, witness and acceptance states under seven stated invariants, and find no vacuous witness in 219 certificate runs; a 60-storey tower is 11,263 characters as KIR against 3,709,235 characters of emitted C#. Native Revit runs are reported from project records and kept separate from reproduced results. A controlled comparison with agents that write host code directly is specified but not yet executed; it is the principal open question.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 KIR（Keyed Intermediate Representation），一种面向建筑信息模型（BIM）自动生成的有类型中间表示（typed IR）。它将建筑视为保存在版本化仓库中的程序，并降低（lowering）到宿主应用（如 Revit）作为构建目标。KIR 围绕"生成器写入一个有状态、部分可观测宿主时悄然出错的七种方式"进行组织，为每种失效模式赋予数据表示（类型化拒绝、默认值溯源、未校验义务命名、静态拒绝空见证、UNCONFIRMED 状态等）。
AI.motivation: 自主智能体撰写建筑信息模型时仅依赖宿主 API（如 Revit API）是不够的。核心问题在于：智能体需要表达"意图"、"编译器代其做出的决定"、"被拒绝的请求"、"执行后观测到的结果"以及"仍然未知的部分"，而现有直接调用宿主 API 的方式缺乏这种显式的意图-决策-观测表示。这导致生成器在有状态、部分可观测的宿主中会以隐蔽方式失败（silently wrong），这类失败难以检测与调试，因此需要一种能够承载意图、溯源与不确定性状态的形式化表示。
AI.method: KIR 是一种有类型中间表示，建筑被写为程序并存放于版本化仓库中，通过 lowering 过程编译为宿主应用（当前仅 Revit 后端）的构建目标。其设计围绕七种"静默出错"模式，并为每种赋予数据层表示：(1) 歧义选择器（ambiguous selectors）转为带候选集的类型化拒绝（typed refusals）；(2) 默认值保留其来源（provenance）；(3) 不会被校验的义务在执行前被显式命名；(4) 空见证（vacuous witnesses）被静态拒绝；(5) 丢失的事务响应被标记为 UNCONFIRMED 状态，并遵循"重试前先验证"（verify-before-retry）规则；(6) 反向路径（reverse path）遵循一致性普查不变式（census invariant）；(7) 决策通过 digest 绑定到其做出时所依据的状态。整体方法强调状态、溯源与不变式的显式数据化。
AI.result: 在固定快照（pinned snapshot）上，包含 83 个操作契约（operation contracts），以 Revit 为唯一后端，离线实验报告如下：在 42 个压力测试程序中拒绝 29 个（给出诊断码且无未捕获异常）；将 377 个见证义务中的 38 个标记为不可见证（unwitnessable）；在七个明确陈述的不变式下，100 种"执行、见证、接受"状态组合中有 31 种被接受；在 219 次证书运行中未发现空见证。一座 60 层塔楼以 KIR 表示为 11,263 字符，而对应生成的 C# 代码为 3,709,235 字符。原生 Revit 运行结果来自项目记录，与可复现结果分开报告。与直接编写宿主代码的智能体的受控对照实验已设计但尚未执行，作者将其列为主要开放问题。
AI.conclusion: KIR 的主要贡献是为智能体驱动的 BIM 生成提供了一种承载意图、决策溯源与不确定性状态的有类型中间表示，通过将七类静默失效模式显式数据化，实现了静态检查、拒绝与状态的严格管理，并以极紧凑的表示（约一万字符 vs 约三百七十万字符 C#）显著压缩了生成输出。其意义在于将"生成即编译"的软件工程形式化方法引入建筑建模智能体，提升可靠性与可验证性。局限在于：受控对照实验（与直接写宿主代码的智能体比较）尚未执行，是核心未解问题；原生 Revit 结果来自项目记录而非完全可复现；目前仅支持单一后端（Revit）。

title: Semantic Fibers and Cross-Gram Interference: A Calculus of Safety Drift in Overcomplete Representations
summary:
A deployed language model may refuse a harmful request in English yet comply with its faithful translation, revealing a cross-lingual safety failure that cannot be characterized reliably by output behavior alone. We formalize this phenomenon through an audited equivalence relation and show that, for a declared quotient, representation, metric, feature dictionary, scoring head, threshold, and contrast model, the resulting safety drift admits an exact linear-algebraic characterization. Specifically, the drift is a cross-Gram functional of the within-fiber contrast; its worst admissible value is a support function, while margin invariance is characterized by an annihilator condition.
  We introduce an intrinsic calibrated exposure measure, governed by the leverage duality $χ^2=1/\ell-1$, which separates observed drift into three diagnostically distinct regimes: a reader fault removable by recalibration, an exact correction that is too ill-conditioned to be reliable, and a representation-level collision that no readout-only intervention can remove. Thus, identical observed exposure can lead to fundamentally different remediation verdicts. The framework also extends to cone-valued safety heads. An untied order-swap identity provides a diagnostic for the linear control interface; its calibration-state residual predicts a distinct three-control composition error on unseen states and targets, achieving median Spearman correlation $0.964$, compared with $0.269$ for a static cross-Gram baseline. etc.....

AI.tldr: 该论文形式化了多语言大模型中的"跨语言安全漂移"现象：用等价关系（equivalence relation）刻画"忠实翻译"这一审计语义，证明在给定商空间、表示、度量、特征字典、评分头、阈值与对比模型下，安全漂移可被精确线性代数描述——漂移是 within-fiber 对比的 cross-Gram 泛函，其最坏取值为支撑函数（support function），而 margin 不变性由 annihilator 条件刻画；并提出内在校准暴露度量，由 leverage 对偶 χ²=1/ℓ−1 支配，将观测漂移区分为三种可诊断状态。
AI.motivation: 动机：已部署语言模型存在"英文拒绝、忠实译文却服从"的跨语言安全失效（cross-lingual safety failure）。仅凭输出行为（是否拒绝）无法可靠区分该失效的成因：同一观测到的暴露程度可能源于不同的机制（可校准的读出故障、病态但理论可矫正的情况、表示层面的碰撞），从而导致截然不同的补救结论。因此需要一个比"输出行为"更内在、可审计的表征层面诊断框架，用以判断某次安全漂移是否可通过读出层干预消除，还是必须回到表示层。这对安全对齐审计、多语言部署合规性评估具有直接意义。
AI.method: 方法：以审计等价关系定义"忠实翻译"下的等价类（fiber），固定一个声明性的六元组（商空间、表示、度量、特征字典、评分头、阈值）加对比模型。核心结论为：安全漂移等于 within-fiber 对比的 cross-Gram 泛函；其最坏可取值为支撑函数；margin 不变性对应 annihilator（零化子）条件。提出内在校准暴露度量，受 leverage 对偶 χ²=1/ℓ−1 支配，据此把观测漂移分为三区：(1) 可由重校准消除的 reader fault；(2) 精确但条件数过大、不可靠的矫正；(3) 表示层碰撞，任何仅改读出的干预都无法移除。框架可推广到 cone-valued 安全头。此外给出 untied order-swap identity 作为线性控制接口的诊断量，其校准态残差可预测未见状态与目标上的三控制组合误差。
AI.result: 结果：在预测未见状态与目标上的三控制组合误差任务中，基于 untied order-swap identity 校准态残差的方法取得中位 Spearman 相关 0.964，显著优于静态 cross-Gram 基线的 0.269。论文还展示了同一观测暴露值可映射到三种不同的补救判定（reader fault / 病态矫正 / 表示碰撞），说明仅用暴露数值无法决定干预层级。文中同步给出框架向 cone-valued 安全头的扩展形式。摘要中用了 "etc...." 结尾，可能还有更多实验未在摘要中展开。
AI.conclusion: 结论：主要贡献是把跨语言安全失效从"行为层观察"提升为"表征层可审计的线性代数刻画"，提供等价关系下的 drift 分解、三态诊断与内在暴露度量，使"能否仅靠读出重校准修复"成为一个可判定的问题，并给出可迁移到未见状态/目标的诊断预测（Spearman 0.964）。局限：摘要未披露具体模型、语言对、数据集与安全基准，抽象设定较形式化，实际部署中的翻译忠实度假设、度量与特征字典选择对结论的敏感性、以及三态判定在真实攻击/对齐场景下的覆盖度仍有待正文验证。与事件视觉、脉冲网络、边缘/实时感知等方向无直接关联，其价值主要在语言模型安全对齐的形式化审计。

title: ResSafe: Learning Safety Filtering with Residual Reinforcement Learning for Humanoids
summary: Safe control of humanoid robots remains challenging due to their high-dimensional dynamics, contact-rich interactions, and sensitivity to disturbances. Although reinforcement learning has enabled effective locomotion and motion tracking, learned policies can still generate unsafe actions that lead to instability or falls. In this work, we propose residual reinforcement learning as an implicit safety-filtering mechanism for safe humanoid control. Instead of relying on a single nominal policy to simultaneously balance performance, safety, and robustness, we decouple performance and safety. The nominal policy focuses solely on task performance, while a residual policy learns safety corrections. This decoupling leads to a better performance--safety Pareto trade-off and avoids the need for careful tuning of multiple competing reward terms within a single policy training. We show that the residual policy can act as an implicit safety filter.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用残差强化学习（residual RL）作为人形机器人安全控制的隐式安全滤波器，将任务性能与安全解耦：标称策略只负责任务性能，残差策略学习安全修正，从而获得更好的性能–安全帕累托权衡。
