AI.motivation: 人形机器人的安全控制面临高维动力学、富接触交互以及对扰动敏感等挑战。尽管强化学习在运动（locomotion）和动作跟踪（motion tracking）上已取得成效，但学到的策略仍可能输出不安全动作，导致不稳定甚至跌倒。传统的单策略方法需要在单一策略训练中同时平衡性能、安全与鲁棒性，这通常依赖对多个相互竞争的奖励项进行精细调参，难以兼顾，因此需要一种能解耦性能与安全的机制。
AI.method: 论文的核心思路是将控制责任解耦为两个部分：(1) 标称策略（nominal policy），仅专注于任务性能；(2) 残差策略（residual policy），在标称策略输出的基础上学习安全修正量。最终动作可理解为标称动作与残差修正的叠加。由于安全约束被转移到独立的残差策略中学习，标称策略的训练无需在单一目标中权衡多个相互冲突的奖励项，避免了多目标奖励的整体调参问题。作者进一步论证，这种残差策略可起到隐式安全滤波器（implicit safety filter）的作用，即在相对安全的标称行为上叠加修正，从而抑制可能导致不稳定或跌倒的不安全动作。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体数据集、实验平台、评价指标或定量结果。论文的主要结论是：通过将性能与安全解耦，残差策略能够带来更好的性能–安全帕累托（Pareto）权衡，并验证残差策略可作为隐式安全滤波器。具体实验设置与数值结果需参见正文。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出一种残差强化学习框架，将人形机器人的性能与安全显式解耦，避免单一策略中多奖励项调参的困难，并赋予残差策略隐式安全滤波的功能，改善性能与安全之间的帕累托权衡。其意义在于为接触丰富、高维动态、易受扰动的人形控制提供了一种更模块化且易训练的安全机制。可能的局限包括：摘要未给出定量实验验证（如稳定性、跌倒率、任务成功率等指标），残差策略对分布外扰动或极端接触场景的泛化与安全保证仍不明确，且隐式安全滤波缺乏形式化的安全保证。

title: Reverse Spatio-Temporal Disease Progression Modelling
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures. Accepted at SASHIMI 2026, held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
summary: Deep learning-based spatio-temporal disease progression models commonly overlook the incubation period of progressive diseases, limiting the use of those models in early interventions, which are vital for not easily reversible diseases such as Alzheimer's. This is because, the existing deep learning based longitudinal disease-progression models are almost always run forward: from an observed baseline they predict future decline. In many clinical settings, however, imaging begins only after pathology is suspected or already visible, the earlier, healthier patient-specific reference was never acquired. To address this, we propose to study reverse disease progression prediction: given later diseased anatomy, reconstruct the unobserved healthier anatomy that preceded it. We use a two-stage model in which a frozen 3D vector-quantised autoencoder defines a compact discrete latent space, while a Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE) learns continuous-time dynamics in that space. A recurrent encoder reads late observations in reverse temporal order, initialises the latent state, and the ODE is integrated backwards across the trajectory. On a controlled Morpho-MNIST benchmark with a sinusoidal perturbation, our model successfully recovered the unseen previous states from later observations of the non-monotonic trajectory. On longitudinal brain MRIs from Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, at the task to recover the previous unseen trajectory towards healthy states of the patients from observed later diseased states, our model outperforms the baselines that uses copy-nearest and mean-observed, with positive disease-reversal scores in every diagnostic stratum. We hope that our work can provide insights and tools towards discovering the incubation periods from single-shot scans, and developing early interventions of diseases based on imaging.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"反向疾病进展预测"任务：给定晚期病变解剖影像，重建此前未被观测到的更健康状态。方法为两阶段模型——冻结的3D向量量化(VQ)自编码器提供离散隐空间，神经ODE在该空间内学习连续时间动力学；循环编码器以逆时序读取晚期观测并初始化隐状态，ODE向后积分以回溯轨迹。在Morpho-MNIST与ADNI纵向脑MRI上验证，可从晚期病变图像恢复未见的历史健康状态。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习时空疾病进展模型几乎都是"前向"的：从观测到的基线预测未来衰退，因而默认基线是健康的、且早期影像可得。但在临床中，影像往往在病理已被怀疑或已可见后才开始采集，患者更早、更健康的个体化参照从未被获取。这一局限使模型无法覆盖疾病潜伏期(incubation period)，而潜伏期恰恰是阿尔茨海默病等不易逆转疾病早期干预的关键窗口。因此论文转向逆向问题：由后期病变解剖反推此前未被采集的健康解剖。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：(1) 表示层——使用冻结(frozen)的3D向量量化自编码器(VQ-VAE)将3D解剖影像编码为紧凑的离散隐空间(latent space)，为动力学学习提供规整的、离散化的状态表示；(2) 动力学层——在该离散潜空间中以神经常微分方程(Neural ODE)建模连续时间演化，学习患者特异性的轨迹动力学。推理时，循环(recurrent)编码器以逆时序(reverse temporal order)读取晚期观测序列，初始化隐状态，随后将ODE向时间反向积分(integrate backwards)以回溯跨越整条轨迹，从而重建未观测到的更早、更健康状态。该设计的关键在于用一次性/少量晚期扫描作为逆向积分的起点，而非依赖缺失的基线，并以连续时间动力学而非离散步进方式刻画非单调病程。
AI.result: 在两个设置下评估：(1) Morpho-MNIST 受控基准，引入正弦扰动(sinusoidal perturbation)构造非单调轨迹，模型成功由后期观测恢复未见的先前状态；(2) 阿尔茨海默病神经影像学倡议(ADNI)纵向脑MRI，任务为从已观测的晚期病变状态恢复此前未见的、朝向健康状态的轨迹。评估指标包含疾病逆转评分(disease-reversal score)，并对比copy-nearest(复制最近观测)与mean-observed(观测均值)基线。结果显示模型在所有诊断分层(diagnostic stratum)中均取得正向的疾病逆转得分，全面优于两个基线。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于：(1) 提出并形式化"反向疾病进展预测"问题，突破现有前向建模必须以健康基线为起点的假设；(2) 结合冻结VQ隐空间与Neural ODE的连续时间逆向动力学框架，配合逆时序循环编码器初始化；(3) 在受控合成基准与真实ADNI脑MRI上验证了从后期病变影像回溯历史健康状态、并获得正向疾病逆转评分的可行性。意义在于为从单次扫描推断潜伏期、支持早期干预提供了思路与工具。潜在局限：仅在Morpho-MNIST合成基准与ADNI脑MRI上验证，尚未扩展到其他模态或疾病；逆向重建依赖模型学到的动力学先验，无真值基线可对照，评估主要基于代理性逆转评分；VQ隐空间的离散化程度与ODE积分稳定性对回溯精度的影响未充分说明。

title: Interpolation Is Not Invariance: Pair Count Is Not Coverage in Transformation Audits
summary:
Counting equivalent pairs is a common way to report transformation-audit coverage, but it can substantially overstate the constraints imposed by an audit: pairs generated from the same semantic object are correlated, and complete orbit graphs contain algebraically redundant edges. We therefore distinguish four complementary quantities---edge count $m$, effective contrast rank $s$, population support rank $r$, and graph spectral gap $η$---and characterize their roles in audit coverage and deployment reliability. Under a rank-$r$ Gaussian contrast model, a population-invariant calibrated reader exists exactly when the anchor has a component in $\ker T$. When an audit has rank $s < r$, its unobserved risk is $R^\star/U$, with $U \sim \operatorname{Beta}((r-s)/2,s/2)$; when $s \ge r$, exact calibrated interpolation is infeasible. The same distinction appears in orbit topology: a spanning tree imposes the same exact-null constraints as a complete graph, while a sharp graph Poincare inequality propagates edge-level drift to an entire orbit at a cost proportional to $1/η$. Cyclic audits can additionally yield zero pair-level leave-one-out error without holding out any semantic object.
  To address these failures, we derive exact block-Woodbury leave-one-orbit-out updates and introduce a source-disjoint deployment gate over finitely many candidate readers. The gate retains the original reader unless uncertainty bounds certify lower drift within a prescribed clean-utility budget. etc..

AI.tldr: 该论文指出以"等价对数量"报告变换审计覆盖率会高估真实约束，提出以四种互补量（边数 $m$、有效对比秩 $s$、总体支撑秩 $r$、图谱间隙 $\eta$）刻画审计覆盖与部署可靠性，并给出秩-$r$ 高斯对比模型下的校准读取器存在性条件、未观测风险分布、轨道拓扑约束，以及块-Woodbury 留一轨道更新与源不交部署门控方法。
AI.motivation: 在变换审计（transformation audit）中，常用"等价对计数"来汇报覆盖率，但同一语义对象生成的等价对彼此相关，且完整轨道图（orbit graph）中含代数冗余边，因此简单计数会显著夸大审计所施加的约束，导致对模型不变性/可靠性的错误评估。论文关注的核心问题是：如何用更本质的量来准确刻画审计覆盖率与部署可靠性，并在有限候选读取器下做出有理论保证的部署决策。
AI.method: 论文区分四个互补量：边数 $m$、有效对比秩 $s$、总体支撑秩 $r$、图谱间隙 $\eta$，并分析其在审计覆盖与部署可靠性中的作用。在秩-$r$ 高斯对比模型下，证明存在总体不变校准读取器当且仅当锚点在 $\ker T$ 中有分量；审计秩 $s<r$ 时未观测风险为 $R^\star/U$，其中 $U\sim\operatorname{Beta}((r-s)/2,s/2)$，而 $s\ge r$ 时精确校准插值不可行。在轨道拓扑层面，证明生成树施加与完全图相同的精确零约束，尖锐的图 Poincaré 不等式可将边级漂移传播到整个轨道，代价与 $1/\eta$ 成正比；循环审计还可在不排除任何语义对象的情况下得到零成对留一误差。方法上推导精确的块-Woodbury 留一轨道（leave-one-orbit-out）更新，并引入在有限候选读取器上的源不交（source-disjoint）部署门控，仅当不确定性边界能在给定干净效用预算内证明更低漂移时才替换原读取器。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数据集、实验设置与数值指标；给出的是一系列理论刻画与算法构件：四量刻画、$s<r$ 时未观测风险的 Beta 分布形式、$s\ge r$ 时精确校准的不可能性、生成树与完全图的等价约束、图 Poincaré 不等式下的漂移传播界、循环审计的零成对留一误差现象，以及块-Woodbury 留一轨道更新和源不交部署门控。这些构成了对审计覆盖率与部署可靠性"何时可信、何时失效"的判定条件与修正手段。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献在于将变换审计的覆盖率评估从朴素的等价对计数提升到以秩与谱量刻画的层次，揭示计数指标的系统性高估风险，并给出校准读取器存在性的充要条件、未观测风险的分布刻画、轨道拓扑的冗余结构，以及可操作的留一轨道更新与保守部署门控。潜在限制是分析依赖秩-$r$ 高斯对比模型等理论假设，且摘要未报告实证验证，实际效益与假设偏离时的稳健性尚待实验检验。

title: Direct Conditional Transition Sampling for Diffusion Inverse Problems
summary: Training-free diffusion inverse solvers typically choose between local measurement guidance and costly clean-space posterior updates. Independent posterior refresh can improve global correction by sampling a clean conditional and re-noising it, but its practical realization requires probability-flow ODE integration and clean-space Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC). We propose Direct Conditional Transition Sampling (DCTS), a direct stochastic-flow approximation to the same ideal refresh target. Rather than explicitly drawing a clean sample, DCTS estimates the measurement-conditioned clean mean along a short inner path and transports Gaussian source noise directly to the next noisy state. A denoiser-compatible sufficient statistic and a covariance-scaled operator update enable this conditional-mean estimation. Experiments on four inverse problems demonstrate that DCTS achieves competitive reconstruction quality with up to $16.8\times$ speedups over competing methods.

AI.tldr: DCTS（Direct Conditional Transition Sampling）提出一种直接随机流近似方法，用于免训练扩散逆问题求解器中的"后验刷新"步骤：通过沿短内路径估计测量条件下的干净均值，将高斯源噪声直接传输到下一个带噪状态，避免了显式采样干净样本、概率流ODE积分与干净空间MCMC，从而在保持重建质量的同时实现最高16.8倍加速。
AI.motivation: 免训练扩散逆求解器面临一个核心权衡：局部测量引导（local measurement guidance）计算便宜但缺乏全局校正能力；干净空间后验更新（clean-space posterior update）能提供更强的全局一致性，但代价高昂。独立后验刷新（independent posterior refresh）虽可改善全局校正，但其实现需要概率流ODE积分以及干净空间的MCMC采样，计算负担沉重，难以实际部署。因此作者希望找到一种能逼近同一理想刷新目标、但计算高效得多的替代方案。
AI.method: DCTS 并不显式地抽取干净样本再进行重加噪，而是直接对"理想刷新目标"做随机流近似：沿一条短内路径（short inner path）估计测量条件下的干净均值（measurement-conditioned clean mean），然后把高斯源噪声直接传输（transport）到下一个带噪状态。为支撑该条件均值估计，作者引入了与去噪器兼容的充分统计量（denoiser-compatible sufficient statistic），并设计了协方差缩放的操作算子更新（covariance-scaled operator update）。整体上，DCTS 用一次性的短路径估计替代了ODE积分+MCMC的迭代流程，属于免训练（training-free）方法。
AI.result: 论文在四类逆问题（inverse problems）上进行了实验评估。结果表明 DCTS 在重建质量上具有竞争力，同时相较对比方法实现了最高 16.8× 的加速。摘要中未给出具体数据集名称、评测指标（如PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS）或逐项数值细节。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出了 DCTS 这一直接随机流近似框架，使独立后验刷新的理想目标可以在无需ODE积分与干净空间MCMC的前提下近似实现，从而在重建质量与推理效率之间取得更优平衡。其意义在于推动免训练扩散逆求解器向实用、实时方向演进。可能的局限包括：方法依赖充分的短内路径近似与协方差缩放假设，摘要未报告对高噪声、强非线性或病态算子的鲁棒性分析，也未给出具体的下游任务与物体级/小目标感知场景验证。

title: AgentKV: Phase-Aware KV Eviction for Agentic LLMs
summary: Agentic serving can consume orders of magnitude more tokens than chatbot workloads, stressing both KV-cache capacity and decode-time bandwidth. Most KV-eviction methods score cached keys against representative queries drawn from the most recent tokens, assuming future attention resembles recent attention. We show that agentic generation violates this assumption: future queries form a mixture over think, act, tool, and others phases, and principal-angle analysis shows these components occupy measurably different query subspaces, so recency representatives systematically undervalue keys that upcoming phases will need. We propose AGENTKV, which maintains a small query buffer per phase and scores cached keys against their union. We further implement AGENTKV in a persistent multi-turn serving path that carries compressed KV state across turns and compacts retained KV pages online. Across two models, six task domains, and three KV budgets each, AGENTKV improves task score by 5.5 points on average over R-KV and 5.3 over Tri-attention. Relative to upstream full-KV SGLang, AGENTKV improves output-token throughput by up to 1.80x. Code: https://github.com/LiuTaowen-Tony/agentkv.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AGENTKV，一种面向智能体（agentic）推理负载的 KV-cache 淘汰方法。核心洞察是：智能体生成的未来注意力并不类似近期注意力，而是由 think/act/tool 等多个阶段构成的混合分布；因此 AGENTKV 为每个阶段维护一个小的查询缓冲区，用这些阶段的查询并集来为缓存键打分，从而在低 KV 预算下更准确地保留关键键。
AI.motivation: 在智能体服务场景中，token 消耗量比聊天机器人负载高出数个数量级，给 KV-cache 容量和解码期带宽带来巨大压力。现有 KV 淘汰方法普遍假设"未来注意力与近期注意力相似"，即用最近 token 作为代表性查询来为缓存键打分。论文通过实验表明该假设在智能体生成中不成立：未来查询是 think、act、tool 等阶段的混合，且主角度（principal-angle）分析显示这些阶段占据可测量的不同查询子空间，因此基于时近性的代表查询会系统性地低估即将到来的阶段所需的键，导致关键 KV 被错误淘汰。
AI.method: AGENTKV 的关键设计有两点：(1) 分阶段查询缓冲——为每个阶段（think、act、tool 等）维护一个小型查询缓冲区，在打分时使用各阶段查询缓冲区的并集来评估缓存键的重要性，避免单一时近代表查询带来的偏差；该设计的依据是主角度分析所揭示的阶段查询子空间差异。(2) 持久化多轮服务实现——在推理服务中跨轮次携带压缩后的 KV 状态，并在线对保留的 KV 页进行压缩整理（compaction），以适配智能体多轮交互的持久化服务路径。
AI.result: 实验覆盖两个模型、六个任务领域，每个设置下测试三种 KV 预算：AGENTKV 相较 R-KV 平均提升任务得分 5.5 分，相较 Tri-attention 提升 5.3 分。与上游全 KV 的 SGLang 相比，AGENTKV 的输出 token 吞吐量最高提升 1.80 倍。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献在于揭示并实证了智能体生成中"未来注意力 ≠ 近期注意力"这一失效假设，并据此提出分阶段查询缓冲的淘汰策略，同时给出跨轮次持久化 KV 与在线页压缩的工程实现。其意义在于提升智能体长会话、低 KV 预算下的任务完成质量与解码吞吐效率。可能的局限在于：AGENTKV 依赖对阶段（think/act/tool）的显式划分，该划分方式及其对阶段边界识别错误的鲁棒性在摘要中未作说明；此外结果仅在两个模型和所述任务领域上验证，向其他智能体框架的泛化性仍需进一步检验。

title: Open-UniMo: Towards Unified Motion-Language Understanding and Generation in the Open World
summary: Unified motion generation and understanding is crucial for embodied AI systems that can both synthesize and interpret human actions in open-world environments. Existing motion-language models often treat motion as an auxiliary modality of a language model, leading to text-dominated representations and limited cross-modal interaction. Moreover, the next-token prediction paradigm is not naturally suited to long motion sequences, where autoregressive generation may accumulate prediction errors. To address these challenges, we propose Open-UniMo, a unified Large Motion-Language Model (LMLM) trained on million-scale open-world motion-language data. Open-UniMo promotes modality parity by extending Qwen's vocabulary of about 150K text tokens with 64K motion tokens, enabling motion and language to share a unified token space. We further introduce motion-consistent Chain-of-Thought reasoning as an intermediate representation to bridge language semantics and motion dynamics. Open-UniMo is trained with a two-stage pipeline, where supervised fine-tuning establishes CoT-guided bidirectional motion-language mapping and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves semantic alignment while mitigating cumulative errors in autoregressive motion-token generation. To support comprehensive evaluation, we propose Open-MoBench, a VLM-guided benchmark for assessing text-to-motion (T2M) generation, motion-to-text (M2T) understanding, and bidirectional consistency. Extensive experiments show that Open-UniMo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both conventional metrics and Open-MoBench. Furthermore, ablation studies reveal that M2T understanding is not primarily limited by motion-token vocabulary size; instead, coupling M2T with the learnable T2M generation path yields stronger cross-modal representations, demonstrating that generation can facilitate understanding in AR-based motion-language modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出 Open-UniMo，一个统一的 Large Motion-Language Model（LMLM），通过扩展 Qwen 词表（约 150K 文本 token + 64K motion token）实现运动与语言共享统一 token 空间，并以 motion-consistent Chain-of-Thought（CoT）作为中间表示桥接语言语义与运动动态，采用 SFT + GRPO 两阶段训练，同时发布 Open-MoBench 评测基准。
AI.motivation: 具身智能系统需要在开放世界环境中同时合成（生成）与理解（解释）人类动作，因此统一的运动生成与理解至关重要。现有 motion-language 模型存在两个核心问题：(1) 将 motion 视为语言模型的辅助模态，导致表征由文本主导、跨模态交互受限，形成模态不平等；(2) next-token prediction 范式并不天然适配长运动序列，自回归生成容易累积预测误差。论文旨在通过促进模态对等（modality parity）与改进自回归生成范式来缓解这些问题。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三部分：(1) 模态对等的统一 token 空间——在 Qwen 约 150K 文本词表基础上扩展 64K motion token，使运动与语言在同一个 token 空间中表示，避免 motion 仅作为语言模型的附属模态；(2) Motion-consistent Chain-of-Thought 推理——引入 motion-consistent CoT 作为中间表示，用于桥接语言语义与运动动力学；(3) 两阶段训练流程——第一阶段监督微调（SFT）建立 CoT 引导的双向 motion-language 映射，第二阶段使用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）强化语义对齐，并缓解自回归 motion token 生成中的累积误差。同时提出 VLM 引导的评测基准 Open-MoBench。
AI.result: 训练数据规模为百万级（million-scale）开放世界 motion-language 数据。评测覆盖三类任务：text-to-motion（T2M）生成、motion-to-text（M2T）理解，以及双向一致性（bidirectional consistency），并同时使用传统指标与所提出的 Open-MoBench（VLM 引导）进行评测。实验显示 Open-UniMo 在传统指标与 Open-MoBench 上均达到 state-of-the-art。消融研究给出两点发现：(1) M2T 理解并非主要受 motion-token 词表规模限制；(2) 将 M2T 与可学习的 T2M 生成路径耦合能获得更强的跨模态表征，说明在基于 AR 的 motion-language 建模中，生成可以促进理解。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献：提出统一 token 空间的 LMLM（Open-UniMo），以 motion-consistent CoT 桥接语义与运动动力学，并通过 SFT + GRPO 两阶段训练提升语义对齐与抑制自回归误差；同时发布 Open-MoBench 以综合评估 T2M、M2T 与双向一致性，并给出"生成促进理解"的实证结论。意义在于推动运动-语言建模从文本主导的辅助模态范式转向模态对等的统一建模范式。局限性：摘要未给出具体数据集名称、模型规模、推理成本或实时性数据，也未说明 GRPO 在长序列生成上的具体误差抑制幅度，且未涉及事件相机、SNN、机器人实时感知等方向。

title: SeqMaestro: From nucleotide sequences to biological hypotheses through interpretable machine learning
summary: Nucleotide sequence analysis is central to problems spanning regulatory genomics, evolutionary biology, and phenotype prediction. Classical bioinformatics methods extract interpretable sequence properties such as motifs and k-mer composition, but their flexibility is limited. In contrast, modern deep learning models can learn powerful predictive representations directly from raw sequences, yet their internal representations and decision mechanisms are difficult to inspect. Interpretable machine learning methods (e.g., sparse linear models and decision trees) provide human-understandable representations of predictive relationships but are not designed to operate directly on nucleotide sequences. Here, we introduce SeqMaestro, a machine learning framework that proposes biological hypotheses from nucleotide sequences using interpretable models. Our solution is centered around a two-layer interface that connects nucleotide sequences with the broader ecosystem of interpretable machine learning. SeqMaestro uses this interface to fit diverse combinations of interpretable models, feature representations, and extraction strategies, leveraging variability across transparent models to identify robust biological signals and richer predictive relationships than feature importance alone can provide. The system also supports data transformation and cleaning, model fitting, hyperparameter tuning, reliability analysis, and synthesis of results into a contextualized written report. By providing these capabilities through a no-code workflow, SeqMaestro is designed to make interpretable sequence analysis accessible to researchers without requiring extensive programming or machine learning expertise. SeqMaestro thereby provides an accessible route from nucleotide sequences to biological hypotheses.

AI.tldr: SeqMaestro 是一个无代码机器学习框架，通过一个双层接口将核苷酸序列连接到可解释机器学习模型生态系统，能够从序列中自动生成具有可解释性的生物学假设并输出文字报告。
AI.motivation: 核苷酸序列分析在调控基因组学、进化生物学和表型预测中处于核心地位。传统生物信息学方法（如 motif 提取、k-mer 组成）可解释但灵活性有限；深度学习方法虽能直接从原始序列学习强大预测表示，但其内部表示和决策机制难以审查，缺乏可解释性。而稀疏线性模型、决策树等可解释机器学习方法虽能提供人类可理解的预测关系，却并非为直接处理核苷酸序列而设计。因此，需要一个既能保留序列建模能力、又能提供可解释生物学假设的桥梁框架。
AI.method: SeqMaestro 的核心是一个双层接口（two-layer interface），用于连接核苷酸序列与更广泛的可解释机器学习生态。基于该接口，框架能够拟合多种组合：可解释模型、特征表示与提取策略的多样组合。通过利用不同透明模型之间的变异性，识别稳健的生物学信号，并挖掘出比单纯特征重要性更丰富的预测关系。系统功能涵盖数据变换与清洗、模型拟合、超参数调优、可靠性分析，以及将结果综合为上下文化文字报告。整个流程通过无代码（no-code）工作流提供。
AI.result: 摘要为方法学/系统介绍性质，未提供具体数据集、定量指标或对比实验结果。框架的设计目标是通过多模型组合的变异性分析来提升生物学信号辨识的稳健性，并支持从数据处理到报告生成的端到端流程。
AI.conclusion: SeqMaestro 的主要贡献在于提出一个面向核苷酸序列的可解释机器学习框架，通过双层接口复用现成的可解释模型与特征表示，无需编程即可获得生物学假设与结构化报告。其意义在于降低了可解释序列分析的使用门槛，使非机器学习专家也能开展相关研究。局限在于：论文摘要未给出实验验证与定量结果，可解释模型的表达能力相对于深度学习可能仍受限，且双层接口对复杂序列关系（如长程依赖）的建模能力尚待评估。该工作与事件视觉、脉冲神经网络等方向无直接关联。

title: ESAFusion: LiDAR--4-D Radar Fusion via Local Geometric Complementation and Multiscale Adaptive Interaction for 3-D Object Detection
summary: LiDAR--4-D radar fusion combines accurate spatial geometry with motion and reflectivity cues from radar, offering a promising solution for 3-D object detection in complex driving environments. However, sparse radar observations and differences in spatial sampling between the two modalities complicate reliable cross-modal complementation. Moreover, the relative importance of modalities and feature scales varies across spatial regions, making adaptive fusion challenging. To address these challenges, we propose ESAFusion, an evidence-aware and scale-adaptive framework that combines local geometric complementation with multiscale adaptive interaction. Specifically, we introduce an Evidence-Aware Radar Selection (ERS) module to suppress radar clutter using motion and observation-quality evidence while retaining foreground confidence for subsequent fusion. Then, the Pillar-Level Complementary Encoder (PCE) improves cross-modal complementation under mismatched spatial sampling using local geometric support from neighboring LiDAR pillars. We further design an Intra- and Inter-Scale Adaptive Fusion (ISAF) module to adaptively adjust the contributions of different modalities and feature scales in bird's-eye-view (BEV) space. Extensive experiments on the View-of-Delft (VoD) dataset show that ESAFusion achieves the highest mean average precision (mAP) among the compared methods, reaching 74.60% in the Entire Annotated Area and 88.89% in the Driving Corridor. It also attains the highest average precision (AP) for Cyclist among these methods in both regions while running at 19.23 FPS. Evaluations on VoD-Fog further demonstrate robustness under progressively degraded LiDAR observations. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/SenJieHu549/ESAFusion.

AI.tldr: 提出 ESAFusion 框架，通过证据感知的雷达筛选与尺度自适应多尺度交互，实现 LiDAR--4-D 雷达融合的 3-D 目标检测，在 VoD 数据集上取得最高 mAP 并兼顾实时性。
AI.motivation: LiDAR 提供精确空间几何，4-D 雷达提供运动与反射率线索，二者融合有助于复杂驾驶场景下的 3-D 检测。但雷达观测稀疏，且与 LiDAR 在空间采样方式上存在差异，导致跨模态互补不可靠；同时不同空间区域内模态与特征尺度的相对重要性动态变化，使自适应融合难以实现，因此需要一个既能处理几何互补又能动态分配模态/尺度权重的框架。
AI.method: ESAFusion 采用局部几何互补与多尺度自适应交互相结合的设计。核心模块包括：(1) Evidence-Aware Radar Selection (ERS)：利用运动与观测质量证据抑制雷达杂波，同时保留前背景置信度，为后续融合提供干净雷达特征；(2) Pillar-Level Complementary Encoder (PCE)：借助相邻 LiDAR pillar 的局部几何支撑，在空间采样不匹配条件下改善跨模态互补；(3) Intra- and Inter-Scale Adaptive Fusion (ISAF)：在 BEV 空间内自适应调整不同模态与不同特征尺度的贡献。整体为证据感知、尺度自适应的融合框架。
AI.result: 在 View-of-Delft (VoD) 数据集上，ESAFusion 在所比较方法中取得最高 mAP：Entire Annotated Area 为 74.60%，Driving Corridor 为 88.89%；在两类区域中 Cyclist 的 AP 亦为最高，同时运行速度达 19.23 FPS。在 VoD-Fog 上的评测进一步表明，在 LiDAR 观测逐步退化时框架仍保持鲁棒性。源码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出证据感知雷达筛选、pillar 级几何互补编码与尺度自适应融合三部分协同的 LiDAR--4-D 雷达 3-D 检测框架，在 VoD 上实现领先精度并具备实时性，且在 LiDAR 退化场景下保持鲁棒。局限在于实验主要集中于 VoD 与 VoD-Fog，跨数据集与其他雷达配置的泛化性、以及 ERS 证据设计的通用性尚待验证。

title: Cross-Block Conditioning in Deep Boltzmann Machines for Statistical Data Fusion
summary: Statistical data fusion combines two panels that share a block of covariates but observe disjoint outcome blocks, and in its traditional form no row observes both outcomes at once. That rules out the discriminative criterion one would rather train a Deep Boltzmann Machine with, since multi-prediction training needs ground truth for whatever it holds out. We propose observed-block multi-prediction, which restricts the multi-prediction objective to targets drawn from what each row actually observes. It is well defined for any missingness pattern and reduces to the original criterion when rows are complete. Having a discriminative criterion that survives the setting lets us ask whether the joint model is needed at all, by separating what it contributes into a representation part and an inference part. On two consumer panels, on grids over sample size and covariate width spanning 35 cells and 875 runs, the fine-tuned DBM is the best of fifteen methods in every cell; but almost none of that advantage comes from generative pre-training, which is confined to the smallest sample size on one dataset and absent on the other. It comes from conditioning on one outcome block when predicting the other. This term amounts to +0.19 and +0.07 percentage points, is positive in all 35 cells, and, unlike every other contribution we measure, neither decays as the panels grow, nor requires a second hidden layer, nor requires more inference. Permuting one outcome block to destroy its association with the other removes the gain entirely, which is what the account predicts. The margins are small. But a small effect that does not decay is a different object from one that does, because it rests on evidence that no model mapping covariates to outcomes can accept.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"观测块多预测"(observed-block multi-prediction)准则，将深度玻尔兹曼机(DBM)的多预测训练目标限制在每行实际观测到的目标上，使其适用于统计数据融合中两面板共享协变量但观测不相交结果的场景。借此论证联合模型的贡献可分为表征部分与推理部分，并发现判别性增益几乎全部来自"以一个结果块为条件预测另一个结果块"，而非生成式预训练。
AI.motivation: 统计数据融合(statistical data fusion)常涉及两个面板共享一组协变量，但各自只观测到互不相交的结果块(disjoint outcome blocks)，传统设定下没有任何一行同时观测到两个结果。这一缺失模式使得多预测(multi-prediction)训练所需的判别性准则难以直接使用——因为多预测训练需要对被留出(hold-out)的变量提供真实标注作为监督信号。论文的动机在于恢复在该数据融合设定下可用的判别性训练目标，并进一步追问：在能进行判别式训练之后，联合模型是否真的必要？其价值究竟来自生成式预训练还是别的机制。
AI.method: 核心方法为"观测块多预测"：将多预测目标中的预测目标限定为每一行实际可观测到的变量，从而使目标在任意缺失模式下都有良好定义；当所有行都完整时，该目标退化为原始的(完整数据)多预测准则。基于这一可用的判别性准则，作者将联合模型的贡献解耦为表征(representation)部分与推理(inference)部分。实验使用两个消费者面板(consumer panels)数据集，在样本量与协变量宽度构成的网格上进行超参数/设置扫描，并将微调后的DBM与另外十四种方法(共十五种)进行对比，同时通过置换(permuting)一个结果块来破坏其与另一结果块的关联，作为机制验证。
AI.result: 在覆盖35个网格单元、共875次运行的实验中，微调后的DBM在每一个单元中都是十五种方法里最优的。然而优势几乎不来自生成式预训练：该贡献仅出现在其中一个数据集的最小样本量下，在另一个数据集上完全缺失。真正的来源是"预测一个结果块时以另一个结果块为条件"这一项，其增益为+0.19和+0.07个百分点，在全部35个单元中均为正。与其他被测量的贡献不同，该效应既不随面板规模增大而衰减，也不依赖第二个隐层，也不要求更多推理步。将其中一个结果块置换以破坏其与另一结果块的关联后，增益完全消失，符合理论预期。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献是提出观测块多预测准则，扩展了DBM多预测训练的适用范围至任意缺失模式的数据融合场景，并借此将联合模型的价值分解为表征与推理两部分，指出判别性增益主要来自跨结果块的条件化而非生成式预训练。其意义在于提供了一个无法由"协变量到结果"的映射模型所获得的证据来源。作者也明确指出增益幅度较小，但强调"不随规模衰减的小效应"与"会衰减的小效应"在性质上不同，前者具有持续的统计证据基础。局限在于效应量有限，且结论基于两个消费者面板数据集，方法在其他领域数据融合任务上的泛化性尚待验证。

title: TTDF: A Two-Stage Framework for Reliable Surgical Phase Transition Detection
comment: Accepted at the COLAS Workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: Reliable workflow transition detection is important for context-aware surgical assistance and downstream decision support. However, online surgical phase recognizers primarily focus on frame-wise accuracy and temporal consistency, rather than the reliability of workflow transition events. Directly converting phase changes into events is unreliable: temporal jitter and workflow-illegal switches produce false or duplicate events, while persistent, workflow-consistent candidates may remain incorrect. To address this limitation, we formulate reliable workflow transition detection as a distinct event-level task operating on outputs of a frozen online phase recognizer. We propose the Two-Stage Transition Detection Framework (TTDF), a causal framework that progressively filters transition candidates. Transition Candidate Extraction (TCE) first applies a minimum-duration requirement and a workflow-graph constraint to remove false candidates caused by temporal jitter and phase transitions not allowed by the workflow graph. Specifically, a candidate is retained only if the predicted target phase persists for a minimum duration and the ordered phase pair belongs to the workflow graph's allowed transition set. TCE thereby produces a high-recall candidate set without additional training. Transition Candidate Verification (TCV) suppresses remaining false candidates using phase-posterior shifts and visual-change cues from frozen DINOv2 features. Events are assessed using a phase-pair-aware one-to-one matching protocol. Experiments on Cholec80 show that TTDF reduces false transition emissions while preserving recall and controlling decision delay.

AI.tldr: 论文将"可靠的工作流转换检测"形式化为一个独立的事件级任务，作用于冻结的在线手术阶段识别器的输出之上，提出两阶段转换检测框架TTDF（Transition Detection Framework），通过渐进式过滤把帧级阶段预测转化为可靠的转换事件。
AI.motivation: 手术工作流转换（如阶段切换）的可靠检测对情境感知的手术辅助和下游决策支持至关重要。然而现有在线手术阶段识别器主要优化帧级准确率和时间一致性，并不关心转换事件本身的可靠性。直接将阶段变化当作事件会带来两类错误：一是时间抖动和不符合工作流图的非法切换会产生虚假或重复事件；二是即使某些候选持续存在且与工作流一致，仍可能是错误的。因此需要一个专门的、事件级的可靠性评估范式，而非简单转换帧级预测。
AI.method: TTDF是一个因果（causal）框架，在冻结的在线阶段识别器输出上逐步过滤转换候选。第一阶段Transition Candidate Extraction（TCE）无需额外训练，通过两个约束剔除虚假候选：(1) 最小持续时间要求——只有预测的目标阶段持续达到最短时长才保留候选，以抑制时间抖动；(2) 工作流图约束——只有当有序阶段对属于工作流图允许的转换集合时才保留，以排除工作流上非法的切换。TCE由此产生高召回率的候选集合。第二阶段Transition Candidate Verification（TCV）进一步抑制剩余虚假候选，利用相位后验偏移（phase-posterior shifts）和冻结DINOv2特征提供的视觉变化线索。事件评估采用相位对感知（phase-pair-aware）的一对一匹配协议。
AI.result: 在Cholec80数据集上进行实验。评估关注转换事件的可靠性，采用相位对感知的一对一匹配协议衡量检测到的转换事件。结果表明TTDF在保持召回率的同时减少了虚假转换事件的产生，并控制了决策延迟。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于：将手术工作流转换检测重新定义为一个独立的事件级任务，并提出无需训练候选提取与冻结特征验证相结合的两阶段因果框架，在保持召回的同时降低虚假转换事件并控制延迟。局限方面，方法依赖冻结的在线阶段识别器输出与预先定义的工作流图，仅在Cholec80单一数据集上验证，且摘要未给出具体的量化提升幅度与延迟数值。

title: Cloud Workflow Scheduling Based on Graph Attention-Driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
comment: Paper submitted to IEEE Internet of Things Journal
summary: Dynamic cloud workflow scheduling must balance deadline satisfaction, container utilization, and energy consumption while dealing with stochastic task-execution speeds, placement-dependent communication, and coupled task and container decisions. Workflows are naturally modeled as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), but conventional vector- or matrix-based states do not fully capture their dependency topology. To better represent task urgency and structural relationships, we assign predicted sub-deadlines to tasks and use a multi-head graph attention network (GAT) to extract dependency information from the evolving DAGs. Based on these representations, we develop a Graph Attention-Driven Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (GA-HRL) framework and model the scheduling process as an event-driven hierarchical semi-Markov decision process (SMDP). Workflow arrivals and task completions trigger scheduling events. At each scheduling event, the Task Scheduling (TS) agent first processes the currently ready tasks by assigning them to admissible existing containers or requesting new ones. The requested containers are then processed by the Container Scheduling (CS) agent for host placement before the environment advances. The two agents are trained alternately using separate Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Experiments on the 2018 Alibaba cluster trace show that GA-HRL maintains competitive workflow success rate and, in settings where success is comparable, generally achieves higher container utilization and lower energy consumption. Under the largest speed variation, it trades a small success-rate margin for substantially lower energy. Simulation code is available at: https://github.com/zongjin130/GA-HRL.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 GA-HRL，一种图注意力驱动的分层强化学习框架，用于动态云工作流调度。它用多头图注意力网络（GAT）从不断演化的 DAG 中提取依赖拓扑，并结合预测子截止期为任务赋予紧急性表示，将调度过程建模为事件驱动的分层半马尔可夫决策过程（SMDP），由任务调度（TS）和容器调度（CS）两个智能体分别用 PPO 交替训练。
AI.motivation: 动态云工作流调度需同时平衡截止期满足、容器利用率和能耗，同时面临任务执行速度的随机性、与放置相关的通信开销，以及任务分配与容器放置相互耦合的决策难题。工作流天然具有 DAG 依赖结构，但传统的向量或矩阵状态表示难以充分刻画其依赖拓扑和任务紧迫性，导致调度策略对结构信息利用不足，进而影响多目标优化效果。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三部分：(1) 表示为每个任务分配预测子截止期以编码紧迫性；(2) 使用多头 GAT 从演化中的 DAG 中提取任务间依赖关系作为状态表示；(3) 将调度过程建模为事件驱动的分层 SMDP，调度事件由工作流到达和任务完成触发。分层结构中，TS 智能体先将当前就绪任务分配到已有可用容器或请求新容器；请求的新容器再由 CS 智能体决定主机放置，之后环境才推进。两个智能体使用独立的 PPO 交替训练，实现任务与容器决策的解耦。
AI.result: 实验基于 2018 年阿里巴巴集群 trace 数据。结果表明 GA-HRL 保持有竞争力的工作流成功率；在成功率相当的情况下，通常获得更高的容器利用率和更低的能耗。在最大速度波动设置下，它以小幅成功率损失换取能耗的显著降低。仿真代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于将 GAT 拓扑表示与事件驱动分层 SMDP 结合，用双 PPO 智能体分别处理任务调度与容器放置，有效利用 DAG 结构信息并改善多目标调度权衡。其意义在于为云工作流提供兼顾截止期、利用率与能耗的强化学习方案。局限性方面，仅在一份集群 trace 上验证，泛化性有待检验；速度波动下需牺牲成功率，且预测子截止期的质量可能影响整体性能。

title: SCOUT-SLAM: Structurally-Coupled Dual Uncertainty-Aware 3DGS SLAM in the Wild
summary: Recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting SLAM (3DGS-SLAM) has gained significant momentum in simultaneous localization and 3DGS scene reconstruction. In real-world scenarios with rapid camera motion and cluttered dynamic environments, existing methods rely on the stability of the underlying scene reconstruction to model uncertainty. This leads to a circular dependency between camera tracking accuracy and reconstruction quality: reconstruction instabilities degrade uncertainty modeling, which affects accurate camera tracking and static scene reconstruction. To address this, the paper proposes SCOUT-SLAM, a structurally-coupled dual-uncertainty framework in which both uncertainties are estimated from a shared base network. A low-rank adaptation of this network, trained on multi-view feature consistency, estimates a tracking uncertainty that does not depend solely on the reconstruction quality. A spatially-adaptive prior modulates the network's training objective so that reconstruction instability does not inflate uncertainty on static regions, keeping the shared representation intact for both branches. Evaluations on dynamic benchmarks (TUM RGB-D, Bonn Dynamic, Wild-SLAM MoCap) demonstrate that SCOUT-SLAM achieves state-of-the-art camera tracking accuracy and artifact-free static scene reconstruction.

AI.tldr: SCOUT-SLAM 提出一种结构耦合的双不确定性框架用于 3DGS-SLAM，通过共享基础网络同时估计跟踪不确定性与重建不确定性，打破相机跟踪精度与重建质量之间的循环依赖，在动态场景基准上实现 SOTA 跟踪精度与无伪影的静态场景重建。
AI.motivation: 在真实场景中，快速相机运动与杂乱的动态环境会导致 3DGS 场景重建不稳定。现有 3DGS-SLAM 方法依赖底层重建的稳定性来建模不确定性，从而形成循环依赖：重建不稳→不确定性建模退化→相机跟踪与静态场景重建精度下降。该问题在动态、快速运动场景下尤为严重，亟需解耦跟踪不确定性与重建质量之间的强耦合关系。
AI.method: 核心是"结构耦合的双不确定性"框架，两类不确定性由同一共享基础网络估计：(1) 跟踪不确定性：通过在共享网络上进行低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation），并以多视图特征一致性为训练目标，使跟踪不确定性不再完全依赖于重建质量；(2) 重建不确定性：引入空间自适应先验（spatially-adaptive prior）来调制网络的训练目标，抑制重建不稳定在静态区域引起的不确定性膨胀，从而保持共享表征对两个分支都有效。二者共享表征，既解耦又保持结构耦合。
AI.result: 在动态基准数据集 TUM RGB-D、Bonn Dynamic、Wild-SLAM MoCap 上进行评估。结果表明 SCOUT-SLAM 在相机跟踪精度上达到 state-of-the-art 水平，同时实现无伪影（artifact-free）的静态场景重建，验证了双不确定性框架在快速运动与动态杂乱环境下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出解耦跟踪不确定性与重建质量循环依赖的共享网络双不确定性框架，并结合低秩适配与空间自适应先验提升动态环境下的鲁棒性。意义在于提升 3DGS-SLAM 在真实动态场景中的跟踪与重建可靠性。潜在局限：抽象未给出定量指标、计算开销与实时性细节；方法主要针对动态场景下的静态背景重建，对大规模室外场景的泛化性尚待验证。

title: High-Probability Nash Regret for Decentralized Learning in Markov $α$-Potential Games: Episodic and Fully Online Asynchronous Algorithms with Applications to Markov Congestion Games
summary: We study decentralized learning of Nash equilibria (NE) in infinite-horizon discounted Markov games under bandit feedback, focusing on Markov $α$-potential games. We develop KL-projected natural policy gradient (NPG) algorithms in two settings: an episodic setting with frozen policies during sampling and a fully online setting in which players receive a single realized cost sample per time step and update their policies asynchronously along a continuing trajectory. We establish finite-time high-probability NE regret bounds of order $\widetilde O(T^{-1/4})$ and $\widetilde O(T^{-2/15})$ for the episodic and fully online settings, respectively, up to fixed approximation terms. Crucially, our bounds eliminate the distribution-mismatch coefficient, which can scale prohibitively with the size of the state space, while accommodating potential approximation, estimation-oracle bias, and transition sensitivity. We further identify a state-wise potential structure that yields sharper guarantees with additive dependence on the potential approximation error $α$. We specialize the framework to independent-resource Markov congestion games (IMCGs), establish their approximate-potential and transition-sensitivity properties, and construct decentralized estimation oracles from realized costs. As an application, we introduce strategic online job scheduling on stochastic machines and obtain a scalable decentralized algorithm for learning stable dispatching policies. Overall, our results provide the first finite-time high-probability NE regret guarantees for fully online asynchronous decentralized learning in Markov $α$-potential games, remove distribution-mismatch coefficients from the regret bounds, accommodate fixed estimation-oracle bias, and provide scalable decentralized learning with finite-time guarantees for IMCGs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无限时域折扣马尔可夫博弈中Nash均衡的分散式（去中心化）学习，聚焦马尔可夫 α-势博弈。作者提出基于KL投影的自然策略梯度（NPG）算法，分别在"采样时冻结策略的回合制（episodic）"与"完全在线异步"两种设定下，给出有限时间高概率NE regret界，并首次实现完全在线异步去中心化学习的高概率保证。
AI.motivation: 在多智能体博弈中，各玩家仅能通过bandit反馈（只观测到自己执行的联合动作产生的成本，而非完整反馈）进行去中心化学习，是实际系统中的典型困难场景。既要保证收敛到Nash均衡，又要在有限时间内控制regret，是理论上的核心挑战。已有工作往往受"分布不匹配系数"（distribution-mismatch coefficient）制约，该系数会随状态空间规模急剧增长，导致在大规模问题上界失效；同时多数结果未能同时覆盖完全在线、异步更新、估计oracle有偏等现实条件。因此，去除该系数、并扩展到完全在线异步设定，对理论可扩展性具有重要意义。
AI.method: 提出KL投影的自然策略梯度（KL-projected NPG）算法，在两种设定下研究：1）回合制设定，采样期间策略冻结；2）完全在线设定，每时间步每玩家仅收到单个实际成本样本，并沿连续轨迹异步更新策略。理论工具上，作者建立有限时间高概率NE regret界，并关键性地消除分布不匹配系数，同时容纳势函数近似误差、估计oracle偏置以及转移敏感性（transition sensitivity）。进一步识别出一种"逐状态势结构"（state-wise potential structure），可获得对势近似误差α具加性依赖的更紧界。随后将该框架特化到独立资源马尔可夫拥塞博弈（IMCGs），证明其近似势与转移敏感性性质，并基于实际成本构造去中心化估计oracle。
AI.result: 理论结果：回合制设定的NE regret达到 Õ(T^{-1/4})，完全在线设定达到 Õ(T^{-2/15})（均到固定近似项为止）。两个界均去除了分布不匹配系数，并容许固定的估计oracle偏置。应用层面，将框架用于随机机器上的策略性在线作业调度，得到具有限时间保证的可扩展去中心化稳定调度策略学习算法。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献在于：给出马尔可夫α-势博弈中首个完全在线异步去中心化学习的有限时间高概率NE regret保证；从regret界中移除分布不匹配系数；容纳固定估计oracle偏置；并为IMCGs提供具有限时间保证的可扩展去中心化学习。局限在于完全在线设定的收敛速率 Õ(T^{-2/15}) 相对较慢，且结果依赖于势近似、oracle偏置等固定近似项的存在。

title: Evaluating Contextual Bias in CNN Image Classification: Evidence from Agricultural Benchmark Datasets
summary: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are typically evaluated using held-out classification accuracy, an approach that presupposes predictions are based primarily on the intended object of interest rather than incidental surrounding context. We test this assumption in CNN-based agricultural image classification by comparing model performance on original images with performance on background-dominated patches extracted from the same images across eight publicly available agricultural benchmark datasets and four widely used CNN architectures. Background-dominated patches were classified above dataset-specific random chance for six of the eight datasets, and substantially above chance for four of them, indicating that contextual information contributes to model predictions for the majority of datasets evaluated. For these four datasets, we further evaluated whether this behavior reflected genuine class-discriminative information or was primarily attributable to class imbalance using macro-averaged precision, recall, and F1 together with class-balanced test subsets. The results show that contextual reliance does not admit a single explanation: class imbalance accounts for a substantial portion of the observed signal for some datasets and architectures, whereas above-chance contextual classification persists after balancing for others. Together with previous evidence from curated object recognition and cancer pathology imaging, these findings support the growing view that contextual bias is a recurring characteristic of CNN-based image classification rather than a phenomenon confined to a single application domain. More broadly, this work provides a systematic framework for quantifying contextual bias across heterogeneous image datasets by combining dataset-specific random-chance baselines, contextual bias categorization, macro-averaged evaluation, and class-balanced robustness analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统性地检验了CNN图像分类中"背景/上下文偏置"这一假设：通过对比原始图像与从同一图像中提取的"背景主导图块"的分类性能，在8个农业基准数据集和4种CNN架构上量化上下文对预测的贡献，并进一步区分该信号来自真实的类别判别信息还是类别不平衡。
AI.motivation: CNN通常以留出集分类准确率来评估，这一评估范式隐含假设模型的预测主要依赖于目标物体本身，而非周围偶然的上下文。然而这一假设在农业图像分类等场景中并未被验证，若模型实际依赖背景/上下文，则高准确率可能掩盖对目标本身的弱理解，影响模型的可靠性、泛化性与可解释性。此前在 curated 物体识别与癌症病理图像中已有上下文偏置的证据，本文旨在检验其是否为跨领域普遍现象，并提供一个可跨异构数据集量化的框架。
AI.method: 方法核心是一种"背景主导图块"（background-dominated patches）的受控对比评估。具体地：对每张原始图像除去目标区域、提取以背景/上下文为主的图块，将原始图像与其背景图块分别输入同一模型进行对比。实验覆盖8个公开农业基准数据集与4种广泛使用的CNN架构。为区分随机水平与真实信号，设定数据集特定的随机概率基线（random chance）；随后针对信号显著高于随机水平的4个数据集，采用宏平均（macro-averaged）精确率、召回率与F1，并结合类别平衡的测试子集，进行类别不平衡归因分析，形成"随机基线—上下文偏置分类—宏平均评估—类别平衡稳健性分析"的量化框架。
AI.result: 在8个数据集中有6个的背景主导图块分类准确率高于数据集特定随机水平，其中4个显著高于随机水平，表明多数数据集中上下文信息对预测有贡献。对上述4个数据集使用宏平均P/R/F1及类别平衡测试子集分析后发现，上下文依赖并不能用单一原因解释：对某些数据集与架构，类别不平衡解释了所观察到信号的相当一部分；而对另一些数据集与架构，即使经过类别平衡，仍存在高于随机的上下文分类性能，说明存在真实的类别判别性上下文信息。结论与此前物体识别与病理图像中的证据一致。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于：以受控的背景主导图块对比，跨8个农业数据集与4种CNN架构系统量化了上下文偏置，并提出结合数据集特定随机基线、上下文偏置分类、宏平均评估与类别平衡稳健性分析的通用框架；结论支持"上下文偏置是CNN图像分类的普遍特性而非单一领域现象"这一观点。局限性方面：分析集中在农业图像分类领域，主要针对分类任务而非检测/分割；上下文贡献与类别不平衡的归因仍依赖统计性分析；未涉及模型架构改动或偏置缓解方法。对事件相机/时空建模领域无直接涉及，但其"评估假设检验"的思路对事件流分类等任务的可解释评估亦有方法学借鉴价值。

title: HiGFRL: Hierarchical Graph Fusion-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Dependency-Aware Task Scheduling in Heterogeneous Cloud
summary: Online scheduling of dependency-aware tasks in heterogeneous cloud clusters is a fundamental yet challenging problem due to the complex interplay between DAG topologies and multi-dimensional resource constraints. While DRL has shown promise, existing GNN-based approaches often struggle to efficiently model high-order topological dependencies and suffer from loose coupling between task and resource states, leading to myopic scheduling decisions. To address these limitations, we propose HiGFRL, a Hierarchical Graph Fusion-Driven Reinforcement Learning framework. HiGFRL constructs a novel three-level state representation comprising a Static Hypergraph, a Dynamic Global Graph, and a Local Bipartite Graph to explicitly model the interplay between task dependencies and real-time cluster dynamics. Specifically, we design a fusion-driven dual-network architecture to optimize RL decision-making, where a Context Fusion Allocator integrates local bipartite matching features with fused global context to execute precise task-to-node allocation, and a Global State Evaluator leverages the global dynamic graph representation to accurately estimate expected long-term cumulative reward. Furthermore, we incorporate a topology-prior-guided hybrid reward mechanism that distills static topological priors into the learning process to accelerate convergence. Extensive experiments using real-world Alibaba cluster traces demonstrate that HiGFRL significantly outperforms heuristics and DRL baselines. Specifically, in challenging large-scale high-load scenarios, HiGFRL reduces the Makespan by up to 32.55%, and optimizes the average task flow time and average task wait time by 13.58% and 13.79%, respectively. Experimental results confirm that HiGFRL not only significantly improves cluster throughput but also ensures superior QoS by substantially reducing queuing delays. Code Release:https://github.com/igeng/HiGFRL.

AI.tldr: HiGFRL是一个分层图融合驱动的强化学习框架，通过构建"静态超图—动态全局图—局部二部图"三级状态表示，显式建模任务依赖与集群实时动态的耦合关系，用于异构云集群中依赖感知任务的在线调度。
AI.motivation: 在线调度具有依赖关系（DAG）的任务是异构云集群中的核心难题，其困难在于DAG拓扑结构与多维资源约束之间存在复杂交互。现有基于DRL的方法（尤其基于GNN的方法）存在两个关键缺陷：（1）难以高效建模高阶拓扑依赖；（2）任务状态与资源状态之间耦合松散，导致调度决策短视（myopic）。这会造成makespan偏长、任务排队延迟高、集群吞吐下降与QoS恶化，因此需要一个能同时捕捉拓扑先验与实时资源动态的调度框架。
AI.method: HiGFRL提出三级状态表示：静态超图（捕获高阶任务依赖）、动态全局图（建模实时集群资源与负载动态）以及局部二部图（刻画当前候选任务与可用节点间的匹配关系）。在决策层面设计了融合驱动的双网络架构：（1）Context Fusion Allocator（上下文融合分配器）将局部二部匹配特征与融合后的全局上下文结合，执行精确的任务到节点分配；（2）Global State Evaluator（全局状态评估器）利用全局动态图表示估计期望长期累积回报，以缓解短视问题。此外引入拓扑先验引导的混合奖励机制，将静态拓扑先验蒸馏进学习过程以加速收敛。
AI.result: 实验使用真实阿里巴巴集群trace，与启发式方法及DRL基线进行对比。结果表明HiGFRL显著优于基线：在大规模高负载场景下，Makespan最高降低32.55%；平均任务流时间（average task flow time）优化13.58%，平均任务等待时间优化13.79%。结果验证了HiGFRL既能提升集群吞吐，又能通过显著减少排队延迟保障更优的QoS。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献是提出三级图状态表示（静态超图+动态全局图+局部二部图）以显式建模依赖与资源的耦合，并构建融合驱动双网络（Context Fusion Allocator + Global State Evaluator）结合拓扑先验混合奖励实现高效调度；在阿里巴巴真实trace上大幅超越启发式与DRL基线。潜在局限：仅在阿里巴巴单一真实trace上验证，对高负载/大规模场景之外的泛化性、超图与多图构建的计算开销、以及双网络融合的实时部署成本尚未充分说明；奖励机制中的拓扑先验依赖静态DAG假设，对动态变化的工作流可能适应性有限。

title: Compositional SVG Generation via VLM-Driven Hierarchical Semantic Parsing
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at visual reasoning, generating structured, editable Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) remains a fundamental challenge. Existing pipelines predominantly yield flat, semantically agnostic collections of paths, where editing a single object requires manually identifying its constituent paths. To address this, we propose a VLM-driven agentic framework for semantic compositional SVG generation. Our pipeline recursively parses visual scenes into semantic and geometric hierarchies via top-down decomposition, visual grounding, and prompt-driven amodal occlusion recovery, ensuring each component is geometrically complete. Furthermore, we introduce the Semantic SVG Benchmark with human-annotated semantic groups and novel sub-component metrics (Semantic Recall/Precision, PERE) to explicitly evaluate structural compositionality and functional editability. Experiments show that our natively predicted structures surpass the upper bounds of existing flat-generation methods in both grouping quality and editability, while maintaining state-of-the-art visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个由视觉语言模型（VLM）驱动的智能体框架，将视觉场景递归地解析为具有语义与几何层次的组成式 SVG，并配套构建 Semantic SVG Benchmark 及子组件级评测指标，使生成结果具备结构化语义分组与可编辑性。
AI.motivation: 现有 SVG 生成流程多输出扁平、语义不可知的路径集合，缺少对象级分组：编辑单个物体需人工辨别其由哪些路径构成，限制了下游的可用性与功能可编辑性。结构化、组成式的矢量图生成，对于设计工具、图形编辑与可复用资产创建具有重要意义，但此前缺少显式衡量结构组成性与可编辑性的基准与指标。
AI.method: 提出 VLM 驱动的智能体（agentic）流水线，核心是自顶向下的递归分解：将视觉场景依次拆解为语义层次与几何层次；结合视觉定位（visual grounding）确定组件位置；并通过提示驱动的非模态遮挡恢复（amodal occlusion recovery）补全被遮挡部分，保证每个组件在几何上完整。为评测组成式生成，构建 Semantic SVG Benchmark，提供人工标注的语义分组，并引入面向子组件的新指标：Semantic Recall/Precision 与 PERE（用于评估结构组成性与功能可编辑性）。
AI.result: 在 Semantic SVG Benchmark 上开展实验，评测维度包括分组质量、可编辑性与视觉保真度。结果显示：该方法原生预测的结构在分组质量和可编辑性上均超过现有扁平生成方法的上界（即优于对其输出做事后聚类的效果），同时在视觉保真度上保持最先进水平。Semantic Recall/Precision 与 PERE 被用于显式量化语义分组与可编辑性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献为：(1) VLM 智能体式的语义组成 SVG 生成框架，含递归分解、视觉定位与提示驱动非模态遮挡恢复；(2) Semantic SVG Benchmark 及子组件级指标（Semantic Recall/Precision、PERE）；(3) 实证表明结构化原生预测在组成性与可编辑性上优于扁平生成的性能上界。意义在于将矢量图生成从"路径集合"推进到"语义可编辑结构"。潜在局限：依赖 VLM 提示与智能体递归流程，可能受幻觉或遮挡恢复误差影响；方法复杂度与推理开销、以及基准规模与人类标注成本等，均需进一步考量。

title: Learning to Solve Stochastic Controls with Unknown Drifts and Running Rewards: Theory, Algorithms and Convergence
summary: We study continuous-time and possibly high-dimensional stochastic control problems where drift coefficients and running reward functions are unknown. Due to these missing model primitives, we take the exploratory, reinforcement learning (RL) framework of Wang, Zariphopoulou, and Zhou(2020) with relaxed controls and entropy regularization. The objective is to develop theoretically grounded, efficient and scalable RL algorithms to learn both the optimal value functions (which also solve the exploratory HJB equation) and optimal exploratory feedback control policies. When the diffusion coefficients do not contain control, we employ probabilistic representations of both the optimal value function and its gradient based on an auxiliary state process depending only on the diffusion part of the original dynamics. With a delicate analysis on some properly defined mappings and their fixed points, this leads to the introduction of our policy iteration algorithms and their convergence. We demonstrate the performance of our algorithms through various numerical examples. Finally, we study a special control-dependent diffusion case where probability representation of the Hessian is called for.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究漂移系数与运行奖励函数未知的连续时间（可能高维）随机控制问题，在Wang-Zariphopoulou-Zhou (2020) 的松弛控制+熵正则化探索式强化学习框架下，提出有理论保证的策略迭代算法，以学习最优价值函数（同时求解探索式HJB方程）与最优探索反馈控制策略。方法核心是利用仅依赖于扩散部分的辅助状态过程，构造最优价值函数及其梯度的概率表示，并通过映射与不动点分析证明算法收敛；最后探讨了控制相关扩散情形下需要Hessian概率表示的特例。
AI.motivation: 经典随机控制与HJB方程求解通常要求已知漂移系数与奖励函数等模型要素，但在实际场景中这些模型primitive往往未知，只能通过与环境交互获得数据。连续时间强化学习中，熵正则化的探索式公式虽然理论上优雅，但如何设计既高效、可扩展又具备收敛保证的算法仍具挑战。该论文正是针对"模型未知的连续时间随机控制"这一缺口，试图在保持理论严谨性的同时给出可落地的学习算法，因此对高维控制与金融、机器人等连续时间决策问题均有意义。
AI.method: 论文采用Wang等人(2020)的松弛控制与熵正则化探索式RL框架。核心创新在于：当扩散系数不含控制时，引入一个仅依赖于原始动力学扩散部分的辅助状态过程，据此给出最优价值函数及其梯度的概率表示（probabilistic representation）。基于这些表示，作者定义相应的映射并分析其不动点性质，进而构造策略迭代（policy iteration）算法并证明其收敛性。概率表示使得价值函数与策略可在模型未知条件下通过采样估计，避免直接求解PDE。最后，作者进一步研究控制相关扩散（control-dependent diffusion）的特殊情形，此时需要引入Hessian的概率表示来刻画二阶项。
AI.result: 论文以理论推导为主：定义了依赖辅助状态过程的映射并分析其不动点，证明了所提策略迭代算法的收敛性，并给出价值函数与梯度的概率表示。作者通过若干数值算例验证算法性能与有效性。对于控制相关扩散的特例，论文指出需要Hessian的概率表示并给出相应讨论。摘要未提供具体数据集、评价指标或定量对比结果，实验部分以数值示例为主要形式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将连续时间探索式强化学习的理论框架与可实现的策略迭代算法结合，主要贡献包括：(1) 在扩散系数不含控制时，利用仅依赖扩散部分的辅助状态过程，建立最优价值函数与梯度的概率表示；(2) 通过映射与不动点分析设计并证明收敛的策略迭代算法；(3) 将框架扩展至控制相关扩散情形并引入Hessian概率表示。其意义在于为模型未知的连续时间随机控制提供有收敛保证的学习方法。局限性方面，数值验证主要停留在示例层面，高维可扩展性与控制相关扩散情形下的实际算法效率仍有待更充分的实验支持。

title: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
summary: We present PhysBrain 1.5, a unified model for understanding physical environments, generating actions, and predicting future states. Motivated by the physical loop of observation, interaction, and environmental change, we bring these capabilities into a common learning framework. Starting from a general vision--language model, we encode language responses, end-effector motion, and dense visual targets as discrete sequences and jointly optimize them with autoregressive next-token prediction. Pre-training draws its embodied supervision entirely from human interaction videos, using task-centered episodes to pair semantic and spatial context with recovered motion and subsequent observations. We then adapt the model through supervised fine-tuning on a mixture of human demonstrations, robot trajectories, and simulated experience. Across 28 embodied understanding benchmarks, our 8B model achieves an average score of 72.5, setting a new open-source state of the art and performing on par with leading proprietary models such as GPT-6-Astra and Gemini 3.6 Flash. It achieves the best open-source results on 14 benchmarks while retaining general multimodal capabilities. Beyond these understanding evaluations, qualitative examples show the model's ability to produce end-effector trajectories and predict future scenes through spatially aligned RGB, depth, and robot-mask outputs.

AI.tldr: PhysBrain 1.5 是一个统一模型，将物理环境理解、动作生成与未来状态预测纳入同一自回归学习框架：把语言响应、末端执行器运动与稠密视觉目标统一编码为离散 token 序列，用下一个 token 预测联合优化。其 8B 模型在 28 个具身理解基准上平均得分 72.5，取得开源 SOTA，并在 14 个基准上达到最佳开源结果。
AI.motivation: 具身智能涉及"观察—交互—环境变化"的物理闭环，而现有模型通常将感知理解、动作生成和未来状态预测割裂为独立任务或独立模型，缺乏统一表示与监督信号。作者希望用一个通用视觉-语言模型同时承载三类能力，提升跨任务的一致性与泛化性，并在数据昂贵的机器人场景下降低对真机数据的依赖。
AI.method: 方法核心是"离散序列统一建模"：以通用 VLM 为骨干，将三类异构输出——语言响应、末端执行器（end-effector）运动、稠密视觉目标——统一 token 化为离散序列，采用自回归 next-token prediction 联合优化，使理解、动作与预测共享同一解码与损失框架。预训练阶段的具身监督完全来自人类交互视频：以 task-centered episode 的形式，将语义与空间上下文同恢复出的运动信息及后续观测配对，从而在无真机标注的情况下获得动作与动态监督。随后通过监督微调（SFT），在人类演示、机器人轨迹与仿真经验的混合数据上适配模型。
AI.result: 在 28 个具身理解基准上，8B 版本平均得分 72.5，创开源 SOTA，并与 GPT-6-Astra、Gemini 3.6 Flash 等领先闭源模型表现相当；在 14 个基准上取得最佳开源结果，同时保持通用多模态能力。除定量理解评测外，定性示例展示了模型生成末端执行器轨迹、以及通过空间对齐的 RGB、深度和机器人掩码（robot-mask）输出预测未来场景的能力。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出统一理解-动作-预测的具身基础模型范式，并以人类交互视频作为可扩展的具身监督来源，实现开源 SOTA 的具身理解性能与部分生成/预测能力。局限在于：动作与未来预测的评估以定性展示为主，缺少大规模定量基准与闭环真机执行验证；稠密视觉目标与轨迹的序列化会带来较长 token 序列与推理开销；预训练监督依赖从人类视频中恢复运动信息，其精度对下游任务的影响尚不明确。

title: Floquet Fibre Geometry and Higher-Order Reduced Coordinates for Off-Manifold Transients near Nonlinear Aeroelastic Flutter
summary: Assigning reduced coordinates to states near an attracting limit cycle requires the correct invariant-fibre geometry. The classical first-order phase-isostable chart obtained from adjoint Floquet modes projects along the strong-stable quotient fibre, whereas a metric-orthogonal complement of the retained slow bundle generally does not. We prove locally that a chart satisfying the linearised semiconjugacy relation leaves an O(delta^2) invariance residual, while projection along a non-invariant complement generically leaves an O(delta) term. For a nonlinear aeroelastic limit cycle, the metric-normal and strong-stable directions differ by 48.5 to 71.7 degrees, and metric-normal perturbations contain first-order retained phase and slow-amplitude components. Replacing the metric normal by the strong-stable fibre changes the measured residual scaling from delta^1.01 to delta^1.87 without fitted parameters. We then test learned higher-order corrections whose linearisation is pinned to the adjoint-Floquet chart, whose symmetry is exact, and whose reduced flow is fixed. Although they reduce the registered fixed-normalisation latent residual, post-hoc amplitude recalibration and adjoint-Floquet-targeted future consistency move or reverse the ranking. Because the learned maps already share the baseline's first-order gauge and the future target is supplied by the baseline chart, these diagnostics establish neither an independent positive nor negative higher-order result. Correct first-order Floquet geometry is therefore necessary in this benchmark, while the additional predictive value of the learned correction remains unidentified by the available representation-dependent diagnostics.

AI.tldr: 该论文从理论上证明：吸引极限环的降维坐标（phase-isostable chart）必须沿"强稳定/不变纤维"方向投影，而非其度规正交补方向；对非线性气动弹性极限环的数值实验验证了这一几何差异会显著改变不变性残差的标度律。
AI.motivation: 在动力系统中，把极限环邻域的高维状态压缩为低维（相位 + isostable/慢幅）坐标，是相位约化、耦合同步分析与控制的基础工具。传统一阶相位-isostable 图由 adjoint Floquet 模式给出，其投影沿强稳定商纤维进行；而在实践中常被当成"合理"替代的度规正交补（metric-normal）并非不变纤维。这一区别的关键在于：非不变补方向上的投影会引入 O(δ) 的一阶耦合残差，而正确的（满足线性化半共轭关系）图只剩 O(δ²) 残差。论文旨在澄清这一几何必要性，并检验学习到的高阶修正能否提供超出基线图的额外预测价值。
AI.method:
- 理论部分：定义满足线性化半共轭关系的降维坐标；局部证明正确的一阶 Floquet 图（沿强稳定纤维投影）留下 O(δ²) 的不变性残差，而沿非不变补方向投影一般留下 O(δ) 项。
- 数值验证对象：一个非线性气动弹性极限环。量化其度规正交方向与强稳定方向之间的夹角，并分析度规法向扰动中是否含一阶相位与慢幅分量。
- 残差标度实验：用强稳定纤维替换度规法向，无需拟合参数测量残差随 δ 的标度指数变化。
- 学习模块：训练学到的高阶修正映射，其线性化被固定到 adjoint-Floquet 图、对称性精确、约化流固定；随后施加事后幅值重标定与面向 adjoint-Floquet 目标的未来一致性检验，以考察排序是否改变。
AI.result:
- 对非线性气动弹性极限环，度规法向与强稳定方向相差 48.5°–71.7°，且度规法向扰动含一阶保留相位与慢幅分量。
- 将度规法向替换为强稳定纤维后，测得残差标度从 δ^1.01 变为 δ^1.87（无拟合参数），与理论上 O(δ) → O(δ²) 的预期一致。
- 学习的高阶修正虽降低了固定归一化下的隐变量残差，但事后幅值重标定和以 adjoint-Floquet 为目标的未来一致性检验会移动甚至反转这一排序；由于学习映射已共享基线的一阶规范、且未来目标由基线图提供，这些诊断既不能确证也不能否证独立的高阶结果。
AI.conclusion: 论文的核心贡献是证明并数值验证：在极限环降维中，正确的一阶 Floquet 几何（沿强稳定/不变纤维投影）在此基准上是必要的，度规正交补会破坏不变性残差的标度律。局限在于：实验仅针对单一非线性气动弹性基准；用于评估"学习高阶修正"的诊断指标是表示依赖的，且受基线一阶规范与基线提供未来目标的混淆，因此学习修正在额外预测价值上的收益仍无法被现有诊断判定。

title: LiftGCN: Efficient Energy-Preserving Graph Learning via Joukowski Spectral Lifting for Finite Element Stress Prediction
summary: Finite element stress fields often exhibit strong local non-smoothness, where stress concentrations near holes, notches, and loading regions induce sharp spatial gradients and high-frequency graph components. Although graph neural networks naturally operate on irregular finite element meshes, conventional message passing is inherently smoothing and progressively attenuates such high-frequency information. Unitary propagation alleviates this problem by preserving spectral magnitudes, but typically relies on matrix functions and high-order approximations with $O(Ked)$ propagation complexity. We propose LiftGCN, an efficient spectrally stable graph network based on Joukowski spectral lifting. LiftGCN maps the real spectrum of a normalized graph operator onto the unit circle through the Joukowski relation and realizes the resulting spectral transformation as a simple second-order recurrence, avoiding matrix exponentials, eigendecomposition, and high-order polynomial truncation. We show that the linear Joukowski backbone has unit-modulus characteristic roots and admits an energy-preserving structure under a positive-definite metric, preventing exponential attenuation of graph-frequency components with depth. Each layer requires only one sparse neighborhood aggregation, yielding $O(ed)$ propagation complexity, while lightweight local nonlinear residuals provide expressive feature transformations. Experiments on finite element stress prediction demonstrate that LiftGCN achieves competitive overall accuracy while improving reconstruction of stress concentrations and local high-gradient structures with substantially reduced computational cost. Our code is available at https://github.com/ChenZeng001/LiftGCN.

AI.tldr: LiftGCN 提出一种基于 Joukowski 谱提升（spectral lifting）的高效谱稳定图神经网络。它把归一化图算子的实谱通过 Joukowski 关系映射到单位圆上，用二阶递推实现该谱变换，避免矩阵指数、特征分解与高阶多项式截断，从而在有限元应力预测中更好地重建应力集中与局部高梯度结构，同时将传播复杂度降至 O(ed)。
AI.motivation: 有限元应力场在孔洞、缺口和加载区域附近存在强烈的局部非光滑性和应力集中，产生尖锐的空间梯度与图信号中的高频分量。图神经网络虽天然适配不规则有限元网格，但常规消息传递本质上是平滑算子，会随深度逐步衰减高频信息。已有的酉传播（unitary propagation）虽能保持谱幅度以缓解该问题，却依赖矩阵函数与高阶近似，传播复杂度高达 O(Ked)。因此需要一个既能保持谱稳定性、又计算高效、无需昂贵矩阵运算的图网络用于高频应力场重建。
AI.method: LiftGCN 的核心是 Joukowski 谱提升：通过 Joukowski 关系将归一化图算子的实谱映射到复平面单位圆上，从而让谱变换具备保模（unit-modulus）特性。该谱变换被实现为简单的二阶递推，无需矩阵指数、特征分解或高阶多项式截断。论文证明线性 Joukowski 主干具有单位模特征根，并在正定度量下具备能量保持结构，从而防止图频率分量随网络加深而指数衰减。每层仅需一次稀疏邻域聚合，传播复杂度为 O(ed)（e 为边数，d 为特征维度），并辅以轻量级局部非线性残差提供特征变换表达能力。
AI.result: 论文在有限元应力预测任务上进行实验，评估整体精度以及对应力集中和局部高梯度结构的重建能力。结果表明 LiftGCN 在取得有竞争力整体精度的同时，改善了对应力集中和局部高梯度结构的重建，并显著降低了计算成本。文中强调其复杂度优势来自每层仅一次稀疏聚合的 O(ed) 传播结构。
AI.conclusion: LiftGCN 的主要贡献是：提出 Joukowski 谱提升这一无需矩阵函数与高阶近似的谱稳定图网络范式，将实谱映射至单位圆并以二阶递推实现；理论证明其线性主干具有单位模特征根并在正定度量下能量保持，抑制深层频率衰减；在有限元应力预测中兼顾精度、高频结构重建与计算效率（O(ed)）。可能的局限在于：方法主要针对归一化图算子的实谱设定，实验集中于有限元应力预测这一特定任务，其向具有更一般或复谱结构的图信号及其他科学计算/感知任务的推广性有待进一步验证。

title: LG-VLN: A Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation Framework with LangGraph State Orchestration
summary: Continuous-environment vision-and-language navigation (VLN-CE) requires interpreting natural-language instructions in unseen 3D environments and executing continuous low-level actions. Existing methods often depend on LiDAR, panoramic cameras, or extra sensors; separate geometric-mapping and semantic-navigation visual representations can cause long-trajectory spatial-semantic inconsistencies. We propose LG-VLN, a monocular zero-shot framework with shared visual features and LangGraph-based state orchestration. An online feed-forward 3D reconstruction network predicts depth, camera poses, and dense point clouds for agent-pose estimation and global map fusion. Geometry and navigation share dense CleanDIFT features: semantic consistency rejects incorrect inter-frame correspondences, while target-instance constraints define visual references whose similarity combines with local BLIP-2 image-text relevance to form a semantic value map. LangGraph represents instruction parsing, geometric perception, semantic value updates, path planning, action execution, and failure recovery as a directed state graph with conditional transitions, persistent state, and modular recovery mechanisms. On a fixed 550-episode subset of the R2R-CE val-unseen split, LG-VLN achieves 21.3% success and 12.1% success weighted by path length. Ablations show shared semantic features improve navigation, further boosted by combining visual similarity and image-text relevance. Results establish shared visual representations and explicit state orchestration as effective for zero-shot VLN-CE using monocular RGB alone. Code will be publicly released for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: LG-VLN 是一个基于单目 RGB 的零样本连续环境视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）框架，通过共享视觉特征（CleanDIFT）与 LangGraph 状态编排，统一几何重建与语义导航，无需 LiDAR 或全景相机，在 R2R-CE val-unseen 子集上取得 21.3% 成功率。
AI.motivation: VLN-CE 要求智能体在未见过的 3D 环境中理解自然语言指令并执行连续的底层动作。现有方法大多依赖 LiDAR、全景相机或额外传感器，硬件成本高、部署受限；同时几何建图与语义导航往往使用相互独立的视觉表示，导致长轨迹中出现空间—语义不一致问题。该文旨在探索仅用单目 RGB 实现零样本 VLN-CE 的可行性，并通过共享视觉表示来缓解上述不一致。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分。其一为在线前馈式 3D 重建网络，预测深度、相机位姿与稠密点云，用于智能体位姿估计与全局地图融合。其二为共享视觉表示：几何与导航共用稠密 CleanDIFT 特征，利用语义一致性剔除错误的帧间对应关系；同时以目标实例约束定义视觉参考，将其相似度与局部 BLIP-2 图文相关性相结合，构建语义价值图（semantic value map）。其三为基于 LangGraph 的状态编排，将指令解析、几何感知、语义价值更新、路径规划、动作执行与失败恢复建模为带条件转移的有向状态图，具备持久化状态与模块化恢复机制。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE val-unseen 划分的固定 550 个 episode 子集上评估，LG-VLN 达到 21.3% 成功率（SR）与 12.1% 路径长度加权成功率（SPL）。消融实验表明，共享语义特征可提升导航性能，而将视觉相似度与图文相关性结合后效果进一步增强。结果表明，仅使用单目 RGB 时，共享视觉表示与显式状态编排对零样本 VLN-CE 是有效的。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于验证了单目 RGB 零样本 VLN-CE 的可行性，并提出两项关键设计：几何与导航共享的稠密视觉特征，以及基于 LangGraph 的显式状态编排以支持模块化失败恢复。其意义在于降低对 LiDAR 与全景传感器的依赖，并为长轨迹空间—语义一致性提供了一种表示层面的解决思路。局限方面，论文仅在单一固定子集（550 episodes）上报告结果，绝对 SR/SPL 相对较低，泛化性与与其他基准的可比性仍有待验证；代码将公开但尚未提供更广泛的评估。

title: From Density to Biopsy Decisions and Malignancy Prediction: A Benchmark Study of Multimodal Large Language Models Against Radiologists in Digital and Contrast-Enhanced Mammography
summary: Purpose: To compare four multimodal large language models (MLLMs) with radiologists of varying expertise in breast density assessment, BI-RADS assessment, biopsy candidacy determination, and continuous malignancy probability estimation using digital mammography (DM) and contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM). Methods: This study included 179 women with paired DM/CEM examinations and reference standards. Four MLLMs (ChatGPT-5.2, Gemini-3.1 Pro, Sonnet-4.6, Muse Spark) interpreted images with and without masks; three radiologists interpreted non-masked images. Results: For binary density classification on DM, radiologist accuracies ranged from 55.81% to 78.60%, exceeding most MLLM values (62.33%-71.63%), while masks added limited benefit. Five-category BI-RADS accuracies were higher for radiologists on DM (56.74-67.44%) and CEM (62.33-82.79%) compared with MLLMs (DM 31.16-45.12%; CEM 40.00-55.81%). Binary biopsy-candidacy accuracies were likewise higher for radiologists (DM 85.12-89.77%; CEM 86.98-92.09%) than for MLLMs (DM 61.39-75.35%; CEM 69.30-82.79%), although CEM improved performance across all readers. Lesion masks substantially improved MLLM continuous malignancy-probability accuracies from 64.65%-71.63% to 72.56-78.60% on DM and from 67.91%-77.21% to 72.56%-81.86% on CEM, approaching radiologist ranges (DM 63.72-82.79%; CEM 81.86-88.84%). The corresponding AUCs for the top masked models overlapped those of the human readers. Overall, Muse Spark, followed by Sonnet-4.6, demonstrated the strongest performance among the MLLMs across domains. Conclusion: Radiologists generally outperformed MLLMs in categorical tasks, while selected masked models approached human performance for continuous malignancy probability estimation, suggesting a potential adjunctive role.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统对比了四种多模态大语言模型（ChatGPT-5.2、Gemini-3.1 Pro、Sonnet-4.6、Muse Spark）与不同资历放射科医生在乳腺密度评估、BI-RADS 分级、活检适应证判定及连续恶性概率估计上的表现，使用数字化乳腺摄影（DM）与对比增强乳腺摄影（CEM）配对数据。结果显示：分类任务中放射科医生总体优于 MLLM，但引入病灶掩膜后，MLLM 在连续恶性概率估计上接近甚至重叠于人类读者水平，Muse Spark 表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 乳腺影像判读任务（密度分类、BI-RADS 分级、活检决策、恶性概率估计）对临床路径至关重要，但读片负担重、主观性强，且医生资历差异会带来一致性波动。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）已在通用医学视觉问答中展现潜力，然而其在乳腺 DM/CEM 这类高难度、细粒度、需定量概率输出的临床任务上，能否达到或补足放射科医生水平尚不明确。此外，CEM 相较 DM 是否提升各类读者表现、以及病灶掩膜（mask）等显式提示能否弥补 MLLM 的定位/注意力不足，也缺乏定量证据。因此本文的核心动机是：在配对 DM/CEM 数据上，以放射科医生为参照，量化 MLLM 的可用性与边界，判断其是否可以作为一种辅助（adjunctive）工具。
AI.method: 研究纳入 179 名女性受试者，均具备配对的 DM 与 CEM 检查及参考标准（reference standards）。评估对象为四种 MLLM：ChatGPT-5.2、Gemini-3.1 Pro、Sonnet-4.6 与 Muse Spark；对照组为三名放射科医生。实验采用消融式设置：MLLM 分别在“无掩膜”和“有掩膜”两种条件下读片，放射科医生仅读无掩膜图像。评估任务覆盖四类：1）二分类乳腺密度分类；2）五分类 BI-RADS 分级；3）二分类活检适应证判定（biopsy candidacy）；4）连续恶性概率估计（continuous malignancy probability）。掩膜的作用是向模型显式提供病灶区域先验，考察“定位提示”对 MLLM 注意力及定量输出的影响；同时通过 DM 与 CEM 两种模态对比，分析对比增强信息对各读者性能的增益。评价指标包括准确率（Accuracy）与连续概率/AUC。
AI.result: 在 DM 二分类密度任务上，放射科医生准确率为 55.81%–78.60%，多数高于 MLLM 的 62.33%–71.63%，掩膜带来的收益有限。五分类 BI-RADS 上，放射科医生在 DM（56.74–67.44%）与 CEM（62.33–82.79%）均高于 MLLM（DM 31.16–45.12%；CEM 40.00–55.81%），说明细粒度分级是 MLLM 的明显短板。二分类活检适应证上同样呈现人优机劣：放射科医生 DM 85.12–89.77%、CEM 86.98–92.09%，MLLM 为 DM 61.39–75.35%、CEM 69.30–82.79%；但 CEM 使所有读者（人与模型）性能普遍提升。在连续恶性概率估计上，加入病灶掩膜后 MLLM 准确率显著提升：DM 从 64.65%–71.63% 升至 72.56–78.60%，CEM 从 67.91%–77.21% 升至 72.56%–81.86%，接近放射科医生区间（DM 63.72–82.79%；CEM 81.86–88.84%），且最优掩膜模型的 AUC 与人类读者发生重叠。综合各任务，Muse Spark 表现最强，其次为 Sonnet-4.6。
AI.conclusion: 主要结论是：在分类/分级类任务（密度二分类、BI-RADS 五分类、活检适应证）中，放射科医生总体优于 MLLM；但在连续恶性概率估计这一更贴近“风险量化”的任务上，配合病灶掩膜的部分 MLLM 已接近人类水平，AUC 区间与人类重叠，提示其可作为辅助角色而非替代。研究意义在于首次（就本设定而言）以配对 DM/CEM 与多资历医生为参照，系统刻画了 MLLM 在乳腺多任务判读中的能力边界，并指出显式定位先验（mask）对提升定量输出尤为有效、CEM 相对 DM 对所有读者均有增益。局限包括：样本量 179 例相对有限、仅三名放射科医生、掩膜条件下的评估可能引入信息泄露式偏差（人未获掩膜而模型获得）、以及 MLLM 版本迭代快、结论时效性受限；此外五分类与活检决策等关键临床任务的模型表现仍不达可用标准。

title: HGTO: A Unified Graph-Based Physics-Informed Formulation for Structural Topology Optimization
summary: Density-based topology optimization is typically structured as a nested sequence of material updates, structural analyses, and sensitivity assessments. While neural density parameterization and dual-field physics-informed approaches provide data-free alternatives, most existing methods represent density and displacement as coordinate fields and make limited use of the discrete relationships inherent in the finite element mesh. The present study introduces HGTO, a unified graph-based formulation that extends complete neural topology optimization from coordinate space to finite-element graph space. Element densities are parameterized on the element graph derived from the mesh, and the structural state is determined on the corresponding node--element hypergraph. Finite element kinematics, numerical quadrature, constitutive response, and force assembly remain explicitly defined operations within the differentiable computation. The material field and equilibrium state are therefore coupled through a common finite-element incidence structure. Numerical studies show compliance comparable to conventional density-based optimization at substantially lower computational cost than a representative coordinate-based dual-field neural method. The same coupled formulation accommodates high-resolution and irregular meshes, three-dimensional structures, finite deformation, and elastoplastic response.

AI.tldr: HGTO 提出统一的图神经网络式拓扑优化框架，将密度场与结构状态从坐标空间迁移到有限元图空间：单元密度参数化在由网格导出的单元图上，位移/结构状态在相应的节点-单元超图上求解，二者通过共享的有限元关联结构耦合。
AI.motivation: 传统密度法拓扑优化是"材料更新—结构分析—灵敏度评估"的嵌套循环，计算代价高。已有的神经密度参数化与双场物理信息方法虽能实现无数据（data-free）优化，但大多把密度场和位移场表示为连续坐标场，忽略了有限元网格中固有的离散邻接/关联关系，因而未能充分利用网格拓扑先验。
AI.method: 核心是把完整神经拓扑优化从坐标空间扩展到有限元图空间：1) 在网格导出的单元图（element graph）上定义并参数化单元密度，用图网络捕捉单元间邻接关系；2) 在对应的节点—单元超图（node–element hypergraph）上确定结构状态（位移场），超边天然编码单元对节点的关联；3) 将有限元运动学、数值积分（quadrature）、本构响应与力装配保留为可微计算图中显式定义的算子，而非黑箱网络；4) 材料场与平衡状态经由同一有限元关联（incidence）结构耦合，形成统一的、无标签的端到端公式。
AI.result: 论文以数值研究验证：在柔度（compliance）指标上，HGTO 达到与传统密度法优化相当的水平，同时计算成本显著低于一个代表性的基于坐标的双场神经方法。同一耦合公式可推广到高分辨率网格与不规则网格、三维结构、有限变形以及弹塑性响应等多种设定。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于提出有限元图空间中的统一神经拓扑优化表述，把显式有限元算子与图/超图表征结合，兼顾物理可解释性与计算效率，并具备向三维、不规则网格、大变形与非线性材料扩展的通用性。局限方面：摘要未给出具体数据集、网格规模、收敛性保证与相对传统方法在最优性/精度上的细致对比，也未讨论训练稳定性与超参敏感性，这些需在正文中进一步验证。

title: GRAVA: Grounded Reasoning-to-Action Representation and Learning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly reason before acting, but their intermediate reasoning is often weakly grounded in physical scene evidence and loosely connected to executable behavior. We present GRAVA, a framework built around Grounded Reasoning-to-Action (GRA), which unifies grounding, reasoning, and action generation in a single autoregressive stream. GRA links action-relevant language references to 2D visual regions and ego-centric physical states, organizes object interactions and decisions in a trajectory-anchored typed graph, and serializes this structure into grounded reasoning. A single VLM generates this reasoning followed by a compact Executable Planner action that is deterministically decoded into a continuous trajectory. We further introduce an agentic GRA data construction pipeline that combines forward scene grounding with backward trajectory anchoring, and use it to build GR-NavSim with 2.2M grounded question-answer pairs and 70K GRA reasoning traces. A progressive training strategy develops grounded cognition through pre-training, establishes the reasoning-to-action interface through imitation, and improves driving behavior through reinforcement learning and exploration. Using about 60% of the available human driving demonstrations for action supervision, GRAVA-8B achieves state-of-the-art performance among purely autoregressive driving models on the full NAVSIM benchmark. On an internal long-tail benchmark, full GRA improves key-object compliance and Closed-loop Driving Score by 19.3% and 20.5% over action-only prediction, respectively. These results show the benefit of preserving action-relevant physical evidence from grounded reasoning through executable action generation.

AI.tldr: GRAVA：一种面向自动驾驶的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过"Ground Reasoning-to-Action (GRA)"将视觉 grounding、结构化推理与动作生成统一到单一自回归流中，实现物理证据落地、推理可执行、动作可确定性解码的驾驶决策。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶 VLA 模型虽具备"先推理后行动"的能力，但中间推理往往缺乏对物理场景证据的 grounding，且与可执行行为之间的连接松散，导致推理沦为无实际约束的语言生成。作者认为，应当在整个推理到执行的链路中保留与动作相关的物理证据，从而提升驾驶行为尤其是长尾场景下的合规性与闭环表现。
AI.method: 核心是 GRA 统一表示：将动作相关的语言指代（references）显式链接到 2D 视觉区域和 ego-centric 物理状态（如自车运动状态）；同时把物体交互与决策组织成以轨迹为锚点（trajectory-anchored）的类型化图结构（typed graph），并将其序列化进 grounded reasoning 文本中。单一 VLM 首先生成该 grounded 推理，随后输出一个紧凑的"Executable Planner"动作表示，该表示被确定性解码为连续轨迹。为支撑训练，作者提出 agentic 数据构建流水线，结合"前向场景 grounding"与"后向轨迹锚定"，构建了 GR-NavSim（含 220 万 grounded QA 对与 7 万条 GRA 推理轨迹）。训练采用渐进策略：预训练建立 grounded cognition，模仿学习建立 reasoning-to-action 接口，再用强化学习与探索优化驾驶行为。
AI.result: 动作监督仅使用约 60% 的人类驾驶示范数据。在完整 NAVSIM 基准上，GRAVA-8B 在纯自回归驾驶模型中取得 SOTA 表现；在内部长尾基准上，完整 GRA 相比仅动作预测（action-only）将关键物体合规性（key-object compliance）提升 19.3%，闭环驾驶分数（Closed-loop Driving Score）提升 20.5%。结果验证了"从 grounded 推理到可执行动作生成全流程保持动作相关物理证据"的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于：(1) 提出 GRA 统一表示，把视觉 grounding、类型化交互图推理与可执行动作生成耦合进单一自回归流；(2) 构建 agentic GRA 数据流水线与 GR-NavSim 数据集；(3) 提出预训练-模仿-强化学习的渐进训练范式，并以更少的人类监督数据达到纯自回归驾驶模型的 SOTA。意义在于强调物理证据落地对推理驱动驾驶的价值。潜在局限包括：实验依赖内部长尾基准，泛化性需更多公开基准验证；确定性解码对多样化轨迹的覆盖能力有限；同时该工作为面向驾驶的 VLA，尚未涉及事件相机/脉冲神经网络等高效感知范式，推理实时性与算力开销亦未充分讨论。

title: LIMODENet: Attention-Free Compact Encoders for Information-Preserving Onboard Satellite Image Restoration
comment: 25 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables; includes supplementary material with full proofs. Code and weights: https://github.com/ltdung/limodenet and https://huggingface.co/ltdung/limodenet
summary: Onboard satellites must restore a channel-degraded image on a few watts, using neuromorphic accelerators (e.g., BrainChip Akida, Intel Loihi-2) that support no softmax or attention. We ask which encoder restores best under that constraint and introduce LIMODENet (LinearMix-ODENet), a 0.69M softmax-/QKV-free backbone whose residual stages read as ODE discretizations and which is empirically information-preserving (probe accuracy rises 79.9% -> 98.4% from stem to head). At iso-parameters it restores 1 dB DVB-S2X-degraded EuroSAT better than a CNN autoencoder (+1.75 dB PSNR) and a skip-connection U-Net (+1.07 dB), three seeds, non-overlapping. Unconstrained modern restorers (NAFNet, Restormer) win on fidelity; we decompose that gap: spiking-legal additive skips recover about half, and the rest traces to attention and channel gating. LIMODENet then converts end-to-end to a spiking network with zero blocked operations, versus 22-24 for the competitors: not the best restorer available, but the best verified deployable within a real power budget.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LIMODENet（LinearMix-ODENet），一个 0.69M 参数、无 softmax 与无 QKV 的编码器骨干网络，用于在低功耗神经形态加速器（BrainChip Akida、Intel Loihi-2）上对退化卫星图像进行板载恢复。其残差阶段可解读为 ODE 离散化，且经验上具有信息保持性（探针准确率从 stem 到 head 由 79.9% 升至 98.4%）。
AI.motivation: 星载卫星必须在数瓦功率预算下恢复信道退化图像，而神经形态加速器（如 Akida、Loihi-2）不支持 softmax 或注意力（attention）操作。因此核心问题是：在这种硬件约束下，哪类编码器能取得最佳恢复性能？该问题关系到星上实时感知与低功耗部署的实际可行性。
AI.method: LIMODENet 是一个 0.69M 参数、无 softmax / 无 QKV 的骨干网络，其残差阶段被设计/解读为 ODE 的离散化形式（LinearMix-ODENet），并在经验上验证为信息保持（information-preserving）。网络使用"spiking-legal"（脉冲合法性兼容）的加性跳跃连接，并可端到端转换为脉冲神经网络（SNN），转换后受阻操作（blocked operations）为零。作者还通过消融分解了与常规现代恢复器之间的性能差距来源。
AI.result: 在 DVB-S2X 信道退化的 EuroSAT 数据集上、参数量相当时（iso-parameters），LIMODENet 的恢复效果优于 CNN 自编码器（+1.75 dB PSNR）和带跳跃连接的 U-Net（+1.07 dB），基于三个随机种子且置信区间不重叠。无约束的现代恢复器（NAFNet、Restormer）在保真度上更优；作者将差距分解为：脉冲合法的加性跳跃连接可追回约一半差距，其余差距源于注意力与通道门控（channel gating）。在端到端转换为脉冲网络时，LIMODENet 的受阻操作为 0，而竞争对手为 22–24 个。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献在于：针对神经形态硬件约束提出一个无 softmax/QKV、可完整转为 SNN 的轻量恢复骨干，并给出与常规现代恢复器差距的来源分解。其意义在于提供了在真实功耗预算下"最佳可验证部署"的方案，而非追求最高保真度恢复器。潜在局限：其保真度仍低于 NAFNet、Restormer 等无约束现代恢复器，且实验主要围绕 EuroSAT 与 DVB-S2X 退化展开，泛化性有待进一步验证。

title: Pick Your Poison: Learning to Select Poison Sets for Stronger LLM Backdoor Attacks
summary:
Backdoor poisoning attacks add poisoned examples to otherwise-clean finetuning data, pairing a trigger with a target behavior that the model learns to produce when the trigger appears. Existing evaluations typically fix the number of poisoned examples and sample them at random from a candidate pool. We show that this can severely underestimate worst-case vulnerability: across three LLaMA-3-8B backdoor settings, holding the model, clean data, and poison count fixed, attack success ranges from 3% to 80% depending only on which poison set is chosen.
  We formalize poison selection as oracle-budgeted set optimization and introduce SAILS (Set-level Audit-Informed Iterative Learned Selection), which learns a set scorer from a few hundred finetune-and-evaluate runs, ranks millions of candidate sets, and audits only a small shortlist. SAILS improves held-out attack success by 30 percentage points on average over the strongest influence baselines, transfers from small-scale to full-scale finetuning, and extends to code-generation, agentic, and API-only backdoors.

AI.tldr: 论文指出固定毒化样本数量、随机采样候选池的常规后门评测会严重低估最坏情况脆弱性；作者将毒化样本选择形式化为"预言机预算受限的集合优化"问题，并提出 SAILS，用少量微调-评估运行学习集合打分器，从数百万候选集合中筛选出高攻击成功率的毒化集。
AI.motivation: 后门投毒攻击通常是在原本干净的微调数据中加入少量毒化样本，将触发器与目标行为绑定，使模型在触发器出现时产生攻击者期望的输出。既有评测范式一般固定毒化样本数量，并从候选池中随机采样毒化样本，隐含假设是"给定数量下不同选法带来的风险大致相同"。论文证明这一假设不成立：在三个 LLaMA-3-8B 后门设置中，在模型、干净数据、毒化数量完全固定的条件下，仅改变选取哪一组毒化样本，攻击成功率（ASR）就从 3% 变化到 80%。这意味着随机采样会系统性低估最坏情况下的真实脆弱性，"毒化集本身的构造"才是决定性变量。该问题的重要性在于：安全评估若只报告随机采样的平均风险，会错误估计模型在真实攻击者（可主动优化选样）面前的暴露程度，也会削弱对防御手段有效性的判断依据。
AI.method: 作者将毒化样本选取重新定义为一个集合级优化问题：在给定"预言机预算"（即允许执行的微调-评估次数）下，从海量候选毒化集合中寻找使攻击成功率最大化的集合，从而把"选哪些样本"而非"选多少样本"作为优化对象。为此提出 SAILS（Set-level Audit-Informed Iterative Learned Selection）：其核心是利用少量（数百次）微调-评估运行的反馈训练一个集合打分器（set scorer），对成百万量级的候选集合进行排序，然后只对进入短名单（shortlist）的小部分集合执行实际审计式微调-评估，从而在有限预算下逼近最坏情况选样。方法特点包括：将逐样本影响力度量提升到集合层面进行学习，避免逐一评估不可行的组合爆炸；通过迭代方式用审计结果不断改进打分器；并设计为能在小规模微调上训练、再迁移到全规模微调。
AI.result: 实验以 LLaMA-3-8B 为主，覆盖三个后门设置，并进一步扩展到代码生成、智能体（agentic）以及仅能通过 API 访问的后门场景。评估指标为攻击成功率（ASR），并区分训练所见的集合与留出（held-out）集合。主要发现：（1）在模型、干净数据与毒化数量完全固定时，不同毒化集合的 ASR 跨度为 3%–80%，直接证实随机采样的评测存在严重低估；（2）SAILS 在留出攻击成功率上相较最强影响力（influence）基线平均提升约 30 个百分点；（3）该方法能从较小规模微调迁移到完整规模微调，说明所学的集合打分器捕捉到了可迁移的选样规律，而非过拟合到特定训练设置；（4）有效性可延伸至代码生成、智能体式与 API-only 后门，表明结论不局限于单一任务或白盒训练场景。
AI.conclusion: 论文的主要贡献有三点：第一，实证揭示后门评测中"随机选样"会造成最坏情况脆弱性的严重低估（同一设置下 ASR 可在 3%–80% 间波动）；第二，将毒化样本选择形式化为预言机预算受限的集合优化问题，为后门安全评估提供了新的问题刻画；第三，提出 SAILS，用学习式集合打分器加短名单审计，在有限微调-评估预算下显著提升留出攻击成功率（平均 +30 个百分点），并可迁移到全规模微调及代码生成、智能体、API-only 等场景。其意义在于把后门评测从"平均风险"推进到"最坏情况风险"，同时为攻击方提供可管理的选样工具、为防御评估提供更严格的测试标准。可能的局限包括：方法依赖一定数量的微调-评估预言机查询（预算受限即性能受限），打分器的学习与迁移虽已验证但成本仍不可忽略；结论主要围绕 LLaMA-3-8B 与文本类后门任务，向更大模型、多模态或其他模态（如事件相机等感知类模型）的适用性尚未验证；此外，增强攻击选样能力本身也带来双重用途风险，需配套防御与披露规范。

title: Perceive, Refine, Reason: A Calibrated Pipeline for Measuring Indicators in Strategic Visual Communication on Social Media
summary: Visual content shapes audience perception and opinion on social media, and computational social science increasingly relies on automated tools to analyze images at scale. Yet a measurement gap persists: existing tools rely on predefined categories or produce only coarse image-level labels, while measuring which specific objects appear in an image, how prominently, and where in the frame remains difficult at scale. We introduce Perceive, Refine, Reason (PRR), a calibrated pipeline that turns flexible vision-language detectors into auditable measurement instruments for social-scientific research. PRR combines natural-language category prompts with pixel-level spatial refinement via the Segment Anything Model (SAM) and a multimodal LLM arbitration layer whose reasoning chains externalize domain knowledge and lower the expertise threshold for human-in-the-loop validation. A complementary three-tier auditability framework applies quantification learning to profile per-category reliability, support task-aligned configuration, and statistically correct prevalence estimates. Across four vision-language detectors and nine sociological categories, the pipeline yields substantial precision gains over zero-shot baselines, including a 43.3-point improvement for the strongest backbone. Applying PRR to 103,920 Facebook images from U.S. legislators during the 2024 election cycle and linking detections to DW-NOMINATE ideology scores, we find that more conservative legislators display U.S. flags as larger visual elements, with a weaker tendency toward peripheral placement, a spatial pattern invisible to binary detection. PRR provides computational social scientists with a model-agnostic toolkit for accessible, spatially-grounded, and correctable visual measurement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 "Perceive, Refine, Reason (PRR)" 校准式流水线，将开放词汇视觉-语言检测器转化为可审计的社会科学研究测量工具，通过自然语言类别提示、SAM 像素级空间精修与多模态 LLM 仲裁层，输出空间定位、可校正的目标测量结果，并提供三层可审计性框架进行量化学习与统计校正。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体视觉内容深刻影响公众认知，计算社会科学日益依赖大规模自动化图像分析。然而现有工具存在测量鸿沟：或依赖预定义类别，或仅输出粗粒度的图像级标签，难以在大规模场景下刻画"哪些具体物体出现、其显著程度如何、位于画面何处"。同时，黑盒式检测缺乏可审计性，非专家用户难以验证与纠偏，导致社会科学测量在空间维度上不可见且可靠性难以刻画。
AI.method: PRR 为模型无关的三阶段流水线：(1) Perceive，使用自然语言类别提示驱动灵活的开集视觉-语言检测器；(2) Refine，借助 Segment Anything Model (SAM) 进行像素级空间精修，将检测框提升为精细掩码与空间测量；(3) Reason，引入多模态 LLM 仲裁层，通过外化推理链注入领域知识，降低人工闭环验证的专家门槛。配套三层可审计性框架应用量化学习（quantification learning）刻画各类别的 per-category 可靠性画像、支持任务对齐的配置选择，并对流行度（prevalence）估计进行统计校正。
AI.result: 在 4 个视觉-语言检测器与 9 个社会学类别上评估，PRR 相比零样本基线取得显著精度提升，最强骨干网络提升达 43.3 个百分点。应用于 2024 年选举周期美国立法者发布的 103,920 张 Facebook 图像，并将检测结果与 DW-NOMINATE 意识形态评分关联，发现更保守的立法者将美国国旗作为更大的视觉元素展示，且较弱地倾向于边缘化放置——这一空间模式是二值检测无法揭示的。
AI.conclusion: PRR 为计算社会科学家提供了模型无关、可访问、空间落地且可校正的视觉测量工具，主要贡献在于将检测器升级为可审计的科学测量仪器，并带来自动化空间测量与统计校正的量化框架。局限方面，流水线依赖 SAM 与多模态 LLM 的组合，可能引入其固有偏差与计算开销；审计性框架的统计校正有效性依赖于可靠性画像的估计质量，论文摘要未给出跨域泛化与时效稳定性的验证。

title: MoARa: Module-Aware Rank Allocation and Structure-Preserving Decomposition for Low-Rank LLM Pre-training
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main Conference. 30 pages, 16 figures
summary: Low-rank gradient projection reduces the optimizer-state memory cost of large language model (LLM) pretraining, but the steps and wall-clock time needed to reach a target quality remain a meaningful axis for improvement. We attribute this to two design choices in existing methods: the projection-rank budget is allocated uniformly across Transformer modules with heterogeneous projection sensitivity, and projecting a raw gradient attenuates its magnitude and direction jointly. We propose MoARa, which combines a static profiling-based module-aware projection-rank allocation with a block-wise magnitude-direction decomposition; the default block size is set in the neighborhood of the attention head dimension. Across five Transformer architectures spanning Llama, Qwen, and DeepSeek at 300M to 7B scales, GaLore with MoARa reaches standard GaLore's final perplexity in 37% fewer steps and 34% less wall-clock time on Llama 2 7B, with only 0.2% peak reserved memory overhead under standard graph compilation. Across the six low-rank pretraining methods we evaluate, module-aware rank allocation alone delivers directionally consistent step reductions on all six. On compatible hosts, the two-component design reaches up to 41.7% step reduction and 37.1% wall-clock reduction.

AI.tldr: MoARa 是一种用于低秩梯度投影（GaLore）优化的改进方法，通过"模块感知投影秩分配 + 分块幅度-方向分解"两项设计，在保持内存开销几乎不变的前提下，显著减少 LLM 预训练收敛所需的步数与墙钟时间。
AI.motivation: 低秩梯度投影（如 GaLore）能有效降低 LLM 预训练的优化器状态内存开销，但"达到目标质量所需的步数和墙钟时间"仍是亟待改进的维度。作者将其归因于现有方法的两个设计缺陷：(1) 投影秩预算在 Transformer 各模块间均匀分配，而不同模块的投影敏感度实际上是异质的；(2) 直接投影原始梯度会同时衰减梯度的幅度与方向，造成信息损失。该问题的重要性在于：内存节省若以更多迭代/更长时间为代价，实际训练效率的提升会被削弱，尤其在 7B 级规模下墙钟时间成本极高。
AI.method: MoARa 提出两个关键组件：(1) 静态 profiling 驱动的模块感知投影秩分配（module-aware projection-rank allocation）——基于敏感性分析为异构的 Transformer 模块分配合适的秩预算，而非均匀分配；(2) 分块幅值-方向分解（block-wise magnitude-direction decomposition）——对梯度进行分块处理，将幅度与方向解耦后再投影，以缓解直接投影带来的联合衰减问题，默认分块大小设在注意力头维度附近。方法以即插即用方式集成到 GaLore 等低秩预训练框架中，并强调在标准图编译下的低内存开销。模块感知秩分配这一组件具有通用性，可单独应用于其他低秩方法。
AI.result: 在 Llama、Qwen、DeepSeek 三类 Transformer 共五种架构、300M 至 7B 参数规模的设置上进行评估。在 Llama 2 7B 上，GaLore+MoARa 以 37% 更少的步数和 34% 更少的墙钟时间达到标准 GaLore 的最终困惑度（perplexity），峰值预留内存开销仅增加 0.2%（标准图编译下）。在评估的六种低秩预训练方法中，仅模块感知秩分配一项即可在全部六种方法上带来方向一致的步数下降。在兼容主机上，双组件设计最高可达 41.7% 的步数缩减与 37.1% 的墙钟时间缩减。
AI.conclusion: MoARa 的主要贡献在于识别出低秩梯度投影中"秩预算分配异质性"与"幅度-方向联合衰减"两个效率瓶颈，并给出轻量、通用且与图编译兼容的解决方案，在不显著增加内存的情况下大幅缩短 LLM 预训练收敛时间，兼容多种低秩优化器。潜在局限包括：依赖静态 profiling 获取模块敏感度（可能需额外的离线分析成本，且对架构/任务迁移的泛化性未充分说明）；默认分块大小与注意力头维度相关的设定是否适配非标准 Transformer 结构尚不明确；评估主要集中在困惑度指标与语言建模预训练场景，对其他下游任务与更大规模（>7B）的适用性有待验证。

title: Patient-Level, Leakage-Aware Deep Learning for Cross-Center Periapical Radiograph Classification
comment: Submitted to the 9th International Conference on Signal Processing and Information Security (ICSPIS 2026)
summary: Dental caries and endodontic disease are among the most common health conditions worldwide, and intraoral periapical radiographs are central to their detection, treatment planning, and follow-up. Automated tooth-level classification of these images, however, lacks reproducible benchmarks, is often evaluated with image-level splits that leak patients between training and test, and is rarely validated across clinics. This paper presents the first patient-level, leakage-aware classification benchmark for single-tooth intraoral periapical radiographs on the DentIRO dataset, which comprises 5,300 images from 3,243 patients across two clinics and four classes: Healthy, Caries, Crowned, and Root Canal. Five transfer-learning models are compared with patient-grouped stratified cross-validation, so that every patient remains within a single fold. DenseNet121 gave the strongest and most stable result at a mean macro-F1 of 0.9787, while the four ImageNet-initialized backbones performed comparably. A controlled comparison on a fixed architecture showed that chest-radiograph pretraining transferred less effectively than ImageNet initialization. Bidirectional cross-center validation produced a small average generalization gap of 0.0077, and Grad-CAM confirmed that predictions rely on clinically meaningful tooth regions rather than acquisition artifacts. The benchmark offers a rigorous and reproducible baseline for intraoral radiograph classification.
